verses.sanskrit: revākhaṇḍa of the vāyupurāṇa rkv adhyāya 1 śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ

oṃ namaḥ śrīpuruṣottamāya / oṃ namaḥ śrīnarmadāyai / oṃ namo hariharahiraṇyagarbhebhyo namo vyāsavālmīkiśukaparāśarebhyo namo gurugobrāhmaṇebhyaḥ / oṃ majjanmātaṅgagaṇḍacyutamadamadirāmodamattālimālaṃ snānaiḥ siddhāṅganānāṃ kucayugavigalat kuṅkumāsaṅgapiṅgam / sāyaṃ prātarmunīnāṃ kusumacayasamācchannatīrasthavṛkṣaṃ pāyādvo narmadāmbhaḥ karimakarakarākrāntarahaṃstaraṃgam
ubhayataṭapuṇyatīrthā prakṣālitasakalalalokaduritaughā / devamunimanujavandyā haratu sadā narmadā duritam
nāśayatu duritamakhilaṃ bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavacca bhuvi bhavinām / sakalapavitri tava sudhā puṇyajalā narmadā bhavati
taṭapulinaṃ śivadevā yasyā yatayo 'pi kāmayante vā / muninivahavihitasevā śivāya mama jāyatāṃ revā
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtvā naraṃ caiva narottamam / devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet
naimiṣe puṇyanilaye nānāṛṣiniṣevite / śaunakaḥ satramāsīnaḥ sūta papraccha vistarāt
manye 'haṃ dharmanaipuṇyaṃ tvayi sūta sadārcitam / puṇyāmṛtakathāvaktā vyāsasaśiṣyastvameva hi
atastvāṃ paripṛcchāmi dharmatīrthāśrayaṃ kave / bahūni santi tīrthāni bahuśo me śrutāni ca
śrutā divyanadī brāhmī tathā viṣṇunadī mayā / tṛtīyā na mayā kvāpi śrutā raudrī saridvarā
tāṃ vedagarbhāṃ vikhyātāṃ vibudhaughābhivanditām / vada me tvaṃ mahāprājña tīrthapūgapariṣkṛtām
kaṃ deśam āśritā revā kathaṃ śrīrudrasaṃbhavā / tatsaṃśritāni tīrthāni yāni tāni vadasva me
sūta uvāca: sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ kulapate caritraṃ narmadāśritam / citraṃ pavitraṃ doṣaghnaṃ śrutamuktaṃ ca sattama
vedopavedavedāṅgādīnyabhivyasya pūritaḥ / aṣṭādaśapurāṇānāṃ vaktā satyavatīsutaḥ
taṃ namaskṛtya vakṣyāmi purāṇāni yathākramam / yeṣām abhivyāharaṇād abhivṛddhir vṛṣāyuṣoḥ
śrutiḥ smṛtiśca viprāṇāṃ cakṣuṣī parikīrtite / kāṇastatraikayā hīno dvābhyāmandhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
śrutismṛtipurāṇāni viduṣāṃ locanatrayam / yastribhirnayanaiḥ paśyet so 'ṃśo māheśvaro mataḥ
ātmano vedavidyā ca īśvareṇa vinirmitā / śaunakīyā ca paurāṇī dharmaśāstrātmikā ca yā
tisro vidyā imā mukhyāḥ sarvaśāstravinirṇaye / purāṇaṃ pañcamo veda iti brahmānuśāsanam
yo na veda purāṇaṃ hi na sa vedātra kiṃcana / katamaḥ sa hi dharmo 'sti kiṃ vā jñānaṃ tathāvidham
anyadvā tatkimatrāha purāṇe yanna dṛśyate / vedāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ pūrvaṃ purāṇe nātra saṃśayaḥ
bibhetyalpaśrutādvedo māmayaṃ pratariṣyati / itihāsapurāṇaiśca kṛto'yaṃ niścayaḥ purā
ātmā purāṇaṃ vedānāṃ pṛthagaṃgāni tāni ṣaṭ / yacca dṛṣṭaṃ hi vedeṣu taddṛṣṭaṃ smṛtibhiḥ kila
ubhābhyāṃ yattu dṛṣṭaṃ hi tatpurāṇeṣu gīyate / purāṇaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ prathamaṃ brahmaṇaḥ smṛtam
anantaraṃ ca vaktrebhyo vedāstasya vinirgatāḥ / purāṇamekamevāsīd asmin kalpāntare mune
trivargasādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ śatakoṭipravistaram / smṛtvā jagāda ca munīnprati devaścaturmukhaḥ
pravṛttiḥ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ purāṇasyābhavattataḥ / kālenāgrahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā purāṇasya tato muniḥ
vyāsarūpaṃ vibhuḥ kṛtvā saṃharetsa yuge yuge / aṣṭalakṣapramāṇe tu dvāpare dvāpare sadā
tadaṣṭādaśadhā kṛtvā bhūloke 'smin prabhāṣyate / adyāpi devaloke tacchatakoṭipravistaram
tathātra caturlakṣaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa niveśitam / purāṇāni daśāṣṭau ca sāmprataṃ tadihocyate / nāmatastāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇu tvamṛṣisattama
sargaśca pratisargaśca vaṃśo manvantarāṇi ca / vaṃśānucaritaṃ caiva purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam
brāhmaṃ purāṇaṃ tatrādyaṃ saṃhitāyāṃ vibhūṣitam / ślokānāṃ daśasāhasraṃ nānāpuṇyakathāyutam
pādmaṃ ca pañcapañcāśatsahasrāṇi nigadyate / tṛtīyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃnāma trayoviṃśatisaṃkhyayā
caturthaṃ vāyunā proktaṃ vāyavīyamiti smṛtam / śivabhaktisamāyogācchaivaṃ taccāparākhyayā
caturviṃśatisaṃkhyātaṃ sahasrāṇi tu śaunaka / caturbhiḥ parvabhiḥ proktaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ pañcamaṃ tathā
caturdaśasahasrāṇi tathā pañca śatāni tat / mārkaṇḍaṃ navasāhasraṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ tatparikīrtitam
āgneyaṃ saptamaṃ proktaṃ sahasrāṇi tu ṣoḍaśa / aṣṭamaṃ nāradīyaṃ tu proktaṃ vai pañcaviṃśatiḥ
navamaṃ bhagavannāma bhāgadvayavibhūṣitam / tadaṣṭādaśasāhasraṃ procyate granthasaṃkhyayā
daśamaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ tāvatsaṃkhyam ihocyate / laiṅgamekādaśaṃ jñeyaṃ tathaikādaśasaṃkhyayā
bhāgadvayaṃ viracitaṃ talliṅgamṛṣipuṃgava / caturviṃśatisāhasraṃ vārāhaṃ dvādaśaṃ viduḥ
vibhaktaṃ saptabhiḥ khaṇḍaiḥ skāndaṃ bhāgyavatāṃ vara / tadekāśītisāhasraṃ saṃkhyayā vai nirūpitam
tatastu vāmanaṃ nāma caturdaśatamaṃ smṛtam / saṃkhyayā daśasāhasraṃ proktaṃ kulapate purā
kaurmaṃ pañcadaśaṃ prāhur bhāgadvayavibhūṣitam / daśasaptasahasrāṇi purā sāṃkhyapate kalau
mātsyaṃ matsyena yatproktaṃ manave ṣoḍaśaṃ kramāt / taccaturdaśasāhasraṃ saṃkhyayā vadatāṃ vara
gāruḍaṃ saptadaśamaṃ smṛtaṃ caikonaviṃśatiḥ / aṣṭādaśaṃ tu brahmāṇḍaṃ bhāgadvayavibhūṣitam
tacca dvādaśasāhasraṃ śatamaṣṭasamanvitam / tathaivopapurāṇāni yāni coktāni vedhasā
idaṃ brahmapurāṇasya sulabhaṃ sauramuttamam / saṃhitādvayasaṃyuktaṃ puṇyaṃ śivakathāśrayam
ādyā sanatkumāroktā dvitīyā sūryabhāṣitā / sanatkumāranāmnā hi tadvikhyātaṃ mahāmune
dvitīyaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ ca purāṇe pādmasaṃjñite / śaukeyaṃ hi tṛtīyaṃ tu purāṇe vaiṣṇave matam
bārhaspatyaṃ caturthaṃ ca vāyavyaṃ saṃmataṃ sadā / daurvāsasaṃ pañcamaṃ ca smṛtaṃ bhāgavate sadā
bhaviṣye nāradoktaṃ ca sūribhiḥ kathitaṃ purā / kāpilaṃ mānavaṃ caiva tathaivośanaseritam
brahmāṇḍaṃ vāruṇaṃ cātha kālikādvayameva ca / māheśvaraṃ tathā sāmbaṃ sauraṃ sarvārthasaṃcayam
pārāśaraṃ bhāgavataṃ kaurmaṃ cāṣṭādaśaṃ kramāt / etānyupapurāṇāni mayoktāni yathākramam
purāṇasaṃhitāmetāṃ yaḥ paṭhedvā śṛṇoti ca / so 'nantapuṇyabhāgī syānmṛto brahmapuraṃ vrajet
|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe purāṇasaṃhitāvarṇanām prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 2 sūta uvāca
narmadāyāstu māhātmyaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano 'bravīt / tatte 'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi yattvayā paripṛcchitam
vistaraṃ narmadāyāstu tīrthānāṃ munisattama / ko 'nyaḥ śakto 'sti vai vaktumṛte brahmāṇamīśvaram
etameva purā praśnaṃ pṛṣṭavāñjanamejayaḥ / vaiśaṃpāyanasaṃjñaṃ tu śiṣyaṃ dvaipāyanasya ha
revātīrthāśritaṃ puṇyaṃ tatte vakṣyāmi śaunaka / purā pārīkṣito rājā yajñādīkṣāsu dīkṣitaḥ
saṃbhṛte tu havirdravye vartamāneṣu karmasu / āsīneṣu dvijāgryeṣu hūyamāne hutāśane
vartamānāsu sarvatra tathā dharmakathāsu ca / śrūyamāṇe tathā śabde janairukte tvaharniśam
yajñabhūmau kulapate dīyatāṃ bhujyatām iti / vividhāṃśca vinodānvai kurvāṇeṣu vinodiṣu
evaṃvidhe vartamāne yajñe svargasadaḥsame / vaiśaṃpāyanam āsīnaṃ papraccha janamejayaḥ
janamejaya uvāca: dvaipāyanaprasādena jñānavānasi me mataḥ / vaiśaṃpāyana tasmāt tvāṃ pṛcchāmi ṛṣisannidhau
brūhi me tvaṃ purāvṛttaṃ pitḥṇāṃ tīrthasevanam / ciraṃ nānāvidhānkleśān prāptāsta iti me śrutam
kathaṃ dyūtajitāḥ pārthā mama pūrvapitāmahāḥ / āsamudrāṃ mahīṃ vipra bhramantastīrthalobhataḥ
kena te sahitāstāta bhūmibhāgān anekaśaḥ / ceruḥ kathaya tatsarvaṃ sarvajño 'si mato mama
vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
kathayiṣyāmi bhūnātha yatpṛṣṭaṃ tu tvayā 'nagha / namaskṛtya virūpākṣaṃ vedavyāsaṃ mahākavim
pitāmahāstu te pañca pāṇḍavāḥ saha kṛṣṇayā / uṣitvā brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ kāmyake vana uttame
pradhānoddālake tatra kaśyapo 'tha mahāmatiḥ / vibhāṇḍakaśca rājendra muruścaiva mahāmuniḥ
pulastyo lomaśaścaiva tathānye putrapautriṇaḥ / snātvā niḥśeṣatīrtheṣu gatāste vindhyaparvatam
te ca tatrāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvairvṛkṣaiḥ samākulam / campakaiḥ karṇakāraiśca punnāgairnāgakesaraiḥ
bakulaiḥ kovidāraiśca dāḍimairupaśobhitam / puṣpitairarjunaiścaiva bilvapāṭalaketakaiḥ
kadambāmramadhūkaiśca nimbajambīratindukaiḥ / nālikeraiḥ kapitthaiśca kharjūrapanasaistathā
nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ nānāvallībhirāvṛtam / sapuṣpaṃ phalitaṃ kāntaṃ vanaṃ caitrarathaṃ yathā
jalāśrayaistu vipulaiḥ padminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam / sitotpalaiśca saṃchannaṃ nīlapītaiḥ sitāruṇaiḥ
haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ cakravākopaśobhitam / āḍīkākabalākābhiḥ sevitaṃ kokilādibhiḥ
siṃhairvyāghrairvarāhaiśca gajaiścaiva mahotkaṭaiḥ / mahiṣaiśca mahākāyaiḥ kuraṅgaiś citrakaiḥ śaśaiḥ
gaṇḍakaiścaiva khaḍgaiśca gomāyusurabhī yutam / sāraṅgair mallakaiścaiva dvipadaiśca catuṣpadaiḥ
tathāca kokilākīrṇaṃ manaḥkāntaṃ suśobhitam / jīvaṃjīvakasaṃghaiśca nānāpakṣisamāyutam
duḥkhaśokavinirmuktaṃ sattvotkaṭamanoramam / kṣuttṛṣārahitaṃ kāntaṃ sarvavyādhivivarjitam
siṃhīstanaṃ pibantyatra kuraṃgāḥ snehasaṃyutam / mārjāramūṣakau cobhāvavalehata unmukhau
pañcāsyāḥ potakebhāśca bhoginastu kalāpinaḥ / dṛṣṭvā tadvipinaṃ ramyaṃ praviṣṭāḥ pāṇḍunandanāḥ
mārkaṇḍaṃ dṛṣṭavāṃstatra taruṇādityasannibham / ṛṣibhiḥ sevyamānaṃ tu nānāśāstraviśāradaiḥ
kulīnaiḥ sattvasampannaiḥ śaucācārasamanvitaiḥ / dhīsaṃgataiḥ kṣamāyuktaistrisaṃdhyaṃ japatatparaiḥ
ṛgyajuḥsāmavihitair mantrair homaparāyaṇaiḥ / kecitpañcāgnimadhyasthāḥ kecidekāntasaṃsthitāḥ
ūrdhvabāhunirālambā ādityabhramaṇāḥ pare / sāyaṃprātarbhujaścānye ekāhārāstathā pare
dvādaśāhāttathā cānye anye māsārdhabhojanāḥ / darśe darśe tathā cānye anye śaivālabhojanāḥ
piṇyākamapare 'bhujan kecit pālāśabhojanāḥ / apare niyatāhārā vāyubhakṣyāmbubhojanāḥ
evaṃbhūtais tathā vṛddhaiḥ sevyate munipuṃgavaiḥ / tato dharmasutaḥ śrīmān āśramaṃ taṃ praviśya saḥ
dṛṣṭvā munivaraṃ śāntaṃ dhyāyamānaṃ paraṃ padam / prādakṣiṇyena sahasā daṇḍavatpatito 'grataḥ
bhaktyānupatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā cirādādāya locanam / ko bhavānityuvācedaṃ dharmaṃ dhīmānapṛcchata
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dārakastatsamīpagaḥ / āhāyaṃ dharmarājaste darśanārthaṃ samāgataḥ
tacchrutvādārakeṇoktaṃ vacanaṃ prāha sādaraḥ / ehyehi vatsavatseti kiṃcit sthānāccalanmuniḥ / taṃ tu snehādupāghrāya āsane upaveśayat
upaviṣṭe sabhāyāṃ tu pūjāṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi / vanyairdhānyaiḥ phalair mūlai rasaiścaiva pṛthagvidhaiḥ
pāṇḍavā brāhmaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ yathāyogyaṃ prapūjitāḥ / muhūrtādatha viśramya dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
pṛcchati sma muniśreṣṭhaṃ kautūhalasamanvitaḥ / bhagavansarvalokānāṃ dīrghāyustvaṃ mato mama
saptakalpānaśeṣeṇa kathayasva mamānagha / kalpakṣaye 'pi lokasya sthāvarasyetarasya ca
na vinaṣṭo 'si viprendra kathaṃ vā kena hetunā / gaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ samudrāntāśca yā mune
tāsāṃ madhye sthitāḥ kāḥ svitkāścaiva pralayaṃ gatāḥ / kā nu puṇyajalā nityaṃ kānu na kṣayamāgatā
etat kathaya me tāta prasannenāntarātmanā / śrotumicchāmyaśeṣeṇa ṛṣibhiḥ saha bāndhavaiḥ
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sādhusādhu mahāprājña dharmaputra yudhiṣṭhira / kathayāmi yathā nyāyaṃ yatpṛcchasi mamānagha
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ purāṇaṃ rudrabhāṣitam / yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
aśvamedha sahasreṇa vājapeyaśatena ca / tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti rājannāstyatra saṃśayaḥ
brahmaghnaśca surāpī ca steyī goghnaśca yo naraḥ / mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudrasya vacanaṃ yathā
gaṅgā tu saritāṃ śreṣṭhā tathā caiva sarasvatī / kāverī devikā caiva sindhuḥ sālakuṭī tathā
sarayūḥ śatarudrā ca mahī carmilayā saha / godāvarī tathā puṇyā tathaiva yamunā nadī
payoṣṇī ca śatadruśca tathā dharmanadī śubhā / etāścānyāśca saritaḥ sarvapāpaharāḥ smṛtāḥ
kiṃ tu te kāraṇaṃ tāta vakṣyāmi nṛpasattama / samudrāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ kalpe kalpe kṣayaṃ gatāḥ
saptakalpakṣaye kṣīṇe na mṛtā tena narmadā / narmadaikaiva rājendra paraṃ tiṣṭhet saridvarā
toyapūrṇā mahābhāga munisaṃghairabhiṣṭutā / gaṃgādyāḥ saritaścānyāḥ kalpe kalpe kṣayaṃ gatāḥ
eṣā devī purā dṛṣṭā tena vakṣyāmi te 'nagha

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe revāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 3 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: saptakalpakṣayā ghorāstvayā dṛṣṭā mahāmune / na cāpīhāsti bhagavandīrghāyuriha kaścana
tvayā hyekārṇave suptaḥ padmanābhaḥ surārihā / dṛṣṭaḥ sahasracaraṇaḥ sahasranayanodaraḥ
tvaṃ kilānugrahāt tasya dahyamāne carācare / na kṣayaṃ samanuprāpto varadānānmahātmanaḥ
kiṃ tvayāścaryabhūtaṃ hi dṛṣṭaṃ ca bhramatānagha / etadācakṣva bhagavanparaṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
samprāpte ca mahāghore yugasyānte mahākṣaye / anāvṛṣṭihate loke purā varṣaśatādhike
auṣadhīnāṃ kṣaye ghore devadānavavarjite / nirvīrye nirvaṣaṭkāre kalinā dūṣite bhṛśam
saritsarastaḍāgeṣu palvalopavaneṣu ca / saṃśuṣkeṣu tadā brahmannirākāre yugakṣaye
janaṃ prāpte maharloke brahmakṣatraviśādayaḥ / ṛṣayaśca mahātmāno divyatejaḥsamanvitāḥ
sthitāni kāni bhūtāni gatānyeva mahāmune / etatsarvaṃ mahābhāga kathayasva pṛthakpṛthak
bhūtāni kāni viprendra kathaṃ siddhim avāpnuyāt / brahmaviṣṇvindrarudrāṇāṃ kāle prāpte sudāruṇe
evamuktas tataḥ so 'tha dharmarājena dhīmatā / mārkaṇḍaḥ pratyuvācedamṛṣisaṃghaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇvantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve tvayā saha nareśvara / mahatpurāṇaṃ pūrvoktaṃ śaṃbhunā vāyudaivate
vāyoḥ sakāśātskandena śrutametatpurātanam / vasiṣṭhaḥ śrutavāṃstasmāt parāśarastataḥ param
tasmācca jātūkarṇyena tasmāccaiva maharṣibhiḥ / evaṃ paramparāproktaṃ śatasaṃkhyair dvijottamaiḥ
saṃhitā śatasāhasrī puroktā śaṃbhunā kila / āloḍya sarvaśāstrāṇi vadārthaṃ tattvataḥ purā
yugarūpeṇa sā paścāc caturdhā viniyojitā / madaprajñānusāreṇa narāṇāṃ tu maharṣibhiḥ
ārādhya paśubhartāraṃ mayā pūrvaṃ maheśvaram / purāṇaṃ śrutametaddhi tatte vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ
yacchrutvā mucyate jantuḥ sarvapāpairnareśvara / mānasaiḥ karmajaiścaiva saptajanmasu saṃcitaiḥ
saptakalpakṣayā ghorā mayā dṛṣṭāḥ punaḥpunaḥ / prasādāddevadevasya viṣṇośca parameṣṭhinaḥ
dvādaśādityanirdagdhe jagatyekārṇavīkṛte / śrānto 'haṃ vibhramaṃs tatra taranbāhubhir arṇavam
athāhaṃ salile rājannādityasamarūpiṇam / purā puruṣamadrākṣamanādinidhanaṃ prabhum
śṛṅgaṃ caivādrirājasya bhāsayantaṃ diśo daśa / dvitīyo 'nyo manurdṛṣṭaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ
agādhe bhramate so 'pi tamobhūte mahārṇave / aviśramanmuhūrtaṃ tu cakrārūḍha iva bhraman
athāhaṃ bhayādudvignastaranbāhubhir arṇavam / tatrastho'haṃ mahāmatsyam apaśyaṃ madasaṃyutam
tato 'bravītsa māṃ dṛṣṭvā ehyehīti ca bhārata / paraṃ pradhānaḥ sarveṣāṃ matsyarūpo maheśvaraḥ
tato 'haṃ tvarayā gatvā tanmukhe manujeśvara / suśrānto vigatajñānaḥ paraṃ nirvedamāgataḥ
tato 'drākṣaṃ samudrānte mahadāvartasaṃkulām / udyattaraṃgasalilāṃ phenapuñjāṭṭahāsinīm
nadīṃ kāmagamāṃ puṇyāṃ jhaṣamīnasamākulām / nadyāstasyāstu madhyasthā pramadā kāmarūpiṇī
nīlotpaladalaśyāmā mahatprakṣobhavāhinī / divyahāṭakacitrāṅgī kanakojjvalaśobhitā
dvābhyāṃ saṃgṛhya jānubhyāṃ mahatpotaṃ vyavasthitā / tāṃ manuḥ pratyuvācedaṃ kā tvaṃ divyavarāṅgane
tiṣṭhase kena kāryeṇa tvamatra surasundari / surāsuragaṇe naṣṭe bhramase līlayārṇave
saritaḥ sāgarāḥ śailāḥ kṣayaṃ prāptā hyanekaśaḥ / tvamekā tu kathaṃ sādhvi tiṣṭhase kāraṇaṃ mahat / śrotumicchāmyahaṃ devi kathayasva hyaśeṣataḥ
abalovāca: īśvarāṅgasamudbhūtā hyamṛtānāma viśrutā / saritpāpaharā puṇyā māmāśritya bhayaṃ kutaḥ
sāhaṃ potamimaṃ tubhyaṃ gṛhītvā hyāgatā dvija / na hyasya potasya kṣayo yatra tiṣṭhati śaṃkaraḥ
tasyās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā vismayotphullalocanaḥ / manunā saha rājendra potārūḍho hyahaṃ tadā
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā praṇamya śirasā vibhum / vyāpinaṃ parameśānamastauṣamabhayapradam
sadyojātāya devāya vāmadevāya vai namaḥ / bhave bhave namastubhyaṃ bhaktigamyāya te namaḥ
bhūrbhuvāya namastubhyaṃ rāmajyeṣṭhāya vai namaḥ / namaste bhadrakālāya kalirūpāya vai namaḥ
acintyāvyaktarūpāya mahādevāya dhāmane / vidmahe devadevāya tanno rudra namonamaḥ
jagatsṛṣṭivināśānāṃ kāraṇāya namonamaḥ / evaṃ stuto mahādevaḥ pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭayā mayānagha
prasanno māvadat paścādvaraṃ varaya suvrata

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye mārkaṇḍeyadharmarājasaṃvāde kalpakṣaye mārkaṇḍeyakṛtapotārdhārohaṇavṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 4 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato 'rṇavātsamuttīrya trikūṭaśikhare sthitam / mahākanakavarṇābhe nānāvarṇaśilācite
mahāśṛṅge samāsīnaṃ rudrakoṭisamanvitam / mahādevaṃ mahātmānamīśānamajam avyayam
sarvabhūtamayaṃ tāta manunā saha suvrata / bhūyo vavande caraṇau sarvadevanamaskṛtau
tatkāle yugasāhasraṃ saha rudreṇa mānada / tasminnekārṇave ghore sthito 'haṃ kurunaṃdana
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: etacchrutvā tu me tāta paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hṛdi / jātaṃ tatkathayasveti śṛṇvataḥ saha bāndhavaiḥ
kā sā padmapalāśākṣī tamobhūte mahārṇave / yogivadbhramate nityaṃ rudrajāṃ svāṃ ca yābravīt
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: etameva mayā praśnaṃ purā pṛṣṭo manuḥ svayam / tadeva te 'dya vakṣyāmi abalāyāḥ samudbhavam
vyatītāyāṃ niśāyāṃ tu brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ / tataḥ prabhāte vimale sṛjyamāneṣu jantuṣu
manuṃ praṇamya śirasā pṛcchāmyetad yudhiṣṭhira / keyaṃ padmapalāśākṣī śyāmā caṃdranibhānanā
ekārṇave bhramatyekā rudrajāsmīti vādinī / sāvitrī vedamātā ca hyathavā sā sarasvatī
mandākinī saricchreṣṭhā lakṣmīrvā kimatho umā / kālarātrirbhavetsākṣāt prakṛtirvā sukhocitā
etadācakṣva bhagavankā sā hyamṛtasaṃbhavā / caratyekārṇave ghore pranaṣṭoragarākṣase
manuruvāca: śṛṇu vatsa yathānyāyamasyā vakṣyāmi saṃbhavam / yayā rudrasamudbhūtā yā ceyaṃ varavarṇinī
purā śivaḥ śāntatanuścacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ / hitārthaṃ sarvalokānāmumayā saha śaṃkaraḥ
ṛkṣaśailaṃ samāruhya tapastepe sudāruṇam / adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvabhūtātmako vaśī
tapatastasya devasya svedaḥ samabhavatkila / taṃ giriṃ plāvayāmāsa sa svedo rudrasaṃbhavaḥ
tasmād āsīt samudbhūtā mahāpuṇyā saridvarā / yā sā tvayārṇave dṛṣṭā padmapatrāyatekṣaṇā
strīrūpaṃ samavasthāya rudramārādhayatpurā / ādye kṛtayuge tasminsamānāmayutaṃ nṛpa
tatastuṣṭo mahādeva umayā saha śaṃkaraḥ / brūhi tvaṃ tu mahābhāge yatte manasi vartate
sariduvāca: pralaye samanuprāpte naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame / prasādāttava deveśa akṣayāhaṃ bhave prabho
saritsu sāgareṣveva parvateṣu kṣayiṣvapi / tava prasādāddeveśa puṇyā kṣayyā bhave prabho
pāpopapātakairyuktā mahāpātakino 'pi ye / mucyante sarvapāpebhyo bhaktyā snātvā tu śaṃkara
uttare jāhnavīdeśe mahāpātakanāśinī / bhavāmi dakṣiṇe mārge yadyevaṃ surapūjitā
svargādāgamya gaṃgeti yathā khyātā kṣitau vibho / tathā dakṣiṇagaṅgeti bhaveyaṃ tridaśeśvara
pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu snātvā yallabhate phalam / tatphalaṃ labhate martyo bhaktyā snātvā maheśvara
brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpam yadāste saṃcitaṃ kvacit / māsamātreṇa taddeva kṣayaṃ yātvavagāhanāt
yatphalaṃ sarvavedeṣu sarvayajñeṣu śaṃkara / avagāhena tatsarvaṃ bhavatviti matirmama
sarvadānopavāseṣu sarvatīrthāvagāhane / tatphalaṃ mama toyena jāyatāmiti śaṃkara
mama tīre narā ye tu arcayanti maheśvaram / te gatāstava lokaṃ syur etad eva bhavecchiva
mama kūle maheśāna umayā saha daivataiḥ / vasa nityaṃ jagannātha eṣa eva varo mama
sukarmā vā vikarmā vā śānto dānto jitendriyaḥ / mṛto janturmama jale gacchatād amarāvatīm
triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātā mahāpātakanāśinī / bhavāmi devadeveśa prasanno yadi manyase
etāṃścānyānvarāndivyānprārthito nṛpasattama / narmadayā tataḥ prāha prasanno vṛṣavāhanaḥ
śrīmaheśa uvāca: evaṃ bhavatu kalyāṇi yattvayoktamanindite / nānyā varārhā lokeṣu muktvā tvāṃ kamalekṣaṇe
yadaiva mama dehāt tvaṃ samudbhūtā varānane / tadaiva sarvapāpānāṃ mocinī tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
kalpakṣayakare kāle kāle ghore viśeṣataḥ / uttaraṃ kūlamāśritya nivasanti ca ye narāḥ
api kīṭapataṅgāśca vṛkṣagulmalatādayaḥ / ā dehapatanāddevi te 'pi yāsyanti sadgatim
dakṣiṇaṃ kūlamāśritya ye dvijā dharmavatsalāḥ / ā mṛtyor nivasiṣyanti te gatāḥ pitṛmandire
ahaṃ hi tava vākyena kasmiṃścit kāraṇāntare / tvattīre nivasiṣyāmi sadaiva hyumayā samam
evaṃ devi mahādevi evameva na saṃśayaḥ / brahmendracandravaruṇaiḥ sādhyaiśca saha viṣṇunā
uttare devi te kūle vasiṣyanti mamājñayā / dakṣiṇe pitṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ tathānye surasundari
vasiṣyanti mayā sārddhameṣa te vara uttamaḥ / gaccha gaccha mahābhāge martyānpāpādvimocaya
sahitā ṛṣisaṃghaiśca tathā siddhasurāsuraiḥ / evamuktā mahādeva umayā sahito vibhuḥ
vandyamāno 'tha manunā mayā cādarśanaṃ gataḥ / tena caiṣā mahāpuṇyā mahāpātakanāśinī
kathitā pṛcchyate yā te mā te bhavatu vismayaḥ / eṣā gaṃgā mahāpuṇyā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā
daśābhiḥ pañcabhiḥ srotaiḥ plāvayantī diśo daśa / śoṇo mahānadaścaiva narmadā surasā kṛtā
mandākinī daśārṇā ca citrakūṭā tathaiva ca / tamasā vidiśā caiva karabhā yamunā tathā
citrotpalā vipāśā ca rañjanā vāluvāhinī / ṛkṣapādaprasūtāstāḥ sarvā vai rudrasaṃbhavāḥ
sarvapāpaharāḥ puṇyāḥ sarvamaṃgaladāḥ śivāḥ / ityetairnāmabhirdivyaiḥ stūyate vedapāragaiḥ
purāṇajñair mahābhāgairājyapaiḥ somapaistathā / ityetatsarvamākhyātaṃ mahābhāgyaṃ narottama
manunoktaṃ purā mahyam amṛtāyāḥ samudbhavam / puṇyaṃ pavitramatulaṃ rudrodgītamidaṃ śubham
ye narāḥ kīrtayiṣyanti bhaktyā śṛṇvanti ye 'pi ca / prātarutthāya nāmāni daśa pañca ca bhārata
te narāḥ sakalaṃ puṇyaṃ labhiṣyantyavagāhajam / vimānenārkavarṇena ghaṇṭāśataninādinā
tyaktvā mānuṣyakaṃ bhāvaṃ yāsyanti paramāṃ gatim

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāpañcadaśanāmavarṇanaṃ nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 5 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: āścaryametadakhilaṃ kathitaṃ bho dvijottama / vismayaṃ paramāpannā ṛṣisaṃghā mayā saha
aho bhagavatī puṇyā narmadeyamayonijā / rudradehādviniṣkrāntā mahāpāpakṣayaṃkarī
saptakalpakṣaye prāpte tvayeyaṃ saha suvrata / na mṛtā ca mahābhāgā kimataḥ puṇyamuttamam
ke te kalpāḥ samuddiṣṭāḥ sapta kalpakṣayaṃkarāḥ / na mṛtā cediyaṃ devī tvaṃ caiva ṛṣipuṃgava
apakṣigaṇasaṃghāte jagatyekārṇavīkṛte / kīdṛgrūpaḥ samabhavanmahādevo yugakṣaye
kathaṃ saṃharate viśvaṃ kathaṃ cāste mahārṇave / kathaṃ ca sṛjate viśvaṃ kathaṃ dhārayate prajāḥ
kīdṛgrūpā bhaveddevī sarid ekārṇavīkṛte / kimarthaṃ narmadā proktā revatī ca kathaṃ smṛtā
añjaneti kimarthaṃ vā kimarthaṃ suraseti ca / mandākinī kimarthaṃ ca śoṇaśceti kathaṃ bhavet
trikūṭeti kimarthaṃ vā kimarthaṃ vāluvāhinī / koṭikoṭyo hi tīrthānāṃ praviṣṭā yā mahārṇavam
kiyatyaḥ saritāṃ koṭyo narmadāṃ samupāsate / yajñopavītairṛṣibhir devatābhis tathaiva ca
vibhakteyaṃ kimarthaṃ ca śrūyate munisattama / vaiṣṇavīti purāṇajñaiḥ kimarthamiha cocyate
keṣu sthāneṣu tīrtheṣu pūjanīyā saridvarā / tīrthāni ca pṛthagbrūhi yatra saṃnihito haraḥ
yatpramāṇā ca sā devī yā rudreṇa vinirmitā / kīdṛśāni ca karmāṇi rudreṇa kathitāni te
kathaṃ mlecchasamākīrṇo deśo 'yaṃ dvijasattama / etadācakṣva māṃ brahmanmārkaṇḍeya mahāmate
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇvantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve tvaṃ ca tāta yudhiṣṭhira / purāṇaṃ narmadāyāṃ tu kathitaṃ ca triśūlinā
vāyoḥ sakāśācca mayā tenāpi ca maheśvarāt / aśakyatvānmanuṣyāṇāṃ saṃkṣiptam ṛṣibhiḥ purā
māyūraṃ prathamaṃ tāta kaurmyam ca tadanantaram / puram tathā kauśikaṃ ca mātsyaṃ dviradam eva ca
vārāhaṃ yanmayā dṛṣṭaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ param / nyagrodhākhyam ataḥ cāsīd ākāṅkṣaṃ punaruttamam
padmaṃ ca tāmasaṃ caiva saṃvartodvartameva ca / mahāpralayamityāhuḥ purāṇe vedacintakāḥ
etatsaṃkṣepataḥ sarvaṃ saṃkṣiptaṃ tairmahātmabhiḥ / vibhaktaṃ ca caturbhāgair brahmādyaiśca maharṣibhiḥ
tadahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi purāṇārthaviśārada / sapta kalpā mahāghorā yair iyaṃ na mṛtā sarit
ā jaṅgamaṃ tamobhūtam aprajñātamalakṣaṇam / naṣṭacandrārkakiraṇam āsīd bhūtavivarjitam
tamaso 'to mahānāmnā puruṣaḥ sa jagadguruḥ / cacāra tasminnekākī vyaktāvyaktaḥ sanātanaḥ
sa cauṃkāramayo 'tīto gāyatrīmasṛjaddvijaḥ / sa tayā sārddham īśānaścikrīḍa puruṣo virāṭ
svadehādasṛjad viśvaṃ pañcabhūtātmasaṃjñitam / krīḍansamasṛjadviśvaṃ pañcabhūtātmasaṃjñitam
krīḍan sṛjad virāṭsaṃjñaḥ sabījaṃ ca hiraṇmayam / taccāṇḍam abhavad divyaṃ dvādaśādityasannibham
tadbhittvā puruṣo jajñe caturvaktraḥ pitāmahaḥ / so 'sṛjadviśvam evaṃ tu sadevāsuramānuṣam
satiryakpaśupakṣīkaṃ svedāṇḍajajarāyujam / etadaṇḍaṃ purāṇeṣu prathamaṃ parikīrtitam
pūrvakalpe nṛpaśreṣṭha krīḍantyā parameṣṭhinā / umayā saha rudrasya krīḍataścārṇavīkṛtaḥ
harṣājjajñe śubhā kanyā umāyāḥ svedasaṃbhavā / śarvasyoraḥsthalājjajñe umā kucavimardanāt
svedādvijajñe mahatī kanyā rājīvalocanā / dvitīyaḥ saṃbhavo yasyā rudradehād yudhiṣṭhira
sā paribhramate lokān sadevāsuramānavān / trailokyonmādajananī rūpeṇa 'pratimā tadā
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devadaityendrā mohitā labhate katham / mṛgayanti sma tāṃ kanyām itaścetaśca bhārata
hāvabhāvavilāsaiśca mohayatyakhilaṃ jagat / bhramate divyarūpā sā vidyutsaudāminī yathā
meghamadhye sthitā bhābhiḥ sarvayoṣidanuttamā / tato rudraṃ surāḥ sarve daityāśca saha dānavaiḥ
varayanti sma tāṃ kanyāṃ kāmenākulitā bhṛśam / tato 'bravīnmahādevo devadānavayordvayoḥ
balena tejasā caiva hyadhiko yo bhaviṣyati / sa imāṃ prāpsyate kanyāṃ nānyathā vai surottamāḥ
tato devāsurāḥ sarve kanyāṃ vai samupāgaman / ahamenāṃ grahīṣyāmi ahamenāmiti bruvan
paśyatāmeva sarveṣāṃ sā kanyāntaradhīyata / punastāṃ dadṛśuḥ sarve yojanāntaradhiṣṭhitām
jagmuste tvaritāḥ sarve yatra sā samadṛśyata / tribhiścaturbhiśca tathā yojanairdaśabhiḥ punaḥ
dhiṣṭhitāṃ samapaśyaṃste sarve mātaṃgagāminīm / yojanānāṃ śatairbhūyaḥ sahasraiścāpyadhiṣṭhitām
tathā śatasahasreṇa laghutvāt samadṛśyata / agrataḥ pṛṣṭhataścaiva diśāsu vidiśāsu ca
tāṃ paśyanti varārohām ekadhā bahudhā punaḥ / divyavarṣasahasraṃ tu bhrāmitāste tayā purā
na cāvāptā tu sā kanyā mahādevāṅgasaṃbhavā / sahomayā tato devo jahāsoccaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ
gaṇāstālakasaṃpātair nṛtyanti ca mudānvitāḥ / akasmāddṛśyate kanyā śaṃkarasya samīpagā
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayāpannā devā yānti parāṅmukhāḥ / tasyāś cakre tato nāma svayameva pinākadhṛk
narma caibhyo dade yasmāt tatkṛtaiś ceṣṭitaiḥ pṛthak / bhaviṣyasi varārohe saricchreṣṭhā tu narmadā
svarūpamāsthito devaḥ prāpa hāsyaṃ yato bhuvi / narmadā tena cokteyaṃ suśītalajalā śivā
saptakalpakṣaye jāte yaduktaṃ śaṃbhunā purā / na mṛtā tena rājendra narmadā khyātimāgatā
tatastāmadadātkanyāṃ śīlavatīṃ suśobhanām / mahārṇavāya deveśaḥ sarvabhūtapatiḥ prabhuḥ
tataḥ sā ṛkṣaśailendrāt phenapuñjāṭṭahāsinī / viveśa narmadā devī samudraṃ saritāṃ patim
evaṃ brāhme purā kalpe samudbhūteyamīśvarāt / mātsye kalpe mayā dṛṣṭā samākhyātā mayā śṛṇu

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 6 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: punaryugānte samprāpte tṛtīye nṛpasattama / dādaśārkavapurbhūtvā bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ
saptadvīpasamudrāntāṃ saśailavanakānanām / nirdagdhāṃ tu mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ kālo bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ
tato mahāghano bhūtvā plāvayāmāsa vāriṇā / kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇavapus tvenāṃ vidyuccandrāyudhāṅkitām
plāvayitvā jagatsarvaṃ tasminnekārṇavīkṛte / suṣvāpa vimale toye jagatsaṃkṣipya māyayā
tato 'haṃ bhramamāstu tamobhūte mahārṇave / divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu vāyubhūte maheśvare
oṃkṛtvā devadeveśaṃ yenedaṃ gahanīkṛtam / dhyāyamānastato devaṃ rājendra vimale jale
tasminmahārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame / mayūraṃ svarṇapatrāḍhyam apaśyaṃsahasā jale / vicitracandrakopetaṃ nīlakaṃṭhaṃ sulocanam
tato mayūraḥ sa mahārṇavānte vikṣobhayitvā hi mahāsveṇa / cacāra devastriśikhī śikhaṇḍī trailokyagoptā sa mahānubhāvaḥ
śivaśca raudreṇa mayūrarūpiṇā vikṣobhyamāṇe salile 'pi tasmin / saha bhramantīṃ ca mahārṇavānte sarinmahaughāṃ sumahāndadarśa
sa tāṃ mahādevamayūrarūpo dṛṣṭvā bhramantīṃ sahasormijālaiḥ / kā tvaṃ śubhe śāśvatadehabhūtā kṣayaṃ na yātāsi mahākṣayānte
devāsuragaṇe naṣṭe saritsaramahārṇave / kā tvaṃ bhramasi padmākṣi kva gatāsi ca na kṣayam
narmadovāca: tava prasādāddeveśa mṛtyurmama na vidyate / sṛja deva punarviśvaṃ śarvarī kṣayamāgatā
evamukto mahādevo vyadhunotpakṣapañjaram / tāvatpañjaramadhyānte tasya pakṣādviniḥsṛtāḥ
tāvanto devadaityendrāḥ pakṣābhyāṃ tasya jajñire / teṣāṃ madhye punaḥ sā tu narmadā bhramate sarit
tataścānyo mahāśailo dṛśyate bharatarṣabha / tribhiḥ kūṭaiḥ suvistīrṇaiḥ śṛṅgavāniva govṛṣaḥ
trikūṭastu iti khyātaḥ sarvaratnairvibhūṣitaḥ / tatastasmāttrikūṭācca plāvayantī mahīṃ yayau
trikūṭī tena vikhyātā pitḥṇāṃ trāyaṇī parā / dvitīyācca tato gaṅgā vistīrṇā dharaṇītale
tṛtīyaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṅgaṃ saptadhā khaṇḍaśo gatam / jambūdvīpe tu saṃjātāḥ sapta te kulaparvatāḥ
candranakṣatrasahitā grahagrāmanadīnadāḥ / aṇḍajaṃ svedajaṃ jātamudbhijjaṃ ca jarāyujam
evaṃ jagadidaṃ sarvaṃ mayūrādabhavatpurā / samastaṃ naraśārdūla mahādevasamudbhavam
tato nadīḥ samudrāṃśca saṃvibhajya pṛthakpṛthak / narmadāmāha deveśo gaccha tvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam
evaṃ sā dakṣiṇā gaṃgā mahāpātakanāśinī / uttare jāhnavī deśe puṇyā tvaṃ dakṣiṇe śubhā
yathā gaṃgā mahāpuṇyā mama mastakasaṃbhavā / tadviśiṣṭā mahābhāge tvaṃ caiveti na saṃśayaḥ
tvayā saha bhaviṣyāmi ekenāṃśena suvrate / mahāpātakayuktānām auṣadhaṃ tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi
evamuktā tu devena mahāpātakanāśinī / dakṣiṇaṃ digvibhāgaṃ tu sā jagāmāśu vikramā
ṛkṣaśailendramāsādya candramauler anugrahāt / vāryaughaiḥ prasthitā yasmānmahādevapraṇoditā
mahatā cāpi vegena yasmād eṣā samucchritā / mahatī tena sā proktā mahādevānmahīpate
tapatastasya devasya śūlāgrādbindavo 'patan / tenaiṣā śoṇasaṃjñā tu daśa sapta ca tāḥ smṛtāḥ
sarveṣāṃ narmadā puṇyā rudradehādviniḥsṛtā / sarvābhyaśca saridbhyaś ca varadānānmahātmanaḥ
śaṃkarānuprahād devī mahāpātakanāśinī / yasmān mahārṇave ghore dṛśyate mahatī ca sā
suvyaktāṅgī mahākāyā mahatī tena sā smṛtā / tasmād vikṣobhyamāṇā hi diggajairambudopamaiḥ
kaluṣatvaṃ nayatyeva rasena surasā tathā / kṛpāṃ karoti sā yasmāllokānāmabhayapradā
saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ tena caiṣā kṛpā smṛtā / purā kṛtayuge puṇye divyamandārabhūṣitā
kalpavṛkṣasamākīrṇā rohītakasamākulā / vahatyeṣā ca mandena tena mandākinī smṛtā
bhittvā mahārṇavaṃ kṣipraṃ yasmāllokamihāgatā / pūjyā suraiśca siddhaiśca tasmādeṣā mahārṇavā
vicitrotpalasaṃghātair ṛkṣadvipasamākulā
bhittvā śailaṃ ca vipulaṃ prayātyevaṃ mahārṇavam / bhrāmayantī diśaḥ sarvā raveṇa mahatā purā
plāvayantī virājantī tena revā iti smṛtā / bhāryāputrasuduḥkhāḍhyānnarāñchāpaiḥ samāvṛtān
vipāpānkurute yasmādvipāpā tena sā smṛtā / viṇmūtranicayāṃ ghorāṃ pāṃśuśoṇitakardamām
pāśairnityaṃ tu sambādhāṃ yasmānmocayate bhṛśam / vipāśeti ca sā proktā saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī
narmadā vimalāmbhā ca vimalenduśubhānanā / tamobhūte mahāghore yasmādeṣā mahāprabhā
vimalā tena sā proktā vidvadbhirnṛpasattama / karair indukaraprakhyaiḥ sūryaraśmisamaprabhā
kṣarantī modate viśvaṃ karabhā tena cocyate / yasmād rañjayate lokāndarśanādeva bhārata
rañjanād rañjanā proktā dhātvarthe rājasattama / tṛṇavīrudhagulmādyās tiryañcaḥ pakṣiṇastathā / tānudbhūtānnayetsvargaṃ tenoktā vāyuvāhinī
evaṃ yo vetti nāmāni nirgamaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ / sa yāti pāpavirmukto rudralokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye sahaitukarevānāmamāhātmyavarṇane mayūrakalpasamudbhavo nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 7 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: punarekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame / salilenāplute loke nirāloke tamodbhave
brahmaiko vicaraṃstatra tamībhūte mahārṇave / divyavarṣasahasraṃ tu khadyota iva rūpavān
śete yojanasāhasram aprameyam anuttamam / dvādaśādityasaṃkāśaṃ sahasracaraṇekṣaṇam
prasuptaṃ cārṇave ghore hyapaśyatkūrmarūpiṇam / taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayāpanno brahmā bodhayate śanaiḥ
stutibhirmaṃgalaiścaiva vedavedāṃgasaṃbhavaiḥ / vācaspate vibudhyasva mahābhūta namo 'stu te
tavodare jagatsarvaṃ tiṣṭhate parameśvara / tadvimuñca mahāsattva yatpūrvaṃ saṃhṛtaṃ tvayā
vyatītā rajanī brāhmī dinaṃ samanuvartate / nirīkṣya sarvalokeśa yena saṃbhavate jagat
sa niśamya vacastasya utthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ / samudgiran sa lokāṃstrīn grastān kalpakṣaye tadā
devadānavagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ / sacandrārkagrahāḥ sarve śarīrāttasya nirgatāḥ
tato hyekārṇavaṃ sarvaṃ vibhajya parameśvaraḥ / vistīrṇopalatoyaughāṃ saritsaravivardhitām
paśyate medinīṃ devaḥ savṛkṣauṣadhipalvalām / himavantaṃ giriśreṣṭhaṃ śvetaṃ parvatamuttamam
śṛṅgavantaṃ mahāśailaṃ ye cānye kulaparvatāḥ / jaṃbudvīpaṃ kuśaṃ krauñcaṃ sagomedaṃ saśālmalam
puṣkarāntāśca ye dvīpā ye ca saptamahārṇavāḥ / lokālokaṃ mahāśailaṃ sarvaṃ ca purataḥ sthitam
catuḥprakṛtisaṃyuktaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṃgamam / yugānte tu viniṣkrāntam apaśyatsa maheśvaraḥ
viprakīrṇaśilājālāmapaśyatsa vasuṃdharām / kūrmapṛṣṭhopagāṃ devīṃ mahārṇavagatāṃ prabhuḥ
tasmin viśīrṇaśailāgre saritsarovivarjite / nānātaraṃgabhinnoda āvartodvartasaṃkule
nānauṣadhiprajvalite nānotpalaśilātale / nānāvihaṃgasaṃghuṣṭāṃ matsyakūrmasamākulām
divyamāyāmayīṃ devīm utkṛṣṭāmbudasannibhām / nadīmapaśyaddeveśo hyanaupamyajalāśayām
madhye tasyāmbudaśyāmāṃ pīnorujaghanastanīm / vastrairanupamairdivyairnānābharaṇabhūṣitām
sanūpuraravoddāmāṃ hārakeyūramaṇḍitām / tādṛśīṃ narmadāṃ devīṃ svayaṃ strīrūpadhāriṇīm
yogamāyāmayaiścitrairbhūṣaṇaiḥ svairvibhūṣitām / avyaktāṅgīṃ mahābhāgāmapaśyatsa tu narmadām
ardhodyatabhujāṃ bālāṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇām / stuvantīṃ devadeveśamutthitāṃ tu jalāttadā
vismayāviṣṭahṛdayo hyahamudvīkṣya tāṃ śubhām / snātvā jale śubhe tasyāḥ stotumabhyudyatastataḥ
arcayāmāsa saṃhṛṣṭo mantrairvedāṃgasaṃbhavaiḥ / sṛṣṭaṃ ca tatpurā rājanpaśyeyaṃ sacarācaram
sadevāsuragandharvaṃ sapannagamahoragam / paśyāmyeṣā mahābhāgā naiva yātā kṣayaṃ purā
mahādevaprasādācca taccharīrasamudbhavā / bhūyo bhūyo mayā dṛṣṭā kathitā te nṛpottama
prādurbhāvamimaṃ kaurmyaṃ ye 'dhīyante dvijottamāḥ / ye 'pi śṛṇvanti vidvāṃso mucyante te 'pi kilbiṣaiḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye kūrmakalpasamudbhavo nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 8 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: naṣṭe loke punaścānye salilena samāvṛte / mahārṇavasya madhyastho bāhubhyāmataraṃ jalam
divye varṣaśate pūrṇe śrānto 'haṃ nṛpasattama / dhyātuṃ samārabhaṃ devaṃ mahadarṇavatāraṇam
dhyāyamānastataḥ kāle apaśyaṃ pakṣiṇaṃ param / hārakundendusaṃkāśaṃ bakaṃ gokṣīrapāṇḍuram
tato 'haṃ vismayāviṣṭastaṃ bakaṃ samudīkṣya vai / asmin mahārṇave ghore kuto 'yaṃ pakṣisaṃbhavaḥ
taranbāhubhiraśrāntastaṃ bakaṃ pratyabhāṣiṣi / pākṣarūpaṃ samāsthāya kastvamekārṇavīkṛte
bhramase divyayogātmanmohayanniva māṃ prabho / etatkathaya me sarvaṃ yo 'si so 'si namo 'stu te
so 'bravīnmāṃ mahādevo brahmāhaṃ viṣṇureva ca / jagatsarvaṃ mayā vatsa saṃhṛtaṃ kiṃ na budhyase
tava mātā pitāhaṃ vai viśvasya ca mahāmune / kāruṇyaṃ mama saṃjātaṃ dṛṣṭvā magnaṃ mahārṇave
pakṣirūpaṃ samāsthāya ato 'trāhaṃ samāgataḥ / kim arthamāturo bhūtvā bhramasītthaṃ mahārṇave
śīghraṃ praviśa matpakṣau yena viśramase dvija / evamuktastatastena devenāhaṃ nareśvara
tato 'haṃ tasya pakṣānte pralīnastu bhramañjale / kāle yugasāhasrānte aśrānto 'rṇavamadhyagaḥ
tataḥ śṛṇomi sahasā dikṣu sarvāsu suvrata / kiṃcinnūpurasaṃmiśram adbhutaṃ śabdamuttamam
tadārṇavajalaṃ sarvaṃ saṃkṣiptaṃ sahasābhavat / kimetaditi saṃcintya diśaḥ samavalokayam
daśa kanyāstato dikṣu āgatāśca mahārṇave / vastrālaṃkārasahitā digbhyo nūpurabhūṣitāḥ
kāciccandrasamābhāsā kācidādityasaprabhā / kācidaṃjanapuñjābhā kācidraktotpalaprabhā
nānārūpadharā saumyā nānābharaṇabhūṣitā / arghyapādyādibhirmālyairbakamabhyarcya suvratāḥ
tatastaṃ parvatākāraṃ guhyaṃ pakṣiṇamavyayam / praviveśa mahāghoraṃ parvato hyarṇavaṃ svarāṭ
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi tāvantyeva śatāni ca / triṃśadyojanasāhasraṃ yāvadbhūmaṇḍalaṃ tviti
tato bhūmaṇḍalaṃ divyaṃ pañcaratnasamākulam / divyasphaṭikasopānaṃ rukmastaṃbhamanoramam
yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ tu vistarāddviguṇāyatam / vāpīkūpasamākīrṇaṃ prāsādāṭṭālakāvṛtam
kalpavṛkṣasamākīrṇaṃ dhvajaṣaṣṭivibhūṣitam / tasminpuravare ramye nānāratnopaśobhitam
tathānyacca puraṃ ramyaṃ patākojjvalavedikam / śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ tāvaddviguṇamāyatam
puramadhye tatastasminnadī paramaśobhanā / mahatī puṇyasalilā nānāratnaśilā tathā
tasyāstīre mayā dṛṣṭaṃ taḍitsūryasamaprabham / indranīlamahānīlaiścitaṃ ratnaiḥ samantataḥ
kvacidvahnisamākāraṃ kvacidindrāyudhaprabham / kvaciddhūmraṃ kvacitpītaṃ kvacidraktaṃ kvacitsitam
nānāvarṇaiḥ samāyuktaṃ liṅgamadbhutadarśanam / brahmaviṣṇvindrasādhyaiśca samantātparivāritam
nandīśvaragaṇādhyakṣaiścendrādityaiśca tadvṛtam / paśyāmi liṅgamīśānaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ tameva ca
parivārya tatastaṃ tu prasuptāndevadānavān / nimīlitākṣānpaśyāmi divyābharaṇabhūṣitān
tatastāḥ padmapatrākṣyo nāryaḥ paramasaṃmatāḥ / nadyāstasyā jale snātvā divyapuṣpairmanoramaiḥ
dattvārghapādyaṃ vidhivalliṃgasya saha pakṣiṇā / arcayantīrvarārohā daśa tāḥ pramadottamāḥ
tatastvabhyarcya talliṅgaṃ tasminneva purottame / sarvā adarśanaṃ jagmurvidyuto 'bhragaṇeṣviva
na cāsau pakṣirāṭ tasminna striyo na ca devatāḥ / tadevaikaṃ sthitaṃ liṅgamarcayanvismayānvitaḥ
tato'haṃ duḥkhamūḍhātmā rudramāyeti cintayan / tataḥ kanyāḥ samuttīrya divyāṃbaravibhūṣaṇāḥ
bhāsayantyo jagatsarvaṃ vidyuto 'bhragaṇāniva / padmairhiraṇmayairdivyairarcayitvā śubhānanāḥ
viviśustajjalaṃ kṣipraṃ samaṃtād varabhūṣaṇāḥ / tasminpuravare cānye tāmevāhaṃ punaḥpunaḥ
paśyāmi hyamarāṃ kanyām arcayantīṃ maheśvaram / tato 'haṃ tāṃ varārohāmapṛcchaṃ kamalekṣaṇām
kā tvamasminpure devi vasase śivamarcatī / tāścāgatāḥ striyaḥ sarvāḥ kva gatāste gaṇeśvarāḥ
namo 'stu te mahābhāge brūhi puṇye maheśvari / tava prasādādvijñātumetadicchāmi suvrate / dayāṃ kṛtvā mahādevi kathayasva mamānaghe
śryuvāca: vismṛtāhaṃ kathaṃ vipra dṛṣṭvā kalpe purātane / mā te 'bhūtsmṛtivibhraṃśaḥ sā cāhaṃ kalpavāhinī
narmadā nāma vikhyātā rudradehād viniḥsṛtā / yāstāḥ kanyāstvayā dṛṣṭā hyarcayantyo maheśvaram
yābhistviha samānītaḥ pakṣirājasamanvitāḥ / diśastā viddhi sarveśāḥ sarvāstvaṃ munisattama
tiryakpakṣisvarūpeṇa mahāyogī maheśvaraḥ / ebhiḥ śivapurādvipra ānītaḥ sa maheśvaraḥ
saiṣa devo mahādevo liṅgamūrtirvyavasthitaḥ / arcyate brahmaviṣṇvindraiḥ surāsurajagadguruḥ
layamāyāti yasmāddhi jagatsarvaṃ carācaram / tena liṅgamiti proktaṃ purāṇajñair maharṣibhiḥ
tena devagaṇāḥ sarve saṃkṣiptā māyayā purā / pralīnāścaiva lokeśa na dṛśyante hi sāṃpratam
punardṛśyā bhaviṣyanti sṛjamānāḥ svayaṃbhuvā / sāhaṃ liṅgārcanaparā narmadā nāma nāmataḥ
kālaṃ yugasahasrasya rudrasya paricārikā / asya prasādādamarastathā tvaṃ dvijapuṃgava
satyārjavadayāyuktaḥ siddho 'si tvaṃ śivārcanāt / evamuktvā tu sā devī tatraivāntaradhīyata
tāḥ striyaḥ sa ca deveśo bakarūpo maheśvaraḥ / tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā avatīrya mahānadīm
snātvā samarcaya tvaṃ hi vidhinā mantrapūrvakam / tato 'haṃ sahasā tasmāt samuttīrya jalāśayāt
na ca paśyāmi talliṅgaṃ na ca tāṃ nimnagāṃ nṛpa / tadaiva lokāḥ saṃjātāḥ kṣitiścaiva sakānanā
ṛkṣacandrārkavitataṃ tadeva ca nabhastalam / yathāpūrvam adṛṣṭaṃ tu tathaiva ca punaḥ kṛtam / nato'haṃ manasā devamapūjayaṃ maheśvaram
evaṃ bake purā kalpe mayā dṛṣṭeyam avyayā / narmadā martyalokasya mahāpātakanāśinī
tasmāddharmaparair vipraiḥ kṣatraśūdraviśādibhiḥ / sadā sevyā mahābhāgā dharmavṛddhyarthakāribhiḥ
ye 'pi bhaktayā sakṛttoye narmadāyā maheśvaram / snātvā te sarvaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayantyasaṃśayam

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye bakakalpasamudbhavo nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 9 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: punaryugāntaṃ te cānyaṃ sampravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu / sūryairādīpite loke jaṅgame sthāvare purā
saritsaraḥsamudreṣu kṣayaṃ yāteṣu sarvaśaḥ / nirmānuṣavaṣaṭkāre hyamaryādagatiṃ gate
nānārūpaistato medhaiḥ śakrāyudhavirājitaiḥ / sarvamāpūritaṃ vyoma vāryaughaiḥ pūrite tadā
tatastvekārṇavībhūte sarvataḥ salilāvṛte / jagatkṛtvodare sarvaṃ suṣvāpa bhagavānharaḥ
prakṛtiṃ svāmavaṣṭabhya yogātmā sa prajāpatiḥ / śete yugasahasrāntaṃ kālamāviśya sārṇavam
tatra suptaṃ mahātmānaṃ brahmalokanivāsinaḥ / bhṛgvādiṛṣayaḥ sarve ye cānye sanakādayaḥ
paryaṅke vimale śubhre nānāstaraṇasaṃstṛte / śayānaṃ dadṛśurdevaṃ sapatnīkaṃ vṛṣadhvajam
viśvarūpā tu sā nārī viśvarūpo maheśvaraḥ / gāḍhamāliṅgya suptas tāṃ dadṛśe cāhamavyayam
pādamūle tatastasya śyāmāṃ tāṃ padmalakṣaṇām / kanyāṃ paśyāmi suśroṇīṃ caraṇau tasya mṛdgatīm
vimalāmbarasaṃvītāṃ vyālayajñopavītinīm / śyāmāṃ kamalapatrākṣīṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām
sakalaṃ yugasāhasraṃ narmadeyaṃ vijānatī / prasuptaṃ devadeveśamupāste varavarṇinī
hṛtairvedaiścaturbhiśca brahmāpyevaṃ maheśvaraḥ / bhṛgvādyairmānasaiḥ putraiḥ stauti śaṅkaramavyayam
bhaktyā paramayā rājaṃstatra śambhum anāmayam / stuvantastatra deveśaṃ mantrairīśvarasambhavaiḥ
prasuptaṃ devamīśānaṃ bodhayansamupasthitaḥ / uttiṣṭha hara piṅgākṣa mahādeva maheśvara
mama vedā hṛtāḥ sarve ato 'haṃ stotumudyataḥ / vedairvyāptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ divyādivyaṃ carācaram
atītaṃ vartamānaṃ ca smarāmi ca sṛjāmyaham / tairvinā cāhamekastu mūko 'dho jaḍavatsadā
gatirvīryaṃ balotsāhau tairvinā na prajāyate / tairvinā devadeveśa nāhaṃ kiṃcit smarāmi vai
tānvedāndevadeveśa śīghraṃ me dātumarhasi / jaḍāndhabadhiraṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam
sthānādi daśa catvāri na śobhante sureśvara / praṇamāmy alpavīryatvād vedahīnaḥ sureśvara
vedebhyaḥ sakalaṃ jātaṃ yatkiṃcitsacarācaram / tāvacchobhanti śāstrāṇi samastāni jagadguro
yāvadvedanidhirayaṃ nopatiṣṭhetsanātanaḥ / yathoditena sūryeṇa tamo yāti vināśatām
evaṃ samastapāpāni yānti vedasya dhāraṇāt / vede rahasi yatsūkṣmaṃ yattadbrahma sanātanam
hṛdisthaṃ deva jānāmi gataṃ tadvedagarjanāt / vedānuccarato me 'dya tava śaṅkara cāgrataḥ
akasmātte gatā vedā na sṛjeyaṃ vibho bhuvam / te 'pi sarve mahādeva praviṣṭāḥ sammukhārṇavam
te yācyamānā deveśa tiṣṭhantu smaraṇe mama / duhiteyaṃ viśālākṣī sarvaḥ sarvaṃ vijānate
jāyatī yugasāhasraṃ nānyā kācidbhavedṛśī / ṛṣiścāyaṃ mahābhāgo mārkaṇḍo dhīmatāṃ varaḥ
kalpe kalpe mahādeva tvāmayaṃ paryupāsate / jagattrayahitārthāya carate vratamuttamam
evamuktastu deveśo brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā / uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā narmadāṃ saritāṃ varām
kathayasva mahābhāge brahmaṇastvaṃ tu pṛcchataḥ / kena vedā hṛtāḥ sarve vedhaso jagatīguroḥ
evamuktā tu rudreṇa uvāca mṛgalocanā / brahmaṇo japato vedāṃstvayi supte maheśvara
bhavataśchidramāsādya ghore 'sminsalilāvṛte / pūrvakalpasamudbhūtāvasurau suradurjayau
śriyāvṛttau mahādeva tvayā cotpāditau purā / surāsurasudurjeyau dānavau madhukaiṭabhau
tau vāyubhūtau sūkṣmau ca paṭhato 'smātpitāmahāt / tāvāśu hṛtvā vedāṃśca praviṣṭau ca mahārṇavam
etacchrutvā mahātejā hyamṛtāyāstato vacaḥ / sasmāra sa ca deveśaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam
sa viveśa mahārāja bhūtalaṃ sasurottamaḥ / dānavāntakaro devaḥ sarvadaivatapūjitaḥ
mīnarūpadharo devo loḍayāmāsa cārṇam / vedāṃśca dadṛśe tatra pātāle nihitānprabhuḥ
tau ca daityau mahāvīryau dṛṣṭavānmadhusūdanaḥ / mahāvegau mahābāhū sūdayāmāsa tejasā
vedāṃstatrāpi toyasthānānināya jagadguruḥ / caturvaktrāya devāyādadāccakravibhūṣitaḥ
tataḥ prahṛṣṭo bhagavān vedāṃllabdhvā pitāmahaḥ / janayāmāsa nikhilaṃ jagadbhūyaścarācaram
sā ca devī nadī puṇyā rudrasya paricārikā / pāvanī sarvabhūtānāṃ provāha salilaṃ tadā
tasyāstīre tato devā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ / yajanti tryambakaṃ devaṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā
ekā mūrtirmaheśasya kāraṇāntaragatā / traiguṇyā kurute karma brahmacakrīśarūpataḥ
eteṣāṃ tu pṛthagbhāvaṃ ye kurvanti sumohitāḥ / teṣāṃ dharmaḥ kutaḥ siddhirjāyate pāpakarmiṇām
evametā mahānadyastisro rudrasamudbhavāḥ / ekā eva tridhā bhūtā gaṅgā revā sarasvatī
gaṅgā tu vaiṣṇavī mūrtiḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśinī / rudradehasamudbhūtā narmadā caivameva tu
brāhmī sarasvatī mūrtistriṣu lokeṣu viśrutā / divyā kāmagamā devī vāgvibhūtyai tu saṃsthitā
narmadā paramā kācinmartyamūrtikalā śivā / divyā kāmagamā devī sarvatra surapūjitā
vyāpinī sarvabhūtānāṃ sūkṣmātsūkṣmatarā smṛtā / akṣayā hyamṛtā hyeṣā svargasopānamuttamā
sṛṣṭā rudreṇa lokānāṃ saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī
sīrajalaṃ ye 'pi pibanti loke mucyanti te pāpaviśeṣasaṅghaiḥ / vrajanti saṃsāramanādibhāvaṃ tyaktvā ciraṃ mokṣapadaṃ viśuddham
yathā gaṅgā tathā revā tathā caiva sarasvatī / samaṃ puṇyaphalaṃ proktaṃ snānadarśanacintanaiḥ
varadānānmahābhāgā hyadhikā cocyate budhaiḥ / kāruṇyāntarabhāvena na mṛtā samupāgatā
mucyante darśanāttena pātakaiḥ snānamaṅgalaiḥ / narmadāyāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha ye namanti trilocanam
umārudrāṅgasambhūtā yena caiṣā mahānadī / lokānprāpayate svargaṃ tena puṇyatvamāgatā
ya evamīśānavarasya dehaṃ vibhajya devīmiha saṃśṛṇoti / sa yāti rudraṃ mahatāraveṇa gandharvayakṣairiva gīyamānaḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye narmadotpattitatsnānaphalādikathanaṃ nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 10 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kasminkalpe mahābhāgā narmadeyaṃ dvijottama / vibhaktā ṛṣibhiḥ sarvaistapoyuktairmahātmabhiḥ
etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ brūhi me vadatāṃ vara / kalpānte yadbhavetkaṣṭaṃ lokānāṃ tattvameva ca
atīte tu purā kalpe yatheyaṃ vartate 'nagha / asyāntyasya ca kalpasya vyavasthāṃ kathaya prabho / evamuktaḥ sabhāmadhye mārkaṇḍo vākyamabravīt
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: vakṣye 'haṃ śrūyatāṃ sarvaiḥ katheyaṃ pūrvataḥ śrutā
mahatkatheyaṃ vaiśiṣṭī kalpādasmātparaṃ tu yā / lokakṣayakaro ghora āsītkālaḥ sudāruṇaḥ
tasminnapi mahāghore yatheyaṃ vā mṛtā satī / parituṣṭairvibhaktā ca śṛṇudhvaṃ tāṃ kathāmimām
yugānte samanuprāpte pitāmahadinatraye / mānasā brahmaṇaḥ putrāḥ sākṣādbrahmeva sattamāḥ
sanakādyā mahātmāno ye ca vaimānikā gaṇāḥ / yamendravaruṇādyāśca lokapālā dinatraye
kālāpekṣāstu tiṣṭhanti lokavṛttāntatatparāḥ / tataḥ kalpakṣaye prāpte teṣāṃ jñānamanuttamam
sarveṣāṃ naśyate cāyuryugarūpānusārataḥ / bhūrlokaṃ te parityajya agamaṃśca bhuvaṃ tadā
svarlokaṃ ca mahaścaiva janaścaiva tapastadā / āśrayaṃ satyalokaṃ ca sarvalokamanuttamam
kālaṃ yugasahasrāntaṃ putrapautrasamanvitāḥ / satyaloke ca tiṣṭhanti yāvatsaṃjāyate jagat
brahmaputrāśca ye kecitkalpādau na bhavanti ha / trailokyaṃ te parityajya anādhāraṃ bhavanti ca
taiḥ sārdhaṃ ye tu te viprā anye cāpi tapodhanāḥ / yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācāśca anye vaimānikā gaṇāḥ
ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgā varṇāścānye pṛthagvidhāḥ / sīdanti bhūmyāṃ sahitā ye cānye talavāsinaḥ
anāvṛṣṭirabhūttatra mahatī śatavārṣikī / lokakṣayakarī raudrā vṛkṣavīrudvināśinī
trailokyasaṃkṣobhakarī saptārṇavaviśoṣaṇī / tato lokāḥ kṣudhāviṣṭā bhramantīva diśo daśa
kaṃdairmūlaiḥ phalairvāpi vartayante suduḥkhitāḥ / saritaḥ sāgarāḥ kūpāḥ sevante pāvanāni ca
tatrāpi sarve śuṣyanti saridbhiḥ saha sāgarāḥ / tato yānyalpasārāṇi sattvāni pṛthivītale
tānyevāgre pralīyante bhinnānyurujalena vai / atha saṃkṣīyamāṇāsu saritsu saha sāgaraiḥ
ṛṣīṇāṃ ṣaṣṭisāhasraṃ kurukṣetranivāsinām / ye ca vaikhānasā viprā dantolūkhalinastathā
himācalaguhāguhye ye vasanti tapodhanāḥ / sarve te māmupāgamya kṣuttṛṣārtāstapodhanāḥ
ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve sīdayāmo mahāmune / saritsāgaraśailāntaṃ jagatsaṃśuṣyate dvija
kutra yāsyāma sahitā yāvatkālasya paryayaḥ / dīrghāyurasi viprendra na mṛtastvaṃ yugakṣaye
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca sarvaṃ tava hṛdi sthitam / tasmāttvaṃ vetsi sarvaṃ ca kathayasva mahāvrata
kīdṛkkālaṃ mahābhāga kṣapiṣyāmo 'tha suvrata / anāvṛṣṭihataṃ sarvaṃ sīdate sacarācaram
paritrāhi mahābhāga na yathā yāma saṃkṣayam / tataḥ saṃcintya manasā tvaranviprān athābravam
kurukṣetraṃ tyajadhvaṃ ca putradārasamanvitāḥ / tyaktvodīcīṃ diśaṃ sarve yāmo yāmyāmanuttamām
nagaragrāmaghoṣāḍhyāṃ purapattanaśobhitām / gacchāmo narmadātīraṃ bahusiddhaniṣevitam
rudrāṅgīṃ tāṃ mahāpuṇyāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm / paśyāmastāṃ mahābhāgāṃ nyagrodhāvārasaṃkulām
māheśvarairbhāgavataiḥ sāṃkhyaiḥ siddhaiḥ susevitām / anāvṛṣṭibhayādbhītāḥ kūlayorubhayorapi
āśrame hyāśramāndivyānkārayāmo jitavratāḥ / evamuktāstu te sarve sametānucaraiḥ saha
narmadātīramāsādya sthitāḥ sarve 'kutobhayāḥ / kiṃcit pūrvam anusmṛtya purā kalpādibhirbhayam
prāptāstu narmadātīramādāveva kalau yuge / tato varṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ divyaṃ revātaṭe 'vasan
ṣaḍviṃśacca sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ mānuṣāṇi ca / tatrāścaryaṃ mayā dṛṣṭamṛṣīṇāṃ vasatāṃ nṛpa
anāvṛṣṭihate loke saṃśuṣke sthāvare care / bhinne yugādikalane hāhābhūte vicetane
cāturvarṇe pralīne tu naṣṭe homabalikrame / niḥsvāhe nirvaṣaṭkāre śaucācāravivarjite
iyamekā saricchreṣṭhā ṛṣikoṭiniṣevitā / nānyā kācittriloke 'pi ramaṇīyā nareśvara
yatheyaṃ puṇyasalilā indrasyevāmarāvatī / devatāyatanaiḥ śubhrairāśramaiśca sukalpitaiḥ
śobhate narmadā devī svarge mandākinī yathā / yāvadvṛkṣā mahāśailā yāvatsāgarasaṃbhavā
ubhayoḥ kūlayos tāvan maṇḍitāyatanaiḥ śubhaiḥ / hūyadbhir agnihotraiśca havirdhūmasamākulā
babhūva narmadā devī prāvṛṭkāla iva śarvarī / devatāyatanairnaikaiḥ pūjāsaṃskāraśobhitā
saridbhirbhrājate śreṣṭhā purī śākrī ca bhāskarī / kecitpañcāgnitapasaḥ kecidapyagnihotriṇaḥ
kecid dhūmakamaśnanti tapasyugre vyavasthitāḥ / ātmayajñaratāḥ kecidapare bhaktibhāginaḥ
vaiṣṇavajñānam āsādya kecicchaivaṃ vrataṃ tathā / ekarātraṃ dvirātraṃ ca kecitṣaṣṭhāhabhojanāḥ
cāndrāyaṇavidhānaiśca kṛcchriṇaścātikṛcchriṇaḥ / evaṃvidhaistapobhiśca narmadātīraśobhitaiḥ
yajadbhiḥ śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ keśavaṃ bhāti nityadā / ekatve ca pṛthaktve ca yajatāṃ ca maheśvaram
kalau yuge mahāghore prāptāḥ siddhimanuttamām / yasya yasya hi yā bhaktirvijñānaṃ yasya yādṛśam
yasminyasmiṃśca deve tu tāṃtāmīśo 'dadātprabhuḥ / svabhāvaikatayā bhaktyā tāmetyāntaḥ pralīyate
saṃsāre parivartante ye pṛthagbhājino narāḥ / ye mahāvṛkṣamīśānaṃ tyaktvā śākhāvalambinaḥ
punarāvartamānāste jāyante hi caturyuge / devānte sthāvarānte ca saṃsāre cābhramankramāt
punarjanma punaḥ svarge punarghore ca raurave / ye punardevamīśānaṃ bhavaṃ bhaktisusaṃsthitāḥ
yajanti narmadātīre na punaste bhavanti ca / ā dehapatanāt kecid upāsantaḥ paraṃ gatāḥ
keciddvādaśabhirvarṣaiḥ ṣaḍbharanye tapodhanāḥ / tribhiḥ saṃvatsaraiḥ kecitkecitsaṃvatsareṇa tu
ṣaḍbhirmāsaistu saṃsiddhās tribhir māsais tathāpare / munayo devamāśritya narmadāṃ ca yaśasvinīm
chittvā saṃsāradoṣāṃśca agamanbrahma śāśvatam / evaṃ kaliyuge ghore śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
narmadātīramāśritya munayo rudramāviśan
ye narmadātīramupetya viprāḥ śaive vrate yatnam upaprapannāḥ / trikālam ambhaḥ pravigāhya bhaktyā devaṃ samabhyarcya śivaṃ vrajanti
dhyānārcanairjāpyamahāvrataiśca nārāyaṇaṃ vā satataṃ smaranti / te dhautapāṇḍurapaṭā iva rājahaṃsāḥ saṃsārasāgarajalasya taranti pāram
satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyamutkṣipya bhujam ucyate / idamekaṃ suniṣpannaṃ dhyeyo nārāyaṇaḥ sadā
yo vā haraṃ pūjayate jitātmā māsaṃ ca pakṣaṃ ca vasennarendra / revāṃ samāśritya mahānubhāvaḥ sa devadevo 'tha bhavetpinākī
kīṭāḥ pataṃgāśca pipīlikāśca ye vai mriyante 'mbhasi narmadāyāḥ / te divyarūpāstu kulaprasūtāḥ śataṃ samā dharmaparā bhavanti
kālena vṛkṣāḥ prapatanti ye 'pi mahātaraṃgaughanikṛttamūlāḥ / te narmadāṃbhobhirapāstapāpā dedīpyamānāstridivaṃ prayānti
akāmakāmāśca tathā sakāmā revāntam āśritya mriyanti tīre / jaḍāndhamūkās tridivaṃ prayānti kimatra viprā bhavabhāvayuktāḥ
māsopavāsairapi śoṣitāṅgā na tāṃ gatiṃ yānti vimuktadehāḥ / mriyanti revājalapūtakāyāḥ śivārcane keśavabhāvayuktāḥ
nīvāraśyāmākayaveṅgudādyair anyair munīndrā iha vartayanti / āpritya kūlaṃ tridaśānugītaṃ te narmadāyā na viśanti mṛtyum
bhramanti ye tīramupetya devyās trikāladevārcanasatyapūtāḥ / viṇmūtracarmāsthitiropadhānāḥ kukṣau yuvatyā na vasanti bhūyaḥ
kiṃ yajñadānairbahubhiśca teṣāṃ niṣevitaistīrthavaraiḥ samastaiḥ / revātaṭaṃ dakṣiṇamuttaraṃ vā sevanti te rudracarānupūrvam
te vañcitāḥ paṅgujaḍāndhabhūtā lokeṣu martyāḥ paśubhiśca tulyāḥ / ye nāśritā rudraśarīrabhūtāṃ sopānapaṅktiṃ tridivasya revām
yugaṃ kaliṃ ghoramimaṃ ya iccheddraṣṭuṃ kadācinna punar dvijendraḥ / sa narmadātīramupetya sarvaṃ sampūjayet sarvavimuktasaṃgaḥ
vighnair anekair atiyojyamānā ye tīram ujhanti na narmadāyāḥ / te caiva sarvasya hitārthabhūtā vandyāśca te sarvajanasya mānyāḥ
bhṛgvatrigārgeyavaśiṣṭhakaṅkāḥ śataiḥ sametair niyatās tvasaṃkhyaiḥ / siddhiṃ parāṃ te hi jalaplutāṅgāḥ prāptāstu lokānmarutāṃ na cānye
jñānaṃ mahatpuṇyatamaṃ pavitraṃ paṭhantyado nityaviśuddhasattvāḥ / gatiṃ parāṃ yānti mahānubhāvā rudrasya vākyaṃ hi yathā pramāṇam

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye narmadāsnānaphalaśrutikathanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 11 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: aho mahatpuṇyatamā viśiṣṭā kṣayaṃ na yātā iha yā yugānte / tasmātsadā sevyatamā munīndrair dhyānārcanasnānaparāyaṇaiśca
yāmāśritya gatā mokṣamṛṣayo dharmavatsalāḥ / ye tvayoktāstu niyamā ṛṣīṇāṃ vedanirmitāḥ
mokṣāvāptirbhavedyeṣāṃ niyamaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ / daśadvādaśabhirvāpi ṣaḍbhiraṣṭābhir eva vā
tribhistathā caturbhirvā varṣairmāsaistathaiva ca / mucyante kalidoṣaiste deveśānasamarcanāt
brahmāṇaṃ vā suraśreṣṭha keśavaṃ vā jagadgurum / arcayanpāpamakhilaṃ jahātyeva na saṃśayaḥ
etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ kathayasva mamānagha / yasminsaṃsāragahane nimagnāḥ sarvajantavaḥ / te kathaṃ tridivaṃ prāptā iti me saṃśayo vada
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: janmāntarairanekaistu mānuṣyamupalabhyate / bhaktirutpadyate cātra kathaṃcidapi śaṅkare
tīrthadānopavāsānāṃ yajñairdevadvijārcanaiḥ / avāptirjāyate puṃsāṃ śraddhayā parayā nṛpa
tasmācchraddhā prakartavyā mānavairdharmavatsalaiḥ / īśo 'pi śraddhayā sādhyastena śraddhā viśiṣyate
anyathā niṣphalaṃ sarvaṃ śraddhāhīnaṃ tu bhārata / tasmāt samāśrayed bhaktiṃ rudrasya parameṣṭhinaḥ
teṣāṃhi saphalaṃ janma yeṣāṃ bhaktiracañcalā / sā caiva trividhā bhaktiḥ sāttvikī rājasī tathā
tāmasī sarvalokasya trividhaṃ ca phalaṃ labhet / te karmaphalasaṃyogādāvartante punaḥpunaḥ
janmāntaraśataisteṣāṃ jñānināṃ devayājinām / devatraye bhavedbhaktiḥ kṣayātpāpasya karmaṇaḥ
īśānāttu punarmokṣo jāyate chinnasaṃśayaḥ / ye punarnarmadātīramāśritya dvijapuṃgavāḥ
trayīmārgam asandigdhāste yānti paramāṃ gatim / ekāgramanaso ye tu śaṅkaraṃ śivamavyayam
arcayantīha niratāḥ kṣipraṃ sidhyanti te janāḥ / kālena mahatā siddhirjāyate 'nyatra dehinām
narmadāyāḥ punastīre kṣipraṃ siddhiravāpyate / ṣaḍbhirvarṣaistu sidhyanti ye tu sāṃkhyavido janāḥ
vaiṣṇavā jñānasampannāste 'pi sidhyanti cāgrataḥ / sarvayogavido ye ca samudramiva sindhavaḥ
ekībhavanti kalpānte yoge māheśvare gatāḥ / sarveṣāmeva yogānāṃ yogo māheśvaro varaḥ
tamāsādya vimucyante ye 'pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ / śivamarcya nadīkūle jāyante te na yoniṣu
gatireṣā durārohā sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī / mucyante maṅkṣu saṃsārādrevāmāśritya jantavaḥ
tasmātsnāyī bhavennityaṃ tathā bhasmavilepanaḥ / narmadātīramāsādya kṣipraṃ siddhimavāpnuyāt
trikālaṃ pūjayecchānto yo naro liṅgam ādarāt / sarvarogavinirmuktaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
ṣaḍbhiḥ sidhyati masaistu yadyapi syātsa pāpakṛt / ye punaḥ śuddhamanaso māsaiḥ śudhyanti te tribhiḥ
yathā dinakaraspṛṣṭaṃ himaṃ śailād viśīryante / tadvadvilīyate pāpaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ bhasmakaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ
vainateyabhayatrastā yathā naśyanti pannagāḥ / tadvatpāpāni naśyanti bhasmanābhyukṣitāni ha
narmadātoyapūtena bhasmanoddhūlayanti ye / sadyaste pāpasaṅghācca mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ
vrataṃ pāśupataṃ bhaktayā yathoktaṃ pālayanti ye / śūdrānnena vihīnāstu te yānti paramāṃ gatim
amṛtaṃ brāhmaṇasyānnaṃ kṣatriyānnaṃ payaḥ smṛtam / vaiśyānnam annameva syācchūdrānnaṃ rudhiraṃ smṛtam
śūdrānnarasasaṃpuṣṭā ye mriyante dvijottamāḥ / te tapojñānahīnāstu kākā gṛdhrā bhavanti te
duṣkṛtaṃ hi manuṣyāṇāmannamāśritya tiṣṭhati / yo yasyānnaṃ samaśnāti sa tasyāśnāti kilbiṣam
viśeṣādyatidharmeṇa tapolaulyaṃ samāśritāḥ / narakaṃ yāntyasandigdhamityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
īdṛgrūpāśca ye viprāḥ pāśupatye vyavasthitāḥ / te mahatpāpasaṃghātaṃ dahantyeva na saṃśayaḥ
viḍambena ca saṃyuktā laulupyena ca pīḍitāḥ / asaṃgrāhyā ityevaṃ śrutinodanā
mātāpitṛkṛtairdoṣairanye kecitsvakarmajaiḥ / naṣṭā jñānāvalepena ahaṅkāreṇa 'pare
śāṅkare prasthitā dharme ye smṛtyarthabahiṣkṛtāḥ / kliśyamānāstu kalena te yānti paramāṃ gatim
aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā mūrkhā dambhavivardhitāḥ / na sidhyanti durātmānaḥ kudṛṣṭāntārthakīrtanāḥ
mahābhāgye 'pi tīrthasya śāṅkaraṃ vratamāsthitāḥ / viyoniṃ yāntyasandigdhaṃ laulupyena samanvitāḥ
na tīrthairna ca dānaiśca duṣkṛtaṃ hi vilupyate / ajñānācca pramādācca kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vinaśyati
evaṃ jñātvā tu vidhinā vartitavyaṃ dvijātibhiḥ / paraṃ brahma japadbhiśca vārtitavyaṃ muhurmuhuḥ
ūrdhvarūpaṃ virūpākṣaṃ yo'dhīte rudrameva ca / īśānaṃ paśyate sākṣāt ṣaṇmāsāt saṅgavarjitaḥ
saṃhitāyā daśāvṛttīryaḥ karoti susaṃyataḥ / narmadātaṭamāśritya sa mucyetsarvapātakaiḥ
purāṇasaṃhitāṃ vāpi śaivīṃ vā vaiṣṇavīmapi / yaḥ paṭhennarmadātīre śivāgre sa śivātmakaḥ
ā bhūtasaṃkṣayaṃ yāvatsvargaloke mahīyate / saṃsākhyasanaṃ hātuṃ purā proktaṃ tu nandinā
devarṣisiddhagandharvasamavāye śivālaye / nandigītāmimāṃ rājañchṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ śubhām
svargamokṣapradāṃ puṇyāṃ saṃsārabhayanāśinīm
saṃsāragahvaraguhāṃ pravihātumetāṃ cedicchatha pratipadaṃ bhavatāpakhinnāḥ / nānāvidhairnijakṛtairbahukarmapāśairbaddhāḥ sukhāya śṛṇutaikahitaṃ mayoktam
śakra vakragatiṃ mā gā mā kṛthā yama yātanām / cetaḥ pracetaḥ śamaya laulupyaṃ tyaja vittapa
dīnānāthaviśiṣṭebhyo dhanaṃ sarvaṃ parityaja / yadi saṃsārajaladher vīcīpreṅkhollanāturaḥ
janmodvignaṃ mṛtestrastaṃ grastaṃ kāmādibhirnaram / srastaṃ yo na yamādibhyaḥ pinākī pāti pāvanaḥ
mā dhehi garvaṃ kīnāśa hāsyaṃ yāsyasi pīḍayan / prāṇinaṃ sarvaśaraṇaṃ tadbhāvi śaraṇaṃ tava
kālaḥ karālako bālaḥ ko mṛtyuḥ ko yamādhamaḥ / śivaviṣṇuparāṇāṃ hi narāṇāṃ kiṃ bhayaṃ bhavet
bhavabhārārtajantūnāṃ revātīranivāsinām / bhargaśca bhagavāṃścaiva bhavabhītivibhedanau
śivaṃ bhaja śivaṃ dhyāya śivaṃ stuhi śivaṃ yaja / śivaṃ nama varāka tvaṃ jñānaṃ mokṣaṃ yadīcchasi
paṭha pañcānanaṃ śāstraṃ mantraṃ pañcākṣaraṃ japa / dhehi pañcātmakaṃ tattvaṃ yaja pañcānanaṃ param
kiṃ taiḥ karmagaṇaiḥ śocyairnānābhāvaviśeṣitaiḥ / yadi pañcānanaḥ śrīmān sevyate sarvathā śivaḥ
kiṃ saṃsāragajonmattabṛṃhitair nibhṛtairapi / yadi pañcānano devo bhāvagandhopasevitaḥ
re mūḍha kiṃ viṣādena prāpya karmakadarthanām / bhavānīvallabhaṃ bhīmaṃ japa tvaṃ bhayanāśanam
narmadātīranilayaṃ duḥkhaughavilayaṃkaram / svargamokṣapradaṃ bhargaṃ bhaja mūḍha sureśvaram
vihāya revāṃ surasindhusevyāṃ tattīrasaṃsthaṃ ca haraṃ hariṃ ca / unmattavad bhāvavivarjitastvaṃ kva yāsi re mūḍha digantarāṇi
bhaja revājalaṃ puṇyaṃ yaja rudraṃ sanātanam / japa pañcākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ vraja sthānaṃ ca vāñchitam
kleśayitvā nijaṃ kāyam upāyair bahubhistu kim / bhaja revāṃ śivaṃ prāpya sukhasādhyaṃ paraṃ padam
evaṃ kailāsamāsādya nadīṃ sa śivasannidhau / jagau yallokapālānāṃ tanmayoktaṃ tavādhunā
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: snānadānaparo yastu nityaṃ dharmamanuvrataḥ / narmadātīramāśritya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
vidhihīno japennityaṃ vedānsarvāñchataṃ samāḥ / mṛtyulāṅgalajāpyena samo yo 'pyadhiko guṇaiḥ
bījayonyaviśuddhastu yathā rudraṃ na vindati / tathā lāṅgalamantro 'pi na tiṣṭhati gatāyuṣi
gāyatrījapasaṃyuktaḥ saṃyamī hyadhiko guṇaiḥ / agnim īḍe iṣetvo vā agna āyāhi nityadā
śanno devīti kūlastho japenmucyeta kilbiṣaiḥ
sāṅgopāṅgāṃs tathā vedāñjapannityaṃ samāhitaḥ / na tatphalamavāpnoti gāyatryā saṃyamī yathā
rudrādhyāyaṃ sakṛjjaptvā vipro vedasamanvitaḥ / mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
anyadvai japyasaṃsthānaṃ sūktamāraṇyakaṃ tathā / mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
yatkiṃcitkriyate jāpyaṃ yacca dānaṃ pradīyate / narmadājalamāśritya tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet
evaṃvidhairvratairnityaṃ narmadāṃ ye samāśritāḥ / te mṛtā vaiṣṇavaṃ yānti padaṃ vā śaivam avyayam
satyalokaṃ narāḥ kecitsūryalokaṃ tathāpare / apsarogaṇasaṃvītā yāvadābhūtasamplavam
evaṃ vai vartamāne 'smiṃlloke tu nṛpapuṃgava / ṛṣīṇāṃ daśakoṭyastu kurukṣetranivāsinām
mayā saha mahābhāga narmadātaṭamāśritāḥ / phalamūlakṛtāhārā arcayantaḥ sthitāḥ śivam
tacca varṣaśataṃ divyaṃ kālasaṃkhyānumānataḥ / ṣaḍviṃśatisahasrāṇi tāni mānuṣasaṃkhyayā
tatastasyāmatītāyāṃ sandhyāyāṃ nṛpasattama / śeṣaṃ mānuṣyamekaṃ tu kāle varṣaśataṃ sthitam
tato 'bhavadanāvṛṣṭirlokakṣayakarī tadā / yayā yātaṃ jagatsarvaṃ kṣayaṃ bhūyo hi dāruṇam
ye pūrvamiha saṃsiddhā ṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ / teṣāṃ prabhāvād bhagavān vavarṣa balavṛtrahā
mahatī bhūrisalilā samantādvṛṣṭirāhitā / tato vṛṣṭyā tu teṣāṃ vai vartanaṃ samajāyata
punar yugānte samprāpte kiṃciccheṣe kalau yuge / niḥśeṣam abhavat sarvaṃ śuṣkaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam
nirvṛkṣauṣadhagulmaṃ ca tṛṇavīrudvivarjitam / anāvṛṣṭihataṃ sarvaṃ bhūmaṇḍalam abhūdbhṛśam
tataste ṛṣayaḥ sarve kṣuttṛṣārtāḥ sahasraśaḥ / yugasvabhāvamāviṣṭā hīnasattvā abhavannṛpa
naṣṭahomasvadhākāre yugānte samupasthite / kiṃ kāryaṃ kva nu yāsyāmaḥ ko 'smākaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhavet
tānahaṃ pratyuvācedaṃ mā bhaiṣṭeti punaḥpunaḥ / īdṛgvidhā mayā dṛṣṭā bahavaḥ kālaparyayāḥ
narmadātīramāśritya te sarve gamitā mayā / eṣā hi śaraṇaṃ devī samprāpte hi yugakṣaye
nānyā gatirihāsmākaṃ vidyate dvijasattamāḥ / janitrī sarvabhūtānāṃ viśeṣeṇa dvijottamāḥ
pitāmahā ye pitaro ye cānye prapitāmahāḥ / te samastā gatāḥ svargaṃ samāśritya mahānadīm
bhṛgvādyāḥ sapta ye tvāsanmama pūrvapitāmahāḥ / dhaumṛṇī ca mahābhāgā mama bhāryā śucismitā / manasvatī ca yā matā bhārgavo'ṅgirasastathā
pulastyaḥ pulahaścaiva vasiṣṭhātreyakāśyapāḥ / tathānye ca mahābhāgā niyamavratacāriṇaḥ / anye ca śatasāhasrā atra siddhiṃ samāgatāḥ
tasmādiyaṃ mahābhāgā na moktavyā kadācana / nānyā kācinnadī śaktā lokatrayaphalapradā
dvandvairanekairbahubhiḥ kṣuttṛṣādyair mahābhayaiḥ / mucyante te narāḥ sadyo narmadātīravāsinaḥ
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sevitavyā saridvarā / vāñchadbhiḥ paramaṃ śreya iha loke paratra ca

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīnarmadāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 12 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: etacchrutvā vaco rājansaṃhṛṣṭā ṛṣayo 'bhavan / narmadāṃ stotumārabdhāḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭā dvijāḥ
namo 'stu te puṇyajale namo makaragāmini / namaste pāpamocinyai namo devi varānane
namo 'stu te puṇyajalāśraye śubhe viśuddhasattvaṃ surasiddhasevite / namo 'stu te tīrthagaṇairniṣevite namo 'stu rudrāṅgasamudbhave vare
namo 'stu te devi samudragāmini namo 'stu te devi varaprade śive / namo 'stu lokadvayasaukhyadāyini hyanekabhūtaughasamāśrite 'naghe
saridvare pāpahare vicitrite gandharvayakṣoragasevitāṅge / sanātani prāṇigaṇānukampini mokṣaprade devi vidhehi śaṃ naḥ
mahāgajair ghamahiṣair varāhaiḥ saṃsevite devi mahormimāle / natāḥ sma sarve varade sukhaprade vimocayāsmānpaśupāśabandhāt
pāpairanekairaśubhairvibaddhā bhramanti tāvannarakeṣu martyāḥ / mahānilodbhūtataraṅgabhūtaṃ yāvattavāmbho hi na saṃspṛśanti
anekaduḥkhaughabhayārditānāṃ pāpairanekairabhiveṣṭitānām / gatistvam ambhojasamānavakre dvandvairanekairapi saṃvṛtānām
nadyaśca pūtā vimalā bhavanti tvāṃ devi samprāpya na saṃśayo 'tra / duḥkhāturāṇām abhayaṃ dadāsi śiṣṭairanekairabhipūjitāsi
spṛṣṭaṃ karaiścandramaso raveśca tadaiva dadyātparamaṃ padaṃ tu / yatropalāḥ puṇyajalāplutāste śivatvam āyānti kimatra citram
bhramanti tāvannarakeṣu martyā duḥkhāturāḥ pāpaparītadehāḥ / mahānilodbhūtataraṅgabhaṅgaṃ yāvattavāmbho na hi saṃśrayanti
mlecchāḥ pulindāstvatha yātudhānāḥ pibanti ye 'mbhastava devi puṇyam / muktā bhavantīha bhayāttu ghorānniḥsaṃśayaṃ te'pi kimatra citram
sarāṃsi nadyaḥ kṣayamabhyupetā ghore yuge 'smin hi kalau pradūṣite / tvaṃ bhrājase devi jalaughapūrṇā divīva nakṣatrapathe ca gaṅgā
tava prasādād varade variṣṭhe kālaṃ yathemaṃ paripālayitvā / yāmo 'tha rudraṃ tava suprasādād vayaṃ tathā tvaṃ kuru vai prasādam
gatistvamambeva piteva putrāṃstvaṃ pāhi no yāvadimaṃ yugāntam / kālaṃ tvanāvṛṣṭihataṃ sughoraṃ yāvattarāmastava suprasādāt
paṭhanti ye stotramidaṃ dvijendrāḥ śṛṇvanti ye cāpi narāḥ praśāntāḥ / te yānti rudraṃ vṛṣasaṃyutena yānena divyāmbarabhūṣitāśca
ye stotrametat satataṃ paṭhanti snātvā tu toye khalu narmadāyāḥ / ante hi teṣāṃ sariduttameyaṃ gatiṃ viśuddhām acirād dadāti
prātaḥ samutthāya tathā śayāno yaḥ kīrtayetānudinaṃ stavaṃ ca / sa muktapāpaḥ suviśuddhadehaḥ samāśrayaṃ yāti maheśvarasya

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīnarmadāmāhātmye narmadāstotrakathanaṃ nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 13 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: evaṃ bhagavatī puṇyā stutā sā munipuṃgavaiḥ / cintayāmāsa sarveṣāṃ dāsyāmi varamuttamam
tataḥ prasuptāṃstāñjñātvā rātrau devī jagāma ha / ekaikasya ṛṣeḥ svapne darśanaṃ cāruhāsinī
tato 'rdharātre samprāpta utthitā jalamadhyataḥ / vimalāmbarasaṃvītā divyamālāvibhūṣitā
ghṛtātapatrā suśroṇī padmarāgavibhūṣitā / jagāda mā bhair iti tān ekaikaṃ tu pṛthakpṛthak
vasadhvaṃ mama pārśve tu bhayaṃ tyaktvā kṣudhādijam
evamuktvā tadā devī svapnānte tānmahāmunīn / jagāmādarśanaṃ paścātpraviśya jalam ātmikam
tataḥ prabhāte munayo mitha ūcurmudanvitāḥ / tathā dṛṣṭā mayā dṛṣṭā svapne devī sudarśanā
abhayaṃ dattamasmākaṃ siddhiścāpyacireṇa tu / praśastaṃ darśanaṃ tasyā narmadāyā na saṃśayaḥ
athānyadivase rājanmatsyānāṃ rūpam uttamam / paśyanti saparīvārāḥ svakīyāśramasannidhau
tāndṛṣṭvā vismayāviṣṭā matsyāṃstatra maharṣayaḥ / pūjayāmāsuravyagrā havyakavyena devatāḥ
tānmatsyasaṅghānsamprāpya mahādevyāḥ prasādataḥ / saputradārabhṛtyāste vartayanti pṛthakpṛthak
dine dine tathāpyevamāśrameṣu dvijātayaḥ / matsyānāṃ sañcayaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitāścābhavaṃstadā
mṛtāṃstāṃstu supuṣṭāṅgān pāṭhīnāṃśca viśeṣataḥ / dvāre dvāre cāśramāṇāṃ tāpasānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira
hṛṣṭapuṣṭāstadā sarve narmadātīravāsinaḥ / ṛṣayaste bhayaṃ sarve tatyajuḥ kṣuttṛṣodbhavam
te japantastapantaśca tiṣṭhanti bharatarṣabha / arcayanti pitḥndevānnarmadātaṭamāśritāḥ
tairjapadbhistapadbhiśca satataṃ dvijasattamaiḥ / bhrājate sā saricchreṣṭhā tārābhir dyaur grahairiva
tatra tairbahulaiḥ śubhrair brāhmaṇair vedaparāgaiḥ / narmadā dharmadā pūrvaṃ saṃvibhaktā yathākramam
ṛṣibhir daśakoṭibhir narmadātīravāsibhiḥ / vibhakteyaṃ vibhaktāṅgī narmadā śarmadā nṛṇām
yajñopavītaiśca śubhair akṣasūtraiśca bhārata / kūladvaye mahāpuṇyā narmadodadhigāminī
pṛthagāyatanaiḥ śubhrairliṅgairvālukamṛnmayaiḥ / bhrājate yā saricchreṣṭhā nakṣatrairiva śarvarī
evaṃ ta ṛṣayaḥ sarve tarpayantaḥ surānpitḥn / nyavasannarmadātīre yāvadābhūtasamplavam
kiṃcidgate tatastasminghore varṣaśatādhike / ardharātre tadā kanyā jalāduttīrya bhārata
vidyutpuṃjasamābhāsā vyālayajñopavītinī / triśūlāgrakarā saumyā tānuvāca ṛṣīṃstadā
āgacchadhvaṃ munigaṇā viśadhvaṃ māmayonijām / sametāḥ putradāraiśca tataḥ siddhimavāpsyatha
yasya yasya hi yā vāñchā tasya tāṃ tāṃ dadāmyaham / viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇamīśānamanyaṃ vā suramuttamam
tatra sarvānnayiṣyāmi prasannā varadā hyaham / prāṇāyāmaparā bhūtvā māṃ viśadhvaṃ samāhitāḥ
saha putraiśca dāraiśca tyaktvāśramapadāni ca / kālakṣepo na kartavyaḥ pralayo 'yamupasthitaḥ
saṃhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ kalpadāhaḥ sudāruṇaḥ / ekāham abhavaṃ pūrvaṃ mahāghore janakṣaye
śeṣā nadyaḥ samudrāśca sarva eva kṣayaṃgatāḥ / varadānān maheśasya tenāhaṃ na kṣayaṃ gatā
amṛtaḥ śāśvato devaḥ sthāṇurīśaḥ sanātanaḥ / sa pūjitaḥ prārthito vā kiṃ na dadyād dvijottamāḥ
evamuktvā ṛṣīvrevā praviveśa jalaṃ tataḥ / karāttaśūlā sā devī vyālayajñopavītinī
tataste tadvacaḥ śrutvā vismayāpannamānasāḥ / abhivandya ca māṃ sarve kṣāmayantaḥ punaḥ punaḥ
kṣamyatāṃ no yaduktaṃ hi vasatāṃ tava saṃśraye / gṛhāṃstyaktvā mahābhāgāḥ saśiṣyāḥ sahabāndhavāḥ
japtvā caikākṣaraṃ brahma hṛdi dhyātvā maheśvaram / snātvā ca mantrapūtābhiratha cādbhir jitavratāḥ
viviśurnarmadātoyaṃ sapakṣā iva parvatāḥ / dyotayanto diśaḥ sarvāḥ kuśahastāḥ sahāgrayaḥ
gateṣu teṣu rājendra ahamekaḥ sthitastadā / amareśaṃ samāsādya pūjayannarmadāṃ nadīm
anubhūtāḥ saptakalpā māyūrādyā mayā nṛpa / prasādād vedhasaḥ sarve revayā saha bhārata
janmato'dya dinaṃ yāvanna jāne 'syāḥ purāsthitim
iyaṃ hi śāṃkarī śaktiḥ kalā śambhorilāhvayā / narmadā duritadhvaṃsakāriṇī bhavatāriṇī
yadāhamapi nābhūvaṃ purākalpeṣu pāṇḍava / caturdaśasu kalpeṣu teṣviyaṃ sukhasaṃsthitā
caturdaśa purā kalpā na mṛtā yeṣu narmadā / tānahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi devī prāha yathā mama
kāpilaṃ prathamaṃ viddhi prājāpatyaṃ dvitīyakam / brāhmaṃ saumyaṃ ca sāvitraṃ bārhaspatyaṃ prabhāsakam
māhendram agnikalpaṃ ca jayantaṃ mārutaṃ tathā / vaiṣṇavaṃ bahurūpaṃ ca jyautiṣaṃ ca caturdaśam
ete kalpā mayā khyātā na mṛtā yeṣu narmadā / māyūraṃ pañcadaśamaṃ kaurmaṃ caivātra ṣoḍaśam
bakaṃ mātsyaṃ ca pādmaṃ ca vaṭakalpaṃ ca bhārata / ekaviṃśatimaṃ caitaṃ vārāhaṃ sāṃpratīnakam
ime sapta mayā sākaṃ revayā pariśīlitāḥ / ekaviṃśatikalpāstu narmadāyāḥ śivāṅgataḥ
saṃjātāyā nṛpaśreṣṭha mayā dṛṣṭā hyanekaśaḥ / kathitā nṛpatiśreṣṭha bhūyaḥ kiṃ kathayāmi te

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmya ekaviṃśatikalpakathānakavarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 14 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: tatasta ṛṣayaḥ sarve mahābhāgāstapodhanāḥ / gatāstu paramaṃ lokaṃ tataḥ kiṃ jātamadbhutam
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tatasteṣu prayāteṣu narmadātīravāsiṣu / babhūva raudrasaṃhāraḥ sarvabhūtakṣayaṃkaraḥ
kailāsaśikharasthaṃ tu mahādevaṃ sanātanam / brahmādyāḥ prāstuvan devam ṛgyajuḥsāmabhiḥ śivam
saṃhara tvaṃ jagad deva sadevāsuramānuṣam / prāpto yugasahasrāntaḥ kālaḥ saṃharaṇakṣamaḥ
madrūpaṃ tu samāsthāya tvayā caitadvinirmitam / vaiṣṇavīṃ mūrtimāsthāya tvayaitatparipālitam
ekā mūrtistridhā jātā brāhmī śaivī ca vaiṣṇavī / sṛṣṭisaṃhārarakṣārthaṃ bhavedevaṃ maheśvara
etacchrutvā vacastathyaṃ viṣṇośca parameṣṭhinaḥ / sagaṇaḥ saparīvāraḥ saha tābhyāṃ sahomayā
samalokānvibhidyemānbhagavānnīlalohitaḥ / bhūrādyabrahmalokāntaṃ bhittvāṇḍaṃ parataḥ param
śaivaṃ padam ajaṃ divyam āviśat saha tairvibhuḥ / na tatra vāyur nākāśaṃ nāgnistatra na bhūtalam
yatra saṃtiṣṭhe deva umayā saha śaṅkaraḥ / na sūryo na grahāstatra na ṛkṣāṇi diśastathā
na lokapālā na sukhaṃ na ca duḥkhaṃ nṛpottama
brāhmaṃ padaṃ yatkavayo vadanti śaivaṃ padaṃ yatkavayo vadanti / kṣetrajñamīśaṃ pravadanti cānye sāṃkhyāśca gāyanti kilādimokṣam
yadbrahma ādyaṃ pravadanti kecidyaṃ sarvamīśānamajaṃ purāṇam / tam ekarūpaṃ tam anekarūpam arūpam ādyaṃ param avyayākhyam
avarṇamapyartham anāmagotraṃ turyaṃ padaṃ yatkavayo vadanti / dhyānārthavijñānamayaṃ susūkṣmam ātmastham īśānavaraṃ vareṇyam
tatastrayaste bhagavantamīśaṃ samprāpya saṃkṣipya bhavantyarthakam / pṛthaksvarūpaistu punasta eva jagat samastaṃ paripālayanti
saṃhāraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ rudratve kurute prabhuḥ / viṣṇutve pālayellokānbrahmatve sṛṣṭikārakaḥ
prakṛtyā saha saṃyuktaḥ kālo bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ / viśvarūpā mahābhāgā tasya pārśve vyavasthitā
yāmāhuḥ prakṛtiṃ tajjñāḥ padārthānāṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ / puruṣatve prakṛtitve ca kāraṇaṃ parameśvaraḥ
tasmād etajjagatsarvaṃ carācaram / tasminneva layaṃ yāti yugānte samupasthite
bhagaliṅgāṅkitaṃ sarvaṃ vyāptaṃ vai parameṣṭhinā / bhagarūpo bhavedviṣṇurliṅgarūpo maheśvaraḥ
bhāti sarveṣu lokeṣu gīyate bhūrbhuvādiṣu / praviṣṭaḥ sarvabhūteṣu tena viṣṇurbhagaḥ smṛtaḥ
viśanādviṣṇurityuktaḥ sarvadevamayo mahān / bhāsanādgamanāccaiva bhagasaṃjñā prakīrtitā
brahmādistambaparyantaṃ yasminneti layaṃ jagat / ekabhāvaṃ samāpannaṃ liṅgaṃ tasmād vidurbudhāḥ
mahādevastato devīmāha pārśve sthitāṃ tadā / saṃharasva jagatsarvaṃ mā vilambasva śobhane
tyaja saumyamidaṃ rūpaṃ sitacandrāṃśunirmalam / rudraṃ rūpaṃ samāsthāya saṃharasva carācaram
raudrairbhūtagaṇairghorairdevi tvaṃ parivāritā / jīvalokamimaṃ sarvaṃ bhakṣayasvāmbujekṣaṇe
tato 'haṃ mardayiṣyāmi plāvayiṣye tathā jagat / kṛtvā caikārṇavaṃ bhūyaḥ sukhaṃ svapsye tvayā saha
śrīdevyuvāca: nāhaṃ deva jagaccaitatsaṃharāmi mahādyute / ambā bhūtvā viceṣṭaṃ na bhakṣayāmi bhṛśāturam
strīsvabhāvena kāruṇyaṃ karoti hṛdayaṃ mama / kathaṃ vai nirdahiṣyāmi jagad etajjagatpate
tasmāt tvaṃ svayamevedaṃ jagatsaṃhara śaṅkara / athaivamuktastāṃ devīṃ dhūrjaṭirnīlalohitaḥ
kruddho nirbhartsayāmāsa huṅkāreṇa maheśvarīm / oṃ huṃphaṭ tvaṃ sa ityāha kopāviṣṭair athekṣaṇaiḥ
huṃkāritā viśālākṣī pīnorujaghanasthalā / tatkṣaṇāccābhavadraudrā kālarātrīva bhārata
huṃkurvatī mahānādairnādayantī diśo daśa / vyavardhata mahāraudrā vidyutsaudāminī yathā
vidyutsampātaduṣprekṣyā vidyutsaṃghātacañcalā / vidyujjvālākulā raudrā vidyudagninibhekṣaṇā
muktakeśī viśālākṣī kṛśagrīvā kṛśodarī / vyāghracarmāmbaradharā vyālayajñopavītinī
vṛścikairagnipuñjābhair gonasaiśca vibhūṣitā / trailokyaṃ pūrayāmāsa vistāreṇocchrayeṇa ca
bhāsurāṅgā tu saṃvṛttā kṛṣṇasarpaikakuṇḍalā / citradaṇḍodyatakarā vyāghracarmopasevitā
vyavardhata mahāraudrā jagatsaṃhārakāriṇī / sṛkkiṇī lelihānā ca krūraphūtkārakāriṇī
vyāttāsyā ghurghurārāvā jagatsaṃkṣobhakāriṇī / kheladbhūtānugā krūrā niḥśvāsocchvāsakāriṇī
jātāṭṭaahāsā durnāsā vahnikuṇḍasamekṣaṇā / prodyatkilakilārāvā dadāha sakalaṃ jagat
dahyamānāḥ surāstatra patanti dharaṇītale / patanti yakṣagandharvāḥ sakinnaramahoragāḥ
patanti bhūtasaṅghāśca hāhāhaihaivirāviṇaḥ / bumbāpātaiḥ sanirghātair uditārtasvarairapi
vyāptam āsīt tadā viśvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram / saṃpatadbhiḥ patadbhiśca jvaladbhūtagaṇairmahī
jātaiścaṭacaṭāśabdaiḥ patadbhirgirisānubhiḥ / tatra raudrotsave jātā rudrānandavivardhinī
vihiṃsamānā bhūtāni carvamāṇācarānapi / tattadgandham upādāya śivārāvavirāviṇī
galacchoṇitadhārābhimukhā digdhakalevarā / caṇḍaśīlābhavaccaṇḍī jagatsaṃhārakarmaṇi
ye 'pi prāptā maharlokaṃ bhṛgvādyāśca maharṣayaḥ / te 'pi naśyanti śataśo brahmakṣattraviśādayaḥ
devāsurā bhayatrastāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ / viśanti ke'pi pātālaṃ līyante ca guhādiṣu
sā ca devī diśaḥ sarvā vyāpya mṛtyur iva sthitā / yugakṣayakare kāle devena viniyojitā
ekāpi navadhā jātā daśadhā daśadhā tathā / catuḥṣaṣṭisvarūpā ca śatarūpāṭṭahāsinī
jajñe sahasrarūpā ca lakṣakoṭitanuḥ śivā / nānārūpāyudhākārā nānāvādanacāriṇī
evaṃrūpā 'bhavaddevī śivasyānujñayā nṛpa / dikṣu sarvāsu gagane vikaṭāyudhaśīlinaḥ
rundhanto naśyamānāṃstāngaṇā māheśvarāḥ sthitāḥ / vicaranti tayā sārddhaṃ śūlapaṭṭiśapāṇayaḥ
tato mātṛgaṇāḥ kecidvināyakagaṇaiḥ saha / vyavardhanta mahāraudrā jagatsaṃhārakāriṇaḥ
tatastasyā vyavardhanta daṃṣṭrāḥ kundendusannibhāḥ / yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi ayutānyarbudāni ca
daṃṣṭrāvaliḥ kararuhāḥ krūrāstīkṣṇāśca karkaśāḥ / viyaddiśo likhantyeva saptadvīpāṃ vasuṃdharām
tasyā daṃṣṭrābhisampātaiścūrṇitā vanaparvatāḥ / śilāsaṃcayasaṃghātā viśīryate sahasraśaḥ
himavānhemakūṭaśca niṣadho gandhamādanaḥ / mālyavāṃścaiva nīlaśca śvetaścaiva mahāgiriḥ
merumadhyamilāpīṭhaṃ saptadvīpaṃ ca sārṇavam / lokālokena sahitaṃ prākampata nṛpottama
daṃṣṭrāśanivispṛṣṭāśca viśīryante mahādrumāḥ / utpātaiśca diśo vyāptā ghorarūpaiḥ samantataḥ
tārā grahagaṇāḥ sarve ye ca vaimānikā gaṇāḥ / śivāsahasrair ākīrṇā mahāmātṛgaṇaistathā
sā cacāra jagat kṛtsnaṃ yugānte samupasthite / bhramadbhiśca bruvadbhiśca krośadbhiśca samantataḥ
pramathadbhir jvaladbhiśca raudrairvyāptā diśo daśa / vistīrṇaṃ śailasaṅghātaṃ vighūrṇitagiridrumam
prabhinnagopuradvāraṃ keśaśuṣkāsthisaṃkulam / pradagdhagrāmanagaraṃ bhasmapuṃjābhisaṃvṛtam
citādhūmākulaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram / hāhākārākulaṃ sarvamahahasvananisvanam
jagad etad abhūt sarvamaśaraṇyaṃ nirāśrayam

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye kalpānukathane kālarātrikṛtajagatsaṃharaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 15 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato mātṛsahasraiśca raudraiśca parivāritā / kālarātrir jagatsarvaṃ harate dīptalocanā
tatastā mātaro ghorā brahmaviṣṇuśivātmikāḥ / vāyvindrānalakauberā yamatoyeśaśaktayaḥ
skandakroḍanṛsiṃhānāṃ vicarantyo bhayānakāḥ / cakraśūlagadākhaḍgavajraśaktyṛṣṭipaṭṭiśaiḥ
khaṭvāṅgairulmukairdīptairvyacaranmātaraḥ kṣaye / umāsaṃnoditā sarvāḥ pradhāvantyo diśo daśa
tāsāṃ caraṇavikṣepair huṅkārodgāranisvanaiḥ / trailokyametatsakalaṃ vipradagdhaṃ samantataḥ
hāhāravākranditanisvanaiśca prabhinnarathyāgṛhagopuraiśca / babhūva ghorā dharaṇī samantāt kapālakośākulakarburāṅgī
yadetacchatasāhasraṃ jambūdvīpaṃ nigadyate / sarvameva tad ucchannaṃ samādhṛṣya nṛpottama
jambuṃ śākaṃ kuśaṃ krauñcaṃ gomedaṃ śālmalistathā / puṣkaradvīpasahitā ye ca parvatavāsinaḥ
te grastā mṛtyunā sarve bhūtairmātṛgaṇaistathā / mahāsurakapālaiśca māṃsamedovasotkaṭaiḥ
rudhirodgāraśoṇāṅgī mahāmāyā subhīṣaṇā / pibantī rudhiraṃ tatra mahāmāṃsavasāpriyā
kapālahastā vikaṭā bhakṣayantī surāsurān / nṛtyantī ca hasantī ca viparītā mahāravā
trailokyasaṃtrāsakarī vidyutsaṃsphoṭahāsinī / saptadvīpasamudrāntāṃ bhakṣayitvā ca medinīm
tataḥ svasthānamagamadyatra devo maheśvaraḥ / narmadātīram āśrityāvasanmātṛgaṇaiḥ saha
amarāṇāṃ kaṭe tuṅge nṛtyantī hasitānanā / amarā devatāḥ proktāḥ śarīraṃ kaṭamucyate
taiḥ kaṭairāvṛto yasmāt parvato 'yaṃ nṛpottama / chinnabhinnāsthinikarair vasāmedo'sraviplutaiḥ
amaraṃkaṭa ityevaṃ tena prokto manīṣibhiḥ / mahāpavitro lokeṣu śambhunā sa vinirmitaḥ
nityaṃ saṃnihitastatra śaṅkaro hyumayā saha / tato 'haṃ niyatastatra tasya pādāgrasaṃsthitaḥ
prahvaḥ praṇatabhāvena staumi taṃ nīlalohitam / tatas tālakasampātair gaṇair mātṛgaṇaiḥ saha
saṃpranṛtyati saṃhṛṣṭo mṛtyunā saha śaṅkaraḥ / khaṭvāṅgairulmukaiścaiva paṭṭiśaiḥ parighais tathā
māṃsamedovasāhastā hṛṣṭā nṛtyanti saṃghaśaḥ / vāmanā jaṭilā muṇḍā lambagrīvoṣṭhamūrddhajāḥ
mahāśiśnodarabhujā nṛtyanti ca hasanti ca / vikṛtairānanair ghorair arbhujolbaṇamukhādibhiḥ
amaraṃ kaṇṭakaṃ cakruḥ prāpte kālaviparyaye / teṣāṃ madhye mahāghoraṃ jagatsantrāsakāraṇam
mṛtyuṃ paśyāmi nṛtyantaṃ taḍitpiṅgalamūrddhajam / tasya pārśve sthitāṃ devīṃ vimalāmbarabhūṣitām
kuṇḍalodghuṣṭagaṇḍāṃ tāṃ nāgayajñopavītinīm / vicitrairupahāraiśca pūjayantīṃ maheśvaram
apaśyaṃ narmadāṃ tatra mātaraṃ viśvavanditām / nānātaraṅgāṃ sāvartāṃ suvelārṇavasaṃnibhām
mahāsaraḥsaritpātair adṛśyāṃ dṛśyarūpiṇīm / vandyamānāṃ suraiḥ siddhairmunisaṅghaiśca bhārata
etasminnantare ghorāṃ saptasaptakasaṃjñitām / mahāvīcyaughaphenāḍhyāṃ kurvantīṃ sajalaṃ jagat
dṛṣṭavānnarmadāṃ devīṃ mṛgakṛṣṇāmbarāṃ punaḥ / sadhūmāśaninirhrādair vahantīṃ saptadhā tadā
iti saṃhāramatulaṃ dṛṣṭavānrājasattama / naṣṭacandrārkakiraṇam abhūd etaccarācaram
mahotpātasamudbhūtaṃ naṣṭanakṣatramaṇḍalam / alātacakravat tūrṇam aśeṣaṃ bhrāmayaṃstataḥ
vimānakoṭisaṃkīrṇaḥ sa kiṃnaramahoragaḥ / mahāvātaḥ sanirghāto yenākampaccarācaram
rudravaktrātsamudbhūtaḥ saṃvarto nāma viśrutaḥ / vāyuḥ saṃśoṣayāmāsa vitatan saptasāgarān
uddhūlitāṅgaḥ kapilākṣamūrddhajo jaṭākalāpair avabaddhamūrddhajaḥ / mahāravo dīptaviśālaśūladhṛksa pātu yuṣmāṃśca dine dine haraḥ
śūlī dhanuṣmānkavacī kirīṭī śmaśānabhasmokṣitasarvagātraḥ / kapālamālākulakaṇṭhanālo mahāhisūtrairavabaddhamauliḥ
sa gonasaughaiḥ pariveṣṭitāṅgo viṣāgnicandrāmarasindhumauliḥ / pinākakhaṇṭūvāṅgakarālapāṇiḥ sa kṛttivāsā ḍamarupraṇādaḥ
sa saptalokāntaraniḥsṛtātmā mahabhujāveṣṭitasarvagātraḥ / netreṇa sūryodayasannibhena pravālakāṅkūranibhodareṇa
sandhyābhraraktotpalapadmarāgasindūravidyutprakarāruṇena / tatena liṅgena ca locanena cikrīḍamānaḥ sa yugāntakāle
hiraṇmayenaiva samutsṛjan sa daṇḍena yadvad bhagavān sameruḥ / pādāgravikṣepaviśīrṇaśailaḥ kurvañjagat so 'pi jagāma tatra
saṃhartukāmastridivaṃ tvaśeṣaṃ pramuñcamāno vikṛtāṭṭahāsam / jahāra sarvaṃ tridivaṃ mahātmā saṃkṣobhayanvai jagadīśa ekaḥ
taṃ devamīśānamajaṃ vareṇyaṃ dṛṣṭvā jagatsaṃharaṇaṃ maheśam / sā kālarātriḥ saha mātṛbhiśca gaṇāśca sarve śivamarcayanti
nandī ca bhṛṅgī ca gaṇādayaśca taṃ sarvabhūtaṃ praṇamanti devam / jāgadvaraṃ sarvajanasya kāraṇaṃ haraṃ smarārātim aharniśaṃ te

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye sṛṣṭisaṃharaṇasaṃrambhavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 16 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: samātṛbhirbhūtagaṇaśca ghorairvṛtaḥ samantātsa nanarta śūlī / gajendracarmāvaraṇe vasānaḥ saṃhartukāmaśca jagatsamastam
maheśvaraḥ sarvasureśvarāṇāṃ mantrair anekekhabaddhamālī / medovasāraktavicarcitāṅgastrailokyadāhe praṇanarta śambhuḥ
sa kālarātryā sahito mahātmā kāle trilokīṃ sakalāṃ jahāra / saṃvartakākhyaḥ sahabhānubhāvaḥ śambhurmahātmā jagato variṣṭhaḥ
sa visphuliṅgotkaradhūmamiśraṃ maholkavajrāśanivātatulyam / tato 'ṭṭahāsaṃ pramumoca ghoraṃ vivṛtya vaktraṃ vaḍavāmukhābham
sahasravajrāśanisaṃnibhena tenāṭṭahāsena harodgatena / āpūritāstatra diśo daśaiva saṃkṣobhitāḥ sarvamahārṇavāśca
sa brahmalokaṃ prajagāma śabdo brahmāṇḍabhāṇḍaṃ pracacāla sarvam / kimetadityākulacetanāste vitrastarūpā ṛṣayo babhūvuḥ
praṇamya sarve sahasaiva bhītā brahmāṇamūcuḥ parameśvareśam / bhītāśca sarve ṛṣayastataste surāsuraiścaiva mahoragaiśca
vidyutprabhābhāsurabhīṣaṇāṅgaḥ ka eṣa cikrīḍati bhūtalasthaḥ / kālānalaṃ gātramidaṃ dadhāno yasyāṭṭahāsena jagadvimūḍham
vitrastarūpaṃ prababhau kṣaṇena saṃhartumicchetkimayaṃ trilokīm / sārdhaṃ tvayā saptabhirarṇakaiśca janastapaḥ satyamabhiprayāti
saṃhartukāmo hi ka eṣa deva etatsamastaṃ kathayāprameya / na dṛṣṭametad viṣamaṃ kadāpi jānāsi tattvaṃ paramo mato naḥ
niśamya tadvākyamathābabhāṣe brahmā samāśvāsya surādisaṅghān
śrībrahmovāca: sa eṣa kālastridivaṃ tvaśeṣaṃ saṃhartukāmo jagadakṣayātmā / pūrṇe ca śete parivatsarāṇāṃ bhaviṣyatīśānavibhurna citram
saṃvatsaro 'yaṃ parivatsaraśca udvatsaro vatsara eṣa devaḥ / dṛṣṭo 'pyadṛṣṭaḥ prahutaḥ prakāśī sthūlaśca sūkṣmaḥ paramāṇureṣaḥ
nātaḥ paraṃ kiṃcidihāsti loke parāparo 'yaṃ prabhurātmavādī / tuṣyeta me kālasamānarūpa ityevamuktvā bhagavānsureśaḥ
sanatkumārapramukhaiḥ sametaḥ saṃtoṣayāmāsa tato yatātmā
brahmovāca: namo 'stu sarvāya suśāntamūrtāye hyaghorarūpāya namonamaste / sarvātmane sarva namonamaste mahātmane bhūtapate namaste
oṅkāra huṅkārapariṣkṛtāya svadhāvaṣaṭkāra namonamaste / guṇatrayeśāya maheśvarāya te trayīmayāya triguṇātmane namaḥ
tvaṃ śaṅkaratvaṃ hi maheśvaro 'si pradhānamagryaṃ tvamasi praviṣṭaḥ / tvaṃ viṣṇurīśaḥ prapitāmahaśca tvaṃ saptajihvastvamanantajihvaḥ
sraṣṭāsi sṛṣṭiśca vibho tvameva viśvasya vedyaṃ ca paraṃ nidhānam / āhurdvijā vedavido vareṇyaṃ parātparastvaṃ parataḥ paro 'si
sūkṣmātisūkṣmaṃ pravadanti yacca vāco nivartanti mano yataśca
śrīmahādeva uvāca: tvayā stuto'haṃ vividhaiśca mantraiḥ puṣṇāmi śāntiṃ tava padmayone / īkṣasva māṃ lokamimaṃ jvalantaṃ vaktrairanekaiḥ prasabhaṃ harantam
evamuktvā sa deveśo devyā saha jagatpatiḥ / pitāmahaṃ samāśvāsya tatraivāntaradhīyata
idaṃ mahatpuṇyatamaṃ variṣṭhaṃ stotraṃ niśamyeha gatiṃ labhante / pāpairanekaiḥ pariveṣṭitā ye prayānti rudraṃ vimalairvimānaiḥ
bhayaṃ ca teṣāṃ na bhavetkadācitpaṭhanti ye tāta idaṃ dvijāgryāḥ / saṅgrāmacaurāgnivane tathābdhau teṣāṃ śivastrāti na saṃśayo 'tra

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye brahmakṛtaśivastutivarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 17 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: evaṃ saṃstūyamānastu brahmādyair munipuṃgavaiḥ / brahmalokagataistatra saṃjahāra jagatprabhuḥ
sa tadbhīmaṃ mahāraudraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ vaktramavyayam / mahādaṃṣṭrotkaṭārāvaṃ pātālatalasaṃnibham
vidyujjvalanapiṅgākṣaṃ bhairavaṃ lomaharṣaṇam / mahājihvaṃ mahādaṃṣṭraṃ mahāsarpaśirodharam
mahāsuraśiromālaṃ mahāpralayakāraṇam / grasatsamudranihitavātavārimayaṃ haviḥ
vaḍavāmukhasaṅkāśaṃ mahādevasya tanmukham / jihvāgreṇa jagatsarvaṃ lelihānamapaśyata
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi sahasrāṇāṃ śatāni ca / diśo daśa mahāghorā māṃsamedovasotkaṭāḥ
tasya daṃṣṭrā vyavardhata śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ / sāsurānsuragandharvān sayakṣoragarākṣasān
tasya daṃṣṭrāgrasaṃlagnānsa dadarśa pitāmahaḥ / dantayantrāntasaṃviṣṭaṃ vicūrṇitaśirodharam
jagat paśyāmi rājendra viśantaṃ vyādite mukhe / nānātaraṅgabhaṅgāṅgā mahāphenaughasaṃkulāḥ / yathā nadyo layaṃ yānti samudraṃ prāpya sasvanāḥ
tathā tataṃ viśvamidaṃ samastamanekajīvārṇavadurvigāhyam / viveśa rudrasya mukhaṃ viśālaṃ jvalattadugraṃ ghananādaghoram
jvālāstatastasya mukhātsughorāḥ savisphuliṅgā bahulāḥ sadhūmāḥ / anekarūpā jvalanaprakāśāḥ pradīpayantīva diśo 'khilāśca
tato ravijvālasahasramāli babhūva vaktraṃ calajihvadaṃṣṭram / maheśvarasyādbhutarūpiṇas tadā sa dvādaśātmā prababhūva ekaḥ
tataste dvādaśādityā rudravaktrādvinirgatāḥ / āśritya dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ nirdahanto vasuṃdharām
