gṛhītvā tāṃ tadā rakṣo 'bhyarcyamāno niśācaraiḥ / devodyāne vimānaiśca krīḍate sa tayā saha
kenacittvatha kālena rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ / putraṃ putravatāṃ śreṣṭho janayāmāsa bhārata
tenaiva jātamātreṇa rāvo mukto mahātmanā / saṃvartakasya meghasya tena lokā jaḍīkṛtāḥ
śrutvā tannarditaṃ ghoraṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / nāma cakre tadā tasya meghanādo bhaviṣyati
evaṃnāmā kṛtaḥ so 'pi paramaṃ vratamāsthitaḥ / toṣayāmāsa deveśamumayā saha śaṅkaram
vratairniyamadānaiśca homajāpyavidhānataḥ / kṛcchracāndrāyaṇairnityaṃ kṛśaṃ kurvankalevaram
evam anyaddine tāta kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam / gatvā liṅgadvayaṃ gṛhya prasthito dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ
narmadātaṭam āśritya snātukāmo mahābalaḥ / nikṣipya pūjayan devaṃ kṛtajāpyo nareśvara
tatrāyatanāvāsena snāto hutahutāśanaḥ / kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ mānayitvā niśācaraḥ
gantukāmaḥ paraṃ mārgaṃ laṅkāyāṃ nṛpasattama / ekamuddharato liṅgaṃ praṇataḥ savyapāṇinā
dvitīyaṃ tu dvitīyena bhaktyā paulastyanandanaḥ / tāvad eva mahāliṅgaṃ patitaṃ narmadāṃbhasi
yāhi yāhīti cetyuktvā jalamadhye pratiṣṭhitaḥ / namitvā rāvaṇistasya devasya parameṣṭhinaḥ
jagāmākāśam āviśya pūjyamāno niśācaraiḥ / tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ meghanādeti viśrutam
pūrvaṃ tu garjanaṃ nāma sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram / tasmiṃstīrthe tu rājendra yastu snānaṃ samācaret
ahorātroṣito bhūtvā aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet / piṇḍadānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa
yatphalaṃ sattrayajñena tadbhavennātra saṃśayaḥ / tena dvādaśavarṣāṇi pitaraḥ saṃpratarpitāḥ
yastu bhojayate vipraṃ ṣaḍrasātrena bhārata / akṣayapuṇyam āpnoti tatra tīrthe narottama
prāṇatyāgaṃ tu yaḥ kuryād bhāvito bhāvitātmanā / sa vasecchāṅkare loke yāvad ā bhūtasamplavam
eṣā te naraśārdūla garjanotpattiruttamā / kathitā snehabandhena sarvapāpakṣayakarī

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe meghanādatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 36 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchecca rājendra dārutīrthamanuttamam / dāruko yatra saṃsiddha indrasya dayitaḥ purā
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: dārukeṇa kathaṃ tāta tapaścīrṇaṃ purānagha / vidhānaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvatsakāśāddvijottama
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi vicitraṃ yatpurātanam / vṛttaṃ svargasabhāmadhye ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām
sūto vajradharasyeṣṭo mātalirnāma nāmataḥ / sa putraṃ śaptavānpūrvaṃ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare
śāpāhato vepamāna indrasya caraṇau śubhau / prapīḍya mūrdhnā deveśaṃ vijñāpayati bhārata
tamuvācābhiśaptaṃ cāpyanāthaṃ ca sureśvaraḥ / karmaṇā kena śāpasya ghorasyānto bhaviṣyati
narmadātaṭamāśritya toṣayanvai maheśvaram / tiṣṭha yāvad yugasyāntaṃ punarjanma hyavāpsyasi
punarbhūtvā tu pūtastvaṃ dāruko nāma viśrutaḥ / saṃsevya paramaṃ devaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam
mānuṣaṃ bhāvamāpannastataḥ siddhimavāpsyasi / evamuktastu devena sahasrākṣeṇa dhīmatā
praṇamya śirasā bhūmim āgato 'sau hyacetanaḥ / narmadātaṭamāśritya karṣayannijavigraham
vratopavāsasaṃkhinno japahomarataḥ sadā / mahādevaṃ mahātmānaṃ varadaṃ śūlapāṇinam
bhaktyā tu parayā rājanyāvadābhūtasamplavam / aṃśāvataraṇād viṣṇoḥ sūto bhūtvā mahāmatiḥ
toṣayan vai jagannāthaṃ tato yāto hi sadgatim
eṣa tatsambhavastāta dārutīrthasya suvrata / kathito 'yaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ yathā me śaṅkaro 'bravīt
tato yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śrutvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ / bhrātḥn vilokayāmāsa hṛṣṭaromā muhurmuhuḥ
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā vidhipūrvaṃ nareśvara / upāsya saṃdhyāṃ deveśamarcayedyaśca śaṅkaram
vedābhyāsaṃ tu tatraiva yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ / so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ rājaṃllabhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
tasmiṃstīrthe tu yo bhaktyā bhojayed brāhmaṇāñchuciḥ / sa tu viprasahasrasya labhate phalamuttamam
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam / yatkṛtaṃ śuddhabhāvena tatsarvaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dārukatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 37 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gaccheta rājendra devatīrthamanuttamam / yena devāstrayastriṃśat snātvā siddhiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kathaṃ tāta surāḥ sarve dānavairbalavattaraiḥ / nirjitāstatra tīrthe ca snātvā siddhiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: purā daityagaṇairugrairyuddhe 'tibalavattaraiḥ / indro devagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ svarājyāccyāvito nṛpa
hastyaśvarathayānaughairmardayitvā varūthinīm / vidhvastā bhejire mārgaṃ prahārair jarjarīkṛtāḥ
jambhaśumbhaiśca kūṣmāṇḍakuhakādibhiḥ / vepamānārditāḥ sarve brahmāṇamupatasthire
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam / tadā vijñāpayāmāsurdevā vahnipurogamāḥ
paśya paśya mahābhāga dānavaiḥ śakalīkṛtāḥ / viyojitāḥ putradāraistvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
paritrāyasva deveśa sarvalokapitāmaha / nānyā gatiḥ sureśāna tvāṃ muktvā parameśvara
brahmovāca: dānavānāṃ vighātārthaṃ narmadātaṭam āsthitāḥ / tapaḥ kurudhvaṃ svasthāḥ stha tapo hi paramaṃ balam
nānyopāyo na vai mantro vidyate na ca me kriyā / vinā revājalaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
dāridryavyādhimaraṇabandhanavyasanāni ca / etāni caiva pāpasya phalānīti matirmama
evaṃ jñātvā tataścaiva tapaḥ kuruta duṣkaram / tathā caiva surāḥ sarve devā hyagnipurogamāḥ
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tathyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ / narmadām āgatāḥ sarve devā hyagnipurogamāḥ
cerurvai tatra vipulaṃ tapaḥ siddhimavāpnuvan / tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ devatīrtham anuttamam
gīyate triṣu lokeṣu sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram / tatra gatvā ca yo martyo vidhinā saṃyatendriyaḥ
snānaṃ samācaredbhaktyā sa labhenmauktikaṃ phalam / yastu bhojayate viprāṃstasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa
sa labhenmukhyaviprāṇāṃ phalaṃ sāhasrikaṃ nṛpa / tatra devaśilā ramyā mahāpuṇyavivardhinī
saṃnyāsena mṛtā ye tu teṣāṃ syād akṣayā gatiḥ / agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃs tīrthe narādhipa
rudraloke vaset tāvad yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam / evaṃ snānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam
sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ vā 'pi tatra tīrthe 'kṣayaṃ bhavet / eṣa te vidhiruddiṣṭa utpattiścaiva bhārata
devatīrthasya nikhilā yathā vai śaṅkarācchrutā / paṭhanti ye pāpaharaṃ sarvaduḥkhavimocanam
devatīrthasya caritaṃ devalokaṃ vrajanti te

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe devatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 38 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gaccheta rājendra guhāvāsīti cottamam / yatra siddho mahādevo guhāvāsī samārbudam
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kena kāryeṇa bho tāta mahādevo jagadguruḥ / guhāyām anayatkālaṃ sudīrghaṃ dvijasattama
etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ kathayasva mamānagha / śrotumicchāmyahaṃ sarvaparaṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sādhu praśno mahārāja pṛṣṭo yo vai tvayottamaḥ / purāṇe vistaro hyasya na śakyo hi mayādhunā
kathituṃ vṛddhabhāvatvādatīto bahukālikaḥ / saṃkṣepāt tena te tāta kathayāmi nibodha me
purā kṛtayuge rājannāsīd dāruvanaṃ mahat / nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ nānāvallyupaśobhitam
siṃhavyāghravarāhaiśca gajaiḥ khaḍgairniṣevitam / bahupakṣiyutaṃ divyaṃ yathā caitrarathaṃ vanam
tatra kecin mahāprājñā vasanti saṃśitavratāḥ / vasanti parayā bhaktyā caturāśramabhāvitāḥ
brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho yatis tathā / svadharmaniratāḥ sarve vāñchantaḥ paramaṃ padam
tāvadvasantasamaye kasmiṃścit kāraṇāntare / vimānastho mahādevo gacchanvai hyumayā saha
dadarśa toya āvāsamṛksāmayajurnāditam / alakṣyāgatanirgamyaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
taṃ dṛṣṭvā muditā devī harṣagaṅgadayā girā / papraccha devadeveśaṃ śaśāṅkakṛtabhūṣaṇam
devyuvāca: kasyāyamāśramo deva vedadhvaninināditaḥ / yaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣutpipāsādyaiḥ śramaiśca parihīyate
maheśvara uvāca: kiṃ tvayā na śrutaṃ devi mahādāruvanaṃ mahat / bahuviprajano yatra gṛhadharmeṇa vartate
atra yaḥ strījanaḥ kaścid bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ / nānyo devo na vai dharmo jñāyate śailanandini
etacchrutvā paraṃ vākyaṃ devadevena bhāṣitam / kautūhalasamāviṣṭā śaṅkaraṃ punarabravīt
yattvayoktaṃ mahādeva patidharmaratāḥ striyaḥ / tāsāṃ tvaṃ madano bhūtvā cāritraṃ kṣobhaya prabho
īśvara uvāca: yattvayoktaṃ ca vacanaṃ na hi me rocate priye / brāhmaṇā hi mahadbhūtaṃ na caiṣāṃ vipriyaṃ caret
manyupraharaṇā viprāścakrapraharaṇo hariḥ / cakrātkrūrataro manyus tasmād vipraṃ na kopayet
na te devā na te lokā na te nagā na cāsurāḥ / dṛśyante triṣu lokeṣu ye tairdṛṣṭair na nāśitāḥ
teṣāṃ mokṣas tathā svargo bhūmirmartye phalāni ca / yeṣāṃ tuṣṭā mahābhāgā brāhmaṇāḥ kṣitidevatāḥ
evaṃ jñātvā mahābhāge asadgrāhaṃ parityaja / tatra loke viruddhaṃ vai kupyante yena vai dvijāḥ
devyuvāca: nāhaṃ te dayitā deva nāhaṃ te vaśavartinī / akṛtvādhaśva vai tāsāṃ mānaṃ surasupūjitam
lokaloke mahādeva aśakyaṃ nāsti te prabho / kriyatāṃ mama caivaikam etat kāryaṃ surottama
evamukto mahādevo devyā vākyahite rataḥ / kṛtvā kāpālikaṃ rūpaṃ yayau dāruvanaṃ prati
mahāhitajaṭājūṭaṃ niyamya śaśibhūṣaṇam / kaṇṭhatrāṇaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā dhārayan karṇakuṇḍale
vyāghracarmaparīdhāno mekhalāhārabhūṣitaḥ / nūpuradhvaninighoṣaiḥ kampayan vai vasuṃdharām
mahānūrddhvajaṭāmālī kṛttibhasmānulepanaḥ / kṛtvā haste kapālaṃ tu brahmaṇaśca mahātmanaḥ
mahāḍamarughoṣeṇa kampayan vai vasuṃdharām / prabhātasamaye prāpto mahādāruvanaṃ prati
tāvat puṇyajanaḥ sarvapuṣpapatraphalārthikaḥ / nirgato bahubhiḥ sārddhaṃ pavamānaḥ samantataḥ
tad dṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ rūpaṃ devasya bhārata / yuvatīnāṃ manas tāsāṃ kāmena kaluṣīkṛtam
śobhanaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvā api varāṅganāḥ / kledabhāvaṃ tato jagmurmudā dāruvanastriyaḥ
vikārā bahavastāsāṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahādbhutam / saṃjātā viprapatnīnāṃ tadā tāsu narottama
paridhānaṃ na jānanti kāścid dṛṣṭvā varāṅganāḥ / uttarīyaṃ tathā cānyā mahāmohasamanvitāḥ
keśabhāraparibhraṣṭā kācidevāsanotthitā / dātukāmā tadā bhaikṣyaṃ ceṣṭituṃ naiva cāśakat
kācid dṛṣṭvā mahādevaṃ rūpayauvanagarvitā / utsaṅge saṃsthitaṃ bālaṃ vismṛtā pāyitum stanam
kāmabāṇahatā cānyā bāhubhyāṃ pīḍya sustanau / niḥśvasantī tadā coṣṇaṃ na kiṃcit pratijalpati
evaṃ saṃkṣobhya taṃ sarvaṃ strījanaṃ parameśvaraḥ / jagāma tatra vai tāsāṃ kṣobhaṃ kṛtvā mahādbhutam
tāvat te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve bhramitvā kānanaṃ mahat / āgatāḥ svagṛhe dārān dadṛśuś ca hataujasaḥ
yāsāṃ pūrvatarā bhaktiḥ pātivratye patīnprati / calitāstā viditvāśu nirjagmurdvijasattamāḥ
saṃvidaṃ paramāṃ kṛtvā jñātvā devaṃ maheśvaram / kṣobhayitvā manastāsāṃ tataścādarśanaṃ gatam
krodhāviṣṭo dvijaḥ kaścid daṇḍamudyamya dhāvati / kalmāṣayaṣṭimanye ca tathānye darbhamuṣṭikām
itaścetaśca te sarve bhramitvā kānanaṃ nṛpa / ekībhūtvā mahātmāno vyājahruśca ruṣā giram
yad idaṃ ca hutaṃ kiṃcid guravas toṣitā yadi / tena satyena devasya liṅgaṃ patatu cottamam
āśramād āśramaṃ sarve na tyajāmo vidhikramāt / tena satyena devasya liṅgaṃ patatu bhūtale
evaṃ satyaprabhāvena triruktena dvijanmanām / śivasya paśyato liṅgaṃ patitaṃ dharaṇītale
hāhākāro mahānāsīllokāloke 'pi bhārata / devasya patite liṅge jagataśca mahākṣaye
patamānasya liṅgasya śabdo 'bhūcca sudāruṇaḥ / ulkāpātā diśāṃ hāhā bhūmikampāśca dāruṇāḥ
patanti parvatāgrāṇi śoṣaṃ yānti ca sāgarāḥ / devasya patite liṅge devā vimanaso 'bhavan
sametya sahitāḥ sarve brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam / kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve stuvanti vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ
tatas tuṣṭo jagannāthaś caturvadanapaṅkajaḥ / ārtānprāha surānsarvānmā viṣādaṃ gamiṣyatha
brahmaśāpābhibhūto 'sau devadevastrilocanaḥ / tuṣṭaistaistapasā yuktaiḥ punarmokṣaṃ gamiṣyati
etacchrutvā yayurdevā yathāgatamarindama / bhāvayitvā tataḥ sarve munayaścaiva bhārata
viśvāmitravasiṣṭhādyā jābāliratha kaśyapaḥ / sametya sahitāḥ sarve tamūcus tripurāntakam
brahmatejo hi balavaddvijānāṃ hi sureśvara / kṣāntiyuktastapastaptvā bhaviṣyasi gataklamaḥ
yataḥ kṣobhādṛṣīṇāṃ ca tadevaṃ liṅgamuttamam / patitaṃ te mahādeva na tatpūjyaṃ bhaviṣyati
na tacchreyo 'gnihotreṇa nāgniṣṭomena labhyate / prāpnuvanti ca yacchreyo mānavā liṅgapūjane
devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām / vacanena tu viprāṇām etat pūjyaṃ bhaviṣyati
brahmaviṣṇvindracandrāṇām etat pūjyaṃ bhaviṣyati / yatphalaṃ tava liṅgasya iha loke paratra ca
evamukto jagannāthaḥ praṇipatya dvijottamān / mudā paramayā yuktaḥ kṛtāñjalir abhāṣata
brāhmaṇā jaṅgamaṃ tīrthaṃ nirjalaṃ sārvakāmikam / yeṣāṃ vākyodakenaiva śudhyanti malino janāḥ
na tatkṣetraṃ na tattīrthamūṣaraṃ puṣkarāṇi ca / brāhmaṇe manyumutpādya yatra gatvā sa śudhyati
na tacchāstraṃ yanna viprapraṇītaṃ na tad dānaṃ yanna viprapradeyam / na tatsaukhyaṃ yannavipraprasādānna tadduḥkhaṃ yanna vipraprakopāt
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni gaṅgādyāḥ saritas tathā / ekasya vipravākyasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm
abhinandya dvijānsarvānanujñāto maharṣibhiḥ / tato 'gamat tadā devo narmadātaṭamuttamam
paramaṃ vratamāsthāya guhāvāsī samārbudam / tapaścacāra bhagavāñjapasnānarataḥ sadā
samāpte niyame tāta sthāpayitvā maheśvaram / vandyamānaḥ suraiḥ sārddhaṃ kailāsamagamat prabhuḥ
narmadāyās taṭe tena sthāpitaḥ parameśvaraḥ / tenaiva kāraṇenāsau narmadeśvara ucyate
yo 'rcayennarmadeśānaṃ yatir vai saṃjitendriyaḥ / snātvā caiva mahādevam aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
dadāti yaḥ pitṛbhyastu tilapuṣpakuśodakam / triḥsaptapūrvajāstasya svarge modanti pāṇḍava
yastu bhojayate viprāṃs tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa / pāyasaṃ ghṛtamiśraṃ tu sa labhet koṭijaṃ phalam
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira / dadāti toyamadhyasthaḥ so 'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet
aṣṭamyāṃvā caturdaśyāṃ nirāhāro vaset tu yaḥ / narmadeśvaramāsādya prāpnuyājjanmanaḥ phalam
agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa / tasya vyādhibhayaṃ na syāt saptajanmasu bhārata
anāśakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa / anivartikā gatis tasya rudraloke bhaviṣyati
eṣa te vidhir uddiṣṭas tasyotpattir narottama / purāṇe vihitā tāta saṃjñā tasya tu vistarāt
etaṃ kīrtayate yastu narmadeśvarasambhavam / bhaktyā śṛṇoti ca naraḥ so 'pi snānaphalaṃ labhet

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye narmadeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 39 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchecca rājendra kapilātīrthamuttamam / snānamātrānnaro bhaktyā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: āścaryabhūtaṃ lokeṣu kathitaṃ dvijasattama / narmadeśvaramāhātmyaṃ kāpilaṃ kathayasva me
yasmin kāle 'tha sambandhe utpannaṃ tīrtham uttamam / sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ jātaṃ kathaṃ prabho
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu vakṣye'dya te rājankapilātīrthamuttamam / yena te vismayaḥ sarvaḥ śrutvā gacchati bhārata
purā kṛtayugasyādau brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / utpādayitvā sakalaṃ bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham
japahomaparo bhaktyā kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā ca tiṣṭhati / jvalamānāt tu kapilā tāvat kuṇḍātsamutthitā
agnijvālojjvalaiḥ śṛṅgaistrinetrā supayasvinī / agnipūrṇā hyagnimukhā agnighrāṇāgnilocanā
agnikhurā hyagnipṛṣṭhā agnisarvāṅgasaṃsthitiḥ / sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇā ghaṇṭālalitaniḥsvanā
dṛṣṭvā tu tāṃ mahābhāgāṃ kapilāṃ kuṇḍamadhyagām / brahmā lokagurustāta praṇamyedam uvāca ha
namaste kapile puṇye sarvalokanamaskṛte / maṅgalye maṅgale devi triṣu lokeṣvanupame
tvaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ smṛtirmedhā tvaṃ dhṛtistvaṃ varānane / umādevīti vikhyātā tvaṃ satī nātra saṃśayaḥ
vaiṣṇavī tvaṃ mahādevī brahmāṇī tvaṃ varānane / kumārī tvaṃ mahābhāge bhaktiḥ śraddhā tathaiva ca
kālarātristu bhūtānāṃ kumārī parameśvarī / tvaṃ lavastvaṃ truṭiścaiva muhūrtaṃ lakṣameva ca
saṃvatsarastvaṃ māsastvaṃ kālastvaṃ ca kṣaṇastathā / nāsti kiṃcit tvayā hīnaṃ trailokye sacarācare
evaṃ stutā tu mānena kapilā parameṣṭhinā / tamuvāca mahābhāgaṃ prahṛṣya padmasambhavam
prasannā tava vākyena devadeva jagadguro / kiṃ karomi priyaṃ te 'dya brūhi sarvaṃ pitāmaha
brahmovāca: jagaddhitāya janitā mayā tvaṃ parameśvari / svargānmartyaṃ tato yāhi lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
sarvadevamayī tvaṃ tu sarvalokamayī tathā / vidhinā ye pradāsyanti teṣāṃ vāsastriviṣṭape
evamuktvā tato devī brahmāṇaṃ parameśvarī / vandyamānā suraiḥ siddhair ājagāma dharātalam
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: yadāyāteha sā tāta brāhmaṇo vacanācchubhā / tadā devāśca lokāśca kathamaṅgeṣu saṃsthitāḥ
kathaṃ vā saṃsthitāgatya kapilā sā dvijottama / tīrthe vā hyūṣare kṣetra etanme kathaya dvija
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sā tadā brahmaṇā coktā dhātrā lokasya bhārata / brahmalokādgatā puṇyāṃ narmadāṃ lokapāvanīm
tapaḥ kṛtvā suvipulaṃ narmadātaṭam āśritā / cacāra pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ saśailavanakānanām
tadāprabhṛti rājendra kapilātīrtham uttamam / sarvapāpaharaṃ khyātamṛṣisaṅghair niṣevitam
tattīrthe vidhivat snātvā kapilāyāḥ prayacchati / pṛthvī tena bhaveddattā saśailavanakānanā
tāṃ tu paśyati yo bhaktyā dīyamānāṃ dvijottame / tasya varṣaśataṃ pāpaṃ naśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
bhūrbhuvaḥ svarmahaścaiva janaḥ satyaṃ tapastathā / te tatpṛṣṭhaṃ samāśritya sthitā lokā nṛpottama
mukhe hyagniḥ sthito devo danteṣu ca bhujaṅgamāḥ / dhātā vidhātā hyoṣṭhau ca jihvāyāṃ tu sarasvatī
sahasrakiraṇau devau candrādityau sulocanau / nāsikāmadhyagaścaiva māruto nṛpasattama
lalāṭe tu mahādevo hyaśvinau karṇasaṃsthitau / naranārāyaṇau śṛṅge śṛṅgamadhye pitāmahaḥ
kambalo 'dhigatas tāta pāśadhṛg varuṇas tathā / yamaśca bhagavāndeva āśritya codaraṃ śritaḥ
khureṣu pannagāścaivaṃ pucchāgre sūryaraśmayaḥ / evambhūtāṃ hi kapilāṃ sarvadevamayīṃ nṛpa
ye dhārayanti ca gṛhe dhanyāste nātra saṃśayaḥ / prātar utthāya yastasyāḥ kurute tu pradakṣiṇām
pradakṣiṇā kṛtā tena saśailavanakānanā / kapilāpañcagavyena yaḥ snāpayati śaṅkaram
upavāsaparo yastu tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa / snātvā hyuktavidhānena tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ
tasya te vaṃśajāḥ sarve daśa pūrve daśāpare / tṛptā rohanti vai svarge dhyāyanto 'sya manorathān
eṣa te vidhiruddiṣṭaḥ sambhavo nṛpasattama / tīrthasya ca phalaṃ puṇyaṃ kimanyat paripṛcchasi
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam / yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīnarmadāmāhātmye kapilātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 40 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra karañjeśvaram uttamam / yatra siddho mahābhāgo daityo lokeṣu viśrutaḥ
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: yo 'sau siddho mahābhāga tatra tīrthe mahātapāḥ / kasya putraḥ kathaṃ siddhaḥ kasminkāle vada dvija
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: purā kṛtayuge rājanmānaso brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ / vedavedāṅgatattvajño marīcirnāma nāmataḥ
tasyāpi tapaso rāśeḥ kālena mahatānagha / putro 'tha mānaso jātaḥ sākṣād brahmeva cāparaḥ
kṣamā damo dayā dānaṃ satyaṃ śaucam athārjavam / marīceśca guṇā hyete santi tasya ca bhārata
evaṃ guṇagaṇākīrṇaṃ kaśyapaṃ dvijasattamam / jñātvā prajāpatir dakṣo bhāryārthe svasutāṃ dadau
aditirditirdanuścaiva tathāpyevaṃ daśāparāḥ / yāsāṃ putrāśca saṃjātāḥ pautrāśca bharatarṣabha
aditirjanayāmāsa putrān indrapurogamān / jātāstasya mahābāho kaśyapasya prajāpateḥ
yaistu lokatrayaṃ vyāptaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ mahat / tathānyasya mahābhāgo danoḥ putro vyajāyata
sarvalakṣaṇasampannaḥ karañjo nāma nāmataḥ / bāla eva mahābhāga cacāra sa mahattapaḥ
narmadātaṭamāśritya cātighoram anuttamam / divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca kṛcchracāndrāyaṇaṃ nṛpa
śākamūlaphalāhāraḥ snānahomaparāyaṇaḥ / tatastuṣṭo mahādeva umayā sahitaḥ kila
vareṇa chandayāmāsa tripurāntakaraḥ prabhuḥ / bhoḥ karañja mahāsattva parituṣṭo 'smi te 'nagha
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva te dadmi hyamaratvamṛte mama
karañja uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva yadi deyo varo mama / tarhi putrāśca pautrāśca santu me dharmavatsalāḥ
tathetyuktvā mahādeva umayā sahitas tadā / vṛṣārūḍho gaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata
gate cādarśanaṃ deve so 'pi daityo mudānvitaḥ / svanāmnātra mahādevaṃ sthāpayitvā yayau gṛham
tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ sarvatīrtheṣvanuttamam / snānamātrānarastatra mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ / so 'gniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam
anāśakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa / anivartyā gatistasya rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
athavāgnijale prāṇānyastyajed dharmanandana / ayutadvitayaṃ vaste varṣāṇāṃ śivamandire
tataścaiva kṣaye jāte jāyate vimale kule / vedavedāṅgatattvajñaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ
rājā vā rājatulyo vā jīvecca śaradaḥ śatam / putrapautrasamopetaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ
evaṃ te sarvamākhyātaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ yadyattvayānagha / tīrthasya tu phalaṃ tasya snānadāneṣu bhārata
etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam / paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam
yastu śrāvayate śrāddhe paṭhet pitṛparāyaṇaḥ / akṣayaṃ jāyate puṇyamityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye karañjeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 41 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchecca rājendra kuṇḍaleśvaramuttamam / yatra siddho mahāyakṣaḥ kuṇḍadhāro nṛpottama
tapaḥ kṛtvā suvipulaṃ surāsurabhayaṃkaram / paulastyamandire caiva cikrīḍa nṛpasattama
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kasminyuge samutpannaḥ kasya putro mahāmatiḥ / tapastaptvā suvipulaṃ toṣito yena śaṅkaraḥ
etadvistaratastāta kathayasva mamānagha / śṛṇvataśca na tṛptir me kathāmṛtamanuttamam
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tretāyuge brahmasamaḥ paulastyonāma viśravāḥ / tapaḥ kṛtvā suvipulaṃ bharadvājasutodbhavaḥ
putraṃ pautragaṇair yuktaṃ patnyā bhaktyā sutoṣitaḥ / dhanadaṃ janayāmāsa sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam
jātamātraṃ tu taṃ jñātvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / cakāra nāma suprīta ṛṣidevasamanvitaḥ
yasmād viśravaso jāto mama pautratvam āgataḥ / tasmād vaiśravaṇo nāma tava dattaṃ mayānagha
tathā tvaṃ sarvadevānāṃ dhanagoptā bhaviṣyasi / caturtho lokapālānāmakṣayaścāvyayo bhuvi
tasya bhāryā mahārāja īśvarīti ca viśrutā / yakṣo yakṣādhipaḥ śreṣṭhastasya kuṇḍo 'bhavat sutaḥ
sa ca rūpaṃ paraṃ prāpya mātāpitroranujñayā / tapaś cacāra vipulaṃ narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ
grīṣme pañcāgnisaṃtapto varṣāsu sthaṇḍileśayaḥ / hemante jalamadhyastho vāyubhakṣaḥ śataṃ samāḥ
evaṃ varṣaśate pūrṇe ekāṅguṣṭhe 'bhavan nṛpa / asthibhūtaḥ paraṃ tāta ūrdhvabāhustataḥ param
atapacca ghṛtaśvāsaḥ kuṇḍalo bharatarṣabha / caturthe varṣaśatake tutoṣa vṛṣavāhanaḥ
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bho vatsa yatte manasi rocate / dadāmi te na sandehastapasā toṣito hyaham
kuṇḍala uvāca: yakṣādhipaprasādena tasyaivānucaraḥ pure / vicarāmi yathākāmamavadhyaḥ sarvaśatruṣu
tathetyuktvā mahādevaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ / jagāmākāśamāviśya kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam
gate cādarśanaṃ deve so 'pi yakṣo mudānvitaḥ / sthāpayāmāsa deveśaṃ kuṇḍaleśvaramuttamam
alaṃkṛtvā jagannāthaṃ puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ / vimānaiścāmaraiśchatrais tathā vai liṅgapūraṇaiḥ
tarpayitvā dvijānsamyagannapānādibhūṣaṇaiḥ / prīṇayitvā mahādevaṃ tataḥ svabhavanaṃ yayau
tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam / uttamaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ kuṇḍaleśvaranāmataḥ
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścid upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ / arcayed devamīśānaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi maṇiṃ mauktikameva ca / dadyād bhojyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sa sukhī modate divi
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā ṛgyajuḥsāmago 'pi vā / ṛcamekāṃ japitvā tu sakalaṃ phalamaśnute
gāṃ prayacchati viprebhyastatphalaṃ śṛṇu pāṇḍava / yāvanti tasyā romāṇi tatprasūtikuleṣu ca
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate / svarge vāso bhavettasya putrapautraiḥ samanvitaḥ
tāvanti varṣāṇi mahānubhāvaḥ svarge vaset putrapautraiśca sārddham / tatrānnado yāti maheśalokamasaṃkhyavarṣāṇi na saṃśayo 'tra
sa vai sukhī modate svargaloke gandharvasiddhāpsaraḥsampragīte / evaṃ tu te dharmasuta prabhāvastīrthasya sarvaḥ kathitaśca pārtha
śrutvā stuvanmucyate sarvapāpaiḥ punastrilokīm iha tatprabhāvāt

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye kuṇḍaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 42 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra pippaleśvaramuttamam / yatra siddho mahāyogī pippalādo mahātapāḥ
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: pippalādasya caritaṃ śrotumicchāmyahaṃ vibho / māhātmyaṃ tasya tīrthasya yatra siddho mahātapāḥ
kasya putro mahābhāga kimarthaṃ kṛtavāṃstapaḥ / etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ kathayasva mamānagha
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: mithilāstho mahābhāgo vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ / yājñavalkyaḥ purā tāta cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ
tāpasī tasya bhaginī yājñavalkyasya dhīmataḥ / sā saptame 'pi varṣe ca vaidhavyaṃ prāpa daivataḥ
pūrvakarmavipākena hīnābhūtpitṛmātṛtaḥ / nābhūttatpatipakṣe 'pi ko'pītyekākinī sthitā
bhūmau bhramantī bhrātuḥ sā samīpamagamacchanaiḥ / cacāra ca tapaḥ so 'pi paralokasukhepsayā
cacāra sāpi tatrasthā śuśrūṣantī mahattapaḥ / kasmiṃścit samaye sātha snātāhani rajasvalā
antarvāso dhṛtavatī dṛṣṭvā karpaṭakaṃ rahaḥ / yājñavalkyo 'pi tadrātrau supto yatra susaṃvṛtaḥ
svapnaṃ dṛṣṭvātyajacchukraṃ kaupīne raktabinduvat / virājitena tapasā siddhaṃ tadanalaprabham
yāvatprabuddho vipro 'sau vīkṣyocchiṣṭaṃ tad aṃśukam / cikṣepa dūrato 'spṛśyaṃ śaucaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ
niṣiddhaṃ tu niśi snānamiti suṣvāpa sa dvijaḥ / niśīthe sāpi tadvastraṃ bhagasyāvaraṇaṃ vyadhāt
prātar anveṣayāmāsa munirvastramitastataḥ / tataḥ sā brāhmaṇī prāha kiṃ anveṣayase prabho / kena kāryaṃ tava tathā vadasva mama tattvataḥ
yājñavalkya uvāca: apavitro mayā bhadre svapno dṛṣṭo 'dya vai niśi / sakledaṃ tatra me vastraṃ nikṣiptaṃ tanna dṛśyate
tacchrutvā brāhmaṇī vākyaṃ bhītabhītāvadan nṛpa / tadvastraṃ tu mayā vipra snātvā hyantaḥ kṛtaṃ mahat
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā hāhetyuktvā mahāmuniḥ / nipapāta tadā bhūmau chinnamūla iva drumaḥ
kimetaditi setyuktvā hyākāśamiva nirmalā / āśvāsayantī taṃ vipraṃ provāca vacanaṃ tadā
vadasva kāraṇaṃ tāta guhyād guhyataraṃ yadi / pratīkāro 'sya yenaiva vimṛśya kriyate tvarā
tataḥ sa suciraṃ dhyātvā labdhavāgvai tataḥ kṣaṇam / provāca sādhvasamanā yattacchṛṇu nareśvara
nātra doṣo 'sti te kaścinmama caiva śubhavrate / tavodare tu garbho yastatra daivaṃ parāyaṇam
tasya tattvena rakṣā ca tvayā kāryā sadaiva hi / vināśī naiva kartavyo yāvatkālasya paryayaḥ
tatheti vrīḍitā sādhvī dūyamānena cetasā / apālayacca taṃ garbhaṃ yāvatputro hyajāyata
jātamātraṃ ca taṃ garbhaṃ gṛhītvā brāhmaṇī ca sā / aśvatthacchāyām āśritya tam utsṛjya vaco 'bravīt
yāni sattvāni lokeṣu sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca / tāni sarvāṇi rakṣantu tyaktaṃ vai bālakaṃ mayā
evamuktvā gatā sā tu brāhmaṇī nṛpasattama / tathāgataḥ sa tu śiśus tatra sthitvā muhūrtakam
pāṇipādau vinikṣipya nikuñcya nayane śubhe / āsyaṃ tu vikṛtaṃ kṛtvā ruroda vikṛtaiḥ svaraiḥ
tena śabdena vitrastāḥ sthāvarā jaṅgamāśca ye / ākampitā mahotpātaiḥ saśailavanakānanā
tato jñātvā mahadbhūtaṃ kṣudhāviṣṭaṃ dvijarṣabham / na jahāti nagaśchāyāṃ pānārthāya tataḥ param / apibacca sutaṃ tasmādabhṛtaṃ caiva bhārata
evaṃ sa vardhitas tatra kumāro nijacetasi / cintayāmāsa viśrabdhaḥ kiṃ mama grahagocaram
tataḥ krūrasabhācāraḥ krūraṃ dṛṣṭvā nirīkṣitaḥ / papāta sahasā bhūmau śanaiścārī śanaiścaraḥ
uvāca ca bhayatrastaḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭastadā / kiṃ mayāpakṛtaṃ vipra pippalāda mahāmune
caranvai gaganād yena pātito dharaṇītale / sauriṇā hyevamuktastu pippalādo mahāmuniḥ
krodharūpo 'bravīdvākyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa / pitṛmātṛvihīnasya mama bālasya durmate / pīḍāṃ karoṣi kasmāt tvaṃ saure brūhi hyaśeṣataḥ
śanaiścara uvāca: krūrasvabhāvaḥ sahajo mama dṛṣṭistathedṛśī / muñcasva māṃ tathā kartā yadbravīṣi na saṃśayaḥ
pippalāda uvāca: adyaprabhṛti bālānāṃ varṣād ā ṣoḍaśādgraha / pīḍā tvayā na kartavyā eṣa te samayaḥ kṛtaḥ
evamastviti coktvā sa jagāma punarāgataḥ / devamārgaṃ śanaiścārī praṇamya ṛṣisattamam
gate cādarśanaṃ tatra so 'pi bālo mahāgrahaḥ / vicintayanvai pitaraṃ krodhena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ
āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ dhyātvā janayāmāsa pāvakam / kṛtyāmantrairjuhāvāgnau kṛtyā vai saṃbhavatviti
tāvajjhaṭiti sā kanyā jvālāmālāvibhūṣitā / hutabhuksadṛśākārā kiṃ karomīti cābravīt
śoṣayāmi samudrān kiṃ cūrṇayāmi ca parvatān / avaniṃ veṣṭayāmīti pātaye kiṃ nabhastalam
kasya mūrdhni patiṣyāmi ghātayāmi ca kaṃ dvija / śīghramādiśyatāṃ kāryaṃ mā me kālātyayo bhavet
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā pippalādo mahātapāḥ / krodhasaṃraktanayana idaṃ vacanam abravīt
mahatā krodhavegena mayā tvaṃ cintitā śubhe / pitā me yājñavalkyaśca tasya tvaṃ pata māciram
evamuktvāgamacchīghraṃ sphoṭayantī nabhastalam / mithilāstho mahāprājñastapastepe mahāmanāḥ
yāvatpaśyati digbhāgaṃ jvalanārkasamaprabham / yājñavalkyo mahātejā mahadbhūtamupasthitam
tad dṛṣṭvā sahasāyāntaṃ bhītabhīto mahāmuniḥ / anuyukto 'tha bhūtena janakaṃ nṛpatiṃ yayau
śaraṇyaṃ mām anuprāptaṃ viddhi tvaṃ nṛpasattama / mahadbhūtabhayādrakṣa yadi śaknoṣi pārthiva
brahmatejobhavaṃ bhūtamanivāryaṃ durāsadam / na ca śaknomyahaṃ trātuṃ rājā vacanam abravīt
tataścānyaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ śaraṇārthī mahātapāḥ / jagāma tena mukto 'sau cendrasya sadanaṃ bhayāt
devarāja namaste 'stu mahābhūtabhayānnṛpa / kampamāno 'bravīd vipro rakṣasveti punaḥpunaḥ
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devarājo 'bravīd idam / na śaknomi paritrātuṃ brahmakopādahaṃ mune
tataḥ sa brahmabhavanaṃ brāhmaṇo brahmavittamaḥ / jagāma viṣṇulokaṃ ca tenāpītyukta eva saḥ
tataḥ sa munirudvigno nirāśo jīvite nṛpa / anugamyamāno bhūtena agacchacchaṅkarālayam
tasya yogabalopeto mahādevasya pāṇḍava / nakhamāṃsāntare gupto yathā devo na paśyati
tadante cāgamadbhūtaṃ jvalanārkasamaprabham / muñca muñceti puruṣaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram
evamukto mahādevas tena bhūtena bhārata / yogīndraṃ darśayāmāsa nakhamāṃsāntare tadā
saṃsthāpya bhūtaṃ bhūteśaḥ paramāpadgataṃ munim / uvāca mā bhaistvaṃ vipra nirgacchasva mahāmune
tataḥ susūkṣmadehasthaṃ bhūtaṃ dṛṣṭvābravīdidam / kimasya tvaṃ mahābhūta kariṣyasi vadasva me
kṛtyovāca: krodhāviṣṭena deveśa pippalādena cintitā / asya dehaṃ haniṣyāmi hiṃsārthaṃ viddhi māṃ prabho
etacchrutvā mahādevo bhūtasya vadanāccyutam / kaṭisthaṃ yājñavalkyaṃ ca mantrayāmāsa mantravit
yogīśvareti viprasya kṛtvā nāma yudhiṣṭhira / visarjayitvā deveśastatraivāntaradhīyata
preṣayitvā tu taṃ bhūtaṃ pippalādo 'pi durmanāḥ / pitṛmātṛsamudvigno narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ
ekāṅguṣṭho nirāhāro varṣād ā ṣoḍaśān nṛpa / toṣayāmāsa deveśamumayā saha śaṅkaram
tatastattapasā tuṣṭaḥ śaṅkaro vākyamabravīt
īśvara uvāca: parituṣṭo 'smi te vipra tapasānena suvrata / varaṃ vṛṇīṣva te dadmi manasā cepsitaṃ śubham
pippalāda uvāca: yadi me bhagavāṃs tuṣṭo yadi deyo varo mama / atra saṃnihito deva tīrthe bhava maheśvara
evamuktastathetyuktvā pippalādaṃ mahāmunim / jagāmādarśanaṃ devo bhūtasaṅghasamanvitaḥ
pippalādo gate deve snātvā tatra mahāmbhasi / sthāpayitvā mahādevaṃ jagāmottaraparvatam
tatra tīrthe naro bhaktyā snātvā mantrayutaṃ nṛpa / tarpayitvā pitḥn devān pūjayecca maheśvaram
aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam / mṛto rudrapuraṃ yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
atha yo bhojayed viprān pitḥn uddiśya bhārata / tasya te dvādaśābdāni modante divi tarpitāḥ
saṃnyāsena tu yaḥ kaścit tatra tīrthe tanuṃ tyajet / anivartikā gatistasya rudralokāt kadācana
etatsarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭhe hi tvayānagha / māhātmyaṃ pippalādasya tīrthasyotpattireva ca
etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam / paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye pippalādatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 43 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra vimaleśvaram uttamam / tatra devaśilā ramyā svayaṃ devair vinirmitā
tatra snātvā tu yo bhaktyā brāhmaṇānpūjayen nṛpa / svalpenāpi hi dānena tasya cānto na vidyate
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kāni dānāni viprendra śastāni dharaṇītale / yāni dattvā naro bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ maṇimauktikameva ca / bhūmidānaṃ ca godānaṃ mocayat paśubhānnaram
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścitkurute prāṇasaṃkṣayam / rudraloke vaset tāvad yāvad ā bhūtasamplavam
tataḥ puṣkariṇīṃ gacchet sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarīm / tatra snātvārcayeddevaṃ tejorāśiṃ divākaram
ṛcamekāṃ japet sāmnaḥ sāmavedaphalaṃ labhet / yajurvedasya japanād ṛgvedasya tathaiva ca
akṣaraṃ vā japen mantraṃ dhyāyamāno divākaram / ādityahṛdayaṃ japtvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā vidhinā japeddvijān / tasya koṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
anāśakenāgnigatyā jale vā dehapātanāt / tasmiṃstīrthe mṛto yastu sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā nṛpasattama / vihitaṃ karma kurvāṇaḥ sa gacchet paramāṃ gatim
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: vyādhiṃ sattvakṣayaṃ mohaṃ jñātvā varṇā dvijottama / pāpebhyo vipramucyante kena tatsādhanaṃ vada
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tilodakī tilasnāyī kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ / brāhmaṇo 'naśanaiḥ prāṇāṃs tyajallabhati sadgatim
saṅgrāme sadgatiṃ tāta kṣatriyo nidhane labhet / tadabhāvānmahāprājña sevamāno labhed iti
vyādhigrahagṛhīto vā vṛddho vā vikalendriyaḥ / ātmānaṃ dāhayitvāgnau vidhinā sadgatiṃ labhet
vaiśyo 'pi hi tyajanprāṇānevaṃ vai śubhabhāg bhavet / jale vā śuddhabhāvena tyaktvā prāṇāñchivo bhavet
śūdro 'pi dvijaśuśrūṣustoṣayitvā maheśvaram / vimucya nānyathā pāpaḥ patate narake dhruvam
athavā praṇavāśakto dvijebhyo gurave tathā / pañcāgnau śoṣayeddehamāpṛcchya dvijasattamān
śāntadāntajitakrodhāñchāstrayuktān vicakṣaṇān / teṣāṃ caivopadeśena karīṣāgniṃ prasādhayet
evaṃ varṇā yathātvena mūḍhāhaṅkāramohitāḥ / patanti narake ghore yathāndho girigahvare
ye śāstravidhimutsṛjya vartante kāmacārataḥ / kṛmiyoniṃ prapadyante teṣāṃ piṇḍo na ca kriyā
śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmaṃ tyaktvā yathecchācārasevinaḥ / aṣṭāviṃśatirvai koṭyo narakāṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira
pratyekaṃ vā patantyete magnā narakasāgare / durlabhaṃ mānuṣaṃ janma bahudharmārjitaṃ nṛpa
tallabdhvā madamātsaryaṃ yo vai tyajati mānavaḥ / saṃniyamya sadātmānaṃ jñānacakṣur naro hi saḥ
ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāṃjanaśalākayā
yasya nonmīlitaṃ cakṣurjñeyo jātyandha eva saḥ / etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yatpṛṣṭaṃ nṛpasattama
tathāniṣṭatarāṇāṃ hi rudrasya vacanaṃ yathā / narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā rudradehād viniḥsṛtā
tārayet sarvabhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca / sarvadevādhidevena īśvareṇa mahātmanā
lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya mahāpuṇyāvatāritā / mānasaṃ vācikaṃ pāpaṃ snānānnaśyati karmajam
rudradehādviniṣkrāntā tena puṇyatamā hi sā / prātarutthāya yo nityaṃ bhūmimākramya bhaktitaḥ
etanmantraṃ japettāta snānasya labhate phalam / namaḥ puṇyajale devi namaḥ sāgaragāmini
namo'stu pāpanirmoce namo devi varānane
namo 'stu te ṛṣivarasaṅghasevite namo 'stu te trinayanadehaniḥsṛte / namo 'stu te sukṛtavatāṃ sadā vare namo 'stu te satatapavitrapāvani

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vimaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 44 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa / revāyā dakṣiṇe kūle nirmitaṃ śūlapāṇinā
mokṣārthaṃ mānavendrāṇāṃ nirmitaṃ nṛpasattama / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: śrutā me vividhā dharmāstīrthāni vividhāni ca / dānadharmāḥ samastāśca tvatprasādāddvijottama
anyacca śrotumicchāmi saṃsāraśchidyate yathā / punarāgamanaṃ nāsti mokṣaprāptirbhaved yathā
etadākhyāhi me sarvaṃ prasādād dvijasattama
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā tīrthāt tīrthāntaraṃ mahat / śrute yasya prabhāve tu mucyate cābdikādaghāt
vācikairmānasairvāpi śārīraiśca viśeṣataḥ / kīrtanāt tasya tīrthasya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
pañcakrośapramāṇaṃ tu tacca tīrthaṃ mahīpate / bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ prāṇināṃ pāpakarmiṇām
revāyā dakṣiṇe kūle parvato bhṛgusaṃjñitaḥ / tasya mūrdhni ca tattīrthaṃ sthāpitaṃ caiva śambhunā
śūlabhedeti vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu bhūpate / tatra sthitāśca ye vṛkṣāstīrthāccaiva caturdiśam
patitā nilayaṃ yānti rudrasya nātra saṃśayaḥ / mṛtāstatraiva ye kecij jantavo bhuvi pakṣiṇaḥ
te yānti paramaṃ lokaṃ tatra tīrthe na saṃśayaḥ / pātālān niḥsṛtā gaṅgā bhogavatītisaṃjñitā
niṣkrāntā śūlabhedāc ca sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī / yā sā gīrvāṇanāmnyanyā vahet puṇyā mahānadī
patitā kuṇḍamadhye tu yatra bhinnaṃ triśūlinā / śambhunā ca purā tāta utpādya ca sarasvatī
sā tatra patitā rājan prācīnāghavimocinī / bhāsvatyā tritayaṃ yatra śilā gīrvāṇasaṃjñitā
tatra tīrthe ca tattīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati / kedāraṃ ca prayāgaṃ ca kurukṣetraṃ gayā tathā
anyāni ca sutīrthāni kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm / pañca sthānāni tīrthāni pṛthagbhūtāni yāni ca
vakṣyāmi ca samāsena ekaikaṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak / gayā nābhyāṃ yathā puṇyā cakratīrthaṃ ca tatsamam
dharmāraṇye yathā kūpaṃ śūlabhedaṃ ca tatsamam / brahmayūpaṃ yathā puṇyaṃ devanadyāstathaiva ca
yathā gayāśiraḥ puṇyaṃ surāṇāṃ ca yathā śilā / yathā ca puṣkaraṃ sthānaṃ mārkaṇḍahrada eva ca
dattvā piṇḍodakaṃ tatra piṇḍāṇāṃ ca tathākṣayam / yas tatra kurute śrāddhaṃ toyaṃ pibati nityaśaḥ / mucyate sarvapāpaistu uragaḥ kañcukairiva / anindyānpūjayed viprān dambhakrodhavivarjitān
trayodaśadinaṃ dānaṃ trayodaśaguṇaṃ bhavet / abhyarcitaṃ suraṃ dṛṣṭvā gaṇanāthaṃ gajānanam
sarve vighnā vinaśyanti dṛṣṭvā kambalakṣetrapam
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā śūlapāṇiṃ maheśvaram
devasya pūrvabhāge tu umā pūjyā prayatnataḥ / mārkaṇḍeśaṃ tato bhaktyā pūjayed guhavāsinam
mucyante pātakaiḥ sarvair ajñānajñānasaṃcitaiḥ / guhāmadhye praviṣṭastu japet sūktaṃ tu tryakṣaram
nīlaparvatajaṃ puṇyaṃ ṣaṣṭhāṃśena labheta saḥ / trinarās tatra tiṣṭhanti sādityamarutaiḥ saha
sarvadevamayaṃ sthānaṃ koṭiliṅgamanuttamam / yathā nadīnadāḥ sarve sāgare yānti saṃkṣayam
tathā pāpāni naśyanti śūlabhedasya darśanāt / pratyakṣo dṛśyate 'dyāpi pratyayo hyavanīpate
visphuliṅgā liṅgamadhye spandante snānayogataḥ / dvitīyaḥ pratyayas tatra tailabindur na sarpati
evaṃ hi pratyayas tatra śūlabhedaprabhāvajaḥ / yaḥ smarecchūlabhedaṃ tu trikālaṃ nityameva ca
sa pūtaśca bhavetsākṣāt sabāhyābhyantaro nṛpa / na kasyacin mayā khyātaṃ pṛṣṭo 'haṃ tridaśairapi
guhyādguhyataraṃ tīrthaṃ sadā gopyaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā / sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvadoṣaghnamuttamam
sarvatīrthamayaṃ tīrthaṃ śūlabhedaṃ janeśvara / śrute yasya prabhāve tu mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
śūlabhedaṃ mayā tāta saṃkṣepāt kathitaṃ tava / yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedapraśaṃsāvarṇanaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|| rkv adhyāya 45 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: eṣa eva purā praśnaḥ paripṛṣṭo maheśvaram / rājñā cottānapādena ṛṣidevasamāgame
uttānapāda uvāca: idaṃ tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ param / guhyādguhyataraṃ sthānaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ hara
śūlabhedaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ kenaivotpāditaṃ purā / māhātmyaṃ tasya tīrthasya vistarācchaṃsa me prabho
īśvara uvāca: āsītpurā mahāvīryo dānavo baladarpitaḥ / martye na tādṛśaḥ kaścid vikrameṇa balena vā
sūnur brahmasutasyāyam andhako nāma durmadaḥ / nijasthāne vasan pāpaḥ kurvan rājyam akaṇṭakam
hṛṣṭapuṣṭo vasan martye sa surairnābhibhūyate / bhavanaṃ tasya pāpasya vahnerupavanaṃ yathā
etasminn andhakaḥ kāle cintayāmāsa bhārata / toṣayāmi mahādevaṃ yena sānugraho bhavet
prārthayāmi varaṃ divyaṃ yo me manasi vartate / paraṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā so 'ndhako nirgato gṛhāt
revātaṭaṃ samāsādya dānavastapasi sthitaḥ / ugraṃ tapaścacārāsau dāruṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ sa nirāhāro 'bhavat tataḥ / dvitīyaṃ tu sahasraṃ sa nyavasadvāribhojanaḥ
tṛtīyaṃ tu sahasraṃ sa dhūmapānarato 'bhavat / caturthaṃ varṣasāhasraṃ yogābhyāsena saṃsthitaḥ
kopīha nedṛśa cakre tapaḥ paramadāruṇam / asthicarmāvaśeṣo 'sau yāvattiṣṭhati bhārata
tasya mūrdhni tato rājan dhūmavārttir viniḥsṛtā / devalokamatītyāsau kailāsaṃ vyāpya saṃsthitā
tāvaddevasamīpasthā umā vacanam abravīt / ko 'styayaṃ mānuṣe loke tapasogreṇa saṃsthitaḥ
caturvarṣasahasrāṇi vyatīyuḥ parameśvara / na kenāpīdṛśaṃ taptaṃ tapo dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ tathā
avajñāṃ kuruṣe deva kimatra niyamānvite / sarvasya datse śīghraṃ tvamalpena tapasā vibho
nākṣakrīḍāṃ kariṣye 'dya tvayā saha maheśvara / yāvannotthāpyate hyeṣa dānavo bhaktavatsala
īśvara uvāca: sādhu sādhu mahādevi sarvalakṣaṇalakṣite / ahaṃ taṃ na vijānāmi kliśyantaṃ dānaveśvaram
yogābhyāse sthito bhadre dhyāyaṃstatparamaṃ padam / tatrāgaccha mayā sārddhaṃ yatra tapyatyasau tapaḥ
umayā sahito devo gatastatra maheśvaraḥ / asthicarmāvaśeṣastu dṛṣṭo devena śambhunā
pratyuvāca prasanno 'sau devadevo maheśvaraḥ / bhobhoḥ kaṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ bhīmaṃ dāruṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam
īdṛśaṃ ca tapo ghoraṃ kasmādvatsa tvayā kṛtam / varaṃ dāsyāmyahaṃ vatsa yaste manasi vartate
andhaka uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva varado yadi śaṅkara / surān sarvān vijeṣyāmi tvatprasādān maheśvara
īśvara uvāca: svapne 'pi tridaśāḥ sarve na yoddhavyāḥ kadācana / asaṃbhāvyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ manaso yanna rocate
anyaṃ kimapi yācasva yaste manasi vartate / svarge vā yadi vā martye pātāleṣu ca saṃsthitān
martyeṣu vividhān bhogān bhokṣyasi tvaṃ yathepsitān / kuru niṣkaṇṭakaṃ rājyaṃ svarge devapatiryathā
devasya vacanaṃ śrutvā so 'ndhako vimanāḥ sthitaḥ / vṛthā kleśaśca me jāto na kiṃcit sādhitaṃ mayā
niśvāsaṃ paramaṃ muktvā nipapāta dharātale / mūlacchinno yathā vṛkṣo nirucchvāsas tadābhavat
mūrcchāpannaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā devī vacanam abravīt / yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayatyeṣa tamasmai dehi śaṅkara
bhaktānupekṣamāṇasya tavākīrtir bhaviṣyati
īśvara uvāca: yadi dāsye varaṃ devi icchābhūtaṃ kadācana / tato na maṃsyate viṣṇuṃ na brahmāṇaṃ na māmapi
uccatvamāpto deveśi anyānapi surāsurān
devyuvāca: kamapyupāyamāśritya utthāpaya maheśvara / viṣṇuvarjaṃ surānsarvāñjayasveti varaṃ vada
īśvara uvāca: upāyaḥ śobhano devi yo me manasi vartate / tamevāsmai pradāsyāmi yastvayā kathito varaḥ
tato 'mṛtena saṃsiktaḥ svastho 'bhūt tatkṣaṇād ayam / tathā punarnavo jātaḥ sarvāvayavaśobhitaḥ
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā gṛhāṇa varamuttamam / viṣṇuvarjaṃ pradāsyāmi yattavābhimataṃ priyam
sarvaṃ ca saphalaṃ tubhyaṃ mā dharmaste 'nyathā bhavet / dadāmīti varaṃ tubhyaṃ manyase yadi cāsura
viṣṇuvarjaṃ surān sarvāñjeṣyasi tvaṃ ca māṃ vinā
andhaka uvāca: bhavatvevam iti prāha balamāsthāya kevalam / viṣṇuvarjaṃ vijeṣye 'haṃ svabalena maheśvara
kṛtārtho 'haṃ hi saṃjāta ityuktvā praṇatiṃ gataḥ / gaccha devomayāsārddhaṃ kailāsaśikharaṃ varam
vṛṣapuṃgavam āruhya devo 'sāvumayā saha / varaṃ dattvā sa tasyaivaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe andhakavarapradānavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 46 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sa dānavo varaṃ labdhvā jagāma svapuraṃ prati / dadarśa svapuraṃ rājañchobhitaṃ citracatvaraiḥ
udyānaiścaiva vividhaiḥ kadalīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitaiḥ / panasairbakulaiścaivāmrātairāmraiśca campakaiḥ
aśokairnālikeraiśca mātuliṅgaiḥ sadāḍimaiḥ / nānāvṛkṣaiśca śobhāḍhyaṃ taḍāgairupaśobhitam
devatāyatanair divyair dhvajamālāsuśobhitaiḥ / vedādhyayananirghoṣair maṅgalādyair vināditam
prāviśadbhavane divye kāñcane rukmamālini / apaśyatsa sutān bhāryām amātyān dāsabhṛtyakān
tato jayapradān sarvān itaścetaśca dhāvataḥ / hṛcchobhāṃ ca prakurvāṇān vai jayantībhiruccakaiḥ
kecit toraṇam ābadhya kecit puṣpāṇyavākiran / mātuliṅgakarāścānye dhāvanti hyandhakaṃ prati
pure janāśca dṛśyante bhājanairannapūritaiḥ / pūrṇahastāḥ pradṛśyante tatraiva bahavo janāḥ
sākṣatair bhājanais tatra śatasāhasrayoṣitaḥ / mantrān paṭhanti viprāśca maṅgalānyapi yoṣitaḥ
amātyāścaiva bhṛtyāśca gajāṃścāḍhaukayanti ca / vardhāpayanti te sarve ye kecit puravāsinaḥ
hṛṣṭastuṣṭo 'vasattatra sacivaiḥ saha so 'ndhakaḥ / dadarśa sa jagatsarvaṃ turaṅgāṃśca padātikān
tathaiva vividhān kośāṃs tatra kāñcanapūritān / mahiṣīrgā vṛṣāṃścaivāpaśyacchatrāṇyanekadhā
sa evamandhakas tatra kiyantaṃ kālamāvasat / hṛṣṭastuṣṭo vasan martye sa surair nābhyabhūyata
varaṃ labdhaṃ tu taṃ jñātvā śaṅkitāḥ svargavāsinaḥ / ekībhūtāśca te sarve vāsavaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
śakra uvāca: kathamāgamanaṃ vo 'tra sarveṣām api nākinām / kasmādvo bhayamutpannamāgatāḥ śaraṇaṃ katham
tataste hyamarāḥ sarve śakram etad vaco 'bruvan
devā ūcuḥ / suranāthāndhako nāma daityaḥ śambhuvarorjitaḥ / ajeyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ kiṃ nu kāryamataḥ param
tattvaṃ cintaya deveśa ka upāyo vidhīyatām / itthaṃ vadanti te devāḥ śakrāgre mantraṇodyatāḥ
mantrayanti ca yāvad vai tāvaccāramukheritam / jñātvā tatra sa devaughaṃ dānavo nirgato gṛhāt
ekākī syandanārūḍha āyurdhaibahubhir vṛtaḥ / durgamaṃ merupṛṣṭhaṃ sa līlayaiva gato nṛpa
svarṇaprākārasaṃyuktaṃ śobhitaṃ vividhāśramaiḥ / durgamaṃ śatruvargasya tadā pārthivasattama
praviveśāsurastatra līlayā svagṛhe yathā / vṛtrahā bhayamāpannaḥ svakīyaṃ cāsanaṃ dadau
upaviṣṭo 'ndhakastatra śakrasyaivāsane śubhe / āsthānaṃ kalayāmāsa sarvatastridaśāvṛtam
śakra uvāca: kiṃ tavāgamanaṃ cātra kiṃ kāryaṃ kathayasva me / yadasmadīyaṃ vittaṃ hi tatte dāsyāmi dānava
andhaka uvāca: nāhaṃ vai kāmaye kośaṃ na gajāṃśca sureśvara / svakīyaṃ darśayasvādya svargaśṛṅgārabhūṣitam
airāvataṃ mahānāgaṃ taṃ caivoccaiḥśravohayam / urvaśyādīni ratnāni mama darśaya gopate
pārijātakapuṣpāṇi vṛkṣajātīnanekaśaḥ / vāditrāṇi ca sarvāṇi darśayasva śacīpate
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śakraś cintitavān idam / yo 'muṃ nihanti pāpmānaṃ na taṃ paśyāmi karhicit
nāsti rakṣāpradaḥ kaścitsvargalokasya duḥkhinaḥ / bhayatrasto dadāvanyadvāditrādyapsarogaṇaiḥ
raṅgabhūmāvupāviśya kārayāmāsa tāṇḍavam / upaviṣṭāḥ surāḥ sarve yamamārutakinnarāḥ
urvaśyādyā apsaraso gītavāditrayogataḥ / nanṛtuḥ puratastasya sarvā ekaikaśo nṛpa
na vyaśrāmyata taccittaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāpsarasastadā / śacīṃ prati manastasya sakāmamabhavannṛpa
gṛhītvā śakrabhāryāṃ sa prasthitaḥ svapuraṃ prati / tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhamandhakasya suraiḥ saha
tena devagaṇāḥ sarve dhvastāḥ pārthivasattama / saṃgrāme vividhaiḥ śastraiś cakravajrādibhirghanaiḥ
saṃtāpitāḥ surāḥ sarve kṣayaṃ nītā hyanekaśaḥ / sarve 'pi marutastena bhagnāḥ saṃgrāmamūrdhani
yathā siṃhogajān sarvān vicitya vicared vanam / tadvad ekena te devā jitāḥ sarve parāṅmukhāḥ
bālo 'dhipo yathā grāme svecchayā pīḍayejjanān / svairamākramya gṛhṇāti kośavāsāṃsi cāsakṛt
gataṃ na paśyaty ātmānaṃ prajāsaṃtāpanena ca / gṛhītvā śakrabhāryāṃ sa gato vai dānavottamaḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedamāhātmye śacīharaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 47 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: gīrvāṇāśca tataḥ sarve brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ / gajair girivarākārair hayaiścaiva gajopamaiḥ
syandanairnagarākāraiḥ siṃhaśārdūlayojitaiḥ / kacchapair mahiṣaiścānyair makaraiśca tathāpare
brahmalokamanuprāptā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ / dṛṣṭvā padmodbhavaṃ devaṃ sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇatāḥ surāḥ
devā ūcuḥ / jaya deva jagadvandya jaya saṃsṛtikāraka / padmayone suraśreṣṭha tvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
sodvegaṃ bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā devānāṃ bhāvitātmanām / meghagambhīrayā vācā devarājamuvāca ha
kimatrāgamanaṃ devāḥ sarveṣāṃ vai vivarṇatā / kenāpamānitāḥ sarve śīghraṃ me kathyatāṃ svayam
devā ūcuḥ / andhakākhyo mahādaityo balavān padmasambhava / tena devagaṇāḥ sarve dhanaratnair viyojitāḥ
hatvā devagaṇāṃs tāvad asicakraparaddviśvadhaiḥ / gṛhītvā śakrabhāryāṃ sa dānavo 'pi gato balāt
devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / cintayāmāsa rājendra vadhārthaṃ dānavasya ha
avadhyo dānavaḥ pāpaḥ sarveṣāṃ vo divaukasām / sa trātā sarvajagatāṃ nānyo vidyeta kutracit
evamuktāḥ surāḥ sarve brahmaṇā tadanantaram / brahmāṇaṃ te puraskṛtya gatā yatra sa keśavaḥ / tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotrair brahmādyāś cakrapāṇinam
devā ūcuḥ / jaya tvaṃ devadeveśa lakṣmyā vakṣaḥsthalāśritaḥ / asurakṣaya deveśa vayaṃ te śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
stūyamānaḥ suraiḥ sarvairbrahmādyaiśca janārdanaḥ / samprahṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā surasaṅghamuvāca ha
śrīvāsudeva uvāca: svāgataṃ devaviprāṇāṃ suprabhātādya śarvarī / kiṃ kāryaṃ procyatāṃ kṣipraṃ kasya ruṣṭā divaukasaḥ
kiṃ duḥkhaṃ kaśca saṃtāpaḥ kuto vā bhayam āgatam / kathayantu mahābhāgāḥ kāraṇaṃ yanmanogatam
parābhavaḥ kṛto yena so 'dya yātu yamālayam / evamuktāstu kṛṣṇena kathayāmāsurasya tat
darśayantaḥ svakāndehān lajjamānā hyadhomukhāḥ / hṛtarājyā hyandhakena kṛtā nistejasaḥ prabho
piteva putraṃ parirakṣa deva jahīndraśatruṃ saha putrapautraiḥ / tatheti coktaḥ kamalāsanena surāsurair vanditapādapadmaḥ
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ cāpaṃ saṃgṛhya parameśvaraḥ / utthito bhogaparyaṅkād devānāṃ puratastadā
śrīvāsudeva uvāca: pātāle yadi vā martye nāke vā yadi tiṣṭhati / taṃ haniṣyāmyahaṃ pāpaṃ yena saṃtāpitāḥ surāḥ
svaṃ sthānaṃ yāntu gīrvāṇāḥ saṃtuṣṭā bhāvitaujasaḥ / viṣṇostadvacanaṃ śrutvā brahmādyāste savāsavāḥ
svayānaistu hariṃ natvā hṛdi tuṣṭā divaṃ yayuḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe gīrvāṇasvargamanavarṇanaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 48 uttānapāda uvāca: kasminsthāne 'vasad deva so 'ndhako daityapuṃgavaḥ / sarvāndevāṃśca nirjitya kasminsthāne samāsthitaḥ
śrīmaheśa uvāca: praviṣṭo dānavo yatra kathayāmi narādhipa / pātālalokamāśritya kanyā vidhvaṃsate tu saḥ
tatra sthitaṃ taṃ vijñāya cāpamādāya keśavaḥ / vyasṛjadbāṇamāgneyaṃ dahyatāmiti cintayan
dahyamāno 'gninā so 'pi vāruṇāstraṃ sa saṃdadhe / vāruṇāstreṇa mahatā āgneyaṃ śamitaṃ tadā
tato 'sau cintayāmāsa kena bāṇo visarjitaḥ / kasyaiṣā pauruṣī śaktiḥ ko yāsyati yamālayam
tato 'ndhako mṛdhe kruddho bāṇamārgeṇa nirgataḥ / sa dṛṣṭvā bāṇamārgeṇa cāpahastaṃ janārdanam
andhaka uvāca: na śarma lapsyase hyadya mayā dṛṣṭyābhivīkṣitaḥ / na śaknoṣi tathā gantuṃ nāgaḥ śārdūladarśanāt
āgacchati yathā bhakṣyaṃ mārjārasya ca mūṣikaḥ / na śaknoṣi tathā yātuṃ saṃsthitas tvaṃ mamāgrataḥ
ahaṃ tvāṃ preṣayiṣyāmi yamamārge sudāruṇe / ahamanveṣayiṣyāmi kila yāsyāmi te gṛham
upanīto 'si kālena saṅgrāme mama keśava / ye tvayā nirjitāḥ pūrvaṃ dānavā apyanekaśaḥ
na bhavanti pumāṃsaste striyastāś caiva keśava / paraṃ na śastrasaṅgrāmaṃ kariṣyāmi tvayā saha
vadato dānavendrasya na cukopa sa keśavaḥ / ayudhyamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā cintayāmāsa dānavaḥ
dvandvayuddhaṃ kariṣyāmi niścitya yuyudhe nṛpa / sa kṛṣṇena padākṣiptaḥ patitaḥ pṛthivītale
muhūrtātsa samāśvasya utthāyedaṃ vyacintayat / aśakto dvandvayuddhāya tataḥ sāma prayuktavān / pāṇibhyāṃ sampuṭaṃ kṛtvā sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇataḥ śuciḥ
andhaka uvāca: jaya kṛṣṇāya haraye viṣṇave jiṣṇave namaḥ / hṛṣīkeśa jagaddhātre acyutāya mahātmane
namaḥ paṅkajanābhāya namaḥ paṅkajamāline / janārdanāya śrīśāya śrīpate pītavāsase
govindāya namo nityaṃ namo jaladhiśāyine / namaḥ karālavaktrāya narasiṃhāya nādine
śārṅgiṇe sitavarṇāya śaṅkhacakragadābhṛte / namo vāmanarūpāya yajñarūpāya te namaḥ
namo varāharūpāya krāntalokatrayāya ca / vyāptāśeṣadigantāya keśavāya namonamaḥ
vāsudeva namastubhyaṃ namaḥ kaiṭabhanāśine / lakṣmyālaya suraśreṣṭha namaste suranāyaka
viṣṇordevādhidevasya pramāṇaṃ ye 'pi kurvate / prajāpaterjagaddhātus teṣām api namāmyaham
samastabhūtadevasya vāsudevasya dhīmataḥ / praṇāmaṃ ye prakurvanti teṣāmapi namāmyaham
tasya yajñavarāhasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ / praṇāmaṃ ye prakurvanti teṣāmapi namāmyaham
guṇānāṃ hi nidhānāya namaste 'stu punaḥpunaḥ / kāruṇyāmbunidhe deva sarvabhaktipriyāya ca
śrībhagavān uvāca: tuṣṭaste dānavendrāhaṃ varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam / dadāmi te varaṃ nūnamapi trailokyadurlabham
andhaka uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva varaṃ dāsyasi cepsitam / tadā dadasva me deva yuddhaṃ paramaśobhanam / avaddhastapūto yenāhaṃ lokāngantāsmi śobhanān
śrībhagavānuvāca: kathaṃ dadāmi te yuddhaṃ toṣito 'haṃ tvayā punaḥ / na tvāṃ tu prabhavetkopaḥ kathaṃ yudhyāmi te 'ndhaka
yadi te vartate buddhiryuddhaṃ prati na saṃśayaḥ / tato gacchasva yuddhāya devaṃ prati maheśvaram
andhaka uvāca: na tatra sidhyate kāryaṃ devaṃ prati maheśvaram
śrībhagavān uvāca: putra tvaṃ śikharaṃ gatvā dhūnayasva balena ca
vidhūte tatra deveśaḥ kopaṃ kartā sudāruṇam / kopitaḥ śaṅkaro raudraṃ yuddhaṃ dāsyati dānava
viṣṇuvākyādasau pāpo gato yatra maheśvaraḥ / kailāsaśikharaṃ prāpya dhunoti sma muhurmuhuḥ
dhūnite tatra śikhare kampitaṃ bhuvanatrayam / nipetuḥ śikharāgrāṇi kampamānānyanekaśaḥ
catvāraḥ sāgarāḥ kṣipramekībhūtā mahīpate / nipeturulkāpātāśca pādapā apyanekaśaḥ
umayā sahito devo vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ / gāḍhamāliṅgya girijā devaṃ vacanam abravīt
kimarthaṃ kampate śailaḥ kimarthaṃ kampate dharā / kimarthaṃ kampate nāgo martyaḥ pātālameva ca / kiṃ vā yugakṣayo deva tanmamākhyātum arhasi
īśvara uvāca: kasyaiṣā durmatirjātā kṣiptaḥ sarpamukhe karaḥ / lalāṭe ca kṛtaṃ varma sa yāsyati yamālayam
kailāsamāśrito yena supto 'haṃ yena bodhitaḥ / taṃ vadhiṣye na sandehaḥ sammukho vā bhaved yadi
cintayāmāsa deveśo hyandhako 'yaṃ na saṃśayaḥ / upāyaṃ cintayāmāsa yenāsau vadhyate kṣaṇāt
āgatāśca surāḥ sarve brahmādyā vasubhiḥ saha / rathaṃ devamayaṃ kṛtvā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam
keciddevāḥ sthitāścakre kecit tuṇḍāgrapārśvayoḥ / kecin nābhyāṃ sthitā devāḥ keciddhuryeṣu saṃsthitāḥ
dhurīṣu niścalāḥ kecitkecidyūpeṣu saṃsthitāḥ / kecitsyandanasaṃstambhāḥ kecitsyandanaveṣṭakāḥ
āmalasārake 'nye 'pi anye 'pi kalaśe sthitāḥ / riporbhayaṃkaraṃ divyaṃ dhvajamālādiśobhitam
rathaṃ devamayaṃ kṛtvā tamārūḍho jagadguruḥ / niryayau dānavo yatra kopāviṣṭo maheśvaraḥ
tiṣṭha tiṣṭhetyuvācātha kva prayāsyasi durmate / śarāsanaṃ kare gṛhya śarāṃścikṣepa dānave
dānave 'dhiṣṭhite yuddhe śaraiścicheda sāyakān / śarāsaneṇa tatraiva andhakaśchāditas tadā
na tatra dṛśyate sūryo nākāśaṃ na ca candramāḥ / āgneyamastraṃ vyasṛjaddānavo 'pi śivaṃ prati
dahyamānāḥ śarāṅgāraistatrasuḥ sarvadevatāḥ / rakṣa rakṣa mahādeva dahyamānāṃstu dānavāt
tato devādhidevo 'sau vāruṇāstramayo 'jayat / vāruṇāstreṇa nimiṣādāgneyaṃ nāśitaṃ tadā
dānavena tadā muktaṃ vāyavyāstraṃ raṇājire / vāruṇaṃ ca gataṃ tāta vāyavyāstravināśitam
devo vyasarjayatsārpaṃ krodhāviṣṭena cetasā / mārutaṃ nāśitaṃ bāṇaiḥ sarpais tatra na saṃśayaḥ
dānavena tato muktaṃ garuḍāstraṃ ca līlayā / gāruḍāstraṃ ca tad dṛṣṭvā sārpaṃ naiva vyadṛśyata
tato devādhidevena nārasiṃhaṃ visarjitam / nārasiṃhāstrabāṇena gāruḍāstraṃ praśāmitam
astramastreṇa śamyeta na bādhyeta parasparam / mahad yuddham abhūt tātasurāsurabhayaṃkaram
cakranālīkanārācaistomaraiḥ khaḍgamudgaraiḥ / vatsadantaistathā bhallaiḥ karṇikāraiśca śobhanaiḥ
evaṃ na śakyate hantuṃ dānavo vividhāyudhaiḥ / tadā jvālākarālāśca khaḍganārācatomarāḥ
vṛṣāṅkena vimuktāstu samare dānavaṃ prati / na saṃspṛśanti śastrāṇi gātraṃ gauḍavadhūriva
āyudhāni tatastyaktvā bāhuyuddham upasthitau / karaṃ kareṇa saṃgṛhya praharantau svamuṣṭibhiḥ / raṇaprayogairyudhyantau yuyudhāte śivāndhakau
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: andhakaṃ prati deveśaścintayāmāsa nigraham / haniṣyāmi na sandeho duṣṭātmānaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
sa śivena yadā kṣiptaḥ patitaḥ pṛthivītale / ūrdhvabāhuradhovaktro dānavo nṛpasattama
krodhāviṣṭena deveśaḥ saṅgrāme devaśatruṇā / kakṣayoḥ kuhare kṣiptvā bandhenākramya pīḍitaḥ
nispandaścābhavad devo mūrcchāyukto maheśvaraḥ / mūrcchāpannaṃ tu taṃ jñātvā cintayāmāsa dānavaḥ
hāhā kaṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ me 'dya duṣkṛtaṃ pāpakarmaṇā / kiṃ karomi kathaṃ karma kasminsthāne tu mocaye
gṛhītvā devamutsaṅge gataḥ kailāsaparvatam / śayyāyāṃ śaṅkaraṃ nyasya niryayau daityarāṭ tataḥ
śayyāyāṃ patito devaḥ prapede vedanāṃ tataḥ / tāvaddadarśa cātmānaṃ svakīyabhavanasthitam
parābhavaḥ kṛto madyaṃ kathaṃ tena durātmanā / krodhavegasamāviṣṭo niryayau dānavaṃ prati
āyasīṃ laguḍīṃ gṛhya prabhur bhārasahasrajām / dānavaṃ ca tato dṛṣṭvā prākṣipattasya mūrdhani
khaḍgena tāḍayāmāsa dānavaḥ prahasanraṇe / devenāthasmṛtaṃ cāstraṃ kauccherākhyaṃ mahāhave
dīpyamānaṃ samutsṛjya hṛdaye tāḍitaḥ kṣaṇāt / tataḥ sa tāḍitastena rudhirodgāramudvaman
patito 'dhomukho bhūtvā tataḥ śūlena bheditaḥ / punaśca devadevena śūlena dvidalīkṛtaḥ
śūlāgre 'sau sthitaḥ pāpo bhrāntavāṃś cakravat tadā / ye ye bhūmyāṃ patanti sma tatkāyād raktabindavaḥ
te te sarve samuttasthur dānavāḥ śāstrapāṇayaḥ / vyākulastu tato devo dānavena tarasvinā
devenātha smṛtā durgā cāmuṇḍā bhīṣaṇānanā / āyātā bhīṣaṇākārā nānāyudhavirājitā
mahādaṃṣṭrā mahākāyā piṅgākṣī lambakarṇikā / ādeśo dīyatāṃ deva ko yāsyati yamālayam
īśvara uvāca: pibāsya rudhiraṃ bhadre yatheṣṭaṃ dānavasya ca / nipatadrudhiraṃ bhūmau durge gṛhṇīṣva māciram
nihanmi dānavaṃ yāvatsāhāyyaṃ kuru sundari / evamuktā tu sā durgā papau ca rudhiraṃ tataḥ
nihatā dānavāḥ sarve deveśena sahasraśaḥ / andhako 'pi ca tān dṛṣṭvā dānavānavaniṃ gatān / tato vāgbhiḥ pratuṣṭāva devadevaṃ maheśvaram
andhaka uvāca: jayasva devadeveśa umārdhārdhāśarīradhṛk / namaste devadeveśa sarvāya triguṇātmane
vṛṣabhāsanamārūḍha śaśāṅkakṛtaśekhara / jaya khaṭvāṅgahastāya gaṅgādhara namo 'stu te
namo ḍamaruhastāya namaḥ kapālamāline / smaradehavināśāya maheśāya namo 'stu te
pūṣṇo dantanipātāya gaṇanāthāya te namaḥ / jaya svarūpadehāya arūpabahurūpiṇe
uttamāṅgavināśāya viriñcerapi śaṅkara / śmaśānavāsine nityaṃ nityaṃ bhairavarūpiṇe
tvaṃ sarvago 'si tvaṃ kartā tvaṃ hartā nānya eva ca / tvaṃ bhūmistvaṃ diśaścaiva tvaṃ gururbhārgavastathā
sauristvaṃ devadeveśa bhūmiputras tathaiva ca / ṛkṣagrahādikaṃ sarvaṃ yaddṛśyaṃ tattvameva ca
evaṃ stutiṃ tadā kṛtvā devaṃ prati sa dānavaḥ / saṃhatābhyāṃ tu pāṇibhyāṃ praṇanāma maheśvaram
īśvara uvāca: sādhu sādhu mahāsattva varaṃ yācasva dānava / dātāhaṃ yācakastvaṃ hi dadāmīha yathepsitam
andhaka uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama / tadātmasadṛśo 'haṃ te kartavyo nāparo varaḥ
bhasmī jaṭī trinetrī ca triśūlī ca caturbhujaḥ / vyāghracarmottarīyaśca nāgayajñopavītakaḥ
etadicchāmyahaṃ sarvaṃ yadi tuṣṭo maheśvara
īśvara uvāca: dadāmi te varaṃ hyadya yastvayā yācito 'nagha / gaṇeṣu me sthitaḥ putra bhṛṅgīśastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe 'ndhakavadhatadvarapradānavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 49 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: andhakaṃ tu nihatyātha devadevo maheśvaraḥ / umayā sahito rudraḥ kailāsamagamannagam
āgatāśca tato devā brahmādyāśca savāsavāḥ / hṛṣṭāstuṣṭāśca te sarve praṇemuḥ pārvatīpatim
īśvara uvāca: upāviśantu te sarve ye kecana samāgatāḥ / nihato dānavo hyeṣa gīrvāṇārthe pitāmaha
raktena tasya me śūlaṃ nirmalaṃ naiva jāyate / śubhavratatapojapyarato brahmanmayā hataḥ
kartumicchāmyahaṃ samyak tīrthayānaṃ caturmukha / āgacchantu mayā sārddhaṃ ye yūyamiha saṃgatāḥ
ityuktvā devadeveśaḥ prabhāsaṃ pratiniryayau / prabhāsādyāni tīrthāni gaṅgāsāgaramadhyataḥ
avagāhyāpi sarvāṇi nairmalyaṃ nābhavannṛpa / narmadāyāṃ tato gatvā devo devaiḥ samanvitaḥ
uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ kūlam avāgāhat priyavrataḥ / gatastu dakṣiṇe kūle parvate bhṛgusaṃjñitam
tatra sthitvā mahādevo devaiḥ saha mahīpate / bhrāntvā bhrāntvā ciraṃ śrānto nirviṇṇo niṣasāda ha
manohāri yataḥ sthānaṃ sarveṣāṃ vai divaukasām / tīrthaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ tanmatvā sthito devo maheśvaraḥ
giriṃ vivyādha śūlena bhinnaṃ tena rasātalam / nirmalaṃ cābhavacchūlaṃ na lepo dṛśyate kvacit
devair āhvānitā tatra mahāpuṇyā ca bhāratī / parvatān niḥsṛtā tatra mahāpuṇyā sarasvatī
dvitīyaḥ saṅgamas tatra yathā veṇyāṃ sitāsitaḥ / tatra brahmā svayaṃ devo brahmeśaṃ liṅgam uttamam
saṃsthāpayāmāsa puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam / tasya yāmye diśo bhāge svayaṃ devo janārdanaḥ
tiṣṭhate ca sadā tatra viṣṇupādāgrasaṃsthitā / ambhaso na bhaven mārgaḥ kuṇḍamadhyasthitasya ca
śūlāgreṇa kṛtā rekhā tatas toyaṃ vahen nṛpa / tat toyaṃ ca gataṃ tatra yatra revā mahānadī
jalaliṅgaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ cakatīrthaṃ nṛpottama / śūlabhede ca deveśaḥ snānaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi
ātmānaṃ manyate śuddhaṃ na kiṃcit kalmaṣaṃ kṛtam / tasyaivottarakāṣṭhāyāṃ devadevo jagadguruḥ
ātmanā devadeveśaḥ śūlapāṇiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ / sarvatīrtheṣu tattīrthaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ param
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnam uttamam / tatra tīrthe pratiṣṭhāpya devadevaṃ jagadguruḥ
rakṣāpālāṃs tato muktvā śataṃ sāṣṭavināyakān / kṣetrapālāḥ śataṃ sāṣṭaṃ tadrakṣanti prayatnataḥ
vighnāstasyopajāyante yastatra sthātum icchati / kecit kuṭumbāttatāsu vyāgrāḥ kecit kṛṣīṣu ca
kecitsabhāṃ prakurvanti keciddravyārjane ratāḥ / parokṣavādaṃ kurvanti ke 'pi hiṃsāratāḥ sadā
paradāraratāḥ kecitkecidvṛttivihiṃsakāḥ / anye kecidvadantyevaṃ kathaṃ tīrtheṣu gamyate
kṣudhayā pīḍyate bhāryā putrabhṛtyādayas tadā / mohajāleṣu yojyante evaṃ devagaṇair narāḥ
pāpācārāśca ye martyāḥ snānaṃ teṣāṃ na jāyate / saṃrakṣanti ca tattīrthaṃ devabhṛtyagaṇāḥ sadā
dhanyāḥ puṇyāśca ye martyās teṣāṃ snānaṃ prajāyate / sarasvatyā bhogavatyā devanadyā viśeṣataḥ
ayaṃ tu saṅgamaḥ puṇyo yathā veṇyāṃ sitāsitaḥ / dṛṣṭvā tīrthaṃ tu te sarve gīrvāṇā hṛṣṭacetasaḥ
devasya sannidhau bhūtvā varṇayāmāsuruttamam / idaṃ tīrthaṃ tu deveśa gayātīrthena te samam
guhyādguhyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati / śūlapāṇiḥ samabhyarcya indrādyairapsarogaṇaiḥ
yakṣakinnaragandharvair dikpālair lokapairapi / nṛtyagītais tathā stotraiḥ sarvaiścāpi surāsuraiḥ
pūjyamāno gaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ siddhair nāgair maheśvaraḥ / devena bheditaṃ tatra śūlāgreṇa narādhipa
tridhā yatrekṣyate 'dyāpi hyāvartaḥ surapūritaḥ / kuṇḍatrayaṃ naravyāghra mahatkalakalānvitam
sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnam uttamam / tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snāti upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ
dīkṣāmantravihīno 'pi mucyate cābdikādaghāt / ye punarvidhivatsnānti mantraiḥ pañcabhireva ca
vedoktaiḥ pañcabhirmantraiḥ sahiraṇyaghaṭaiḥ śubhaiḥ / akṣarair daśabhiścaiva ṣaḍbhirvā tribhireva vā
pṛthagbhūtairdvijātīnāṃ tīrthe kāryaṃ narādhipa / brahmakṣatraviśāṃ vāpi strīśūdrāṇāṃ tathaiva ca
puruṣāṇāṃ trayīṃ dhyātvā snānaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi / daśākṣareṇa mantreṇa ye pibanti jalaṃ narāḥ
te gacchanti paraṃ lokaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ / kedāre ca yathā pītaṃ rudrakuṇḍe tathaiva ca
pañcarephasamāyuktaṃ kṣakāraṃ surapūjitam / oṅkāreṇa samāyuktam etad vedyaṃ prakīrtitam
yastatra kurute snānaṃ vidhiyukto jitendriyaḥ / tilamiśreṇa toyena tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ
kulānāṃ tārayed viṃśaṃ daśapūrvāndaśāparān / gayādipañcasthāneṣu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ
sa tatra phalamāpnoti śūlabhede na saṃśayaḥ / yastatra vidhinā yukto dadyāddānāni bhaktitaḥ
tudakṣayaṃ phalaṃ tatra sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ tathā / gayāśiro yathā puṇyaṃ pitṛkāryeṣu sarvadā
śūlabhedaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ snānadānāditarpaṇaiḥ / bhaktyā dadāti yastatra kāñcanaṃ gāṃ mahīṃ tilān
āsanopānahau śayyāṃ varāśvān kṣatriyas tathā / vastrayugmaṃ ca dhānyaṃ ca gṛhaṃ pūrṇaṃ prayatnataḥ
sayoktraṃ lāṅgalaṃ dadyāt kṛṣṭāṃ caiva vasuṃdharām / dānānyetāni yo dadyād brāhmaṇe vedapārage
śrotriye kulasampanne śuciṣmati jitendriye / śrutādhyayanasampanne dambhahīne kriyānvite / trayodaśāhaḥsvekaikaṃ trayodaśaguṇaṃ bhavet

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 50 uttānapāda uvāca: dvijāśca kīdṛśāḥ pūjyā apūjyāḥ kīdṛśāḥ smṛtāḥ / śrāddhe vaivāhike kārye dāne caiva viśeṣataḥ
yadi śraddhā bhaved daivayogācchrāddhādike vidhau / etadākhyāhi me deva kasya dānaṃ na dīyate
īśvara uvāca: yathā kāṣṭhamayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ / brāhmaṇaścānadhīyānastrayaste nāmadhārakāḥ
yathā ṣaṇḍho 'phalaḥ strīṣu yathā gaur gavi cāphalā / yathā cājñe 'phalaṃ dānaṃ tathā vipro 'nṛco 'phalaḥ
yathā 'nṛṇe bījamuptvā vaptā na labhate phalam / tathānṛce havirdattvā na dātā labhate phalam
rogī hīnātiriktāṅgaḥ kāṇaḥ paunarbhavastathā / avakīrṇī śyāvadantaḥ sarvāśī vṛṣalīpatiḥ
mitradhruk piśunaḥ somavikrayī paranindakaḥ / pitṛmātṛgurutyāgī nityaṃ brāhmaṇanindakaḥ
śūdrānnaṃ mantrasaṃyuktaṃ yo vipro bhakṣayennṛpa / so 'spṛśyaḥ karmacāṇḍālaḥ spṛṣṭvā snānaṃ samācaret
kunakhī vṛṣalī steyī vārddhuṣyaḥ kuṇḍagolakau / mahādānarato yaśca yaścātmahanane rataḥ
bhṛtakādhyāpakaḥ klībaḥ kanyādūṣyabhiśastakaḥ / ete viprāḥ sadā tyājyāḥ paribhāvya prayatnataḥ
pratigrahaṃ gṛhītvā tu vāṇijyaṃ yastu kārayet / tasya dānaṃ na dātavyaṃ vṛthā bhavati tasya tat
śrutādhyayanasampannā ye dvijā vṛttatatparāḥ / teṣāṃ yaddīyate dānaṃ sarvamakṣayatāṃ vrajet
daridrānbhara bhūpāla mā samṛddhān kadācana / vyādhitasyauṣadhaṃ pathyaṃ nīrujasya kimauṣadhaiḥ
uttānapāda uvāca: kīdṛśo 'tha vidhistatra tīrthaśrāddhasya kā kriyā / dānaṃ ca dīyate yadvat tanmamākhyāhi śaṅkara
īśvara uvāca: śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā gṛhe bhaktyā śuciścāpi jitendriyaḥ / guruṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya bhojya sīmāntake tataḥ
vāgyataḥ pravrajet tāvad yāvat sīmāṃ na laṅghayet / śūlabhedaṃ tato gatvā snānaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi
pañcasthāneṣu ca śrāddhaṃ havyakavyādibhiḥ kramāt / piṇḍadānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryāt pāyasair madhusarpiṣā
pitarastasya tṛpyanti dvādaśābdāni pañca ca / akṣatair badarair bilvair gudamadhusarpiṣā
sāpi tatphalamāpnoti tīrthe 'sminnātra saṃśayaḥ / upānahau ca yo dadyādbrāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayatnataḥ
so 'pi svargam avāpnoti hayārūḍho na saṃśayaḥ / śayyāmaśvaṃ ca yo dadyācchattrikāṃ vā viśeṣataḥ
gacched vimānamārūḍhaḥ so 'psarovṛndaveṣṭitaḥ / uttamaṃ yo gṛhaṃ dadyāt saptadhānyasamanvitam
svecchayā me vaselloke kāñcane bhavane hi saḥ / tiladhenuṃ ca yo dadyāt savatsāṃ vastrasaṃplutām
nākapṛṣṭhe vaset tāvad yāvad ābhūtasamplavam / gṛhe vā yadi vāraṇye tīrthavartmani vā nṛpa
toyamannaṃ ca yo dadyād yamalokaṃ sa nekṣate / sarvadānāni dīyante teṣāṃ phalam avāpyate
udakaṃ cātra dānaṃ ca dadyād abhayam eva ca / annadānāt paraṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati
kanyādānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryād vṛṣaṃ vā yaḥ samutsṛjet / tasya vāso bhavet tatra yatrāham iti nānyathā
uttānapāda uvāca: kanyādānaṃ kathaṃ svāmin kartavyaṃ dhārmikaiḥ sadā / parigraho yathā poṣyaḥ kanyodvāhas tathaiva ca
anyatpṛcchāmi deveśa kasya kanyā na dīyate / dātavyaṃ kutra taddeva kasmai dattam athākṣayam
uttamaṃ madhyamaṃ vāpi kanīyaḥ syāt kathaṃ vibho / rājasaṃ tāmasaṃ vāpi niḥśreyasam athāpi vā
īśvara uvāca: sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ kanyādānaṃ viśiṣyate / yo dadyātparayā bhaktyābhigamya tanayāṃ nijām
kulīnāya surūpāya guṇajñāya manīṣiṇe / sulagne sumuhūrte ca dadyāt kanyām alaṃkṛtām
aśvānnā gāṃśca vāsāṃsi yo 'tra dadyātsvaśaktitaḥ / tasya vāso bhavet tatra padaṃ yatra nirāmayam
yenātra duhitā dattā prāṇebhyo 'pi garīyasī / tena sarvamidaṃ dattaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
yaḥ kanyārthaṃ tato labdhvā bhikṣate caiva taddhanam / sa bhavet karmacaṇḍālaḥ kāṣṭhakīlo bhaven mṛtaḥ
gṛhe 'pi tasya yo 'śnīyājjihvālaulyāt kathaṃcana / cāndrāyaṇena śudhyeta taptakṛcchreṇa vā punaḥ
uttānapāda uvāca: vittaṃ na vidyate yasya kanyaivāsti ca yadgṛhe / kathaṃ codvāhanaṃ tasya na yāñcāṃ kurute yadi
īśvara uvāca: avitenaiva kartavyaṃ kanyodvahanakaṃ nṛpa / kanyānāma samuccārya na doṣāya kadācana
abhigamyottamaṃ dānaṃ yacca dānamayācitam / bhaviṣyati yugasyāntastasyānto naiva vidyate
abhigamyottamaṃ dānaṃ smṛtam āhūya madhyamam / yācyamānaṃ kanīyaḥ syād dehi dehīti cādhamam
yathaivāśmāśmanābaddho nikṣipto vārimadhyataḥ / dvāvetau nidhanaṃ yātas tadvad annam apātrake
asamarthe tato dānaṃ na pradeyaṃ kadācana / dātāraṃ nayate 'dhastādātmānaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
samarthastārayeddvau tu kāṣṭhaṃ śuṣkaṃ yathā jale / yathā nauśca tathā vidvānprāpayedaparaṃ taṭam
āhitāgniśca gṛhṇāti yaḥ śūdrāṇāṃ pratigraham / iha janmani śūdro 'sau mṛtaḥ śvā copajāyate
vṛthā kleśaśca jāyeta brāhmaṇe hyagnihotriṇi / asatpratigrahaṃ kurvanguptaṃ nīcasya garhitam
abhojyaḥ sa bhavenmartyo dahyate kāriṣāgninā / kaṭakāro bhavet paścāt sapta janma na saṃśayaḥ
lajjādākṣiṇyalobhācca yad dānaṃ coparodhajam / bhṛtyebhyaśca tu yad dānaṃ tadvṛthā niṣphalaṃ bhavet

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedamāhātmye pātrāpātraparīkṣādānādiniyamavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 51 uttānapāda uvāca: kāle tatkriyate kasmiñchrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tatheśvara / yātrā tatra prakartavyā tithau yasyāṃ vadāśu tat
īśvara uvāca: pitṛtīrthaṃ yathā puṇyaṃ sarvakāmikamuttamam / idaṃ tīrthaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ snānadānāditarpaṇaiḥ
viśeṣeṇa tu kurvīta śrāddhaṃ sarvayugādiṣu / manvantarādayo vatsa śrūyantāṃ ca caturdaśa
aśvayukchuklanavamī dvādaśī kārttikasya ca / tṛtīyā caitramāsasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca
āṣāḍhasyaiva daśamī māghasyaiva tu saptamī / śrāvaṇasyāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathāṣāḍhasya pūrṇimā
phālgunasya tvamāvāsyā pauṣasyaikādaśī sitā / kārttikī phālgunī caitrī jyaiṣṭhī pañcadaśī tathā
manvantarādayaścaite anantaphaladāḥ smṛtāḥ / ayane cottare rājandakṣiṇe śrāddhamācaret
kārttikī ca tathā māghī vaiśākhasya tṛtīyikā / paurṇamāsī ca caitrasya jyeṣṭhasya ca viśeṣataḥ
aṣṭakāsu ca saṃkrāntau vyatīpāte tathaiva ca / śrāddhakālā ime sarve dattameṣvakṣayaṃ smṛtam
madhumāse site pakṣa ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ / niśi jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād viṣṇupādasamīpataḥ
dhūpadīpādinaivedyaiḥ sraṅmālāgurucandanaiḥ / arcāṃ kurvanti ye viṣṇoḥ paṭheyuḥ prāktanīṃ kathām
ṛgyajuḥsāmamantroktaṃ sūktaṃ japati yo dvijaḥ / sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
prātaḥ śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta dvijān sampūjya yatnataḥ / dānaṃ dadyād yathāśakti gohiraṇyāmbarādikam
pitarastasya tṛpyanti yāvad ābhūtasamplavam / śrāddhadastu vrajet tatra yatra devo janārdanaḥ
trayodaśyāṃ tato gacchedguhāvāsini liṅgake / dṛṣṭvā mārkaṇḍamīśānaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
uttānapāda uvāca: guhāmadhye mahādeva liṅgaṃ paramaśobhitam / yena pratiṣṭhitaṃ deva tanmamākhyātum arhasi
īśvara uvāca: triṣu lokeṣu vikhyāto mārkaṇḍeyo munīśvaraḥ / divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ sa tapastepe sudāruṇam
guhāmadhyaṃ praviṣṭo 'sau yogābhyāsamupāśritaḥ / liṅgaṃ tu sthāpitaṃ tena mārkaṇḍeśvarasaṃjñitam
tatra snātvā ca yo bhaktyā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ / tatra jāgaraṇaṃ kurvan dadyād dīpaṃ prayatnataḥ
devasya snapanaṃ kuryānmṛtaiḥ pañcabhis tathā / yathā śaktyā samālabhya pūjāṃ kuryād yathāvidhi
svaśākhotpannamantraiśca japaṃ kuryur dvijātayaḥ / sāvitryaṣṭasahasraṃ tu śatāṣṭakam athāpi vā
etatkṛtvā nṛpaśreṣṭha janmanaḥ phalamāpnuyāt / caturdaśyāṃ tu vai snātvā pūjāṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi
pātraṃ parīkṣya dātavyam ātmanaḥ śreya icchatā / pitarastasya tṛpyanti dvādaśābdānyasaṃśayam
dātā sa gacchate tatra yatra bhogāḥ sanātanāḥ / guhāmadhye praviṣṭastu loṭayeccaiva śaktitaḥ
nīle girau hi yatpuṇyaṃ tatsamastaṃ labhanti te / śūlabhede tu yaḥ kuryācchrāddhaṃ parvaṇi parvaṇi
viśeṣāccaitramāsānte tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu / kedāre caiva yatpuṇyaṃ gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgame
sitāsite tu yatpuṇyamanyatīrthe viśeṣataḥ / arbude vidyate puṇyaṃ puṇyaṃ cāmaraparvate
gayādisarvatīrthānāṃ phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ / vidhimantrasamāyuktas tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ
kulānāṃ tārayed viṃśaṃ daśa pūrvān daśāparān / dakṣiṇasyāṃ tato mūrtau śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ
nyāsaṃ kṛtvā tu pūrvoktaṃ pradadyād aṣṭapuṣpikām / śāstroktairaṣṭabhiḥ puṣpairmānasaiḥ śṛṇu tadyathā
vārijaṃ saumyamāgneyaṃ vāyavyaṃ pārthivaṃ punaḥ / vānaspatyaṃ bhavet ṣaṣṭhaṃ prājāpatyaṃ tu saptamam
aṣṭamaṃ śivapuṣpaṃ syād eṣāṃ śṛṇu vinirṇayam / vārijaṃ salilaṃ jñeyaṃ saumyaṃ madhughṛtaṃ payaḥ
āgneyaṃ dhūpadīpādyaṃ vāyavyaṃ candanādikam / pārthivaṃ kandamūlādyaṃ vānaspatyaṃ phalātmakam
prājāpatyaṃ tu pāṭhādyaṃ śivapuṣpaṃ tu vāsanā / ahiṃsā prathamaṃ puṣpaṃ puṣpamindriyanigrahaḥ
tṛtīyaṃ tu dayā puṣpaṃ kṣamā puṣpaṃ caturthakam / dhyānapuṣpaṃ tapaḥ puṣpaṃ jñānapuṣpaṃ tu saptamam
satyaṃ caivāṣṭamaṃ puṣpamebhis tuṣyanti devatāḥ / bhaktyā tapasvinaḥ pūjyā jñāninaśca narādhipa
chatramāvaraṇaṃ dadyād upānadyugalaṃ tathā / tena pūjitamātreṇa pūjitāḥ puruṣāstrayaḥ
svargaloke vaset tāvad yāvad ābhūtasamplavam / śūlapāṇestu bhaktyā vai jāpyaṃ kurvanti ye narāḥ
pañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyair yakṣakardamakuṅkumaiḥ / samālabheta deveśaṃ śrīkhaṇḍāgurucandanaiḥ
nānāvidhaiśca ye puṣpairarcāṃ kurvanti śūlinaḥ / niśi jāgaraṇaṃ kuryur dīpadānaṃ prayatnataḥ
dhūpanaivedyakaṃ dadyāt paṭhetpaurāṇikīṃ kathām / tatra sthāne sthitā bhaktyā japaṃ kurvanti ye narāḥ
śrīsūktaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ pāvamānaṃ vṛṣākapim / vedoktaiścaiva mantraiśca raudrīṃ vā bahurūpiṇīm
brāhmaṇān pūjayed bhaktyā pūjayitvā praṇamya ca / nānāvidhair mahābhogaiḥ śivaloke mahīyate
agnim ityādi jāpyāni ṛgvedī japate tu yaḥ / rudrān puruṣasūktaṃ ca ślokādhyāyaṃ ca śukriyam
iṣetvā dikamantraughaṃ jyotirbrāhmaṇameva ca / gāyatryaṃ vai madhu caiva maṇḍalabrāhmaṇāni ca
etāñjapyāṃstu yo bhaktyā yajurvedī japed yadi / devavrataṃ vāmadevyaṃ puruṣarṣabhameva ca
bṛhadrathāntaraṃ caiva yo japed bhaktitatparaḥ / sa prayāti naraḥ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ
pādaśaucaṃ tathābhyaṅgaṃ kurute yo 'tra bhaktitaḥ / godāne caiva yatpuṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
brāhmaṇān bhojayet tatra madhunā pāyasena ca / ekasmin bhojite vipre koṭir bhavati bhojitā
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ dadyād bhaktyā dvijottame / tarpitāstena devāḥ syur manuṣyāḥ pitaras tathā
candrasūryagrahe bhaktyā snānaṃ kurvanti ye narāḥ / devārcanaṃ ye ca kuryur japaṃ homaṃ viśeṣataḥ / dadyād dānaṃ yathāśakti brāhmaṇe vedapārage
aśvaṃ rathaṃ gajaṃ yānaṃ tulāpuruṣameva ca / śakaṭaṃ yaḥ pradadyādvā saptadhānyaprapūritam
sayoktraṃ lāṅgalaṃ dadyādyuvānau tu dhuraṃdharau / gobhūtilahiraṇyādi pātre dātavyam arcitam
apātre viduṣā kiṃcinna deyaṃ bhūtimicchatā / yato 'sau sarvabhūtāni dadhāti dharaṇī kila
tato viprāya sā deyā sarvasasyaughamālinī / athānyacchṛṇu rājendra godānasya tu yatphalam
yāvadvatsasya pādau dvau mukhaṃ yonyāṃ pradṛśyate / tāvadgauḥ pṛthivī jñeyā yāvad garbhaṃ na muñcati
yena kenāpyupāyena brāhmaṇe tāṃ samarpayet / pṛthvī dattā bhavet tena saśailavanakānanā
tārayenniyataṃ dattā kulānām ekaviṃśatim / raupyakhurīṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ savastrāṃ ca payasvinīm
ye prayacchanti kṛtino graste sūrye niśākare / teṣāṃ saṃkhyāṃ na jānāmi puṇyasyābdaśātair api
sarvasyāpi hi dānasya saṃkhyāstīha narādhipa / candrasūryoparāge ca dānasaṃkhyā na vidyate
yatra gaur dṛśyate rājan sarvatīrthāni tatra hi / tatra parva vijānīyānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā
punaḥ smṛtvā tu tattīrthaṃ yaḥ kuryād gamanaṃ naraḥ / athavā mriyate yo 'tra rudrasyānucaro bhavet

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhede dānadharmapraśaṃsāvarṇanaṃ nāmaikapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 52 īśvara uvāca: anyadākhyānakaṃ vakṣye purā vṛttaṃ narādhipa / sakuṭumbo gataḥ svargaṃ muniryatra mahātapāḥ
uttānapāda uvāca: kathaṃ nākaṃ gato vipraḥ sakuṭumbo mahānṛṣiḥ / kautukaṃ paramaṃ deva kathayasva mama prabho
īśvara uvāca: citrasena iti khyātaḥ kāśīrājaḥ purābhavat / śūro dātā sudharmātmā sarvakāmasamṛddhimān
sā purī janasaṃkīrṇā nānāratnopaśobhitā / vārāṇasīti vikhyātā gaṅgātīram upāśritā
śaraccandrapratīkāśā vidvajjanavibhūṣitā / indrayaṣṭisamākīrṇā gopagokulasaṃvṛtā
bahudhvajasamākīrṇā vedadhvaninināditā / vaṇigjanair bahuvidhaiḥ krayavikrayaśālinī
yantrādānaiḥ pratolībhiruccaiścānyaiḥ suśobhitā / devatāyatanair divyair āśramair gahanair yutā
nānāpuṣpaphalair ramyā kadalīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitā / panasair bakulais tālair aśokair āmrakais tathā
rājavṛkṣakapitthaiśca dāḍimair upaśobhitā / vedādhyayananirghoṣaiḥ pavitrīkṛtamaṅgalā
tasyā uttaradigbhāge āśramo 'bhūtsuśobhanaḥ / tanmandāravanaṃ nāma triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
bahumandārasaṃyuktaṃ tena mandārakaṃ viduḥ / vipro dīrghatapā nāma sarvadā tatra tiṣṭhati
tapastapati so 'tyarthaṃ tena dīrghatapāḥ smṛtaḥ / sa tiṣṭhati sapatnīkaḥ sasutaḥ sasnuṣas tathā
śuśrūṣanti sadā tasya putrāḥ pañca prayatnataḥ / tasya putraḥ kanīyāṃstu ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mahātapāḥ
vedādhyayanasampanno brahmacārī guṇānvitaḥ / yogābhyāsarato nityaṃ kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ
tiṣṭhate mṛgarūpeṇa mṛgayūthacarastadā / dinānte ca dinānte ca mātāpitroḥ samīpagaḥ
abhivādayate nityaṃ bhaktimān muniputrakaḥ / punargacchati tatraiva kānane girigahvare
krīḍanbālamṛgaiḥ sārddhaṃ pratyahaṃ sa muneḥ sutaḥ / kadāciddaivayogena ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mamāra saḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedamāhātmye ṛkṣaśṛṅgacaritre dīrghatapomunyākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma dvipañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 53 uttānapāda uvāca: āśrame vasatas tasya sa dīrghatapaso muneḥ / kanīyāṃs tanayo deva kathaṃ mṛtyumupāgataḥ
īśvara uvāca: śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā kathāṃ divyāṃ mahīpate / śravaṇādeva yasyāstu mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
kāśīrājo mahāvīryo mahābalaparākramaḥ / citrasena iti khyātāṃ dharaṇyāṃ sa narādhipa
tasya rājye sadā dharmo nādharmo vidyate kvacit / vedadharmarato nityaṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan
svadharmanirataścaiva yuddhātithyapriyaḥ sadā / kṣatradharmaṃ samāśritya bhogānbhuṅkte sa kāmataḥ
kośasyānto na vidyeta hastyaśvarathapattimān / itihāsapurāṇajñaiḥ paṇḍitaiḥ saha saṃkathām
kathayanrājate rājā kailāsa iva śaṅkaraḥ / evaṃ sa pālayanrājyaṃ rājā mantriṇam abravīt
mṛgayāyāṃ gamiṣyāmi tiṣṭhadhvaṃ rājyapālane / gamyatāṃ sacivaiḥ prokte gato 'sau vasudhādhipaḥ
aśvārūḍhāśca dhāvanto rājāno maṇḍalādhipāḥ / chatraiśchatrāṇi ghṛṣyanto 'nujagmuḥ kānanaṃ prati
rajastatrotthitaṃ bhaumaṃ gajavājipadāhatam / tenaitacchāditaṃ sarvaṃ sadiṅmārtaṇḍamaṃlam
na tatra dṛśyate sūryo na kāṣṭhā na ca candramāḥ / pādapāśca na dṛśyante giriśṛṅgāṇi sarvataḥ
parasparaṃ na paśyanti niśārddhe vārṣike yathā / tatrāsau sumahadyūthaṃ mṛgāṇāṃ samalakṣyata
adhāvatsahitaḥ sarvaiḥ sa rājā rājaputrakaiḥ / vṛndāsphoṭo 'bhavat teṣāṃ śīghraṃ jagmurdiśo daśa
ekamārgagato rājā citraseno mahīpatiḥ / ekākī sa gatastatra yatra yatra ca te mṛgāḥ
praviṣṭo 'sau tato durgaṃ kānanaṃ girigahvaram / vallīgulmasamākīrṇaṃ sthito yatra na lakṣyate
adṛśyāṃstu mṛgānmatvā diśo rājā vyalokayat / kāṃ diśaṃ nu gamiṣyāmi kva me sainyasamāgamaḥ
evaṃ kaṣṭaṃ gato rājā citraseno narādhipaḥ / vṛkṣacchāyāṃ samāśritya viśrāmamakaronnṛpaḥ
kṣuttṛṣārto bhramandurge kānane girigahvare / tato 'paśyatsaro divyaṃ padminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam
haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ cakravākopaśobhitam / tato dṛṣṭvā sa rājendraḥ samprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ
kamalāni gṛhītvā tu tataḥ snānaṃ samācarat / tarpayitvā pitṛdevānmanuṣyāṃśca yathāvidhi
ācchādya śatapatraiśca pūjayāmāsa śaṅkaram / yayau pānīyamamalaṃ yathāvatsa samāhitaḥ
uttīrya salilāttīre dṛṣṭvā vṛkṣaṃ samīpagam / uttarīyamadhaḥ kṛtvopaviṣṭo dharaṇītale
cintayannupaviṣṭo 'sau kimadya prakaromyaham / tatrāsīno dadarśātha vanoddeśe mṛgānbahūn
kecitpūrvamukhāstatra cāpare dakṣiṇāmukhāḥ / vāruṇyamimukhāḥ kecit kecit kauberadiṅmukhāḥ
kecin nidrāparāḥ kecidūrdhvakarṇāḥ sthitāḥ pare / mṛgamadhye sthito yogī ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mahātapāḥ
mṛgāndṛṣṭvā tato rājā āhārārtham acintayat / hatvaiteṣu mṛgaṃ kaṃcidbhakṣayāmi yadṛcchayā
svasthāvastho bhaviṣyāmi mṛgamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇāt / kāśīṃ prati gamiṣyāmi mārgamanviṣya yatnataḥ
vicintyaivaṃ tato rājā vṛkṣamūlamupāśritaḥ / cāpaṃ gṛhya karāgreṇa sa śaraṃ saṃdadhe tataḥ
vicikṣepa śaraṃ tatra yatra te bahavo mṛgāḥ / teṣāṃ madhye sa vai viddha ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mahātapāḥ
jagmustrastāstu te sarve śabdaṃ kṛtvā vanaukasaḥ / sa ṛṣiḥ patitas tatra kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti cābravīt
hāhā kaṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ tena yenāhaṃ ghātito 'dhunā / kasyaiṣā durmatirjātā pāpabuddher mamopari
mṛgamadhye sthitaścāhaṃ na kaṃcid uparodhaye / tāṃ vācaṃ mānuṣīṃ śrutvā sa rājā vismayānvitaḥ
śīghraṃ gatvā tato 'paśyad brāhmaṇaṃ brahmatejasā / hāhā kaṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ me 'dya yenāsau ghātito dvijaḥ
citrasena uvāca: akāmādghātitastvaṃ tu mṛgabhrāntyā mayānagha / gṛhītvā bahudārūṇi svatanuṃ dāhayāmyaham
dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaṃ tu yatkiṃcinna samaṃ brahmahatyayā / anyathā brahmahatyāyāḥ śuddhir me na bhaviṣyati
ṛkṣaśṛṅga uvāca: na te siddhir bhavet kācinmayi pañcatvamāgate / bahvyo hatyā bhaviṣyanti vināśe mama sāmpratam
jananī me pitā vṛddho bhrātaraśca tapasvinaḥ / bhrātṛjāyā mariṣyanti mayi pañcatvam āgate
etā hatyā bhaviṣyanti kathaṃ śuddhirbhavet tava / upāyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi taṃ kartuṃ yadi manyase
citrasena uvāca: upāyaḥ kathyatāṃ me 'dya yaste manasi vartate / kariṣye tamahaṃ sarvaṃ yatnenāpi mahāmune
ṛkṣaśṛṅga uvāca: pṛcchāmi tvāṃ kathaṃ ko vā kutastvamiha cāgataḥ / brahmakṣatraviśāṃ madhye ko bhavānuta śūdrajaḥ
citrasena uvāca: nāhaṃ śūdro 'smi bhostāta na vaiśyo brāhmaṇo na vā / na cāntyajo 'smi viprendra kṣatriyo 'smi mahāmune
dharmajñaśca kṛtajñaśca sarvasattvahite rataḥ / akāmāt pātakaṃ jātaṃ kathaṃ śuddhirbhaviṣyati
ṛkṣaśṛṅga uvāca: māṃ gṛhītvā āśramaṃ gaccha yatra tau pitarau mama / āvedayasva cātmānaṃ putraghātinam āturam
te dṛṣṭvā māṃ kariṣyanti kāruṇyaṃ ca tavopari / upāyaṃ kathayiṣyanti yena śāntirbhaviṣyati
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā citraseno nṛpottama / skandhe kṛtvā tu taṃ vipraṃ jagāmāśramasannidhau
na śaknoti yadā voḍhuṃ viśrāmyati punaḥpunaḥ / tāvat paśyati taṃ vipraṃ mūrchitaṃ vikalendriyam
mumoca citrasenas taṃ chāyāyāṃ vaṭabhūruhaḥ / vastraṃ caturguṇaṃ kṛtvā cakre vātaṃ muhurmuhuḥ
paśyatas tasya rājendra ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mahātapāḥ / pañcatvamagamacchīghraṃ dhyānayogena yogavit
dāhayāmāsa taṃ vipraṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā / snānaṃ kṛtvā sa śokārto vilalāpa muhurmuhuḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedamāhātmye ṛkṣaśṛṅgasvargagamanavarṇanaṃ nāma tripañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 54 īśvara uvāca: tataścānantaraṃ rājā jagāmodvegam uttamam / kathaṃ yāmi gṛhaṃ tvadya vārāṇasyām ahaṃ punaḥ
brahmahatyāsamāviṣṭo juhomyagnau kalevaram / athavā tasya vākyena taṃ gacchāmyāśramaṃ prati
kathayāmi yathāvṛttaṃ gatvā tasya mahāmuneḥ / evaṃ saṃcintya rājāsau jagāmāśramasannidhau
ṛkṣaśṛṅgasya cāsthīni gṛhītvā sa nṛpottamaḥ / dṛṣṭimārge sthitastasya maharṣer bhāvitātmanaḥ
dīrghatapā uvāca: āgaccha svāgataṃ te 'stu āsane 'tropaviśyatām / arghaṃ dadāmyahaṃ yena madhuparkaṃ saviṣṭaram
citrasena uvāca: arghasyāsya na yogyo 'haṃ maharṣe nāsmi bhāṣaṇe / mṛgamadhyasthito vipras tava putro mayā hataḥ
putraghnaṃ viddhi māṃ vipra tīvradaṇḍena daṇḍaya / mṛgabhrāntyā hato vipra ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mahātapāḥ
iti matvā muniśreṣṭha kuru me tvaṃ yathocitam / mātā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā gṛhān niṣkramya vihvalā
hā hatāsmītyuvācedaṃ papāta dharaṇītale / vilalāpa suduḥkhārtā putraśokena pīḍitā
hā hatā putra putreti karuṇaṃ kurarī yathā / vilalāpāturā mātā kva gato māṃ vihāya vai / mukhaṃ darśaya cātmīyaṃ mātaraṃ māṃ hi mānaya
śrutādhyayanasampannaṃ japahomaparāyaṇam / āgataṃ tvāṃ gṛhadvāre kadā drakṣyāmi putraka
lokoktyā śrūyate caitaccandanaṃ kila śītalam / putragātrapariṣvaṅgaścandanād api śītalaḥ
kiṃ candanena pīyūpabindunā kiṃ kimindunā
putragātrapariṣvaṅgapātraṃ gātraṃ bhavedyadi
pariṣvajitum icchāmi tvāmahaṃ putra supriya / pañcatvam anuyāsyāmi tvadvihīnādya duḥkhitā
evaṃ vilapatī dīnā putraśokena pīḍitā / mūrchitā vihvalā dīnā nipapāta mahītale
bhāryāṃ ca patitāṃ dṛṣṭvā putraśokena pīḍitām / cukopa sa munistatra citrasenāya bhūbhṛte
dīrghatapā uvāca: yāhi yāhi mahāpāpa mā mukhaṃ darśayasva me / kiṃ tvayā ghātito vipro hyakāmācca suto mama
brahmahatyā bhaviṣyanti bahvyaste vasudhādhipa / sakuṭumbasya me tvaṃ hi mṛtyureṣa upasthitaḥ
evamuktvā tato vipro vicintya ca punaḥpunaḥ / parityajya tadā krodhaṃ munibhāvājjagāda ha
dīrghatapā uvāca: udvegaṃ tyaja bho vatsa duruktaṃ gadito mayā / putraśokābhibhūtena duḥkhataptena mānada
kiṃ karoti naraḥ prājñaḥ preryamāṇaḥ svakarmabhiḥ / prāgeva hi manuṣyāṇāṃ buddhiḥ karmānusāriṇī
anenaiva vidhānena pañcatvaṃ vihitaṃ mama / hatyāstava bhaviṣyanti pūrvamuktā na saṃśayaḥ
brahmakṣatraviśāṃ madhye śūdracaṇḍālajātiṣu / kastvaṃ kathaya satyaṃ me kasmācca nihato dvijaḥ
citrasena uvāca: vijñāpayāmi viprarṣe kṣantavyaṃ te mamopari / nāhaṃ vipro 'smi vai tāta na vaiśyo na ca śūdrajaḥ
na vyādhaścāntyajāto vā kṣatriyo 'haṃ mahāmune / kāśīrājo mṛgān hantum āgato vanamuttamam
bhrāntyā nipātito hyeṣa mṛgarūpadharo muniḥ / idānīṃ tava pādānte saṃśritaḥ pātakānvitaḥ
kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā vipra upāyaṃ kathayasva me
dīrghatapā uvāca: brahmahatyā na śakyetāpyekā nistarituṃ prabho / daśaikā ca kathaṃ śakyāstāḥ śṛṇuṣva nareśvara
