atriruvāca: sādhu sādhu mahāprājñe mama saṃtoṣakāriṇi / ājñātā tvaṃ mayā bhadre putrārthaṃ tapa āśraya
devatānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ pitḥṇāmanṛṇo bhave / na bhāryāsadṛśo bandhustriṣu lokeṣu vidyate
tena devāḥ praśaṃsanti na bhāryāsadṛśaṃ sukham / sanmukhe manmukhāḥ putrāḥ vilome tu parāṅmukhāḥ
tena bhāryāṃ praśaṃsanti sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ / mahāvrate mahāprājñe sattvavati śubhekṣaṇe
tapastapasva śīghraṃ tvaṃ putrārthaṃ tu mamājñayā / etadvākyāvasāne tu sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇatābravīt
tvatprasādena viprendra sarvānkāmānavāpnuyām / haṃsalīlāgatiḥ sā ca mṛgākṣī varavarṇinī
niyamasthā tato bhūtvā samprāptā narmadāṃ nadīm / śivasvedodbhavāṃ devīṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanīm
yasyā darśanamātreṇa naśyate pāpasañcayaḥ / snānamātreṇa vai yasyā aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
ye pibanti mahādevi śraddadhānāḥ payaḥ śubham / somapānena tattulyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
ye smaranti divā rātrau yojanānāṃ śatairapi / mucyante sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ prayānti te
narmadāyāḥ samīpe tu tāvubhau yojanadvaye / na paśyanti yamaṃ tatra ye mṛtā varavarṇini
tatastaduttare kūle eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgame śubhe / niyamasthā viśālākṣī śākāhāreṇa sundari
toṣayantī trīṃśca devāñchubhaiḥ stotrair vrataistathā / grīṣmeṣu ca mahādevi pañcāgniṃ sādhayet tataḥ
varṣākāle cārdravāsāścareccāndrāyaṇāni ca / hemante tu tataḥ prāpte toyamadhye vasetsadā
prātaḥsnānaṃ tataḥ sandhyāṃ kuryād devarṣitarpaṇam / devānāmarcanaṃ kṛtvā homaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi
yajate vaiṣṇavāṃl lokān snānajāpyahutena ca / evaṃ varṣaśate prāpte rudraviṣṇupitāmahāḥ
samprāptā dvijarūpaistu eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgame priye / purataḥ saṃsthitāstasyā vedamabhyuddharanti ca
anasūyā japaṃ tyaktvā nirīkṣya tānmuhurmuhuḥ / utthitā sā viśālākṣī arghaṃ dattvā yathāvidhi
adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ / darśanena tu viprāṇāṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇatābravīt / kandamūlaphalaṃ śākaṃ nīvārānapi pāvanān / prayacchāmyahamadyaiva munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām
viprā ūcuḥ / tapasā tu vicitreṇa tapaḥsatyena suvrate / tṛptāḥ sma sarvakāmaistu suvrate tava darśanāt
asmākaṃ kautukaṃ jātaṃ tāpasena vratena yat / svargamokṣasutasyārthe tapastapasi duṣkaram
anasūyovāca: tapasā sidhyate svargastapasā paramā gatiḥ / tapasā cārthakāmau ca tapasā guṇavānsutaḥ / tapa eva ca me viprāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradam
viprā ūcuḥ / tanvī śyāmā viśālākṣī snigdhāṅgī rūpasaṃyutā / haṃsalīlāgatigamā tvaṃ ca sarvāṅgasundarī
kiṃ ca te tapasā kāryamātmānaṃ śocyase katham
anasūyovāca: yadi rudraśca viṣṇuśca svayaṃ sākṣātpitāmahaḥ / gūḍharūpadharāḥ sarve taccihnamupalakṣaye
tasyā vākyāvasāne tu svarūpaṃ darśayanti te / svasvarūpaiḥ sthitā devāḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhāḥ
caturbhujo mahādevi śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ / atasīpuṣpavarṇastu pītavāsā janārdanaḥ
garutmānvāhanaṃ yasya śriyā ca sahito hariḥ / prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānsvayaṃrūpo vyavasthitaḥ
pītavāsā mahādevi caturvadanapaṅkajaḥ / haṃsopari samārūḍho hyakṣamālākarodyataḥ
āgato narmadātīre brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / yo 'sau sarvajagadvyāpī svayaṃ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ
vṛṣabhaṃ tu samārūḍho daśabāhusamanvitaḥ / bhasmāṅgarāgaśobhāḍhyaḥ pañcavaktrastrilocanaḥ
jaṭāmukuṭasaṃyuktaḥ kṛtacandrārddhaśekharaḥ / evaṃrūpadharo devaḥ sarvavyāpī maheśvaraḥ
anasūyā nirīkṣyaitaddevānāṃ darśanaṃ param / vepamānā tataḥ sādhvī surāndṛṣṭvā muhurmuhuḥ
anasūyovāca: kiṃ vyāpārasvarūpāstu viṣṇurudrapitāmahāḥ / etadvai śrotumicchāmi hyaśeṣaṃ kathayantu me
brahmovāca: prāvṛṭkālo hyahaṃ brahmā āpaścaiva prakīrtitāḥ / megharūpo hyahaṃ prokto varṣayāmi ca bhūtale
ahaṃ sarvāṇi bījāni prāksandhyāsūdite ravau / etadvai kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ param
viṣṇuruvāca: hemantaśca bhavedviṣṇurviśvarūpaṃ carācaram / pālanāya jagatsarvaṃ viṣṇormāhātmyamuttamam
rudra uvāca: grīṣmakālo hyahaṃ proktaḥ sarvabhūtakṣayaṃkaraḥ / karṣayāmi jagatsarvaṃ rudrarūpastapasvini
evaṃ brahmā ca viṣṇuśca rudraścaiva mahāvrate / trayo devāstrayaḥ sandhyāstrayaḥ kālāstrayo 'gnayaḥ
tathā brahmā ca viṣṇuśca rudraścaikātmatāṃ gataḥ / varaṃ dadyuśca te bhadre yastvayā manasīpsitam
anasūyovāca: dhanyā puṇyā hyahaṃ loke ślāghyā vandyā ca sarvadā / brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca prasannavadanāḥ śubhāḥ
yadi tuṣṭāstrayo devā dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari / asmiṃstīrthe tu sāṃnidhyādvaradāḥ santu me sadā
rudra uvāca: evaṃ bhavatu te vākyaṃ yattvayā prārthitaṃ śubhe / pratyakṣā vaiṣṇavī māyā eraṇḍīnāma nāmataḥ
yasyā darśanamātreṇa naśyate pāpasañcayaḥ / caitramāse tu samprāpte ahorātroṣito bhavet
eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgame snātvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati / rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt prabhāte bhojayed dvijān
yathoktena vidhānena piṇḍaṃ dadyād yathāvidhi / pradakṣiṇāṃ tato dadyāddhiraṇyaṃ vastrameva ca
rajataṃ ca tathā gāvo bhūmidānam athāpi vā / sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ proktamiti svāyambhuvo 'bravīt
ye mriyanti narā devi eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgame śubhe / yāvadyugasahasraṃ tu rudraloke vasanti te
ahorātroṣito bhūtvā japedrudrāṃśca vaidikān / ekādaśaikasaṃjñāṃśca sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam / putrārthī labhate putrāṃl labhet kāmān yathepsitān
eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgame snātvā revāyā vimale jale / mahāpātakino vāpi te yānti paramāṃ gatim
anasūyovāca: yadi tuṣṭāstrayo devā mama bhaktipracoditāḥ / mama putrā bhavantveva harirudrapitāmahāḥ
viṣṇuruvāca: pūjyā yatputratāṃ yānti na kadācicchrutaṃ mayā / śubhe dadāmi putrāṃste devatulyaparākramān / rūpavanto guṇopetānyajvinaśca bahuśrutān
anasūyovāca: īpsitaṃ tacca dātavyaṃ yanmayā prārthitaṃ hare / nānyathā caiva kartavyā mama putraiṣaṇā tu yā
viṣṇuruvāca: pūrvaṃ tu bhṛgusaṃvāde garbhavāsa upārjitaḥ / tasyāhaṃ caiva pāraṃ tu naiva paśyāmi śobhane
smaramāṇaḥ purāvṛttaṃ cintayāmi punaḥpunaḥ / evaṃ saṃcintya te devāḥ pitāmahamaheśvarāḥ
ayonijā bhaviṣyāmastava putrā varānane / yonivāse mahāprājñi devā naiva vrajanti ca
sāṃnidhyātsaṅgame devi lokānāṃ tu varapradāḥ / eraṇḍī vaiṣṇavī māyā pratyakṣā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi
trayo devāḥ sthitāḥ pātha revāyā uttare taṭe / varaprāptā tu sā devī gatā māhendraparvatam
kṣīṇāṅgī śukladehā ca rūkṣakeśī sudāruṇā / kṛtayajñopavītā sā taponiṣṭhā śubhekṣaṇā
śilātalaniviṣṭo 'sau dṛṣṭaḥ kānto mahāyaśāḥ / hṛṣṭacitto 'bhavaddevi uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha sābravīt
atriruvāca: sādhu sādhu mahāprājñe hyanasūye mahāvrate / acintyaṃ gālavādīnāṃ varaṃ prāptāsi durlabham
anasūyovāca: tvatprasādena devarṣe varaṃ prāptāsmi durlabham / tena devāḥ praśaṃsanti siddhāśca ṛṣayo 'malāḥ
evamuktā tu sā devī harṣeṇa mahatā yutā / ālokayettataḥ kāntaṃ tenāpi śubhadarśanā
īkṣaṇāccaiva saṃjātaṃ lalāṭe maṇḍalaṃ śubham / navayojanasāhasraṃ maṇḍalaṃ raśmibhirvṛtam
kadambagolakākāraṃ triguṇaṃ parimaṇḍalam / tasya madhye tu deveśi puruṣo divyarūpadhṛk
hemavarṇo 'mṛtamayaḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ / ādyaḥ putro 'nasūyāyāḥ svayaṃ sākṣātpitāmahaḥ
candramā iti vikhyātaḥ somarūpo nṛpātmaja / iṣṭāpūrte ca saṃpāti kalāṣoḍaśakena tu
pratipac ca dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca maheśvari / caturthī pañcamī caiva avyayā ṣoḍaśī kalā
caturvidhasya lokasya sūkṣmo bhūtvā varānane / āprīṇāti jagatsarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
sarve te hyupajīvanti hutaṃ dattaṃ śaśisthitam / vanaspatigate some dhanavāṃśca varānane
bhuñjan paragṛhe mūḍho dadedabdakṛtaṃ śubham / vanaspatigate some yastu chindyādvanaspatīn / tena pāpena deveśi narā yānti yamālayam
vanaspatigate some maithunaṃ yo niṣevate / brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
vanaspatigate some manthānaṃ yo 'dhivāhayet / gāvastasya praṇaśyanti yāśca vai pūrvasaṃcitāḥ
vanaspatigate some hyadhvānaṃ yo 'dhigacchati / bhavanti pitarastasya taṃ māsaṃ reṇubhojanāḥ
amāvasyāṃ mahādevi yastu śrāddhaprado bhavet / abdamekaṃ viśālākṣi tṛptāstatpitaro dhruvam
hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ yo dadāti dvijātiṣu / sarvaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ devi labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
evaṃ guṇaviśiṣṭo 'sau somarūpaḥ prajāpatiḥ / saṃjātaḥ prathamaḥ putro hyanasūyāsunandanaḥ
dvitīyastu mahādevi durvāsā nāma nāmataḥ / sṛṣṭisaṃhārakartā ca svayaṃ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ
ṛṣimadhyagato devi tapastapati duṣkaram / so 'pi rudratvamāyāti samprāpte bhūtaviplave
indro 'pi śaptastenaiva durvāsasā varānane / dvitīyasya tu putrasya sambhavaḥ kathito mayā
dattātreyasvarūpeṇa bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ / jagadvyāpī jagannāthaḥ svayaṃ sākṣājjanārdanaḥ
ete devāstrayaḥ putrā anasūyāyā maheśvari / varadānena te devā hyavatīrṇā mahītale
putraprāptikaraṃ tīrthaṃ revāyāścottare taṭe / anasūyākṛtaṃ pārtha sarvapāpakṣayaṃ param
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: āścaryabhūtaṃ loke 'sminnarmadāyāṃ purātanam / bhrūṇahatyā gatā tatra brāhmaṇasya narādhipa
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: itihāsaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha kathayasva mamānagha / sarvapāpaharaṃ loke duḥkhārtasya ca kathyatām
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: suvarṇaśilake grāme gautamānvayasambhavaḥ / kṛṣīvalo mahādevi bhāryāputrasamanvitaḥ
vasate tatra govindaḥ saṃjāto vipule kule / putradārasamopeto gṛhakṣetrarataḥ sadā
śakaṭaṃ pūrayitvā tu kāṣṭhānāmagamadguham / prakṣiptāni ca kāṣṭhāni hyekākī kṣudhayānvitaḥ
riṅgamāṇas tadā putraḥ pituḥ śabdātsamāgataḥ / na dṛṣṭastena vai putraḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ saṃchādito 'vaśaḥ
āgatastvarito gehe pipāsārto narādhipa / śakaṭaṃ mocya taddvāri savṛṣaṃ rajjusaṃyutam
bhāryā tasyaiva yā dṛṣṭā cittajñā vaśavartinī / dṛṣṭvā nipātitaṃ putraṃ kāṣṭhairnirbhinnamastakam
ajalpamānākaruṇaṃ nikṣiptaṃ jñolikāṃ śiśum / śuśrūṣaṇe ratā sādhvī priyasya ca narādhipa
tataḥ snānādikaṃ kṛtvā bhojanācchayanaṃ śubham / putraṃ putravatāṃ śreṣṭhā hyutthāpayati śāsanaiḥ
yadā ca notthitaḥ suptaḥ putraḥ pañcatvamāgataḥ / tadā sā dīnavadanā ruroda ca mumoha ca
tacchrutvā ruditaṃ śabdaṃ govindastrastamānasaḥ / kimetaditi coktvā tu patito dharaṇītale
dvāvetau muktakeśau tu bhūmau nipatitau nṛpa / vilepāte ca rājendra niḥśvāsocchvāsitena ca
kaṃ paśye prāṅgaṇe putraṃ dṛṣṭvā krīḍantamāturam / saṃdhārayiṣye hṛdayaṃ sphuṭitaṃ tava kāraṇe
tvajjanmāntaṃ yaśo nityam akṣayāṃ kulasantatim / dṛṣṭvā kim anṛṇībhūto yāsyāmi paramāṃ gatim
mama vṛddhasya dīnasya gatistvaṃ kila putraka / ete manorathāḥ sarve cintitā viphalā gatāḥ
imāṃ tu vikalāṃ dīnāṃ vihīnāṃ sutabāndhavaiḥ / rudantīṃ patitāṃ pāhi mātaraṃ dharaṇītale
punnāmno narakādyasmāt pitaraṃ trāyate sutaḥ / tena putra iti proktaḥ svayameva svayambhuvā
aputrasya gṛhaṃ śūnyaṃ diśaḥ śūnyā hyabāndhavāḥ / mūrkhasya hṛdayaṃ śūnyaṃ sarvaśūnyaṃ daridratā
mṛṣāyaṃ vadate lokaścandanaṃ kila śītalam / putragātrapariṣvaṅgaścandanādapi śītalaḥ
śmaśrugrahaṇakrīḍantaṃ dhūlidhūsaritānanam / puṇyahīnā na paśyanti nijotsaṅgasamāsthitam
digambaraṃ gatavrīḍaṃ jaṭilaṃ dhūlidhūsaram / puṇyahīnā na paśyanti gaṅgādharamivātmajam
vīṇāvādyasvaro loke susvaraḥ śrūyate kila / ruditaṃ bālakasyaiva tasmād āhlādakārakam
mṛgapakṣiṣu kākeṣu paśūnāṃ svarayoniṣu / putraṃ teṣu samasteṣu vallabhaṃ bruvate budhāḥ
matsyāśvaprakarāścaiva kūrmagrāhādayo 'pi vā / putrotpattau ca hṛṣyanti vipattau yānti duḥkhitām
devagandharvayakṣāśca hṛṣyante putrajanmani / pañcatve te 'pi śocanti mandabhāgyo 'smi putraka
ṛṣimelāpakaṃ cakre putrārthe rāghavo nṛpa / indrasthāne sthitastasya prokṣate hyāsanaṃ yataḥ
svargavāsaṃ sutādbāhyaṃ vidyate na tu pāṇḍava / cakre daśarathas tasmāt putrārthaṃ yajñamuttamam
rāmo lakṣmaṇaśatrughnau bharatastatra sambhavāt / kārtavīryo jito yena rāmeṇāmitatejasā
sa rāmo rāmacandreṇa aṣṭavarṣeṇa nirjitaḥ / ekākinā hato vālī plavagaḥ śatrudurjayaḥ
rāvaṇo brahmaputro yastrailokyaṃ yasya śaṅkate / hataḥ sa rāmacandreṇa saputraḥ sahabāndhavaḥ
evaṃ putraṃ vinā saukhyaṃ martyaloke na vidyate / vaṃśārthe maithunaṃ yasya svargārthe yasya bhāratī
mṛṣṭānnaṃ brāhmaṇasyārthe svarge vāsaṃ tu yānti te / brahmahatyāśvamedhābhyāṃ na paraṃ pāpapuṇyayoḥ
putrotpattivipattibhyāṃ na paraṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ / kiṃ bravīmīti bho vatsa na tu saukhyaṃ sutaṃ vinā
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ duḥkhaṃ pralapitvā punaḥpunaḥ / janaiścāśvāsito vipro bālaṃ gṛhya bahirgataḥ
tataḥ saṃskṛtya taṃ bālaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā / samavetau tu duḥkhārtāvāgatau svagṛhaṃ punaḥ
evaṃ gṛhāgate vipre rātrirjātā yudhiṣṭhira / bhūmau prasupto govindaḥ putraśokena pīḍitaḥ
yāvannirīkṣate bhāryā bhartāraṃ duḥkhapīḍitam / kṛmirāśigataṃ sarvaṃ govindaṃ samapaśyata
duḥkhādduḥkhatare magnā dṛṣṭvā taṃ pātakānvitam / evaṃ duḥkhanimagnāyāḥ śarvarī vigatā tadā
paśupālastu mahiṣīmuktvāraṇye 'gamadgṛhāt / araṇye mahiṣīḥ sarvā rakṣayitvā gṛhāgataḥ
vijñaptaḥ paśupālena govindo brāhmaṇottamaḥ / yāvadbhokṣyāmyahaṃ svāminmahiṣīstvaṃ ca rakṣase
tataḥ sa tvarito vipro jagāma mahiṣīḥ prati / na tatra mahiṣīḥ paśyet paścāt kṣetrābhisammukham
dhāvamānaśca viprastu eraṇḍīsaṅgame gataḥ / tataḥ praviṣṭastu jale revairaṇḍyostu saṅgame
tajjalaṃ pītamātraṃ tu tvarayā cātitarṣitaḥ / akāmāt salilaṃ pītvā prakṣālya nayane śubhe
ājagāma tataḥ paścādbhavanaṃ divasakṣaye / bhuktvā duḥkhānvito rātrau govindaḥ śayanaṃ yayau
nidrābhibhūtaḥ śokena śrameṇaiva tu kheditaḥ / punastaccārdharātre tu tasya bhāryā yudhiṣṭhira
kṛmibhirveṣṭitaṃ gāntraṃ kvacit paśyatyaveṣṭitam / punaḥ sā vismayāviṣṭā tasya bhāryā guṇānvitā / uvāca duṣkṛtaṃ tasya sādhvasāviṣṭacetasā
bhāryovāca: atīte pañcame cāhni tvindhanaṃ kṣipatastu te / gṛhapaścādgato bālo hyajñānādghātitastvayā
mayā tatpātakaṃ ghoraṃ rahasyaṃ na prakāśitam / tena pracchannapāpena dahyamānā divāniśam
na sukhaṃ tava gātrasya paśyāmi na hi cātmanaḥ / nidrā mama śamaṃ yātā ratiścaiva tvayā saha
śrūyate mānave śāstre śloko gīto maharṣibhiḥ / smṛtvā smṛtvā tu taṃ citte paritāpo na śāmyati
kīrtanān naśyate dharmo vardhate 'sau nigūhanāt / iha loke pare caiva pāpasyāpyevameva ca
evaṃ saṃcityamānāhaṃ sthitā rātrau bhayāturā / kṛmirāśigataṃ tvāṃ hi kasyāhaṃ kathayāmi kim
punastvaṃ cādya me dṛṣṭo bhrūṇahatyākṛmiśritaḥ / kvacidbhindanti te gātraṃ kvacinnaṣṭāḥ samantataḥ
etatsaṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya vimṛśāmi punaḥpunaḥ / na jāne kāraṇaṃ kiṃcitpṛcchantyāḥ kathayasva me
taḍāgaṃ vā saridvāpi tīrthaṃ vā devatārcanam / yaṃ gato 'si prabhāvo 'yaṃ tasya nānyasya me sthitam
evamuktastu vipro 'sau kathayāmāsa bhārata / bhāryāyā yaddivā vṛttaṃ śaṅkamāno nṛpottama
adyāhaṃ mahiṣīsārthaṃ eraṇḍīsaṅgamaṃ gataḥ / nābhimātre jale gatvā pītavānsalilaṃ bahu
nānyattīrthaṃ vijānāmi saritaṃ sara eva vā / satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ kathitaṃ tava bhāmini
evaṃ jñātvā tu sā sarvamupavāsakṛtakṣaṇā / sapatnīko gatastatra saṅgame varavarṇini
snātvā tatra jale ramye natvā devaṃ tu bhāskaram / snāpayāmāsa deveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ comayā saha
pañcagavyaghṛtakṣīrair dadhikṣaudraghṛtairjalaiḥ / gandhamālyādidhūpaiśca naivedyaiśca suśobhanaiḥ
pūjya trayīmayaṃ liṅgaṃ devīṃ kātyāyanīṃ śubhām / rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā patyāsi pativratā
tataḥ prabhāte vimale dvijānsampūjya yatnataḥ / godānena hiraṇyena vastreṇānnena bhārata
govindaḥ pūjayāmāsa svaśaktyā brāhmaṇāñchubhān / muktapāpo gṛhāyātaḥ svabhāryāsahito nṛpa
evaṃ yaḥ śṛṇute bhaktyā govindākhyānamuttamam / paṭhate parayā bhaktyā bhrūṇahatyā praṇaśyati
krīḍate śāṃkare loke yāvadābhūtasamplavam / yaścaivāśvayuje māsi caitre vā nṛpasattama
saptamyāṃ ca site pakṣe sopavāso jitendriyaḥ / sāttvikīṃ vāsanāṃ kṛtvā yo vasecchivamandire
dhyāyamāno virūpākṣaṃ triśūlakarasaṃsthitam / kaṃsāsuranihantāraṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam
pakṣirājasamārūḍhaṃ trailokyavaradāyakam / pitāmahaṃ tato dhyāyeddhaṃsasthaṃ caturānanam
sargapradaṃ samastasya kamalākaraśobhitam / yo hyevaṃ vasate tatra triyame sthāna uttame
tataḥ prabhāte vimale hyaṣṭamyāṃ ca narādhipa / brāhmaṇān pūjayed bhaktyā sarvadoṣavivarjitān
sarvāvayavasampūrṇānsarvaśāstraviśāradān / vedābhyāsaratānnityaṃ svadāraniratānsadā
śrāddhe dāne vrate yogyān brāhmaṇān pāṇḍunandana / pretānāṃ pūjanaṃ tatra devapūrvaṃ samārabhet
pretatvān mucyate śīghrameraṇḍyāṃ piṇḍatarpaṇaiḥ / dānāni tatra deyāni hyannamukhyāni sarvadā
hiraṇyabhūmikanyāśca dhūrvāhau śubhalakṣaṇau / sīreṇa sahitau pārtha dhānyaṃ droṇakasaṃkhyayā
alaṃkṛtāṃ savatsāṃ ca kṣīriṇīṃ taruṇīṃ sitām / raktāṃ vā kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ vā pāṭalāṃ kapilāṃ tathā
kāṃsyadohanasaṃyuktāṃ rukmakhuravibhūṣaṇām / svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ savatsāṃ ca brāhmaṇāyopapādayet
prīyatāṃ me jagannāthā harakṛṣṇapitāmahāḥ / saṃsārarakṣaṇī devī surabhī māṃ samuddharet
putrārthaṃ yāḥ striyaḥ pārtha hyeraṇḍīsaṅgame nṛpa / snāpyante rudrasūktaiśca caturvedodbhavaistathā
caturbhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ śastaṃ dvābhyāṃ yogyaiśca kārayet / ekena sārdrakumbhena dāmpatyamabhiṣecayet
daivajñenaiva caikena athavā sāmagena vā / pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ kumbhe tatraiva kārayet
gandhatoyasamāyuktaṃ sarvauṣadhivimiśritam / āmrapallavasaṃyuktam aśvatthamadhukaṃ tathā
guṇṭhitaṃ sitavastreṇa sitacandanacarcitam / sitapuṣpaistu saṃchannaṃ siddhārthakṛtamadhyamam
kāṃsyapātre tu saṃsthāpya putrārthī deśikottamaḥ / aṅgalagnaṃ tu yadvastraṃ kaṭakābharaṇaṃ tathā
tatsarvaṃ maṇḍale tyājyaṃ siddhyarthaṃ cātmanastadā / praṇamya bhāskaraṃ paścādācāryaṃ rudrarūpiṇam
madhuraṃ ca tato 'śnīyād devyā bhuvana uttame / phaladānaṃ ca viprāya chatraṃ tāmbūlameva ca
upānahau ca yānaṃ ca sa bhaved duḥkhavarjitaḥ / bhāskare krīḍate loke yāvad ābhūtasamplavam
dānaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ sarvaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham / yathā nadīnadāḥ sarve sāgare yānti saṃkṣayam
evaṃ pāpāni naśyanti hyeraṇḍīsaṅgame nṛṇām / samantācchastrapātena hyeraṇḍīsaṅgame nṛpa
bhrūṇahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ naśyate śaṅkaro 'bravīt / prāṇatyāgaṃ ca yo bhaktyā jātavedasi kārayet
anāśakaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha jale vā tadanantaram / pañcasāhasrikaṃ mānaṃ varṣāṇāṃ jātavedasi
jale trīṇi sahasrāṇyanāśake ṣaṣṭiṃ bhuñjate / kākā bakāḥ kapotāśca hyulūkāḥ paśavas tathā
saṃgamodakasaṃspṛṣṭās te yānti paramāṃ gatim / vṛkṣāśca tatpadaṃ jñātvā yāṃ gatiṃ yānti yoginaḥ
eraṇḍikā mayā devī dṛṣṭo me manmatheśvaraḥ / kiṃ samartho yamo ruṣṭo bhadro bhadrāṇi paśyati
mṛttikāṃ saṅgamodbhūtāṃ ye ca guṇṭhanti nityaśaḥ / bhrūṇahatyādipāpāni naśyante nātra saṃśayaḥ
eraṇḍīsaṅgame martyo luṇṭhyamāno narādhipa / sarvapāpairvinirmuktaḥ padaṃ gacchatyanāmayam
eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgamaṃ martyāḥ kīrtayantyāśramasthitāḥ / vimuktapāpā jāyante satyaṃ śaṅkarabhāṣitam
eraṇḍīpādapāgraistu dṛṣṭaiḥ pāpaṃ vyapohati
tīrthākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ ye paṭhiṣyanti mānavāḥ / śṛṇvanti cāpare bhaktyā muktapāpā bhavanti te
etatte sarvamākhyātam eraṇḍīsaṅgamaṃ nṛpa / bhūyaścānyat pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe eraṇḍīsaṅgamatīrthaphalamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tryadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 104 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpālaṃ sauvarṇaśilamuttamam / prakhyātamuttare kūle sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
samantācchatapātena munisaṅghaiḥ purā kṛtam / revāyāṃ durlabhaṃ sthānaṃ saṅgamasya samīpataḥ
vibhaktaṃ hastamātraṃ ca puṇyakṣetraṃ narādhipa / suvarṇaśilake snātvā pūjayitvā maheśvaram
natvā tu bhāskaraṃ devaṃ hotavyaṃ ca hutāśane / bilvenājyavimiśreṇa bilvapatrairathāpi vā
prīyatāṃ me jagannātho vyādhir naśyatu me dhruvam / dvijāya kāñcane datte yatphalaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva me
bahusvarṇasya yatproktaṃ yāgasya phalamuttamam / tathāsau labhate sarvaṃ kāñcanaṃ yaḥ prayacchati
tena dānena pūtātmā mṛtaḥ svargamavāpnuyāt / rudrasyānucaras tāvad yāvad indrāścaturdaśa
tataḥ svargāvatīrṇastu jāyate viśade kule / dhanadhānyasamopetaḥ punaḥ smarati tajjalam

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe suvarṇaśilātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 105 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: karañjākhyaṃ tato gacchet sopavāso jitendriyaḥ / tatra snātvā tu rājendra sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
arcayitvā mahādevaṃ dattvā dānaṃ tu bhaktitaḥ / suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi maṇimauktikavidrumān
pādukopānahau chatraṃ śayyāṃ prāvaraṇāni ca / koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ sarvaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe karañjatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 106 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / saubhāgyakaraṇaṃ divyaṃ naranārīmanoramam
tatra yā durbhagā nārī naro vā nṛpasattama / snātvārcayed umārudrau saubhāgyaṃ tasya jāyate
tṛtīyāyāmahorātraṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ / nimantrayed dvijaṃ bhaktyā sapatnīkaṃ surūpiṇam
gandhamālyairalaṃkṛtya vastradhūpādivāsitam / bhojayet pāyasānnena kṛsareṇātha bhaktitaḥ
bhojayitvā yathānyāyaṃ pradakṣiṇamudāharet / prīyatāṃ me mahādevaḥ sapatnīko vṛṣadhvajaḥ
yathā te devadeveśa na viyogaḥ kadācana / mamāpi karuṇāṃ kṛtvā tathāstviti vicintayet
evaṃ kṛte tatastasya yatpuṇyaṃ samudāhṛtam / tatte sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā devena bhāṣitam
daurbhāgyaṃ durgatiścaiva dāridryaṃ śokabandhanam / vandhyatvaṃ saptajanmāni jāyate na yudhiṣṭhira
jyeṣṭhamāse site pakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ / tatra gatvā tu yo bhaktyā pañcāgniṃ sādhayettataḥ
so 'pi pāpairaśeṣaistu mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / guggulaṃ dahate yastu dvidhā cittavivarjitaḥ
śarīraṃ bhedayed yastu gauryāścaiva samīpataḥ / tasminkarmapraviṣṭasya utkrāntir jāyate yadi
dehapāte vrajet svargam ityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt / sitaraktaistathā pītairvastraiśca vividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ
brāhmaṇīṃ brāhmaṇaṃ caiva pūjayitvā yathāvidhi / puṣpairnānāvidhaiścaiva gandhadhūpaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ
kaṇṭhasūtrakasindūraiḥ kuṅkumena vilepayet / kalpayeta striyaṃ gaurīṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śivarūpiṇam
teṣāṃ tadrūpakaṃ kṛtvā dānamutsṛjyate tataḥ / kaṅkaṇaṃ karṇaveṣṭaṃ ca kaṇṭhikāṃ mudrikāṃ tathā
saptadhānyaṃ tathā caiva bhojanaṃ nṛpasattama / anyānyapi ca dānāni tasmiṃstīrthe dadāti yaḥ
sarvadānaiśca yatpuṇyaṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ / sahasraguṇitaṃ sarvaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
śaṅkareṇa samaṃ tasmādbhogaṃ bhuṅkte hyanuttamam / saubhāgyaṃ tasya vipulaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
aputro labhate putramadhano dhanamāpnuyāt / rājendra kāmadaṃ tīrthaṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kāmadatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| rkv adhyāya 107 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gaccheta rājendra bhaṇḍārītīrtham uttamam / daridracchedakaraṇaṃ yugānyekonaviṃśatiḥ
dhanadena tapastaptvā prasanne padmasambhave / tatraiva svalpadānena prāptaṃ vittasya rakṣaṇam
tatra gatvā tu yo bhaktyā snātvā vittaṃ prayacchati / tasya vittaparicchedo na kadācid bhaviṣyati

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhaṇḍārītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 108 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla rohiṇītīrthamuttamam / vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu sarvapāpaharaṃ param
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: rohiṇītīrthamāhātmyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam / śrotumicchāmi tattvena tanme tvaṃ vaktumarhasi
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tasminnekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame / udadhau ca śayānasya devadevasya cakriṇaḥ
nābhau samutthitaṃ padmaṃ ravimaṇḍalasannibham / karṇikākesaropetaṃ patraiśca samalaṃkṛtam
tatra brahmā samutpannaścaturvadanapaṅkajaḥ / kiṃ karomīti deveśa ājñā me dīyatāṃ prabho
evamuktastu deveśaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ / uvāca madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ tadā devaṃ pitāmaham
sarasvatyāṃ mahābāho lokaṃ kuru mamājñayā / bhūtagrāmamaśeṣasya utpādanavidhikṣayam
etacchrutaṃ tu vacanaṃ padmanābhasya bhārata / cintayāmāsa bhagavānsaptarṣīnhitakāmyayā
kramātte cintitāḥ prājñāḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ / prācetaso vasiṣṭhaśca bhṛgurnārada eva ca
yajñe prācetaso dakṣo mahātejāḥ prajāpatiḥ / dakṣasyāpi tathā jātāḥ pañcāśadduhitaro 'nagha
dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa / tathaiva sa mahābhāgaḥ saptaviṃśatimindave
rohiṇīnāma yā tāsāṃ madhye tasya narādhipa / aniṣṭā sarvanārīṇāṃ bhartuścaiva viśeṣataḥ
tataḥ sā paramaṃ kṛtvā vairāgyaṃ nṛpasattama / āgatya narmadātīre cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ
ekarātrais trirātraiśca ṣaḍdvādaśabhireva ca / pakṣamāsopavāsaiśca karśayanti kalevaram
ārādhayantī satataṃ mahiṣāsuranāśinīṃ / devīṃ bhagavatīṃ tāta sarvārtivinivāraṇīm
snātvā snātvā jale nityaṃ narmadāyāḥ śucismitā / tatastuṣṭā mahābhāgā devī nārāyaṇī nṛpa
prasannā te mahābhāge vratena niyamena ca / etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ rohiṇī śaśinaḥ priyā
yathā bhavāmi na cirāttathā bhavatu mānade / evamastviti sā coktvā bhavānī bhaktavatsalā
stūyamānā munigaṇaistatraivāntaradhīyata / tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ rohiṇī śaśinaḥ priyā
saṃjātā sarvakālaṃ tu vallabhā nṛpasattama / tatra tīrthe tu yā nārī naro vā snāni bhaktitaḥ
vallabhā jāyate sā tu bhartur vai rohiṇī yathā / tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścitprāṇatyāgaṃ karoti vai
saptajanmāni dāmpatyaviyogo na bhavet kvacit

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe rohiṇīsomanāthatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 109 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla cakratīrthamanuttamam / senāpuramitikhyātaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
saināpatyābhiṣekāya devadevena cakriṇā / ānītaśca mahāseno devaiḥ sendrapurogamaiḥ
dānavānāṃ vadhārthāya jayāya ca divaukasām / bhūmidānena viprendrāṃs tarpayitvā yathāvidhi
śaṅkhabherīninādaiśca paṭahānāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ / vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgaiśca jhallarīsvaramaṅgalaiḥ
tataḥ kṛtvā svanaṃ ghoraṃ dānavo baladarpitaḥ / rururnāma vighātārthamabhiṣekasya cāgataḥ
hastyaśvarathapattyoghaiḥ pūrayanvai diśo daśa / tatra tena mahadyuddhaṃ pravṛttaṃ kila bhārata
śaktyṛṣṭipāśamuśalaiḥ khaḍgaistomaraṭaṅkanaiḥ / bhallaiḥ karṇikanārācaiḥ kabandhapaṭasaṃkulaiḥ
tatastu tāṃ śatrubalasya senāṃ kṣaṇena cāpancyutabāṇaghātaiḥ / vidhvastahastyaśvarathānmahātmā jagrāha cakraṃ ripusaṅghanāśanaḥ
jvalacca cakraṃ niśitaṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ surāsurāṇāṃ ca sudarśanaṃ raṇe / cakarta daityasya śirastadānīṃ karātpramuktaṃ madhughātinaśca tat
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā vighnamabhiṣeke ṣaḍānanaḥ / tyaktvā tu tatra saṃsthānaṃ cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ
muktaṃ cakraṃ vināśāya hariṇā lokadhāriṇā / dvidalaṃ dānavaṃ kṛtvā papāta vimale jale
tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ cakratīrthamiti śrutam / sarvapāpavināśāya nirmitaṃ viśvamūrtinā
cakratīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayed devamacyutam / puṇḍarīkasya yajñasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayed brāhmaṇāñchubhān / śāntadāntajitakrodhānsa labhetkoṭijaṃ phalam
tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā tyajate dehamātmanaḥ / viṣṇulokaṃ mṛto yāti jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ
krīḍayitvā yathākāmaṃ devagandharvapūjitaḥ / ihāgatya ca bhūyo 'pi jāyate vipule kule
etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥkhapraṇāśanam / kathitaṃ te mahābhāga bhūyaścānyacchṛṇuṣva me

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe senāpure cakratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma navottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 110 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: dhautapāpaṃ tato gacchen mahāpātakanāśanam / samīpe cakratīrthasya viṣṇunā nirmitaṃ purā
nihatair dānavair ghorair devadevo janārdanaḥ / tatpāpasya vināśārthaṃ dānavāntodbhavasya ca
tatra tīrthe jitakrodhaścacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ / duścaraṃ maunamāsthāya hyaśakyaṃ devadānavaiḥ
snātvā dattvā dvijātibhyo dānāni vividhāni ca / tatkṣaṇāt supāpas tu gatastadvaiṣṇavaṃ padam
evaṃ yuktastu yastatra pāpaṃ kṛtvā sudāruṇam / snātvā japtvā vidhānena mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dhautapāpatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma daśottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 111 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / skandena nirmitaṃ pūrvaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā sudāruṇam
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: skandasya caritaṃ sarvamājanma dvijasattama / tīrthasya ca vidhiṃ puṇyaṃ kathayasva yathārthataḥ
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: devadevena vai taptaṃ tapaḥ pūrvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira / vijñaptena suraiḥ sarvairumādevī vivāhitā
nāsti senāpatiḥ kaściddevānāṃ surasattama / nīyante dānavairghoraiḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ
yathā niśā vinā candraṃ divaso bhāskaraṃ vinā / na śobhate muhūrtaṃ vai tathā senā vināyakā
evaṃ jñātvā mahādeva parayā dayayā vibho / senānīr dīyatāṃ kaścittriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ
etacchrutvā śubhaṃ vākyaṃ devānāṃ parameśvaraḥ / kāmayāna umāṃ devīṃ sasmāra manasā smaram
tena mūrchitasarvāṅgaḥ kāmarūpo jagadguruḥ / kāmayāmāsa rudrāṇīṃ divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ kila
devarājastato jñātvā mahāmaithunagaṃ haram / saṃmantrya daivataiḥ sārddhaṃ praiṣayajjātavedasam
tena gatvā mahādevaḥ paramānandasaṃsthitaḥ / sahasā tena dṛṣṭo 'sau hāhetyuktvā samutthitaḥ
tataḥ kruddhā mahādevī śāpavācamuvāca ha / vepamānā mahārāja śṛṇu yatte vadāmyaham
ahaṃ yasmāt suraiḥ sarvairyācitā putrajanmani / kṛtā ratiśca viphalā saṃpreṣya jātavedasam
tasmātsarve putrahīnā bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ / hareṇoktastato vahnirasmākaṃ bījamāvaha
yathā bhavati lokeṣu tathā tvaṃ kartum arhasi / mama tejastvayā śakyaṃ gṛhītuṃ surasattama / devakāryārthasiddhyarthaṃ nānyaḥ śakto jagattraye
agniruvāca: tejasastava me deva kā śaktirdhāraṇe vibho / karoti bhasmasātsarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
īśvara uvāca: udarasthena bījena yadi te jāyate rujā / tadā kṣipasva tattejo gaṅgātoye hutāśana
evamuktvā mahādevo 'moghaṃ bījamuttamam / havyavāhamukhe sarvaṃ prakṣipyāntaradhīyata
gate cādarśanaṃ deve dahyamāno hutāśanaḥ / gaṅgātoye vinikṣipya jagāma svaṃniveśanam
asahantī tu tattejo gaṅgāpi saritāṃ varā / śarastambe vinikṣipya jagāmāśu yathāgatam
tatra jātaṃ tu taddṛṣṭvā sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ / kṛttikāṃ preṣayāmāsuḥ stanyaṃ pāyayituṃ tadā
dṛṣṭvā tā āgatāḥ sarvā gaṅgāgarbhe mahāmateḥ / ṣaṇmukhaiḥ ṣaṇmukho bhūtvā pipāsurapibatstanam
jātakarmādisaṃskārānvedoktānpadmasambhavaḥ / cakāra sarvāndājendra vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā
ṣaṇmukhātṣaṇmukho nāma kārttikeyastu kṛttikāt / kumāraśca kumāratvād gaṅgāgarbho 'gnijo 'paraḥ
evaṃ kumāraḥ sambhūto hyanadhītya sa vedavit / śāstrāṇyanekāni veda cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ
devāraṇyeṣu sarveṣu nadīṣu ca nadeṣu ca / pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni samudrād yāni bhārata
tataḥ paryāyayogena narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ / narmadādakṣiṇe kūle cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ
ṛgyajuḥsāmavihitaṃ japañjāpyamaharniśam / dhyāyamāno mahādevaṃ śucirdhamanisaṃtataḥ
tato varṣasahasrānte pūrṇe devo maheśvaraḥ / umayā sahitaḥ kāle tadā vacanam abravīt
īśvara uvāca: ahaṃ te varadastāta gaurī mātā pitā hyaham / varaṃ vṛṇīṣva yacceṣṭaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham
ṣaṇmukha uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva umayā saha śaṅkara / vṛṇomi mātāpitarau nānyā gatirmatirmama
etacchrutvā śubhaṃ vākyaṃ putrasya vadanāccyutam / tathetyuktvā tu snehena premṇā taṃ pariṣasvaje
tatastaṃ mūrdhnyupāghrāya hyumayovāca śaṅkaraḥ
īśvara uvāca: akṣayaścāvyayaścaiva senānīs tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi
śikhī ca te vāhanaṃ divyarūpo datto mayā śaktidharasya saṃkhye / surāsurādīṃśca jayeti coktvā jagāma kailāsavaraṃ mahātmā
gate cādarśanaṃ deve tadā sa śikhivāhanaḥ / sthāpayitvā mahādevaṃ jagāma surasannidhau
tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ skandatīrthamiti śrutam / sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ martyānāṃ bhuvi durlabham
tatra tīrthe tu yo rājanbhaktyā snātvārcayecchivam / gandhamālyābhiṣekaiśca yājñikaṃ sa labhet phalam
skandatīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet pitṛdevatāḥ / tilamiśreṇa toyena tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
piṇḍadānena caikena vidhiyuktena bhārata / dvādaśābdāni tuṣyanti pitaro nātra saṃśayaḥ
tatra tīrthe tu rājendra śubhaṃ vā yādi vāśubham / iha loke pare caiva tatsarvaṃ jāyate 'kṣayam
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścit prāṇatyāgaṃ kariṣyati / śāstrayuktena vidhinā sa gacchecchivamandiram
kalpamekaṃ vasitvā tu devagandharvapūjitaḥ / atra bhāratavarṣe tu jāyate vimale kule
vedavedāṅgatattvajñaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ / jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ
idaṃ te kathitaṃ rājanskandatīrthasya sambhavam / dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam / sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ devadevena bhāṣitam

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe skandatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādaśottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 112 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthamāṅgirasasya tu / uttare narmadākūle sarvapāpavināśanam
purāsīdaṅgirānāma brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ / putrahetor yugasyādau cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ
nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnāyī japandevaṃ sanātanam / pūjayaṃśca mahādevaṃ kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādibhiḥ
dvādaśābde tataḥ pūrṇe tutoṣa parameśvaraḥ / vareṇa chandayāmāsa dvijam āṅgirasaṃ varam
vavre sa tu mahādevaṃ putraṃ putravatāṃ varam / vedavidyāvratasnātaṃ sarvaśāstraviśāradam
devānāṃ mantriṇaṃ rājan sarvalokeṣu pūjitam / brahmalakṣmyāḥ sadāvāsam akṣayaṃ cāvyayaṃ sutam
tathābhilaṣitaḥ putraḥ sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ / bhaviṣyati na sandehaścaivamuktvā yayau haraḥ
varair aṅgirasaścāpi bṛhaspatirajāyata / yathābhilaṣitaḥ putro vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ
jāte putre'ṅgirās tatra sthāpayāmāsa śaṅkaram / hṛṣṭatuṣṭamanā bhūtvā jagāmottaraparvatam
tatra cāṅgirase tīrthe yaḥ snātvā pūjayecchivam / sarvapāpavinirmukto rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
aputro labhate putramadhano dhanamāpnuyāt / icchate yaśca yaṃ kāmaṃ sa taṃ labhati mānavaḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe 'gnirasatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 113 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra koṭitīrthamanuttamam / ṛṣikoṭirgatā tatra parāṃ siddhimupāgatā
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā bhojayed brāhmaṇāñchuciḥ / ekasminbhojite vipre koṭirbhavati bhojitā
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet pitṛdevatāḥ / pūjite tu mahādeve vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe koṭitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśādhikaśātatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 114 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / ayonijaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
ayonije naraḥ snātvā pūjayet parameśvaram / pitṛdevārcanaṃ kṛtvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
tatra tīrthe tu vidhinā prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ / sa kadācinmahārāja yonidvāraṃ na paśyati

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ayonisambhavatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 115 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahārāja tīrtham aṅgārakaṃ param / rūpadaṃ sarvalokānāṃ viśrutaṃ narmadātaṭe
aṅgārakeṇa rājendra purā taptaṃ tapaḥ kila / arbudaṃ ca nikharvaṃ ca prayutaṃ varṣasaṃkhyayā
tatastuṣṭo mahādevaḥ parayā kṛpayā nṛpa / pratyakṣadarśī bhagavān uvāca kṣitinandanam
varado 'smi mahābhāga durlabhaṃ tridaśair api / varaṃ dāsyāmyahaṃ vatsa brūhi yatte vivakṣitam
aṅgāraka uvāca: tava prasādāddeveśa sarvalokamaheśvara / grahamadhyagato nityaṃ vicarāmi nabhastale
yāvaddharādharo loke yāvaccandradivākarau / nadyo nadāḥ samudrāśca varo me cākṣayo bhavet
evamastviti deveśo dattvā varamanuttamam / jagāmākāśamāviśya vandyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ
bhūmiputrastatastasminsthāpayāmāsa śaṅkaram / gataḥ surālaye loke grahabhāve niveśitaḥ
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram / hutahomo jitakrodhaḥ so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
caturthyaṅgārake yastu snātvā cābhyarcayedgraham / aṅgārakaṃ vidhānena saptajanmāni bhārata
daśayojanavistīrṇe maṇḍale rūpavān bhavet / tatraiva tā mṛto jantuḥ kāmato 'kāmato 'pi vā / rudrasyānucaro bhūtvā tenaiva saha modate

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe aṅgārakatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 116 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: pāṇḍutīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarvapāpavināśanam / tatra snātvā naro rājan mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā dāpayet kāñcanaṃ śuciḥ / bhrūṇahatyādipāpāni naśyante nātra saṃśayaḥ
piṇḍodakapradānena vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet / pitaraḥ pitāmahāśca nṛtyante ca praharṣitāḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe pāṇḍutīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 117 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra puṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ trilocanam / tatra tiṣṭhati deveśaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā bhaktyārcayati śaṅkaram / rudrasya bhavanaṃ yāti mṛto nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ
kalpakṣaye tataḥ pūrṇe krīḍitvā ca ihāgataḥ / āviyogena tiṣṭheta pūjyamānaḥ śataṃ samāḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe trilocanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 118 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / indratīrthetivikhyātaṃ narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle indratīrthaṃ kathaṃ bhavet / śrotumicchāmi viprendra hyādimadhyāntavistaraiḥ
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ dharmaputrasya dhīmataḥ / kathayāmāsa tadvattamitihāsaṃ purātanam
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: viśvāsayitvā suciraṃ dharmaśatruṃ mahābalam / vṛtraṃ jitvātha hatvā tu gacchamānaṃ śacīpatim
niṣkrāmamāṇaṃ mārgeṇa brahmahatyā durāsadā / ahorātramaviśrāntā jagāma bhuvanatrayam
yatoyato brahmahaṇaṃ yāti yānena śobhanam / diśo bhāgaṃ suraiḥ sārddhaṃ tato hatyā na muñcati
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaganāgamaḥ / pātakānāṃ gatirdṛṣṭā na tu viśvāsaghātinām
pāpakarmamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā snānadānairviśudhyati / nārī vā puruṣo vāpi naiva viśvāsaghātinaḥ
evamādīni cānyāni śrutvā vākyāni devarāṭ / vacanaṃ tadvidhairuktaṃ viṣādamagamatparam
tyaktvā rājyaṃ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ jagāma tapa uttamam / putradāragṛhaṃ rājyaṃ vasūni vividhāni ca
phalānyetāni dharmasya śobhayanti janeśvaram / phalaṃ dharmasya bhuñjeti suhṛtsvajanabāndhavāḥ
paśyatāṃ sarvam eteṣāṃ pāpamekena bhujyate / paraṃ hi sukhamutsṛjya karśayanvai kalevaram
devarājo jagāmāsau tīrthānyāyatanāni ca / gaṅgātīrtheṣu sarveṣu yāmuneṣu tathaiva ca
sārasvateṣu sarveṣu sāmudreṣu pṛthakpṛthak / nadīṣu devakhāteṣu taḍāgeṣu saraḥsu ca
pāpaṃ na muñcate sarve paścāddevasamāgame / revāprabhavatīrtheṣu kūlayor ubhayor api
pūjayanvai mahādevaṃ skandatīrthaṃ samāsadat / tava sthitvopavāsaiśca kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādibhiḥ
karśayanvai svakaṃ dehaṃ na lebhe śarma vai kvacit / grīṣme pañcāgnimadhyastho varṣāsu sthaṇḍileśayaḥ
ārdravāsāstu hemante cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ / evaṃ tu tapatastasya indrasya viditātmanaḥ
vatsarāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi gatāni daśa bhārata / tatastvekādaśe prāpte varṣe tu nṛpasattama
sahasā bhagavāndevastu tutoṣa parameśvaraḥ / tathā brahmarṣayaḥ siddhā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ
tatrājagmuḥ surāḥ sarve yatra devaḥ śatakratuḥ / dṛṣṭvā samāgatān devān ṛṣīṃścaiva mahāmatiḥ
uvāca praṇato bhūtvā sarvadevapurohitaḥ / viditaṃ sarvameteṣāṃ yathā vṛtravadhaḥ kṛtaḥ
yuṣmākaṃ cājñayā pūrvaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ / tathāpyevaṃ brahmahaṇaṃ matvā pāpasya kāriṇam
bhramantaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu brahmahatyā na muñcati / na nandati jagatsarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
yathā vihīnacandrārkaṃ tathā rājyamanāyakam / tasmātsarve suraśreṣṭhā vijñāpyaṃ mama samprati
kurvantu śakraṃ nirdoṣaṃ tathā sarve maharṣayaḥ / bṛhaspatimukhodgīrṇaṃ śrutvā tadvacanaṃ śubham
tataḥ provāca bhagavānbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / etatpāpaṃ mahāghoraṃ brahmahatyāsamudbhavam
daivatebhyo 'tha bhūtebhyaścaturbhāgaṃ kṣipāmyaham / evaṃ muktvā kṣipaccaino jalopari mahāmatiḥ
avagāhya tataḥ peyā āpo vai nānyathā budhaiḥ / dharāyāmakṣipadbhāgaṃ dvitīyaṃ padmasaṃbhavaḥ
abhakṣyā tena saṃjātā sadākālaṃ vasuṃdharā / tadārdhamarddhaṃ nārīṇāṃ dvitīye 'hni yudhiṣṭhira
nikṣipya bhagavāndevaḥ punaranyajjagāda ha / asaṃgrāhyā tvasaṃgrāhyā tena jātā rajasvalā
caturdināni sā prājñaiḥ pāpasya mahato mahāt / caturthaṃ tu tato bhāgaṃ vibhajya parameśvaraḥ
kṛṣigorakṣyavāṇijyaiḥ śūdrasevākare dvije / tato 'bhinandayāmāsuḥ sarve devā maharṣayaḥ
devendraṃ vāgbhir iṣṭābhir narmadājalasaṃsthitam / vareṇa chandayāmāsa tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ
varaṃ dāsyāmi deveśa varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam
indra uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama / atra saṃsthāpayiṣyāmi sadā saṃnihito bhava
evamastviti coktvā taṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ / jagmurākāśamāviśya stūyamānā maharṣibhiḥ
gateṣu devadeveṣu devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ / sthāpayitvā mahādevaṃ jagāma tridaśālayam
indratīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ / mahāpātakayukto 'pi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
indratīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet parameśvaram / so 'śvamedhasya yajñasya puṣkalaṃ phalam aśnute
etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam / śrutamātreṇa yenaiva mucyante pātakair narāḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe indratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 119 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra kahloḍītīrtham uttamam / revāyāścottare kūle sarvapāpavināśanam
hitārthaṃ sarvabhūtānām ṛṣibhiḥ sthāpitaṃ purā / tapasā tu samuddhṛtya narmadāyāṃ mahāmbhasi
snātvā tu kapilātīrthe kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati / śrutvā cākhyānakaṃ divyaṃ brāhmaṇāñchṛṇu yatphalam
sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ kapilādānamuttamam / brāhmaṇānveṣitaṃ pūrvamṛṣidevasamāgame
sadyaḥ prasūtāṃ kapilāṃ śobhanāṃ yaḥ prayacchati / sopavāso jitakrodhastasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
sasamudraguhā tena saśailavanakānanā / dattā caiva mahābāho pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā yatpurā kṛtam / naśyate kapilāṃ dattvā saptajanmārjitaṃ nṛpa
bhūmidānaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ hastyaśvakanakādikam / kapilādānasyaikasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm
tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati / mṛto viṣṇupuraṃ yāti gīyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ
yāvanti tasyā romāṇi savatsāyāstu bhārata / tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi sa svarge krīḍate ciram
tato 'vakīrṇakālena tviha mānuṣyatāṃ gataḥ / dhanadhānyasamopeto jāyate vipule kule
vedavidyā vratasnātaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ / vyādhiśokavinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kalhoḍītīrtham uttamam / yatkṛtvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kahloḍītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 120 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kambukeśvaramuttamam / hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo dānavo baladarpitaḥ
avadhyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ / tasya putro mahātejāḥ prahlādo nāma nāmataḥ
viṣṇuprasādādbhaktyā ca tasya rājye pratiṣṭhitaḥ / virocanastasya sutas tasyāpi balireva ca
baliputro 'bhavad bāṇastasmādapi ca śambaraḥ / śambarasyānvaye jātaḥ kamburnāma mahāsuraḥ
jñātvā viṣṇumayaṃ ghoraṃ mahadbhayamupasthitam / dānavānāṃ vināśāya nānyo hetuḥ kadācana
sa tyaktvā putradārāṃśca suhṛdbandhuparigrahān / cacāra maunamāsthāya tapaḥ kamburmahāmatiḥ
akṣasūtrakaro bhūtvā daṇḍī muṇḍī ca mekhalī / śākayāvakabhakṣaśca valkalājinasaṃvṛtaḥ
snātvā nityaṃ dhṛtiparo narmadājalamāśritaḥ / pūjayaṃstu mahādevamarbudaṃ varṣasaṃkhyayā
tatastutoṣa bhagavāndevadevo maheśvaraḥ / uvāca dānavaṃ kāle meghagambhīrayā girā
bhobhoḥ kambo mahābhāga tuṣṭo 'haṃ tava suvrata / iṣṭaṃ vratānāṃ paramaṃ maunaṃ sarvārthasādhanam
caritaṃ ca tvayā loke devadānavaduścaram / varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yatte manasi rocate
kamburuvāca: yadi prasanno deveśa yadi deyo varo mama / akṣayyaścāvyayaścaiva svecchayā vicarāmyaham
daityadānavasaṅghānāṃ saṃyugeṣvapalāyitā / bhayaṃ cānyanna vidyeta muktvā devaṃ gadādharam
tasyāhaṃ saṃyuge sādhyo yenopāyena śaṅkara / bhavāmi na sadā kālaṃ taṃ vadasva varaṃ mama
īśvara uvāca: mama saṃnihito yatra tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi dānava / tatra viṣṇubhayaṃ nāsti vasātra vigatajvaraḥ
tasya devādhidevasya vedagarbhasya saṃyuge / śaṅkhacakradharasyeśā nāhaṃ sarve surāsurāḥ
kiṃ punaryo dviṣatyenaṃ lokālokaprabhuṃ harim / sa sukhī vartate kālaṃ na nimeṣaṃ mataṃ mama
tasmāt tvaṃ parayā bhaktyā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ / vasiṣyasi ciraṃ kālam ityuktvādarśanaṃ gataḥ
gate cādarśanaṃ deve tatra tīrthe mahāmatiḥ / sthāpayāmāsa deveśaṃ śivaṃ śāntamanāmayam
tasmiṃstīrthe mahādevaṃ sthāpayitvā divaṃ gataḥ / tadāprabhṛti tatpārtha kambutīrthamiti śrutam / vikhyātaṃ sarvalokeṣu mahāpātakanāśanam
kambutīrthe naraḥ snātvā vidhinābhyarcya bhāskaram / ṛgyajuḥsāmamantraiśca stūyamāno nṛpottama
tasya puṇyaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ / tatsarvaṃ tu śṛṇuṣvādya mamaiva gadato nṛpa
ṛgyajuḥsāmagīteṣu sāṅgopāṅgeṣu yatphalam / tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti gāyatrīmātramantravit
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ / pūjayed devamīśānaṃ so 'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet
akāmo vā sakāmo vā tatra tīrthe kalevaram / yastyajennātra sandeho rudralokaṃ sa gacchati

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kambukeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 121 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla candrahāsamataḥ param / yatra siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptaḥ somarājaḥ surottamaḥ
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kathaṃ siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptaḥ somanātho jagatpatiḥ / tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi kathayasva mamānagha
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: purā śapto munīndreṇa dakṣeṇa kila bhārata / asevanāddhi dārāṇāṃ kṣayarogī bhaviṣyasi
udvāhitānāṃ patnīnāṃ ye na kurvanti sevanam / yā niṣṭhā jāyate nṛṇāṃ tāṃ śṛṇuṣva narādhipa
ṛtāvṛtau hi nārīṇāṃ sevanājjāyate sutaḥ / sutātsvargaśca mokṣaśca ityevaṃ śrutibhāṣitam
tatkālocitadharmeṇa veṣṭito raurave patet / tasyāstadrudhiraṃ pāpaḥ pibate kālamīpsitam
tato 'vatīrṇaḥ kālena yāṃ yāṃ yoniṃ prayāsyati / tasyāṃ tasyāṃ sa duṣṭātmā durbhago jāyate sadā
nārīṇāṃ tu sadā kāmo 'bhyadhikāḥ parivartate / viśeṣeṇa ṛtau kāle pīḍyate kāmasāyakaiḥ
paribhūtā hitā bhartrā dhyāyante 'nyaṃ patiṃ striyaḥ / tataḥ putraḥ samutpanno hyaṭate kulamuttamam
svargasthāstena pitaraḥ pūrvajāste pitāmahāḥ / patanti jātamātreṇa kulaṭastena cocyate
tena karmavipākena kṣayarogyabhavacchaśī / tyaktvā lokaṃ surendrāṇāṃ martyalokamupāgataḥ
tatastīrthānyanekāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca / bhramanvai narmadāṃ prāptaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanīm
upavāsaṃ ca dānāni vratāni niyamāṃs tathā / cacāra dvādaśābdāni tato muktaḥ sa kilbiṣaiḥ
snāpayitvā mahādevaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam / jagāma prabhayā pūrṇaḥ sa ca lokamanuttamam
yenaiva sthāpito devaḥ pūjyate varṣasaṃkhyayā / tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke sa pūjyate
tena devānvidhānoktānsthāpayanti narā bhuvi / akṣayaṃ cāvyayaṃ yasmātkālaṃ bhuñjanti mānavāḥ
somatīrthe naraḥ snātvā pūjayeddevamīśvaram / sa bhrājate naro loke somavat priyadarśanaḥ
candrahāse tu yo gatvā grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ / snānaṃ samācared bhaktyā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca candrahāse śubhāśubham / kṛtaṃ nṛpavaraśreṣṭha sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam
te dhanyāste mahātmānas teṣāṃ janma sujīvitam / candrahāse tu ye snātvā paśyanti grahaṇaṃ narāḥ
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yatpurākṛtam / snānamātreṇa rājendra tatra tīrthe praṇaśyati
bahavastaṃ na jānanti mahāmohasamanvitāḥ / dehasthamiva sarveṣāṃ paramānandarūpiṇam
paścime sāgare gatvā somatīrthe tu yatphalam / tatsamagram avāpnoti candrahāse na saṃśayaḥ
saṃkrāntau ca vyatīpāte ayane viṣuve tathā / candrahāse naraḥ snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
te mūḍhāste durācārāsteṣāṃ janma nirarthakam / candrahāsaṃ na jānanti ye revāyāṃ vyavasthitam
candrahāse tu yaḥ kaścitsaṃnyāsaṃ kurute dvijaḥ / anivartikā gatistasya somalokānna saṃśayaḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe somatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 122 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla kohanasveti viśrutam / sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ mṛtyuvināśanam
purā tatra dvijaḥ kaścidvedavedāṅgapāragaḥ / patnīputrasuhṛdvargaiḥ svakarmanirato 'vasat
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: brāhmaṇasya tu yatkarma utpattiḥ kṣatriyasya tu / vaiśyasyāpi ca śūdrasya tatsarvaṃ kathayasva me
dharmasyārhasya kāmasya mokṣasya ca paraṃ vidhim / nikhilaṃ jñātum icchāmi nānyo vettā matirmama
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: utpattikāraṇaṃ brahmā devadevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ / prathamaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ carācarajagadguruḥ
dvijātayo mukhājjātāḥ kṣatriyā bāhuyantrataḥ / ūrupradeśād vaiśyāstu śūdrāḥ pādeṣvathābhavan
tatastvanye pṛthagvarṇāḥ pṛthagdharmān samācaran / paryāyeṇa samutpannā hyanulomavilomataḥ
teṣāṃ dharmaṃ pravakṣyāmi śrutismṛtyarthacoditam / yena samyakkṛtenaiva sarve yānti parāṃ gatim
gatirdhyānaṃ vinā bhaktair brāhmaṇaiḥ prāpyate nṛpa / adhyāpayanyato vedānvedaṃ vāpi yathāvidhi
kulajāṃ rūpasampannāṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitām / udvāhayettataḥ patnīṃ guruṇānumate tadā
tataḥ smārtaṃ vivāhāgniṃ śrautaṃ vā pūjayet kramāt / pratigrahadhano bhūtvā dambhalobhavivarjitaḥ
pañcayajñavidhānāni kārayedvai yathāvidhi / vanaṃ gacchet tataḥ paścāddvitīyāśramasevanāt
putreṣu bhāryāṃ nikṣipya sarvasaṅgavivarjitaḥ / iṣṭāṃllokānavāpnoti na ceha jāyate punaḥ
kṣatriyastu sthito rājye pālayitvā vasuṃdharām / śaśvaddharmamanāścaiva prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim
vaiśyadharmo na sandehaḥ kṛṣigorakṣaṇe rataḥ / satyaśaucasamopeto gacchate svargamuttamam
na śūdrasya pṛthagdharmo vihitaḥ parameṣṭhinā / na mantro na ca saṃskāro na vidyāparisevanam
na śabdavidyāsamayo devatābhyarcanāni ca / yathā jātena satataṃ vartitavyamaharniśam
sa dharmaḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ purā sṛṣṭaḥ svayambhuvā / mantrasaṃskārasampannāstrayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ
teṣāṃ matamanādṛtya yadi varteta kāmataḥ / sa mṛto jāyate śvā vai gatirūrdhvā na vidyate
na teṣāṃ preṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ teṣāṃ matamanusmaran / yaśobhāgī svadharmasthaḥ svargabhāgī sa jāyate
evaṃ guṇagaṇākīrṇo 'vasadvipraḥ sa bhārata / hanasveti hanasveti śṛṇoti vākyamīdṛśam
tato nirīkṣate cordhvam adhaścaiva diśo daśa / vepamānaḥ sa bhītaśca praskhalaṃśca pade pade
śṛṅkhalāyudhahastaiśca pāśaiścaiva sudāruṇaiḥ / veṣṭitaṃ mahiṣārūḍhaṃ naraṃ paśyati manmukham
kṛṣṇāṃjanacayaprakhyaṃ kṛṣṇāmbaravibhūṣitam / raktākṣamāyatabhujaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam
dṛṣṭvā taṃ tu samāyāntaṃ nirīkṣyātmānamātmanā / japañjāpyaṃ ca paramaṃ śatarudrīyasaṃstavam
tataḥ provāca bhagavānyamaḥ saṃyamano mahān / śṛṇu vākyamato brahmanyamo 'haṃ sarvajantuṣu
saṃharasva mahābhāga rudrajāpyaṃ sudurbhidam / yenāhaṃ kālapāśaistvāṃ saṃyamāmi gatavyathaḥ
tacchrutvā niṣṭhuraṃ vākyaṃ yamasya mukhanirgatam / mahābhayasamopeto brāhmaṇaḥ prapalāyitaḥ
tasya mārge gatāḥ sarve yamena saha kiṃkarāḥ / tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti taṃ vipramūcuste so 'pyadhāvata
tvaramāṇaḥ pariśrānto hā hato 'haṃ durātmabhiḥ / rakṣa rakṣa mahādeva śaraṇāgatavatsala
evamuktvāpatadbhūmau liṅgamāliṅgya bhārata / gatasattvaḥ sa viprendraḥ samāśritya sureśvaram
taṃ dṛṣṭvā patitaṃ bhūmau devadevo maheśvaraḥ / ko haniṣyati mābhaistvaṃ huṅkāramakarottadā
tena te kiṃkarāḥ sarve yamena saha bhārata / huṅkāreṇa gatāḥ sarve meghā vātahatā yathā
tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ kohanasveti viśrutam / sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣvanuttamam
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet parameśvaram / agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalamāpnotyanuttamam
tatra tīrthe tu rājendra prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ / na paśyati yamaṃ devamityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryājjale vā nṛpasattama / agniloke vaset tāvad yāvat kalpaśatatrayam
evaṃ varuṇaloke 'pi vasitvā kālamīpsitam / iha lokamanuprāpto mahādhanapatirbhavet

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kohanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 123 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra karmadītīrtham uttamam / yatra tiṣṭhati vighneśo gaṇanātho mahābalaḥ
tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā caturthyāṃ vā hyupoṣitaḥ / vighnaṃ na vidyate tasya saptajanmani bhārata
tatra tīrthe hi yatkiṃcid dīyate nṛpasattama / tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe karmadeśvaratīrthamāhatmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| rkv adhyāya 124 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla narmadeśvaramuttamam / tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
agnipraveśaśca jale 'thavā mṛtyuranāśake / anivartikā gatistasya yathā me śaṅkaro 'bravīt

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 125 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla ravitīrthamanuttamam / yatra devaḥ sahasrāṃśustapastaptvā divaṃ gataḥ
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kathaṃ devo jagaddhātā sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ / tapastapati deveśastāpaso bhāskaro raviḥ
ārādhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvadevaiśca pūjitaḥ / pratyakṣo dṛśyate loke sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ
ādityatvaṃ kathaṃ prāptaḥ kathaṃ bhāskara ucyate / sarvametatsamāsena kathayasva mamānagha
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: mahāpraśno mahārāja yastvayā paripṛcchitaḥ / tatsarvaṃ sampravakṣyāmi namaskṛtya svayambhuvam
āsīdidaṃ tamobhūtamaprajñātamalakṣaṇam / apratarkyam avijñeyaṃ prasuptam iva sarvataḥ
tatas tejaśca divyaṃ ca taptapiṇḍamanuttamam / ākāśāttu yathaivolkā sṛṣṭihetor adhomukhī
tattejaso 'ntaḥ puruṣaḥ saṃjātaḥ sarvabhūṣitaḥ / sa śivo 'pāṇipādaśca yena sarvamidaṃ tatam
tasyotpannasya bhūtasya tejo rūpasya bhārata / paścātprajāpatirbhūyaḥ kālaḥ kālāntareṇa vai
agnirjātaḥ sa bhūtānāṃ manuṣyāsurarakṣasām / sarvadevādhidevaśca ādityastena cocyate
ādau tasya namaskāro 'nyeṣāṃ ca tadanantaram / kriyate daivataiḥ sarvaistena sarvairmaharṣibhiḥ
tisraḥ sandhyāstrayo devāḥ sāṃnidhyāḥ sūryamaṇḍale / namaskṛtena sūryeṇa sarve devā namaskṛtāḥ
na divā na bhaved rātriḥ ṣaṇmāsā dakṣiṇāyanam / ayanaṃ cottaraṃ cāpi bhāskareṇa vinā nṛpa
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam / na vartate vinā sūryaṃ tena pūjyatamo raviḥ
śabdagāḥ śrutimukhyāśca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ / pratyakṣo bhagavāndevo dṛśyate lokapāvanaḥ
utpattiḥ pralayasthānaṃ nidhānaṃ bījamavyayam / hetureko jagannātho nānyo vidyeta bhāskarāt
evamātmabhavaṃ kṛtvā jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam / lokānāṃ tu hitārthāya sthāpayed dharmapaddhatim
narmadātaṭamāśritya sthāpayitvātmanas tanum / sahasrāṃśuṃ nidhiṃ dhāmnāṃ jagāmākāśamavyayam
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet parameśvaram / sahasrakiraṇaṃ devaṃ nāmamantravidhānataḥ
tena taptaṃ hutaṃ tena tena sarvamanuṣṭhitam / tena samyagvidhānena samprāptaṃ paramaṃ padam
te dhanyāste mahātmānasteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam / snātvā ye narmadātoye devaṃ paśyanti bhāskaram
tathā devasya rājendra ye kurvanti pradakṣiṇam / ananyabhaktyā satataṃ trirakṣarasamanvitāḥ
tena pūtaśarīrāste mantreṇa gatapātakāḥ / yatpuṇyaṃ ca bhavet teṣāṃ tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu
sasamudraguhā tena saśailavanakānanā / pradakṣiṇīkṛtā sarvā pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ
mantramūlam idaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram / tena mantravihīnaṃ tu kāryaṃ loke na sidhyati
yathā kāṣṭhamayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ / kāryārthaṃ naiva sidhyeta tathā karma hyamantrakam
bhasmahutaṃ pārtha yathā toyavivarjitam / niṣphalaṃ jāyate dānaṃ tathā mantravivarjitam
kāṣṭhapāṣāṇaloṣṭeṣu mṛnmayeṣu viśeṣataḥ / mantreṇa loke pūjāṃ tu kurvanti na hyamantrataḥ
dvādaśābdānnamaskārādbhaktyā yallabhate phalam / mantrayuktanamaskārātsakṛttallabhate phalam
saṃkrāntau ca vyatīpāte ayane viṣuve tathā / narmadāyā jale snātvā yastu pūjayate ravim
dvādaśābdena yat pāpam ajñānajñānasaṃcitam / tatkṣaṇānnaśyate sarvaṃ vahninā tu tuṣaṃ yathā
candrasūryagrahe snātvā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ / tatrādityamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
māghamāse tu samprāpte saptamyāṃ nṛpasattama / sopavāso jitakrodha uṣitvā sūryamandire
prātaḥ snātvā vidhānena dadātyarghaṃ divākare / vidhinā mantrayuktena sa labhet puṇyamuttamam
pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ kṛtvā hyudakatarpaṇam / mandire devadevasya tataḥ pūjāṃ samācaret
gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairdīpanaivedyaśobhanaiḥ / pūjayitvā jagannāthaṃ tato mantramudīrayet
viṣṇuḥ śakro yamo dhātā mitro 'tha varuṇastathā / vivasvānsavitā pūṣā caṇḍāṃśurbharga eva ca
iti dvādaśanāmāni japankṛtvā pradakṣiṇām / yatphalaṃ labhate pārtha tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu
daridro vyādhito mūko badhiro jaḍa eva ca / na bhavetsapta janmāni ityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
evaṃ jñātvā vidhānena japanmantraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ / ārādhayed raviṃ bhaktyā ya icchetpuṇyamuttamam
mantrahīnāṃ tu yaḥ kuryād bhaktiṃ devasya bhārata / sa viḍambati cātmānaṃ paśukīṭapataṅgavat
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścit tyajate dehamuttamam / sa gatastatra devaistu pūjyamāno maharṣibhiḥ
svecchayā suciraṃ kālamiha loke nṛpo bhavet
putrapautrasamāyukto hastyaśvarathasaṅkulaḥ / dāsīdāsaśatopeto jāyate vipule kule

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ravitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 126 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra paraṃ tīrthamayonijam / snātamātro narastatra na paśyed yonisaṅkaṭam
tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā pūjayed devamīśvaram / ayonijo mahādeva yathā tvaṃ parameśvara
tathā mocaya māṃ deva sambhavād yonisaṅkaṭāt / gandhapuṣpādidhūpaiśca sa mucyet sarvapātakaiḥ
tasya devasya yo bhaktyā kurute liṅgapūraṇam / sa vaseddevadevasya yāvatsikthasya saṃkhyayā
ayonije mahādevaṃ snāpayed gandhavāriṇā / madhukṣīreṇa dadhnā vā sa labhed vipulāṃ śriyam
aṣṭabhyāṃ ca site pakṣe asitāṃ vā caturdaśīm / pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ prīṇayed gītavādyakaiḥ
vasetsa ca śive loke ye kurvanti manoharam / te vasanti śive loke yāvad ābhūtasamplavam
tasya devasya bhaktyā tu yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇām / vijñāpayaṃśca satataṃ mantreṇānena bhārata
tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ pāramparyeṇa mānavaiḥ / sakāśāddevadevasya tacchṛṇuṣva samādhinā
ayonijo mahādeva yathā tvaṃ parameśvara / tathā mocaya māṃ śarva sambhavādyonisaṅkaṭāt
kiṃ tasya bahubhirmantraiḥ kaṃṭhaśoṣaṇatatparaiḥ / yenauṃnamaḥ śivāyeti proktaṃ devasya saṃnidhau
tenādhītaṃ śrutaṃ tena tena sarvamanuṣṭhitam / yenauṃnamaḥ śivāyeti mantrābhyāsaḥ sthirīkṛtaḥ
na tatphalamavāpnoti sarvadeveṣu vai dvijaḥ / yatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ṣaḍakṣara udīraṇāt
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayecchivayoginam / dvijānāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ sa labhet phalamuttamam
athavā bhaktiyuktastu teṣāṃ dānte jitendriye / saṃskṛtya dadate bhikṣāṃ phalaṃ tasya tato 'dhikam
yatihaste jalaṃ dadyād bhikṣāṃ dattvā punarjalam / sā bhikṣā meruṇā tulyā tajjalaṃ sāgaropamam

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ayoniprabhavatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 127 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet tu rājendra agnitīrthamanuttamam / tatra snātvā tu pakṣādau mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kanyāṃ dadyāt svayamalaṃkṛtām / tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narottama
agniṣṭomātirātrābhyāṃ śataṃ śataguṇīkṛtam / prāpnoti puruṣo dattvā yathāśaktyā hyalaṃkṛtām
tasyāḥ putraprapautrāṇāṃ yā bhaved romasaṃgatiḥ / sa yāti tena mānena śivaloke parāṃ gatim

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe agnitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 128 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra bhṛkuṭeśvaram uttamam / yatra siddho mahābhāgo bhṛguḥ paramakopanaḥ
tena varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ tapaścīrṇaṃ purānagha / putrārthaṃ varayāmāsa putraṃ putravatāṃ varaḥ
varo datto mahābhāga devenāndhakaghātinā / tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet parameśvaram
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ labhet / bhṛkuṭeśaṃ tu yaḥ kaścid ghṛtena madhunā saha
putrārthī snāpayed bhaktyā sa labhet putramīpsitam / tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā dadyād viprāya kāñcanam
godānaṃ vā mahīṃ vāpi tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
sasamudraguhā tena saśailavanakānanā / dattā pṛthvī na sandehas tena sarvā nṛpottama
tena dānena sa svarge krīḍayitvā yathāsukham / martye bhavati rājendro brāhmaṇo vā supūjitaḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhṛkuṭeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 129 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchen mahīpāla brahmatīrthamanuttamam / anyeṣāṃ caiva tīrthānāṃ parātparataraṃ mahat
tatra tīrthe suraśreṣṭho brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yatpurākṛtam / tatkṣālayati deveśo darśanād eva pātakam
śrutismṛtyuditānyeva tatra snātvā dvijarṣabhāḥ / prāyaścittāni kurvanti teṣāṃ vāsastriviṣṭape
ye punaḥ śāstramutsṛjya kāmalobhaprapīḍitāḥ / prāyaścittaṃ vadiṣyanti te vai nirayagāminaḥ
snātvādau pātakī brahmannatvā tu kīrtayed agham / tasya tannaśyate kṣipraṃ tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet pitṛdevatāḥ / agniṣṭomasya yajñasya sa labhet phalamuttamam
tatra tīrthe tu yad dānaṃ brahmoddiśya prayacchati / tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvamityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
gāyatrīsāramātro 'pi tatra yaḥ kriyate japaḥ / ṛgyajuḥsāmasahitaḥ sa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ
tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā tyajeddehaṃ sudustyajam / anivartikā gatistasya brahmalokān na saṃśayaḥ
yāvadasthīni tiṣṭhanti brahmatīrthe ca dehinām / tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi devaloke mahīyate
avatīrṇastato loke brahmajño jāyate kule / uttamaḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ devānāmiva devatā
vidyāsthānāni sarvāṇi vetti vedāṅgapāragaḥ / jāyate pūjito loke rājabhiḥ sa na saṃśayaḥ
putrapautrasamopetaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ / jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ brahmatīrthaprabhāvataḥ
etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ jñānavatāṃ varam / ye paśyanti mahātmāno hyamṛtatvaṃ prayānti te

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe brahmatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| rkv adhyāya 130 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle devatīrthamanuttamam / tatra devaiḥ samāgatya toṣitaḥ parameśvaraḥ
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ / sa labhennātra sandeho gosahasraphalaṃ dhruvam

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe devatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma triṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 131 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle nāgatīrthamanuttamam / yatra siddhā mahānāgā bhaye jāte tato nṛpa
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: mahābhayānāṃ lokasya nāgānāṃ dvijasattama / kathaṃ jātaṃ bhayaṃ tīvraṃ yena te tapasi sthitāḥ
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca yatsurāsuramānave / tāta te viditaṃ sarvaṃ tena me kautukaṃ mahat
mama saṃtāpajaṃ duḥkhaṃ duryodhanasamudbhavam / tava vaktrāmbujaughena plāvitaṃ nirvṛtiṃ gatam
śrutvā tava mukhodgītāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm / bhūyo bhūyaḥ smṛtirjātā śravaṇe mama suvrata
na kleśatvaṃ dvije yuktaṃ na cānyo jānate phalam / vidyādānasya mahataḥ śrāvitasya sutasya ca
evaṃ jñātvā yathānyāyaṃ yaḥ praśnaḥ pṛcchito mayā / kathā tu kathyatāṃ vipra dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: yathā yathā tvaṃ nṛpa bhāṣase ca tathā tathā me sukhameti bhāratī / śaithilyabhāvājjarayānvitasya tvatsauhṛdaṃ naśyati naiva tāta
kathayāmi yathāvṛttam itihāsaṃ purātanam / kathitaṃ pūrvato vṛddhaiḥ pāramparyeṇa bhārata
dve bhārye kaśyapasyāstāṃ sarvalokeṣvanuttame / garutmato vai vinatā sarpāṇāṃ kadrureva ca
aśvasaṃdarśanāt tābhyāṃ kalirūpaṃ vyavasthitam / prabhātakāle rājendra bhāskarākāravarcasam
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vinatā rūpam aśvaṃ sarvatra pāṇḍuram / atha tāṃ kadrūmavocatsā paśya paśya varānane
uccaiḥśravasaḥ sādṛśyaṃ paśya sarvatra pāṇḍuram / dhāvamānam aviśrāntaṃ javena pavanopamam
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā yāntam īrṣyābhāvena mohitā / kṛṣṇaṃ matvā tathājalpattayā saha nṛpottama
vinate tvaṃ mṛṣā loke nṛśaṃse kulapāṃsani / kṛṣṇaṃ cainaṃ vada śvetaṃ narakaṃ yāsyase param
vinatovāca: satyānṛte tu vacane paṇo 'yaṃ te mamaiva tu / sahasraṃ vatsarāndāsī bhaveyaṃ tava veśmani
tatheti te pratijñāya rātrau gatvā svakaṃ gṛham / parityajya ubhe te tu krodhamūrchitamūrchite
bandhugarvasya gatvā tu kathayāmāsa taṃ paṇam / kadrūrvinatayā sārddhaṃ yadvṛttaṃ pramadālaye
tacchrutvā bāndhavāḥ sarve kadrūputrāstathaiva ca / na manyante hitaṃ kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ mātrā vigarhitam
akṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇatām amba kathaṃ gaccheddhayottamaḥ / dāsatvaṃ prāpsyase tvaṃ hi paṇenānena suvrate
kadrūruvāca: bhaveyaṃ na yathādāsī tatkurudhvaṃ hi satvaram / viśadhvaṃ romakūpeṣu tasyāśvasya matirmama
kṣaṇamātraṃ kṛte kārye sā dāsī ca bhavenmama / tataḥ svasthoragāḥ sarve bhaviṣyatha yathāsukham
sarpā ūcuḥ / yathā tvaṃ jananī devi pannagānāṃ matā bhuvi / tathāpi sā viśeṣeṇa vañcitavyā na karhicit
kadrūruvāca: mama vākyamakurvāṇā ye kecidbhuvi pannagāḥ / havyavāhamukhaṃ sarve te yāsyantyavicāritāḥ
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ ghoraṃ mātṛmukhodbhavam / kecitpraviṣṭā romāṇi tathānye girisaṃsthitāḥ
kecitpraviṣṭā jāhnavyāmanye ca tapasi sthitāḥ
tato varṣasahasrānte tutoṣa parameśvaraḥ / mahādevo jagaddhātā hyuvāca parayā girā
bho bhoḥ sarpā nivartadhvaṃ tapaso 'sya mahatphalam / yamicchatha dadāmyadya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
sarpā ūcuḥ / kadrūśāpabhayādbhītā devadeva maheśvara / tava pārśve vasiṣyāmo yāvadābhūtasamplavam
devadeva uvāca: ekaścāyaṃ mahābāhurvāsukirbhujagottamaḥ / mama pārśve vasennityaṃ sarveṣāṃ bhayarakṣakaḥ
anyeṣāṃ caiva sarpāṇāṃ bhayaṃ nāsti mamājñayā / āplutya narmadātoye bhujagāste ca rakṣitāḥ
nāsti mṛtyubhayaṃ teṣāṃ vasadhvaṃ yatra cepsitam / kadrūśāpabhayaṃ nāsti hyeṣa me vistaraḥ paraḥ
evaṃ dattvā varaṃ teṣāṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ / jagāmākāśamāviśya kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam
gate cādarśanaṃ deve vāsukipramukhā nṛpa / sthāpayitvā tathā jagmurdevadevaṃ maheśvaram
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścit pañcamyāmarcayecchivam / tasya nāgakulānyaṣṭau na hiṃsanti kadācana
mṛtaḥ kālena mahatā tatra tīrthe nareśvara / śivasyānucaro bhūtvā vasate kālamīpsitam

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nāgeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 132 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra uttare narmadātaṭe / sarvapāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ vārāhaṃ nāma nāmataḥ
tatra devo jagaddhātā vārāhaṃ rūpam āsthitaḥ / sthito lokahitārthāya saṃsārārṇavatārakaḥ
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayed dharaṇīdharam / gandhamālyaviśeṣaiśca jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ
upavāsaparo bhūtvā dvādaśyāṃ nṛpasattama / vṛṣalāḥ pāpakarmāṇas tathaivāndhapiśācinaḥ
ālāpād gātrasaṃparkān niḥśvāsāt sahabhojanāt / pāpaṃ saṃkramate yasmāt tasmāt tān parivarjayet
brāhmaṇān pūjayed bhaktyā yathāśaktyā yathāvidhi / rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ kathāyāṃ tatra bhārata
prabhāte vimale snātvā tatra tīrthe jagadgurum / ye paśyanti jitakrodhāste muktāḥ sarvapātakaiḥ
yathā tu dṛṣṭvā bhujagāḥ suparṇaṃ naśyanti muktvā viṣamugratejaḥ / naśyanti pāpāni tathaiva śīghraṃ dṛṣṭvā mukhaṃ śūkararūpiṇastu
nabhogataṃ naśyati cāndhakāraṃ dṛṣṭvā raviṃ devavaraṃ tathaiva / naśyanti pāpāni sudustarāṇi dṛṣṭvā mukhaṃ pārtha dharādharasya
kiṃ tasya bahubhir mantrair bhaktir yasya janārdane / namo nārāyaṇāyeti mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ
eko 'pi kṛṣṇasya kṛtaḥ praṇāmo daśāśvamedhāvabhṛthena tulyaḥ / daśāśvamedhī punareti janma kṛṣṇapraṇāmī na punarbhavāya
dhyāyamānā mahātmāno rūpaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ hareḥ / ye tyajanti svakaṃ dehaṃ tatra tīrthe jitendriyāḥ
te gacchantyamalaṃ sthānaṃ yatsurair api durlabham / kṣarākṣaravinirmuktaṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ādivārāhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvātriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 133 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla paraṃ tīrthacatuṣṭayam / yeṣāṃ darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet
kauberaṃ vāruṇaṃ yāmyaṃ vāyavyaṃ tu tataḥ param / yatra siddhā mahāprājñā lokapālā mahābalāḥ
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kimarthaṃ lokapālaiśca tapaścīrṇaṃ purānagha / narmadātaṭamāśritya hyetanme vaktumarhasi
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: adhiṣṭhānaṃ samicchanti hyacalaṃ nirbale sati / saṃsāre sarvabhūtānāṃ tṛṇabinduvadasthire
kadalīsāraniḥsāre mṛgatṛṣṇeva cañcale / sthāvare jaṅgame sarve bhūtagrāme caturvidhe
dharmo mātā pitā dharmo dharmo bandhuḥ suhṛt tathā / ādhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ trailokye sacarācare
evaṃ jñātvā tu te sarve lokapālāḥ kṛtakṣaṇāḥ / tapaste cakruratulaṃ mārutāhāratatparāḥ
tatastuṣṭo mahādevaḥ kṛtasyārddhe gate tadā / anurūpeṇa rājendra yugasya parameśvaraḥ
vareṇa chandayāmāsa lokapālān mahābalān / yo yamicchati kāmaṃ vai taṃ taṃ tasya dadāmyaham
etacchrutvā vacastasya lokapālā jagaddhitāḥ / varadaṃ prārthayāmāsur devaṃ varam anuttamam
kubera uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva yadi deyo varo mama / yakṣāṇām īśvaraścāhaṃ bhavāmi dhanadastviti
tataḥ provāca deveśaṃ yamaḥ saṃyamane rataḥ / tatra pradhāno bhagavān bhaveyaṃ sarvajantuṣu
varuṇo 'nantaraṃ prāha praṇamya tu maheśvaram / krīḍeyaṃ vāruṇe loke yādogaṇasamanvitaḥ
jagādāśu tato vāyuḥ praṇamya tu maheśvaram / vyāpakatvaṃ trilokeṣu prārthayāmāsa bhārata
teṣāṃ yadīpsitaṃ kāmamumayā saha śaṅkaraḥ / sarveṣāṃ lokapālānaḥ dattvā cādarśanaṃ gataḥ
gate maheśvare deve yathāsthānaṃ tu te sthitāḥ / sthāpanā ca kṛtā sarvaiḥ svanāmnaiva pṛthakpṛthak
kuberaśca kubereśaṃ yamaścaiva yameśvaram / varuṇo varuṇeśaṃ tu vāto vāteśvaraṃ nṛpa
tarpaṇaṃ vidadhuḥ sarve mantraiśca vividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ / sarve sarveśvaraṃ deva pūjayitvā yathāvidhi
āhvayāmāsus tān viprānsarve sarveśvarā iva / kṣāntadāntajitakrodhānsarvabhūtābhayapradān
vedavidyāvratasnātān sarvaśāstraviśāradān / ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃyuktāṃs tathātharvavibhūṣitān
cāturvidhyaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ dānaṃ dāsyāma gṛhṇata / evamuktvā tu sarveṣāṃ viprāṇāṃ dānamuttamam
tatra sthāne dadus teṣāṃ bhūmidānam anuttamam / yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca yāvat tiṣṭhati medinī
tāvaddānaṃ tu yuṣmākaṃ paripanthī na kaścana / rājā vā rājatulyo vā lokapālair anuttamam
dattaṃ lopayate mūḍhaḥ śrūyatāṃ tasya yo vidhiḥ / śoṣayeddhanado vittaṃ tasya pāpasya bhārata
śarīraṃ varuṇo devaḥ saṃtatīṃ śvasanas tathā / āyurnayati tasyāśu yamaḥ saṃyamano mahān
niḥśeṣaṃ bhasmasāt kṛtvā hutabhugyāti bhārata / tasmāt sarvaprayatnena brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira / bhaktiḥ kāryā nṛpaiḥ sarvair icchadbhiḥ śreya ātmanaḥ
rājā vṛkṣo brāhmaṇāstasya mūlaṃ bhṛtyāḥ parṇā mantriṇastasya śākhāḥ / tasmān mūlaṃ yatnato rakṣaṇīyaṃ mūle gupte nāsti vṛkṣasya nāśaḥ
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi svarge tiṣṭhati bhūmidaḥ / ācchettā cāvamantā ca tānyeva narake vaset
svadattā paradattā vā pālanīyā vasuṃdharā / yasya yasya yadā bhūmistasya tasya tadā phalam
devatājñāmanusmṛtya rājāno ye 'pi tāṃ nṛpa / pālayiṣyanti satataṃ teṣāṃ vāsastriviṣṭape
svadattā paradattā vā yatnādrakṣyā yudhiṣṭhira / mahī mahīkṣitā nityaṃ dānācchreyo 'nupālanam
āyuryaśo balaṃ vittaṃ saṃtatiścākṣayā nṛpa / teṣāṃ bhaviṣyate nūnaṃ ye prajāpālane ratāḥ
evamuktvā tu tān sarvāṃllokapālān dvijottamān / pūjayitvā vidhānena praṇipatya vyasarjayan
gateṣu vipramukhyeṣu snātvā hutahutāśanāḥ / lokapālāḥ kṣudhāviṣṭāḥ paryaṭanbhaikṣamātmanaḥ
asthicarmāvaśeṣāṅgāḥ kapāloddhṛtapāṇayaḥ / alabdhagrāsamarddhārdhaṃ niryayur nagarādbahiḥ
śāpaṃ dattvā tadā krodhād brāhmaṇāya yudhiṣṭhira / daridrāḥ satataṃ mūrkhā bhaveyuśca yayurgṛhān
tadāprabhṛti te sarve brāhmaṇā dhanavarjitāḥ / śāpadoṣeṇa kauberyāṃ saṃjātā duḥkhabhājanāḥ
na dhanaṃ paitṛkaṃ putrairna pitā putrapautrikam / bhuñjate sakalaṃ kālamityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
kubereśo naraḥ snātvā yastu pūjayate śivam / gandhadhūpanamaskāraiḥ so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
yamatīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā sampaśyati yameśvaram / sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyeta saptajanmāntarārjitaiḥ
pūrṇamāsyām amāvāsyāṃ snātvā tu pitṛtarpaṇam / yaḥ karoti tilaiḥ snānaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
sutṛptāstena toyena pitaraśca pitāmahāḥ / svargasthā dvādaśābdāni krīḍanti prapitāmahāḥ
varuṇeśe naraḥ snātvā hyarcayitvā maheśvaram / vājapeyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam
mṛtāṃ kālena mahatā loke yatra jaleśvaraḥ / sa gacchet tatra yānena gīyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ
vāteśvare naraḥ snātvā sampūjya ca maheśvaram / jāyate kṛtakṛtyo 'sau lokapālānavekṣayan
kiṃ tasya bahubhiryajñairdānairvā bahudakṣiṇaiḥ / snātvā catuṣṭaye loke avāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam
te dhanyāste mahātmānas teṣāṃ janma sujīvitam / nityaṃ vasanti kaurilyāṃ lokapālānnimantrya ye
etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyamāyurvivardhanam / paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kuberāditīrthacatuṣṭayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 134 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle rāmeśvaramanuttamam / tīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam
tatra tīrthe tu ye snātvā pūjayanti maheśvaram / mahādevaṃ mahātmānaṃ mucyante sarvakilbiṣaiḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe rāmeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catustriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 135 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tasyaivānantaraṃ cānyatsiddheśvaramanuttamam / tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ sarvalokeṣu pūjitam
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā hyumārudraṃ prapūjayet / vājapeyasya yajñasya sa labhet phalamuttamam
tena puṇyena mahatā mṛtaḥ svargamavāpnuyāt / apsarogaṇasaṃvīto jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ
sahasravatsarāṃstatra krīḍayitvā yathāsukham / dhanadhānyasamopete kule mahati jāyate
pūjyamāno naraśreṣṭha vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ / vyādhiśokavinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 136 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla cāhalyeśvaramuttamam / yatra siddhā mahābhāgā tvahalyā tāpasī purā
gautamo brāhmaṇastvāsīt sākṣād brahmeva cāparaḥ / satyadharmasamāyukto vānaprasthāśrame rataḥ
tasya patnī mahābhāgā hyahalyā nāma viśrutā / rūpayauvanasampannā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā
asyā apyatirūpeṇa devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ / mohito lobhayāmāsa hyahalyāṃ balasūdanaḥ
māṃ bhajasva varārohe devarājam anindite / krīḍayasva mayā sārddhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu pūjitā
kiṃ kariṣyasi vipreṇa śaucācārakṛśena tu / tapaḥsvādhyāyaśīlena kliśyantīva sulocane
evamuktā varārohā strīsvabhāvāt sucañcalā / manasādhyāya śakraṃ sā kāmena kaluṣīkṛtā
tasyā viditvā taṃ bhāvaṃ sa devaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ / gautamaṃ vañcayāmāsa duṣṭabhāvena bhāvitaḥ
viditvā cāntaraṃ tasya gṛhītvā veṣamuttamam / ahalyāṃ ramayāmāsa viśvastāṃ mandirāntike
kṣaṇamātrāntare tatra devarājasya bhārata / ājagāma muniśreṣṭho mandiraṃ tvarayānvitaḥ
āgataṃ gautamaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītabhītaḥ puraṃdaraḥ / nirgataḥ sa tato dṛṣṭvā śakro 'yamiti cintayan
tataḥ śaśāpa devendraṃ gautamaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ / ajitendriyo 'si yasmāttvaṃ tasmād bahubhago bhava
evamuktastu devendrastatkṣaṇādeva bhārata / bhagānāṃ tu sahasreṇa tatkṣaṇād eva veṣṭitaḥ
tyaktvā rājyaṃ suraiḥ sārddhaṃ gataśrīko jagāma ha / tapaścacāra vipulaṃ gautamena mahītale
ahalyāpi tataḥ śaptā yasmāt tvaṃ duṣṭacāriṇī / prekṣya māṃ ramase śakraṃ tasmād aśmamayī bhava
gate varṣasahasrānte rāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā yaśasvinam / tīrthayātrāprasaṅgena dhautapāpā bhaviṣyasi
evaṃ gate tataḥ kāle dṛṣṭā rāmeṇa dhīmatā / viśvāmitrasahāyena tyaktvā sāśmamayīṃ tanum
pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ gatapāpā vimatsarā / āgatā narmadātīre tīrthe snātvā yathāvidhi
kṛtaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ māsaṃ kṛcchraṃ cānyaṃ tataḥ param / tatastuṣṭo mahādevo dattvā varamanuttamam
jagāmādarśanaṃ bhūyo reme comāpatiściram / ahalyā tu gate deve sthāpayitvā jagadgurum
ahalyeśvaranāmānaṃ svagṛhe cāgamatpunaḥ / tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet parameśvaram
sa mṛtaḥ svargamāpnoti yatra devo maheśvaraḥ / krīḍayitvā yathākāmaṃ tatra loke mahātapāḥ
gate varṣasahasrānte mānuṣyaṃ labhate punaḥ / dhanadhānyacayopetaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ
vedavidyāśrayo dhīmāñjāyate vimale kule / rūpasaubhāgyasampannaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ / jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgram ahalyātīrthasevanāt

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ahalyātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 137 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: dharmaputra tato gacchet karkaṭeśvaramuttamam / uttare narmadākūle sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
tatra snātvā vidhānena yastu pūjayate śivam / anivartikā gatistasya rudralokād asaṃśayam
tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ purāṇe yacchrutaṃ mayā / na tadvarṇayituṃ śakyaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa vadāmyataḥ
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kuryātkiṃcitkarma śubhāśubham / harṣān madān mahārāja tatsarvaṃ jāyate 'kṣayam
tatra tīrthe tapastaptvā vālakhilyā marīcayaḥ / ramante 'dyāpi lokeṣu svecchayā kurunandana
tatrasthāstanna jānanti narājñānabahiṣkṛtāḥ / śarīrastham ivātmānam akṣayaṃ jyotikhyayam
tatra tīrthe nṛpaśreṣṭha devī nārāyaṇī purā / adyāpi tapate ghoraṃ tapo yāvatkilārbudam
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ / tasya te dvādaśābdāni tṛptiṃ yānti pitāmahāḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe karkaṭeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 138 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet pāṇḍuputra śakratīrtham anuttamam / yatra siddho mahābhāgo devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ
gautamena purā śaptaṃ jñātvā devāḥ sureśvaram / brahmādyā devatāḥ sarva ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ
gautamaṃ prārthayāmāsur vākyaiḥ sānunayaiḥ śubhaiḥ / gatarājyaṃ gataśrīkaṃ śakraṃ prati munīśvara
indrena rahitaṃ rājyaṃ na kaścit kāmayed dvija / devo vā mānavo vāpi etatte viditaṃ prabho
tasya tvaṃ bhagayuktasya dayāṃ kuru dvijottama / gataścādarśanaṃ śakro dūṣitaḥ svena pāpmanā
devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā gautamo vedavittamaḥ / tatheti kṛtvā śakrasya varaṃ dātuṃ pracakrame
etadbhagasahasraṃ tu purā jātaṃ śatakrato / tallocanasahasraṃ tu matprasādād bhaviṣyati
evamuktaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ praṇamya munisattamam / brāhmaṇāṃs tān mahābhāgān narmadāṃ pratyagāt tataḥ
snātvā sa vimale toye saṃsthāpya tripurāntakam / jagāma tridaśāvāsaṃ pūjyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet parameśvaram / paradārābhigamanān mucyate pātakān naraḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śakratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam nāmāṣṭatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 139 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchen mahārāja somatīrthamanuttamam / yatra somastapastaptvā nakṣatrapathamāsthitaḥ
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snāyādācamya vidhipūrvakam / kṛtajāpyo raviṃ dhyāyet tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
ṛgvedayajurvedābhyāṃ sāmavedena bhārata / japato yatphalaṃ proktaṃ gāyatryā cātra tatphalam
tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā brāhmaṇān bhojayecchuciḥ / tena samyagvidhānena koṭirbhavati bhojitā
pādukopānahau chatraṃ vastrakambalavājinaḥ / yo datte vipramukhyāya tasya tatkoṭisaṃmitam
sahasraṃ tu sahasrāṇāmanṛcāṃ yastu bhojayet / ekasya mantrayuktasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm
evaṃ tu bhojayet tatra bahvṛcaṃ vedapāragam / śākhāntargam athādhvaryuṃ chandogaṃ vā samāptigam
agnihotrasahasrasya yatphalaṃ prāpyate budhaiḥ / samaṃ tadvedaviduṣā tīrthe somasya tatphalam
bhojayedyaḥ śataṃ teṣāṃ sahasraṃ labhate naraḥ / ekasya yogayuktasya tatphalaṃ kavayo viduḥ
saṃnirudhyendriyagrāmaṃ yatrayatra vasen muniḥ / tatratatra kurukṣetraṃ naimiṣaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca
tasmātsarvaprayatnena grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ / saṃkrāntau ca vyatīpāte yogī bhojyo viśeṣataḥ
saṃnyāsaṃ kurute yastu tatra tīrthe yudhiṣṭhira / vimānena mahābhāgāḥ sa yāti tridivaṃ naraḥ
somasyānucaro bhūtvā tenaiva saha modate

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe somatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 140 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahārāja nandāhradamanuttamam / yatra siddhā mahābhāgā nandā devī varapradā
mahiṣāsure mahākāye purā devabhayaṃkare / śūlinyā śūlabhinnāṅge kṛte dānavasattame
yenaikādaśarudrāśca hyādityāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ / vasavo vāyunā sārddhaṃ candrādityau sureśvara
balinā nirjitā yena brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ / saṅgrāme sumahāghore kṛte devabhayaṃkare
kṛtvā tatkadanaṃ ghoraṃ nandā devī sureśvarī / yasmātsnātā viśālākṣī tena nandāhradaḥ smṛtaḥ
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā nandāmuddiśya bhārata / dadāti dānaṃ viprebhyaḥ so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
bhairavaṃ caiva kedāraṃ tathā rudraṃ mahālayam / nandāhradaścaturthaḥ syātpañcamaṃ bhuvi durlabham
bahavastaṃ na jānanti kāmarāgasamanvitāḥ / narmadāyā hradaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā nandāṃ devīṃ prapūjayet / kiṃ tasya himavanmadhyagamanena prayojanam
paramārthamavijñāya paryaṭanti tamovṛtāḥ / teṣāṃ samāgame pārtha śrama eva hi kevalam
pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ snānadānena yatphalam / tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti snātvā nandāhrade nṛpa

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nandāhradatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 141 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchen mahīpāla tāpeśvaramanuttamam / yatra sā hariṇī siddhā vyādhabhītā nareśvara
jale prakṣipya gātrāṇi hyantarikṣaṃ gatā tu sā / vyādho vismitacittastu tāṃ mṛgīmavalokya ca
vimucya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ prārebhe tapa uttamam / divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu vyādhenācaritaṃ tapaḥ
atīte tu tataḥ kāle parituṣṭo maheśvaraḥ / varaṃ brūhi mahāvyādha yatte manasi rocate
vyādha uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama / tava pārśve mahādeva vāso me pratidīyatām
īśvara uvāca: evaṃ bhavatu te vyādha yastvayā kāṅkṣito varaḥ / daivadevo mahādeva ityuktvāntaradhīyata / gate cādarśanaṃ deve sthāpayitvā maheśvaram
pūjayitvā vidhānena gato vyādhastato divam / tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
vyādhānutāpasaṃjātaṃ tāpeśvaramiti śrutam / tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā sampūjayati śaṅkaram
śivalokamavāpnoti māmuvāca maheśvaraḥ / ye snātā narmadātoye tīrthe tāpeśvare narāḥ
tāpatrayavimuktāste nātra kāryā vicāraṇā / aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ
snānaṃ samācaren nityaṃ sarvapātakaśāntaye

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tāpeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 142 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahārāja rukmiṇītīrthamuttamam / yatraiva snānamātreṇa rūpavānsubhago bhavet
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ / snānaṃ samācaret tatra na ceha jāyate punaḥ
yaḥ snātvā rukmiṇītīrthe dānaṃ dadyāttu kāṃcanam / tattīrthasya prabhāvena śokaṃ nāpnoti mānavaḥ
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: tīrthasyāsya kathaṃ jāto mahimedṛṅmunīśvara / rūpasaubhāgyadaṃ yena tīrtham etad bravīhi me
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: kathayāmi yathāvṛttamitihāsaṃ purātanam / kathitaṃ pūrvato vṛddhaiḥ pāramparyeṇa bhārata
taṃ te 'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥ / nagaraṃ kuṇḍinaṃ nāma bhīṣmakaḥ paripāti hi
hastyaśvarathasampanno dhanāḍhyo 'ti pratāpavān / strīsahasrasya madhyasthaḥ kurute rājyamuttamam
tasya bhāryā mahādevī prāṇebhyo 'pi garīyasī / tasyāmutpādayāmāsa putramekaṃ ca rukmakam
dvitīyā tanayā jajñe rukmiṇī nāma nāmataḥ / tadāśarīriṇī vācā rājānaṃ tamuvāca ha
caturbhujāya dātavyā kanyeyaṃ bhuvi bhīṣmaka / evaṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā jaharṣa priyayā saha
brāhmaṇaiḥ saha vidvadbhiḥ praviṣṭaḥ sūtikāgṛham / svastikaṃ vācayitvāsyāścakre nāmeti rukmiṇī
yataḥ suvarṇatilako janmanā saha bhārata / tataḥ sā rukmiṇīnāma brāhmaṇaiḥ kīrtitā tadā
tataḥ sā kālaparyāyādaṣṭavarṣā vyajāyata / pūrvoktaṃ caiva tadvākyamaśarīriṇyudīritam
smṛtvā smṛtvātha nṛpatiścintayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ / kasmai deyā mayā bālā bhavitā kaścaturbhujaḥ
etasminnantare tāvadraivatātparvatottamāt / mukhyaścedipatistatra damaghoṣaḥ samāgataḥ
praviṣṭo rājasadanaṃ yatra rājā sa bhīṣmakaḥ / taṃ dṛṣṭvā cāgataṃ gehe pūjayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ
āsanaṃ vipulaṃ dattvā sabhāṃ gatvā niveśitaḥ / kuśalaṃ tava rājendra damaghoṣa śriyāyuta
puṇyāhamadya saṃjātamahaṃ tvaddarśanotsukaḥ / kanyā madīyā rājendra hyaṣṭavarṣā vyajāyata
caturbhujāya dātavyā vāguvācāśarīriṇī / bhīṣmakasya vacaḥ śrutvā damaghoṣo 'bravīd idam
