|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīkapālatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśottaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 215 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṅgitīrthaṃ tato gacchen mokṣadaṃ sarvadehinām / mṛtānāṃ tatra rājendra mokṣaprāptirna saṃśayaḥ
tatraiva piṇḍadānena pitḥṇām anṛṇo bhavet / tena puṇyena pūtātmā labhed gāṇeśvarīṃ gatim

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śṛṅgitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśottaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 216 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: aṣāḍhītīrtham āgacchet tato bhūpālanandana / kāmikaṃ rūpamāsthāya sthito yatra maheśvaraḥ
cāturyugam idaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvatīrtheṣvanuttamam / tatra snātvā naro rājan rudrasyānucaro bhavet
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścit kurute prāṇamokṣaṇam / anivartikā gatistasya rudralokād asaṃśayam

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe aṣāḍhītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśottaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 217 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: eraṇḍīsaṅgamaṃ gacchet surāsuranamaskṛtam / tattu tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam
upavāsaparo bhūtvā niyatendriyamānasaḥ / tatra snātvā vidhānena mucyate brahmahatyayā
tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā prāṇatyāgaparo bhavet / anivartikā gatis tasya rudralokād asaṃśayam

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe eraṇḍītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśottaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 218 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gaccheddharādhīśa tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / jamadagniriti khyātaṃ yatra siddho janārdanaḥ
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kathaṃ siddho dvijaśreṣṭha vāsudevo jagadguruḥ / mānuṣaṃ rūpamāsthāya lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
etatsarvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ devadevasya cakriṇaḥ / caritaṃ śrotum icchāmi kathyamānaṃ tvayānagha
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: āsītpūrvaṃ mahārāja haihayādhipatirmahān / kārtavīrya iti khyāto rājā bāhusahasravān
hastyaśvarathasampannaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / vedavidyāvratasnātaḥ sarvabhūtābhayapradaḥ
māhiṣmatyāḥ patiḥ śrīmānrājā hyakṣauhiṇīpatiḥ / sa kadācinmṛgānhantuṃ nirjagāma mahābalaḥ
bahubhir divasaiḥ prāpto bhṛgukacchamanuttamam / jamadagnir mahātejā yatra tiṣṭhati tāpasaḥ
reṇukāsahitaḥ śrīmānsarvabhūtābhayapradaḥ / tasya putro 'bhavadrāmaḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
sarvakṣatraguṇairyukto brahmavidbrāhmaṇottamaḥ / toṣayanparayā bhaktyā pitarau paramārthavat
taṃ tadā cārjunaṃ dṛṣṭvā jamadagniḥ pratāpavān / carantaṃ mṛgayāṃ gatvā hyātithyena nyamantrayat
tatheti coktvā sa nṛpaḥ sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ / jagāma cāśramaṃ puṇyamṛṣestasya mahātmanaḥ
tatkṣaṇād eva sampannaṃ śriyā paramayā vṛtam / vismayaṃ paramaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā rājā jagāma ha
gatamātrastu siddhena paramānnena bhojitaḥ / sabhṛtyabalavānrājā brāhmaṇena yadṛcchayā / kimetad iti papraccha kāraṇaṃ śaktimeva ca
kāmadhenoḥ prabhāvaṃ taṃ jñātvā prāha tato dvijam / dakṣiṇāṃ dehi me vipra kalmaṣāṃ dhenumuttamām
śataṃ śatasahasrāṇām ayutaṃ niyutaṃ param / bhūṣitānāṃ ca dhenūnāṃ dadāmi tava cārbudam
jamadagnir uvāca: ayutaiḥ prayutair nāhaṃ śatakoṭibhiruttamām / kāmadhenumimāṃ tāta na dadmi pratigamyatām
evamuktaḥ sa rājendras tena vipreṇa bhārata / krodhasaṃraktanayana idaṃ vacanamabravīt
yasyedṛśaḥ kāmacāro mayyapi dvijapāṃsana / ahaṃ te paśyatastasmānnayāmi surabhiṃ gṛhāt
dvija uvāca: kaḥ krīḍati saroṣeṇa nirbhayo hi mahāhinā / mṛtyudṛṣṭotareṇāpi mama dhenuṃ nayeta yaḥ
evamuktvā mahādaṇḍaṃ brahmadaṇḍamivāparam / gṛhītvā paramakruddho jamadagniruvāca ha
yasyāsti śaktistejo vā kṣatriyasya kulādhamaḥ / dhenuṃ nayatu me sadyaḥ kṣīṇāyuḥ saparicchadaḥ
etacchrutvā vacaḥ krūraṃ haihayaḥ śataśo vṛtaḥ / dhāvamānaḥ kṣititale brahmadaṇḍahato 'patat
huṃkṛtena tato dhenvāḥ khaḍgapāśāsipāṇayaḥ / nirgacchantaḥ pradṛśyante kalmaṣāyāḥ sahasraśaḥ
nāsāpuṭāgrādromāgrātkirātā māgadhā gudāt / randhrāntareṣu cotpannāḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
evamanyo 'nyamāhatya haihayaṣṭaṅkaṇāndahan / vināśaṃ saha vipreṇa gatā hyarjunatejasā
kārtavīryo jayaṃ labdhvā saṃkhye hatvā dvijottamam / jagāma svāṃ purīṃ hṛṣṭaḥ kṛtāntavaśamohitaḥ
tatastvarānvitaḥ prāptaḥ paścādrāmo gate ripau / ākrandamānāṃ jananīṃ dadarśa piturantike
rāma uvāca: kenedamātmanāśāya hyajñānāt sāhasaṃ kṛtam / mama tātaṃ jighāṃsuryo draṣṭuṃ mṛtyumihecchati
tataḥ sā rāmavākyena gatasattveva vihvalā / udaraṃ karayugmena tāḍayantī hyuvāca tam
arjunena nṛśaṃsena kṣatriyair aparaiḥ saha / ihāgatya pitā tena nihato bāhuśālinā
taṃ paśya nihataṃ tātaṃ gatāsuṃ gatacetasam / saṃskṛtya vidhivatputra tarpayasva yathātatham
etacchrutvā sa vacanaṃ jananīm abhivādya tām / pratijñām akarod yāṃ tāṃ śṛṇuṣva ca narādhipa
triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivīṃ niḥkṣatriyakulānvayām / snātvā ca teṣām asṛjā tarpayiṣyāmi te patim
tasyāpi paraśunā bāhūn kārtavīryasya durmateḥ / chittvā pāsyāmi rudhiramiti satyaṃ śṛṇuṣva me
evaṃ pratijñāṃ kṛtvāsau jāmadagnyaḥ pratāpavān / krodhena mahatāviṣṭaḥ saṃskṛtya pitaraṃ tataḥ
māhiṣmatīṃ purīṃ rāmo jagāma krodhamūrchitaḥ / chittvā bāhuvanaṃ tasya hatvā taṃ kṣatriyādhamam
jagāma kṣatriyāntāya pṛthivīm avalokayan / saptadvīpārṇavayutāṃ saśailavanakānanām
pūrvataḥ paścimāmāśāṃ dakṣiṇottarataḥ kurūn / samantapañcake pañca cakāra rudhirahradān
sa teṣu rudhirāmbhastu hradeṣu krodhamūrchitaḥ / pitḥn saṃtarpayāmāsa rudhireṇeti naḥ śrutam
atharcīkādaya upetya pitaro brāhmaṇarṣabham / taṃ kṣamasveti jagadus tataḥ sa virarāma ha
teṣāṃ samīpe yo deśo hradānāṃ rudhirāmbhasām / samaṃ tapaṃ cakram iti puṇyaṃ tatparikīrtitam
nivartya karmaṇastasmāt pitḥn provāca pāṇḍava / rāmaḥ paramadharmātmā yadidaṃ rudhiraṃ mayā
kṣiptaṃ pañcasu tīrtheṣu tadbhūyāt tīrthamuttamam / tathetyuktvā tu te sarve pitaro 'dṛśyatāṃ gatāḥ
evaṃ rāmasya saṃsargo devamārge yudhiṣṭhira / sarvapāpakṣayakaro darśanātsparśanān nṛṇām
reṇukāpratyayārthāya adyāpi pitṛdevatāḥ / dṛśyante devamārgasthāḥ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarāḥ
tatra tīrthe tu rājendra narmadodadhisaṅgame / sthānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena mucyante pātakairnarāḥ
kuśāgreṇāpi kaunteya na spṛṣṭavyo mahodadhiḥ / anena tatra mantreṇa snātavyaṃ nṛpasattama
namaste viṣṇurūpāya namastubhyam apāṃ pate / sānnidhyaṃ kuru deveśa sāgare lavaṇāmbhasi / iti sparśanamantraḥ
agniśca tejo mṛḍayā ca dehe reto 'tha viṣṇuramṛtasya nābhiḥ / etad bruvan pāṇḍava satyavākyaṃ tato 'vagāheta patiṃ nadīnām
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ phalapuṣpākṣatairyutam / mantreṇānena rājendra dadyādarghaṃ mahodadheḥ
sarvaratnanidhānastvaṃ sarvaratnākarākaraḥ / sarvāmarapradhāneśa gṛhāṇārghaṃ namo 'stu te / ityarghamantraḥ
ā janmajanitāt pāpānmāmuddhara mahodadhe / yāhyarcito ratnanidhe parvatān pārvaṇottama / iti visarjanamantraḥ
ko 'paraḥ sāgarāddevātsvargadvāravipāṭana / tatra sāgaraparyantaṃ mahātīrthamanuttamam
jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa tatra devaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ / yatra devāḥ sagandharvā munayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ
upāsate virūpākṣaṃ jamadagnim anuttamam / reṇukāṃ caiva ye devīṃ paśyanti bhuvi mānavāḥ
priyavāse śive loke vasanti kālamīpsitam / tatra snātvā naro rājaṃstarpayanpitṛdevatāḥ
tārayen narakādghorāt kulānāṃ śatamuttaram / snātvā dattvātra sahitāḥ śrutvā vai bhaktipūrvakam

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe jāmadagnyatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśādhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 219 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ koṭīśvaraṃ param / yatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet
tatra devāḥ sagandharvā ṛṣayo ye tathāmalāḥ / koṭitīrthe parāṃ siddhiṃ samprāptā bhuvi durlabhām
sthāpitaśca mahādevastatra koṭīśvaro nṛpa / taṃ dṛṣṭvā devadeveśaṃ siddhiṃ prāpnotyanuttamām
tatra tīrthe tu yatkiṃcicchubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham / kriyate tannṛpaśreṣṭha sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet
tatra dakṣiṇamārgasthā ye kecinmunisattamāḥ / siddhā mṛtāḥ padaṃ yānti pitṛlokaṃ dhruvaṃ hi te
uttaraṃ narmadākūlaṃ ye śreṣṭhā munipuṃgavāḥ / devalokaṃ gatāḥ pūrvamiti śāstrasya niścayaḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe koṭitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśadadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 220 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gaccheddharādhīśa loṭaṇeśvaram uttamam / uttare narmadākūle sarvapātakanāśanam
tatkṣaṇādeva tatsarvaṃ saptajanmārjitaṃ tvagham / naśyate devadevasya darśanādeva tannṛpa
bālyātprabhṛti yatpāpaṃ yauvane cāpi yatkṛtam / tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti devadevasya darśanāt
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: āścaryabhūtaṃ lokeṣu narmadācaritaṃ mahat / tvayā vai kathitaṃ vipra sakalaṃ pāpanāśanam
yadekaṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradam / śrotumicchāmi tatsarvaṃ dayāṃ kṛtvā vadāśu me
ye kecid durlabhāḥ praśnāstriṣu lokeṣu sattama / tvatprasādena te sarve śrutā me saha bāndhavaiḥ
etamekaṃ paraṃ praśnaṃ sarvapraśnavidāṃ vara / śrutvāhaṃ tvatprasādena yatra yāmi sabāndhavaḥ
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sādhusādhu mahāprājña yasya te matirīdṛśī / durlabhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu tasya te nāsti kiṃcana
dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca bharatarṣabha / kāle kāle ca yo vetti kartavyas tena dhīmatā
tasmāt te sampravakṣyāmi praśnasyāsyottaraṃ śubham / yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyante bhuvi mānavāḥ
narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvatīrthamayī śubhā / viśeṣaḥ kathitastasyā revāsāgarasaṅgame
āgacchantīṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha dṛṣṭvā revāṃ mahodadhiḥ / praṇamya ca punardevīṃ saṅgame revayā saha
saṃcintya manasā keyamiti māṃ vai saridvarā / jñātvā saṃcintya manasā revāṃ liṅgodbhavāṃ parām
luṭhanvai sammukhastāta gato revāṃ mahodadhiḥ / samudre narmadā yatra praviṣṭāsti mahānadī
tatra devādhidevasya samudre liṅgamutthitam / liṅgodbhūtā mahābhāgā narmadā saritāṃ varā
layaṃ gatā tatra liṅge tena puṇyatamā hi sā / narmadāyāṃ vasannityaṃ narmadāmbu pibansadā / dīkṣitaḥ sarvayajñeṣu somapānaṃ dine dine
saṅgame tatra yaḥ snātvā loṭaṇeśvaram arcayet / so 'śvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā yatkṛtaṃ nṛpa / loṭaṇeśvaram āsādya sarvaṃ vilayatāṃ vrajet
kārttikyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa kathitaṃ śaṅkareṇa tu / tacchṛṇuṣva nṛpaśreṣṭha sarvapāpāpanodanam
samprāptāṃ kārttikīṃ dṛṣṭvā gatvā tatra nṛpottama / caturdaśyāmupoṣyaiva snātvā vai narmadājale
saṃtarpya pitṛdevāṃśca śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi / rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātsampūjya loṭaṇeśvaram
saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ tasya saphalaṃ tasya ceṣṭitam / paṅgavaste na sandeho janma teṣāṃ nirarthakam
ekāgramanasā yaistu na dṛṣṭo loṭaṇeśvaraḥ / piśācatvaṃ viyonitvaṃ na bhavettasya vai kule
saṅgame tatra yo gatvā snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi / puṇyaiścaiva tathā kuryād gītair nṛtyaiḥ prabodhanam
tataḥ prabhātāṃ rajanīṃ dṛṣṭvā natvā mahodadhim / āmantrya snānavidhinā snānaṃ tatra tu kārayet
oṃ namo viṣṇurūpāya tīrthanāthāya te namaḥ / sānnidhyaṃ kuru me deva samudra lavaṇāmbhasi / ityāmantraṇamantraḥ
agniśca tejo mṛḍayā ca deho reto 'dhā viṣṇuramṛtasya nābhiḥ / evaṃ bruvan pāṇḍava satyavākyaṃ tato 'vagāheta patiṃ nadīnām / iti snānamantraḥ
ājanmaśatasāhasraṃ yatpāpaṃ kṛtavān naraḥ / sakṛtsnānādvyapoheta pāpaughaṃ lavaṇāmbhasi
anyathā hi kuruśreṣṭha devayonirasau vibhuḥ / kuśāgreṇāpi vibudhairna spraṣṭavyo mahārṇavaḥ
sarvaratnapradhānastvaṃ sarvaratnākarākara / sarvāmarapradhāneśa gṛhāṇārghaṃ namo 'stu te / iti arvamantra
pitṛdevamanuṣyāṃśca saṃtarpya tadanantaram / uttīrya tīre tasyaiva pañcabhir dvijapuṃgavaiḥ
śrāddhaṃ samācaret paścāllokapālānurūpibhiḥ / kṛtvāgre lokapālāṃstu pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi
sampūjya ca yathānyāyaṃ tāneva brāhmaṇaiḥ saha / sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ paścāt tebhyaḥ sarvaṃ nivedayet
bālyātprabhṛti yatpāpaṃ kṛtaṃ vārdhakayauvane / prakhyāpayitvā tebhyo'gre lokapālān nimantrayet
bālyātprabhṛti yatkiṃcitkṛtam ā janmato 'śubham / viprebhyaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tatsāṃnidhyaṃ sthiteṣu me
ityuktvā sa luṭhetpaścāttebhyo 'greṇa ca sammukham / anumānya ca tānpañca paścāt snānaṃ samācaret
śrāddhaṃ ca kāryaṃ vidhivatpitṛbhyo nṛpasattama / evaṃ kṛte nṛpaśreṣṭha sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet
jijñāsārthaṃ tu yaḥ kaścidātmānaṃ jñātum icchati / śubhāśubhaṃ ca yatkarma tasya niṣṭhāmimāṃ śṛṇu
snātvā tatra mahātīrthe luṭhamāno vrajennaraḥ / pāpakarmānyato yāti dharmakarmā vrajen nadīm
pāpakarmā tato jñātvā pāpaṃ me pūrvasaṃcitam / snātvā tīrthavare tasmindānaṃ dadyād yathāvidhi
loṭaṇeśvaram abhyarcya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate / avakragamanaṃ gatvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena jñātvaivaṃ nṛpasattama / snātavyaṃ mānavaistatra yatra saṃnihito haraḥ
evaṃ snātvā vidhānena brāhmaṇān vedapāragān / pūjayetpṛthivīpāla sarvapāpopaśāntaye
evaṃ guṇaviśiṣṭaṃ hi tattīrthaṃ nṛpasattama / tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa
tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ / śrāddhaṃ yaḥ kurute tatra pitḥṇāṃ bhaktibhāvitaḥ
dānaṃ dadāti viprebhyo gobhūtilahiraṇyakam / ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi koṭirvarṣaśatāni ca
vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ svargaloke mahīyate / narmadāsarvatīrthebhyaḥ snāne dāne ca yatphalam
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti revāsāgarasaṅgame / suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ maṇimauktikabhūṣaṇam
govṛṣaṃ ca mahīṃ dhānyaṃ tatra dattvākṣayaṃ phalam / śubhasyāpyaśubhasyāpi tatra tīrthe na saṃśayaḥ
tatra tīrthe naraḥ kaścit prāṇatyāgaṃ yudhiṣṭhira / karoti bhaktyā vidhivattasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
koṭivarṣaṃ tu varṣāṇāṃ krīḍitvā śivamandire / vedavedāṅgavidvipro jāyate vimale kule
putrapautrasamṛddho 'sau dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ / sarvavyādhivinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃśatam
api dvādaśayātrāsu somanāthe yadarcite / kārttikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge tatpuṇyaṃ loṭaṇeśvare
gayā gaṅgā kurukṣetre naimiṣe puṣkare tathā / tatpuṇyaṃ labhate pārtha loṭaṇeśvaradarśanāt
yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā paṭhyamānam idaṃ śubham / sarvapāpavinirmukto rudralokaṃ sa gacchati

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe loṭaṇeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 221 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra revāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe / krośadvayāntare tīrthaṃ matṛtīrthād anuttamam
nāmnā haṃseśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ vaimanasyavināśanam / kaśyapasya kule jāto haṃso dākṣāyaṇīsutaḥ
brahmaṇo vāhanaṃ jātaḥ purā taptvā tapo mahat / saikadā vidhinirdeśaṃ vinā vaiyagryamāsthitaḥ
abhibhūtaḥ śivagaṇaiḥ praṇanāśa yudhiṣṭhira / dakṣayajñapramathane kāṃdiśīko vidhiṃ vinā
brahmaṇā saṃsṛto 'pyāśu nāyāti sa yadā khagaḥ / tadā taṃ śaptavānbrahmā pātayāmāsa vai padāt
tataḥ sa śaptamātmānaṃ matvā haṃsastvarānvitaḥ / pitāmahamupāgamya praṇipatyedam abravīt
haṃsa uvāca: tiryagyonisamutpannaṃ bhavāñchaptuṃ na cārhati / svabhāva eva tiryakṣu vivekavikalaṃ manaḥ
tathāpi deva pāpo 'smi yadahaṃ svāminaṃ tyaje / kiṃ tu dhāvadbhir atyugrairgaṇaiḥ śārvaiḥ pitāmaha / sahasāhaṃ bhayākrāntastrastastyaktvā palāyitaḥ
adyāpi bhayamevāhaṃ paśyannasmi vibho puraḥ / tena smṛto 'pi bhavatā nāvrajaṃ bhavadantike
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: iti bruvanneva hi dhāturagre haṃsaḥ śvasatyakṣipūjyaḥ sudīnaḥ / tiryañcaṃ māṃ pāpinaṃ mūḍhabuddhiṃ prabho puraḥ patitaṃ pāhi pāhi
eko devastvaṃ hi sargasya kartā nānāvidhaṃ sṛṣṭametattvayaiva / ahaṃ sṛṣṭastvīdṛśo yattvayā vai so 'yaṃ doṣo dhātar addhā tavaiva
śāpasya vānugrahasyāpi śaktastvatto nānyaḥ śaraṇaṃ kaṃ vrajāmi / sevādharmādvicyutaṃ dāsabhūtaṃ capeṭairhantavyaṃ vai tāta māṃ trāhi bhaktam
vidyāvidye tvatta evāvirāstāṃ dharmādharmau sadasad dyurniśe ca / nānābhāvāñjagatastvaṃ vidhatses taṃ tvāmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vai prapadye
eko 'si bahurūpo 'si nānācitraikakarmataḥ / niṣkarmākhilakarmāsi tvāmataḥ śaraṇaṃ vraje
namonamo vareṇyāya varadāya namonamaḥ / namo dhātre vidhātre ca śaraṇyāya namonamaḥ
śikṣākṣaraviyukteyaṃ vāṇī me stauti kiṃ vibho / kā śaktiḥ kiṃ parijñānamidamuktaṃ kṣamasva me
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: evaṃ vadati haṃse vai brahmā prāha prasannadhīḥ / śikṣā dattā tavaiveyaṃ mā viṣādaṃ kṛthāḥ khaga
tapasā śodhayātmānaṃ yathā śāpāntamāpnuyāḥ / revāsevāṃ kuru snātvā sthāpayitvā maheśvaram / acireṇaiva kālena tataḥ saṃsthānamāpsyasi
yacceṣṭvā bahubhir yajñaiḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ / gosvarṇakoṭidānaiśca tatphalaṃ sthāpite śive
brahmaghno vā surāpo vā svarṇahṛd gurutalpagaḥ / revātīre śivaṃ sthāpya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
tasmādbhargasarittīre sthāpayitvā triyambakam / viyuktaḥ sarvadoṣaistvaṃ yāsyase padamuttamam
evamuktaḥ sa vidhinā hṛṣṭatuṣṭaḥ khagottamaḥ / tathetyuktvā jagāmāśu narmadātīramuttamam
tapastaptvā kiyatkālaṃ sthāpayāmāsa śaṅkaram
svanāmnā bharataśreṣṭha haṃseśvaramanuttamam / pūjayitvā paraṃ sthānaṃ prāptavānkhagasattamaḥ
tatra haṃseśvare tīrthe gatvā snātvā yudhiṣṭhira / pūjayetparameśānaṃ sa pāpaiḥ parimucyate
stuvannekamanā devaṃ na dainyaṃ prāpnuyāt kvacit / śrāddhaṃ dīpapradānaṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam / dattvā śaktyā nṛpaśreṣṭha svargaloke mahīyate
trikālam ekakālaṃ vā yo bhaktyā pūjayecchivam / navaprasūtāṃ dhenuṃ ca dattvā pārtha dvijottame / ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe haṃseśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśadadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 222 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tataḥ krośāntare gacchettilādaṃ tīrthamuttamam / tilaprāśanakṛdyatra jābāliḥ śuddhimāptavān
pitṛmātṛparityāgī bhrāturbhāryābhilāṣakṛt / putravikrayakṛtpāpaśchalakṛdguruṇā saha
evaṃ doṣasamāviṣṭo yatra yatrāpi gacchati / tatra tatrāpi dhikkāraṃ labhate satsu bhārata / na ko'pi saṃgatiṃ dhatte tena sārddhaṃ sabhāsvapi
iti lajjānvito vipraḥ kāle na mahatā nṛpa / cintāmavāpa mahatīm agatijño hi pāvane
cakāra sarvatīrthāni revāṃ cāpyavagāhayat
aṇivāpāntam āsādya dakṣiṇe narmadātaṭe / tasthau yatra vratī pārtha jābāliḥ prāśayaṃstilān
tilairekāśanaṃ kurvaṃs tathaivaikāntarāśanam / tryahaṣaḍdvādaśāhāśī pakṣamāsāśanastathā
kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādīni vratāni ca tilairapi / tilādatvamanuprāpto hyabdadvāsaptatiṃ kramāt
kālena gacchatā tasya prasanno 'bhavadīśvaraḥ / prādād ihāmutrikīṃ tu śuddhiṃ sālokyamātmakam
tena sa sthāpito devaḥ svanāmnā bharatarṣabha / tilādeśvarasaṃjñāṃ ca prāpa lokādapi prabhuḥ
tadā prabhṛti vikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam / tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca
upavāsaparaḥ pārtha tathaiva harivāsare / tilahomī tilodvartī tilasnāyī tilodakī
tiladātā ca bhoktā ca nānāpāpaiḥ pramucyate / tilairāpūrayelliṅgaṃ tilatailena dīpadaḥ / rudralokam avāpnoti punāty ā saptamaṃ kulam
tilapiṇḍapradānena śrāddhe nṛpatisattama / vikarmasthāśca gacchanti gatimiṣṭāṃ hi pūrvajāḥ
svargalokasthitāḥ śrāddhair brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanaiḥ / akṣayāṃ tṛptimāsādya modante śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
pituḥ kulaṃ mātṛkulaṃ tathā bhāryākulaṃ nṛpa / kulatrayaṃ samuddhṛtya svargaṃ nayati vai naraḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tilādeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśadadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 223 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tataḥ krośāntare pārtha vāsavaṃ tīrthamuttamam / vasubhiḥ sthāpitaṃ tatra sthitvā vai dvādaśābdakam
dharo dhruvaśca somaśca āpaścaivānilo 'nalaḥ / pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo 'ṣṭāvime purā
pitṛśāpaparikliṣṭā garbhavāsāya bhārata / nārmadaṃ tīrthamāsādya tapaścakruryatendriyāḥ
ārādhayantaḥ paramaṃ bhavānīpatim avyam / dvādaśābdāni rājendra tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ
pratyakṣaḥ pradadau tebhyastvabhīṣṭaṃ varamuttamam / tataḥ svanāmnā saṃsthāpya vasavastaṃ maheśvaram / jagmurākāśamāviśya prasanne sati śaṅkare
tataḥ prabhṛti vikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ tadvāsavāhvayam / tasmiṃstīrthe mahārāja yo bhaktyā pūjayecchivam / yathālabdhopahāraiśca dīpaṃ dadyāt prayatnataḥ
śuklapakṣe tadāṣṭamyāṃ pratyahaṃ vāpi śaktitaḥ / aṣṭau varṣasahasrāṇi sa vasecchivasaṃnidhau
tataḥ śivālayaṃ yāti garbhavāsaṃ na paśyati / puṣpairvā pallavairvāpi phalairdhānyais tathāpi vā
pūjayeddevamīśānaṃ sa dainyaṃ nāpnuyāt kvacit / sarvaśokavinirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate
ekāhamapi kaunteya yo vasedvāsaveśvare / pāparāśiṃ vinirdhūya bhānuvaddivi modate
viprāṃśca bhojayedbhaktyā dadyād vāsāṃsi dakṣiṇām

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vāsaveśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 224 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tataḥ krośāntare pārtha tīrthaṃ koṭīśvaraṃ param / yatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca japahomārcanādikam / bhaktyā kṛtaṃ naraistatra sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet
tatra devāḥ sagandharvā ṛṣayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ / jaladhiṃ pratigacchanti narmadāṃ vīkṣituṃ kila
militāḥ koṭiśo rājanrevāsāgarasaṅgame / vinodamatulaṃ dṛṣṭvā revārṇavasamāgame
snātvā śivaṃ ca saṃsthāpya pūjayitvā maheśvaram / koṭīśvarābhidhānaṃ tu svasvabhaktyā vidhānataḥ
koṭītīrthe parāṃ siddhiṃ samprāptāḥ sarvatoṣaṇāt / tena tatpuṇyamatulaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu cottamam
tatra tīrthe tu yatkiṃcicchubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham / kriyate nṛpaśārdūla sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet
tatra tīrthe tu mārgasthā ye kecidṛṣisattamāḥ / siddhāmṛtapadaṃ yānti pitṛlokaṃ tathottamam
uttare narmadātīre dakṣiṇe cāśritāśca ye / devalokaṃ gatās tatra iti me niścitā matiḥ
bilvārkapuṣpair dhattūrakuśakāśaprasūnakaiḥ / ṛtūdbhavaistathānyaiśca pūjayitvā maheśvaram
nānopacārair vidhivan mantrapūrvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira / dhūpadīpārdhanaivedyaistoṣayitvā ca dhūrjaṭim
śivalokamavāpnoti yāvadindrāścaturdaśa / pauṣakṛṣṇāṣṭamīyoge viśeṣaḥ pūjane smṛtaḥ
nityaṃ ca nṛpatiśreṣṭha caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca / śivamabhyarcya viprāṃśca bhojayed bhaktito varān

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe koṭīśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 225 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tataḥ krośāntare gacched alikātīrthamuttamam / alikā nāma gāndharvī kuśīlā kuṭilāśayā
citrasenasya dauhitrī vidyānandamṛṣiṃ gatā / vavre te svīkṛtā tena daśavarṣāṇi taṃ śritā
patiṃ jaghāna taṃ suptaṃ kasmiṃścit kāraṇāntare / gatvā nivedayāmāsa pitaraṃ ratnavallabham
pitrā mātrā ca saṃtyaktā bahubhirbhartsitā nṛpa / garbhaghnī tvaṃ patighnī tvamiti darśaya mā mukham
brahmaghnī yāhi pāpiṣṭhe parityaktā gṛhādvraja
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: iti duḥkhānvitā mūḍhā tābhyāṃ nirbhartsitā satī / tanuṃ tyaktuṃ manaścakre prāpya tīrthāntaraṃ kvacit
saṃpṛcchyamānā tīrthāni brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira / śrutvā pāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ revāsāgarasaṅgame
tatra pārtha tapaścakre nirāhārā jitavratā / kṛcchrātikṛcchrapārākamahāsāṃtapanādibhiḥ
cāndrāyaṇairbrahmakūrcaiḥ karśayāmāsa vai tanum / evaṃ varṣaśataṃ sārddhaṃ vyatītaṃ tapasā nṛpa
tasyā viśuddhim icchantyāḥ śivadhyānārcanādibhiḥ / tataḥ katipayāhobhis tasyā jñātvā haṭhaṃ param / parituṣṭaḥ śivaḥ prāha pārvatyā paricoditaḥ
īśvara uvāca: putri mā sāhasaṃ kārṣīḥ śuddhadehāsi sāmpratam / tuṣṭo 'haṃ tapasā te 'dya varaṃ varaya vāñchitam
alikovāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si deveśa varārhā yadyahaṃ matā / nānāpāpāgnitaptāyā dehi śuddhiṃ parāṃ mama
tvaṃ me nātho hyanāthāyāstvameva jagatāṃ guruḥ / dīnānāthasamuddhartā śaraṇyaḥ sarvadehinām
īśvara uvāca: tvaṃ bhadre śuddhadehāsi mā kiṃcid anuśocithāḥ / svanāmnā sthāpayitveha māṃ tataḥ svargameṣyasi
ityuktvā devadeveśastatraivāntaradhīyata / alikāpi tato bhaktyā snātvā saṃsthāpya śaṅkaram
dattvā dānaṃ ca viprebhyo lokamāpa mahotkaṭam / pitaraṃ ca samāsādya mātaraṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira
taiśca saṃmānitā prītyā bandhubhiḥ sālikā tataḥ / vimānavaramārūḍhā divyamālānvitā nṛpa
gaurīlokamanuprāptasakhitve 'dyāpi modate / tataḥ prabhṛti tatpārtha vikhyātam alikeśvaram
tatra tīrthe tu yā nārī puruṣo vā yudhiṣṭhira / snātvā sampūjayedbhaktyā mahādevamumāyutam
sa pāpairvividhairmukto lokamāpnoti śāṃkaram / mānasaṃ vācikaṃ pāpaṃ kāyikaṃ yatpurā kṛtam
sarvaṃ tadvilayaṃ yāti bhojayitvā dvijānsadā / dīpaṃ dattvā ca devāgre na rogaiḥ paribhūyate
dhūpapātraṃ vimānaṃ ca ghaṇṭāṃ kalaśameva ca / dattvā devāya rājendra śākraṃ lokamavāpnuyāt

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe revāsāgarasaṅgame 'likeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 226 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tataḥ krośāntare puṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ tadvimaleśvaram / yatra snānena dānena japahomārcanādibhiḥ
vimaleśvaramārādhya yo yadicchetsa tallabhet / svargalābhādikaṃ vāpi pārthivaṃ vā yathepsitam
purā triśirasaṃ hatvā tvaṣṭuḥ putraṃ śatakratuḥ / yasya tīrthasya māhātmyādvaimalyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ
yatra vedanidhirvipro mahattaptvā tapaḥ purā / nānākarmamalaiḥ kṣīṇair vimalo 'bhavad arkavat
mahādevaprasādena somavat priyadarśanaḥ / purā bhānumatīṃ bhānuḥ sutāṃ smaraśarārditaḥ
cakame tena doṣeṇa kuṣṭharogārdito 'bhavat / sa cāpyatra tapastaptvā vimalatvam upāgataḥ
mahādevena tuṣṭena svasthānaṃ mudito 'bhajat / tathaiva ca purā pārtha vibhāṇḍakasuto muniḥ
yogisaṅgaṃ vane prāpya pure ca nṛpates tathā / rājasaṃsargadoṣādvai mālinyaṃ paramātmanaḥ
vicārayannabhyupetya revāsāgarasaṅgamam / śāntayā bhāryayā sārddhaṃ taptvā dvādaśavatsarān
kṛcchracāndrāyaṇair devaṃ toṣayaṃstryambakaṃ muniḥ / mahādevena tuṣṭena so 'pi vaimalyamāptavān
śarvāṇyā preritaḥ śarvaḥ purā dāruvane nṛpa / mohanānmunipatnīnāṃ svaṃ dīkṣya vimalaṃ kila
vicārya paramasthānaṃ narmadodadhisaṅgamam / tatra sthitvā mahārāja tapastaptvā sahomayā
vimalo 'sau yato jātastenāsau vimaleśvaraḥ / tena nāmnā svayaṃ tasthau lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
tatastilottamāṃ sṛṣṭvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / prajānātho 'pi tāṃ sṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvāgre sumanoharām
bhāviyogabalākrāntaḥ sa tasyāmabhiko 'bhavat / tena vīkṣya sadoṣatvaṃ revātīradvayaṃ śritaḥ
tīrthānyanusaranmaunī trisnāyī saṃsmarañchivam / revārṇavasamāyoge snātvā sampūjya śaṅkaram / kālenālpena rājarṣe brahmāpyamalatāṃ gataḥ
evamanye 'pi bahuśo devarṣinṛpasattamāḥ / tyaktvā doṣamalaṃ tatra vimalā bahavo 'bhavan
tathā tvamapi rājendra tatra snātvā śivārcanāt / amalo 'pi viśeṣeṇa vaimalyaṃ prāpsyase param
tatra snātvā naro nārī pūjayitvā maheśvaram / pāpadoṣavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate
tatropavāsaṃ yaḥ kṛtvā paśyeta vimaleśvaram / aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ sarvaparvasu pārthiva
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ hitvā yāti śivālayam / śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena pitḥṇām anṛṇī bhavet / brāhmaṇān bhojayecchaktyā tebhyo dadyācca dakṣiṇām
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yaccaivātmahitaṃ gṛhe / tattadguṇavate deyaṃ tatraivākṣayamicchatā / svarṇadhānyāni vāsāṃsi chatropānatkamaṇḍalum
gṛhaṃ devasya vai śaktyā kṛtvā syād bhuvi bhūpatiḥ / gītanṛtyakathābhiśca toṣayet parameśvaram

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vimaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 227 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: etāni tava saṃkṣepāt prādhānyāt kathitāni ca / na śakto vistarād vaktuṃ saṃkhyāṃ tīrtheṣu pāṇḍava
eṣā pavitrā vimalā nadī trailokyaviśrutā / narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā mahādevasya vallabhā
manasā saṃsmared yastu narmadāṃ satataṃ nṛpa / cāndrāyaṇaśatasyāśu labhate phalamuttamam
aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā nāstikāścātra ye sthitāḥ / patanti narake ghore prāhaivaṃ parameśvaraḥ
narmadāṃ sevate nityaṃ svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ / tena puṇyā nadī jñeyā brahmahatyāpahāriṇī
iyaṃ māheśvarī gaṅgā maheśvaratanūdbhavā / proktā dakṣiṇagaṅgeti bhāratasya yudhiṣṭhira
jāhnavī vaiṣṇavī gaṅgā brāhmī gaṅgā sarasvatī / iyaṃ māheśvarī gaṅgā revā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ
yathā hi puruṣe devas traimūrtatvam upāśritaḥ / brahmaviṣṇumaheśākhyaṃ na bhedas tatra vai yathā / tathā sarittraye pārtha bhedaṃ manasi mā kṛthāḥ
koṭiśo hyatra tīrthāni lakṣaśaścāpi bhārata / tathā sahasraśo revātīradvayagatāni tu
vṛkṣāntarikṣasaṃsthāni jalasthalagatāni ca / kaḥ śaktastāni nirṇetuṃ vāgīśo vā maheśvaraḥ
smaraṇājjanmajanitaṃ darśanācca trijanmajam / saptajanmakṛtaṃ naśyet pāpaṃ revāvagāhanāt
devakāryaṃ kṛtaṃ tena agnayo vidhivaddhutāḥ / vedā adhītāścatvāro yena revāvagāhitā
prādhānyāccāpi saṃkṣepāt tīrthānyuktāni te mayā / na śakyo vistaraḥ pārtha śrotuṃ vaktuṃ ca vai mayā
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: vidhānaṃ ca yamāṃścaiva niyamāṃśca vadasva me / prāyaścittārthagamane ko vidhistaṃ vadasva me
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ mahārāja yacchreyaḥ pāralaukikam / śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā yathājñānaṃ vadāmi te
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa dhruvaṃ karma samācaret / avaśyameva yāsyanti prāṇāḥ prāghūrṇikā iva
dānaṃ vittādṛtaṃ vācaḥ kīrtidharmau tathā khyuṣaḥ / paropakaraṇaṃ kāyādasārātsāram uddharet
asminmahāmohamaye kaṭāhe sūryāgninā rātridivendhanena / māsartudarvīparighaṭṭanena bhūtāni kālaḥ pacatīti vārtā
jñātvā śāstravidhānoktaṃ karma kartum ihārhasi / nāyaṃ loko 'sti na paro na sukhaṃ saṃśayātmanaḥ
mantre tīrthe dvije deve daivajñe bheṣaje gurau / yādṛśī bhāvanā yasya siddhir bhavati tādṛśī
aśraddhayā hutaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat / asadityucyate pārtha na ca tatpretya no iha
yaḥ śāstravidhim utsṛjya vartate kāmakārataḥ / na sa siddhim avāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim
santīha vividhopāyā nṛṇāṃ dehaviśodhanāḥ / tīrthasevāsamaṃ nāsti svaśarīrasya śodhanam
kṛcchracāndrāyaṇād yair vā dvitīyaṃ tīrthasevayā / yadā tīrthaṃ samuddiśya prayāti puruṣo nṛpa / tadā devāśca pitaras taṃ vrajantyanu khecarāḥ
paramā modapūrṇāste prayānty asyānuyāyinaḥ / kṛtvābhyudayikaṃ śrāddhaṃ samāpṛcchaya tu devatām
iṣṭabandhūṃśca viṣṇuṃ ca śaṅkaraṃ sagaṇeśvaram / vrajeddvijābhyanujñāto gṛhītvā niyamānapi
ekāśanaṃ brahmacaryaṃ bhūśayyāṃ satyavāditām / varjanaṃ ca parānnasya pratigrahavivarjanam
varjayitvā tathā drohavañcanādi nṛpottama / sādhuveṣaṃ samāsthāya vinayena vibhūṣitaḥ
dambhāhaṅkāramukto yaḥ sa tīrthaphalamaśnute / yasya hastau ca pādau ca manaścaiva susaṃyatam
vidyā tapaśca kīrtiśca sa tīrthaphalamaśnute / akrodhanaśca rājendra satyaśīlo dṛḍhavrataḥ
ātmopamaśca bhūteṣu sa tīrthaphalamaśnute / muṇḍanaṃ copavāsaśca sarvatīrtheṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ
varjayitvā kurukṣetraṃ viśālāṃ virajāṃ gayām / snānaṃ surārcanaṃ caiva śrāddhe vai piṇḍapātanam
viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ śaktyā sarvatīrtheṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ / prāyaścittanimittaṃ ca yo vrajedyatamānasaḥ
tasyāpi ca vidhiṃ vakṣye śṛṇu pārtha samāhitaḥ / ekāśanaṃ brahmacaryamakṣāralavaṇāśanam
snātvā tīrthābhigamanaṃ haviṣyaikānnabhojanam / varjayet patitālāpaṃ bahubhāṣaṇameva ca
parīvādaṃ parānnaṃ ca nīcasaṅgaṃ vivarjayet / vrajecca nirupānatko vasāno vāsasī śuciḥ
saṃkalpaṃ manasā kṛtvā brāhmaṇānujñayā vrajet / tīrthe gatvā tathā snātvā kṛtvā caiva surārcanam
duṣkarmato vimuktaḥ syād anutāpī bhaved yadi / vede tīrthe ca deve ca daivajñe cauṣadhe gurau
yādṛśī bhāvanā yasya siddhir bhavati tādṛśī / uktatīrthaphalānāṃ ca purāṇeṣu smṛtiṣvapi
arthavādabhavāṃ śaṅkāṃ vihāya bharatarṣabha / kṛtvā vicāraṃ śāstroktaṃ parikalpya yathocitam
kāyena kṛcchracaraṇe hyaśaktānāṃ viśuddhaye / jñātvā tīrthāviśeṣaṃ hi prāyaścittaṃ samācaret
tacchṛṇuṣva mahārāja narmadāyāṃ yathocitam / caturviṃśatisaṃkhyebhyo yojanebhyo vrajennaraḥ
caturviṃśatikṛcchrāṇāṃ phalamāpnoti śobhanam / ata ūrdhvaṃ yojaneṣu pādakṛcchram udāhṛtaḥ
tanmadhye ca mahārāja yo vrajecchuddhikāṅkṣayā / yojane yojane tasya prāyaścittaṃ vidurbudhāḥ
praṇavākhye mahārāja tathā revorisaṃgame / bhṛgukṣetre tathā gatvā phalaṃ taddviguṇaṃ smṛtam
saṅgame devanadyāśca śūlabhede nṛpottama / dviguṇaṃ pādahīnaṃ syāt karajāsaṃgame tathā
eraṇḍīsaṅgame tadvat kapilāyāśca saṃgame / kecit triguṇitaṃ prāhuḥ kubjārevotthasaṅgame
oṃkāre ca mahārāja tadapi syāt samañjasam / saṅgameṣu tathānyāsāṃ nadīnāṃ revayā saha
prāhuste sārdhakṛcchraṃ vai phalaṃ pūrvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira / triguṇaṃ kṛcchram āpnoti revāsāgarasaṅgame
kṛcchraṃ caturguṇaṃ proktaṃ śuklatīrthe yudhiṣṭhira / yojane yojane gatvā caturviṃśatiyojanam / tatra tatra vasedyastu suciraṃ nṛvarottama
revāsevāsamācāraḥ saṃyuktaḥ śuddhabuddhimān / dambhāhaṅkārarahitaḥ śuddhyarthaṃ sa vimucyate
iti te kathitaṃ pārtha prāyaścittārthalakṣaṇam / revāyātrāvidhānaṃ ca guhyametad yudhiṣṭhira
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: yojanasya pramāṇaṃ me vada tvaṃ munisattama / yajjñātvā niścitaṃ me syān manaḥśuddhestu kāraṇam
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu pāṇḍava vakṣyāmi pramāṇaṃ yojanasya yat / tathā yātrāviśeṣeṇa viśeṣaṃ kṛcchrasambhavam
tiryagyavodarāṇyaṣṭāvūrdhvā vā vrīhayastrayaḥ / pramāṇamaṅgulasyāhurvitastir dvādaśāṃgulā
vitastidvitayaṃ hastaścaturhastaṃ dhanuḥ smṛtam / sa eva daṇḍo gadito viśeṣajñair yudhiṣṭhira
dhanuḥsahasre dve krośaś catuḥkrośaṃ ca yojanam / etadyojanamānaṃ te kathitaṃ bharatarṣabha
yena yātrāṃ vrajan vetti phalamānaṃ nijārjitam / uktaṃ kṛcchraphalaṃ tīrthe jalarūpe nṛpottama
yathāviśeṣaṃ te vacmi pūrvokte tatra tatra ca / tanme śṛṇu mahīpāla śraddadhānāya kathyate
yasmiṃstīrthe hi yatproktaṃ phalaṃ kṛcchrādikaṃ nṛpa / tatrāpyupoṣaṇāt kṛcchraphalaṃ prāpnotyathādhikam
dinajāpyācca labhate phalaṃ kṛcchrasya śaktitaḥ / tatra vikhyātadeveśaṃ snātvā dṛṣṭvābhipūjya ca
praṇamya labhate pārtha phalaṃ kṛcchrabhavaṃ sudhīḥ / tīrthe mukhyaphalaṃ snānād dvitīyaṃ cāpyupoṣaṇāt
tṛtīyaṃ khyātadevasya darśanābhyarcanādibhiḥ / caturthaṃ jāpyayogena dehaśaktyā tvaharniśam
pañcamaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu kalpanīyaṃ hi dūrataḥ / tīrastho yojanādarvāgdaśāṃśaṃ labhate phalam
uktatīrthaphalātpārtha nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
upavāsena sahitaṃ mahānadyāṃ hi majjanam / apyarvāgyojanātpārtha dadyātkṛcchraphalaṃ nṛṇām
ṣaḍyojanavahā kulya nadyo 'lpā dvādaśaiva ca / caturviṃśatigā nadyo mahānadyas tato 'dhikāḥ

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tīrthayātrādividhānaviśeṣakathanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 228 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: parārthaṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ gacchataḥ kasya kiṃ phalam / kiyanmātraṃ muniśreṣṭha tanme brūhi kṛpānidhe
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: parārthaṃ gacchatastanme vadataḥ śṛṇu pārthiva / yathā yāvatphalaṃ tasya yātrādivihitaṃ bhavet
uttameneha varṇena dravyalobhādinā nṛpa / nādhamasya kvacit kāryaṃ tīrthayātrādisevanam
dharmakarma mahārāja svayaṃ vidvānsamācaret / śarīrasyāthavā śaktyā anyadvā kāryayogataḥ
dharmakarma sadā prāyaḥ savarṇenaiva kārayet / putrapautrādikairvāpi jñātibhir gotrasambhavaiḥ
śreṣṭhaṃ hi vihitaṃ prāhurdharmakarma yudhiṣṭhira / taireva kārayettasmānnottamairnādhamairapi
adhamena kṛtaṃ samyaṅ na bhavediti me matiḥ / uttamaścādhamārthe vai kurvandurgatimāpnuyāt
na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyānnocchiṣṭaṃ na haviṣkṛtam / na cāsyopadiśeddharmaṃ na cāsya vratamādiśet
japastapastīrthayātrā pravrajyā mantrasādhanam / devatārādhanaṃ dīkṣā strīśūdrapatanāni ṣaṭ
pativatnī patatyeva vidhavā sarvamācaret / sabhartṛkāśake patyau sarvaṃ kuryād anujñayā
gatvā parārthaṃ tīrthādau ṣoḍaśāṃśaphalaṃ labhet / gacchataśca prasaṅgena tīrthamarddhaphalaṃ smṛtam
anusaṅgena tīrthasya snāne snānaphalaṃ viduḥ / naiva yātrāphalaṃ tajjñāḥ śāstroktaṃ kalmaṣāpaham
pitrarthaṃ ca pitṛvyasya māturmātāmahasya ca / mātulasya tathā bhrātuḥ śvaśurasya sutasya ca
poṣakārthādayoścāpi mātāmahyā gurostathā / svasurmātṛṣvasuḥ paitryā ācāryādhyāpakasya ca
ityādyarthe naraḥ snātvā svayamaṣṭāṃśamāpnuyāt / sākṣātpitroḥ prakurvāṇaścaturthāṃśamavāpnuyāt
patipatnyormithaścārddhaṃ phalaṃ prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ / bhāgineyasya śiṣyasya bhrātṛvyasya sutasya ca / ṣaṭtripañcacaturbhāgānphalamāpnoti vai naraḥ
iti te kathitaṃ pārtha pāramparyakramāgatam / kartavyaṃ jñātivargasya parārthe dharmasādhanam
varṣāṛtusamāyoge sarvā nadyo rajasvalāḥ / muktvā sarasvatīṃ gaṅgāṃ narmadāṃ yamunānadīm

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe parārthatīrthayātrāphalakathanaṃ nāmāṣṭaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 229 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: evaṃ te kathitaṃ rājanpurāṇaṃ dharmasaṃhitam / śivaprītyā yathā proktaṃ vāyunā devasaṃsadi
ṣaṣṭitīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭistathaiva ca / ādimadhyāvasāneṣu narmadāyāṃ pade pade
mayā dvādaśasāhasrī saṃhitā yā śrutā purā / devadevasya gadataḥ sāmprataṃ kathitā tava
pṛṣṭastvayāhaṃ bhūpāla parvate 'marakaṇṭake / sthitaḥ saṃkṣepataḥ sarvaṃ mayā tatkathitaṃ tava
narmadācaritaṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇu tasyāsti yatphalam / yatphalaṃ sarvavedaiḥ syāt saṣaḍaṅgapadakramaiḥ
paṭhitaiśca śrutair vāpi tasmād bahutaraṃ bhavet / satrayājī phalaṃ yatra labhate dvādaśābdikam
carite tu śrute devyā labhate tādṛśaṃ phalam / sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ snātvā sāgaramāditaḥ
sakṛtsnātvā tathā śrutvā narmadāyāṃ phalaṃ hi tat / ādimadhyāvasānena narmadācaritaṃ śubham
yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu / sa prāpya śivasaṃsthānaṃ rudrakanyāsamāvṛtaḥ
rudrasyānucaro bhūtvā tenaiva saha modate / etad dharmamupākhyānaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu sattamam
deśe vā maṇḍale vāpi vā grāme nagare 'pi vā / gṛhe vā tiṣṭhate yasya cāturvarṇyasya bhārata
sa brahmā sa śivaḥ sākṣātsa ca devo janārdanaḥ / trividhaṃ kāraṇaṃ loke dharmapanthānamuttamam
devatānāṃ guruṃ śāstraṃ paramaṃ siddhikāraṇam / śrutveśvaramukhātpārtha mayāpi tava kīrtitam
dakṣiṇe cottare kūle yāni tīrthāni kānicit / pradhānataḥ supuṇyāni kathitāni viśeṣataḥ
sparśanād darśanāt teṣāṃ kīrtanācchravaṇāt tathā / mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
idaṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ purāṇaṃ śivabhāṣitam / brāhmaṇo vedavidyāvān kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet
dhanabhāgī bhaved vaiśyaḥ śūdro vai dharmabhāgbhavet / saubhāgyaṃ santatiṃ svargaṃ nārī śrutvāpnuyāddhanam
brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ / māhātmyaṃ narmadāyāstu śrutvā pāpabahiṣkṛtāḥ
pāpabhedī kṛtaghnaśca svāmiviśvāsaghātakaḥ / goghnaśca garadaścaiva kanyāvikrayakārakaḥ
ete śrutvaiva pāpebhyo mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ / ye punarbhāvitātmānaḥ śṛṇvanti satataṃ nṛpa
pūjayanta idaṃ devāḥ pūjitā guravaśca taiḥ / narmadā pūjitā tena bhagavāṃśca maheśvaraḥ
tasmātsarvaprayatnena gandhapuṣpavibhūṣaṇaiḥ / pūjitaṃ parayā bhaktyā śāstrametatphalapradam
lekhāpayitvā sakalaṃ narmadācaritaṃ śubham / uttamaṃ sarvaśāstrebhyo yo dadāti dvijanmane
narmadāsarvatīrtheṣu snāne dāne ca yatphalam / tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti sa naro nātra saṃśayaḥ
etatpurāṇaṃ rudroktaṃ mahāpuṇyaphalapradam / svargadaṃ putradaṃ dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ kīrtivardhanam
sarvapāpaharaṃ pārtha duḥkhaduḥsvapnanāśanam / paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ rājan sarvakāmārthasiddhidam
śāntirastu śivaṃ cāstu lokāḥ santu nirāmayāḥ / gobrāhmaṇebhyaḥ svastyastu dharmaṃ dharmātmajāśrayaḥ
narakāntakarī revā satīrthā viśvapāvanī / narmadā dharmadā cāstu śarmadā pārtha te sadā

|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde revākhaṇḍapaṭhanaśravaṇadānādiphalaśrutivarṇanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 230 sūta uvāca: ityuktvopararāmatha pāṇḍoḥ putrāya vai muniḥ / mṛkaṇḍatanayo dhīmānsaptakalpasmaraḥ puraḥ
mārkaṇḍamuninā proktaṃ yathā pārthāya sattamāḥ / tathā vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ revāmāhātmyamuttamam
iyaṃ puṇyā saricchreṣṭhā revā viśvaikapāvanī / rudradehasamudbhūtā sarvabhūtābhayapradā
oṅkārajaladhiṃ yāvad uvāca bhṛgunandanaḥ / tīrthasaṅgamabhedānvai dharmaputrāya pṛcchate
samāsenaiva munayastathāhaṃ kathayāmi vaḥ / saptaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyastathaiva ca
kathaṃ kenātra śakyante vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi / tathāpyatra muniśreṣṭhāḥ proktaṃ pārthāya vai yathā
tīrthamoṃkāramārabhya vakṣye tīrthāvaliṃ śubhām / procyamānāṃ samāsena tāṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ maharṣayaḥ
natvā somaṃ maheśānaṃ natvā brahmācyutāvubhau / sarasvatīṃ gaṇeśānaṃ devyāsāṅghripañkajam
pūrvācāryāṃs tathā sarvāndṛṣṭvādṛṣṭārthavedinaḥ / praṇamya narmadāṃ devīṃ vakṣye tīrthāvaliṃ tvimām
oṃ namo viśvarūpāya oṅkārāyākhilātmane / yamārabhye pravakṣyāmi revātīrthāvaliṃ dvijāḥ
asmin mārkaṇḍagadite revātīrthakrame śubhe / purāṇasaṃhitādhyāyā mārkaṇḍāśramavarṇanam
tataḥ praśnādhikāraśca praśaṃsā narmadodbhavā / tathā pañcadaśānāṃ ca pravāhānāṃ prakīrtanam
nāmanirvacanaṃ tadvattathā kalpasamudbhavāḥ / ekaviṃśatikalpānāṃ tadvannāmānukīrtanam
mārkaṇḍeyānubhūtānāṃ saptānāṃ lakṣaṇāni ca / māhātmyaṃ caiva revāyāḥ śivaviṣṇvos tathaiva ca
saṃhāralakṣaṇaṃ tadvad oṅkārasya ca sambhavaḥ / tathaivauṃkāramāhātmyam amarakaṇṭakīrtanam
amareśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathā dāruvanaṃ mahat / dārukeśvaratīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ vai carukeśvaram
carukāsaṅgamas tadvyadvatīpāteśvaraṃ tathā / pātāleśvaratīrthaṃ ca koṭiyajñāhvayaṃ tathā
varuṇeśvaratīrthaṃ ca liṅgānyaṣṭottaraṃ śatam / siddheśvaraṃ yameśaṃ ca brahmeśvaramataḥ param
sārasvataṃ cāṣṭarudraṃ sāvitraṃ somasaṃjñitam / śivakhātaṃ mahātīrthaṃ rudrāvartaṃ dvijottamāḥ
brahmāvartaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ sūryāvartamataḥ param / pippalāvartatīrthaṃ ca pippalyāścaiva saṅgamaḥ
amarakaṇṭamāhātmyaṃ kapilāsaṅgamas tathā / viśalyāsambhavaścāpi bhṛgutuṅgādrikīrtanam
viśalyāsaṅgamaḥ puṇyaḥ karamardāsamāgamaḥ / karamardeśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ cakratīrthamanuttamam
saṅgamo nīlagaṅgāyāḥ vidhvaṃsastripurasya ca / kīrtanaṃ tīrthadānānāṃ madhukatṛtīyāvratam
apsareśvaratīrthaṃ ca dehakṣepe vidhistataḥ / tīrthaṃ jvāleśvaraṃ nāma jvālāyāḥ saṅgamastathā
śakratīrthaṃ kuśāvartaṃ haṃsatīrthaṃ tathaiva ca / ambarīṣasya tīrthaṃ ca mahākāleśvaraṃ tathā
mātṛkeśvaratīrthaṃ ca bhṛgutuṅgānuvarṇanam / tatra bhairavamāhātmyaṃ capaleśvarakīrtanam
caṇḍapāṇeśca māhātmyaṃ kāverīsaṅgamastathā / kubereśvaratīrthaṃ ca vārāhīsaṅgamas tathā
saṅgamaścaṇḍavegāyāstīrthaṃ caṇḍeśvaraṃ tathā / eraṇḍīsaṅgamaḥ puṇya eraṇḍeśvaramuttamam
pitṛtīrthaṃ ca tatraiva oṅkārasya ca sambhavam / māhātmyaṃ pañcaliṅgānām oṅkārasya munīśvarāḥ
koṭitīrthasya māhātmyaṃ tīrthaṃ kākahradaṃ tathā / jambukeśvaratīrthaṃ ca sārasvatam ataḥ param
kapilāsaṅgamastadvattīrthaṃ ca kapileśvaram / daityasūdanatīrthaṃ ca cakratīrthaṃ ca vāmanam
tīrthalakṣaṃ viduḥ pūrve kapilāyāstu saṅgame / svargasya narakasyāpi lakṣaṇaṃ munibhāṣitam
vyavasthānaṃ śarīrasya gopradānānuvarṇanam / aśokavanikātīrthaṃ mataṅgāśramavarṇanam
aśokeśvaratīrthaṃ ca mataṅgeśvaramuttamam / tathā mṛgavanaṃ puṇyaṃ tatra tīrthaṃ manoratham
saṅgamo 'ṅgāragartāyā aṅgāreśvaramuttamam / tathā meghavanaṃ tīrthaṃ devyā nāmānukīrtanam
saṅgamaścāpi kubjāyāstīrthaṃ kubjeśvaraṃ tathā / bilvāmrakaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ pūrṇadvīpamataḥ param
tathā hiraṇyagarbhāyāḥ saṅgamaḥ puṇyakīrtanaḥ / dvīpeśvaraṃ nāma tīrthaṃ puṇyaṃ yajñeśvaraṃ tathā
māṇḍavyāśramatīrthaṃ ca viśokāsaṅgamastathā / vāgīśvaraṃ nāma tīrthaṃ puṇyo vai vāgusaṅgamaḥ
sahasrāvartakaṃ tatra tīrthaṃ saugandhikaṃ tathā / saṅgamaśca sarasvatyā īśānaṃ tīrthamuttamam
devatātrayatīrthaṃ ca śūlakhātaṃ tataḥ param / brahmodaṃ śāṅkaraṃ saumyaṃ sārasvatamataḥ param
sahasrayajñatīrthaṃ ca kapālamocanaṃ tathā / āgneyam aditīśaṃ ca vārāhaṃ tīrthamuttamam
tathā devapathaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ yajñasahasrakam / śuklatīrthaṃ dīptikeśaṃ viṣṇutīrthaṃ ca yodhanam
narmadeśvaratīrthaṃ ca varuṇeśaṃ ca mārutam / yogeśaṃ rohiṇītīrthaṃ dārutīrthaṃ ca sattamāḥ
brahmāvartaṃ ca pattreśaṃ vāhnaṃ sauraṃ ca kīrtyate / meghanādaṃ dārutīrthaṃ devatīrthaṃ guhāśrayam
narmadeśvarasaṃjñaṃ tatkapilātīrthamuttamam / karañjeśaṃ kuṇḍaleśaṃ pippalādamataḥ param
vimaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca puṣkariṇyāśca saṅgamaḥ / praśaṃsā śūlabhedasya tatraivāndhakavikramaḥ
devāśvāsanadānaṃ ca tathaivāndhakanigrahaḥ / śūlabhedasya cotpattistathā pātraparīkṣaṇam
praśaṃsā dānadharmasya ṛṣiśṛṅgānubhāvanam / svargatiṃ dīrghatapaso bhānumatyāstatheṅgitam
śabarasvargagamanaṃ māhātmyaṃ śūlabhedajam / kapileśvaratīrthaṃ ca mokṣatīrthamataḥ param
saṅgamo mokṣanadyāśca tīrthaṃ ca vimaleśvaram / tathaivolūkatīrthaṃ ca puṣkariṇyāśca saṅgamaḥ
ādityeśvaratīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ vai saṅgameśvaram / saṅgamo bhīmakulyāyāstīrthaṃ bhīmeśvaraṃ śubham
mārkaṇḍeśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathā vai pippaleśvaram / karoṭīśvaratīrthaṃ ca tīrthamindreśvaraṃ śubham
agastyeśaṃ kumāreśaṃ vyāseśvaramanuttamam / vaidyanāthaṃ ca kedāram ānandeśvarasaṃjñitam
mātṛtīrthaṃ ca muṇḍeśaṃ cauraṃ kāmeśvaraṃ tathā / saṅgamaścānuduhyā vai tīrthe bhīmārjunāhvaye / tīrthaṃ dharmeśvaraṃ nāma luṅkeśvaram ataḥ param
tato dhanadatīrthaṃ ca jaṭeśaṃ maṅgaleśvaram / kapileśvaratīrthaṃ ca gopāreśvaramuttamam
maṇināgeśvaraṃ nāma maṇinadyāśca saṅgamaḥ / tilakeśvaratīrthaṃ ca gautameśamataḥ param
tatraiva mātṛtīrthaṃ ca muninoktaṃ munīśvarāḥ / śaṅkhacūḍaṃ ca kedāraṃ pārāśaramataḥ param
bhīmeśvaraṃ ca candreśam aśvavatyāśca saṅgamaḥ / bahvīśvaraṃ nāradeśaṃ vaidyanāthaṃ kapīśvaram
kumbheśvaraṃ ca mārkaṇḍaṃ rāmeśaṃ lakṣmaṇeśvaram / megheśvaraṃ matsyakeśam apsarāhradasaṃjñakam
dadhiskandaṃ madhuskandaṃ nandikeśaṃ ca vāruṇam / pāvakeśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathaiva kapileśvaram
nārāyaṇāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ cakratīrthamanuttamam / caṇḍādityaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ caṇḍikātīrthamuttamam
yamahāsāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ tathā gaṅgeśvaraṃ śubham / nandikeśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca naranārāyaṇāhvayam
naleśvaraṃ ca mārkaṇḍaṃ śuklatīrthamataḥ param / vyāseśvaraṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tatra siddheśvaraṃ tathā
koṭitīrthaṃ prabhātīrthaṃ vāsukīśvaram uttamam / saṅgamaśca karañjāyā mārkaṇḍeśvaramuttamam
tīrthaṃ koṭīśvaraṃ nāma tathā saṃkarṣaṇāhvayam / kanakeśaṃ manmatheśaṃ tīrthaṃ caivānasūyakam
eraṇḍīsaṅgamaḥ puṇyo mātṛtīrthaṃ ca śobhanam / tīrthaṃ svarṇaśalākākhyaṃ tathā caivāmbikeśvaram
karañjeśaṃ bhārateśaṃ nāgeśaṃ mukuṭeśvaram / saubhāgyasundarī tīrthaṃ dhanadeśvaramuttamam
rohiṇyaṃ cakratīrthaṃ ca uttareśvarasaṃjñitam / bhogeśvaraṃ ca kedāraṃ niṣkalaṅkamataḥ param
mārkaṇḍaṃ dhautapāpaṃ ca tīrthamāṅgiraseśvaram / koṭavīsaṅgamaḥ puṇyaṃ koṭitīrthaṃ ca tatra vai
ayonijaṃ paraṃ tīrtham aṅgāreśvaramuttamam / skāndaṃ ca nārmadaṃ brāhmaṃ vālmīkeśvarasaṃjñitam
koṭitīrthaṃ kapāleśaṃ pāṇḍutīrthaṃ trilocanam / kapileśaṃ kambukeśaṃ prabhāsaṃ kohaneśvaram
indreśaṃ vālukeśaṃ ca deveśaṃ śakrameva ca / nāgeśvaraṃ gautameśam ahalyātīrthamuttamam
rāmeśvaraṃ mokṣatīrthaṃ tathā kuśalaveśvarau / narmadeśaṃ kapardīśaṃ sāgareśamataḥ param
dhaurādityaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ cāparayonijam / piṅgaleśvaratīrtha ca bhṛgvīśvaramanuttamam
daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ koṭitīrthaṃ ca sattamāḥ / mārkaṇḍaṃ brahmatīrthaṃ ca ādivārāhamuttamam
āśāpūrābhidhaṃ tīrthaṃ kauberaṃ mārutaṃ tathā / varuṇeśaṃ yameśaṃ ca rāmeśaṃ karkaṭeśvaram
śakreśaṃ somatīrthaṃ ca nandāhradamanuttamam / vaiṣṇavaṃ cakratīrthaṃ ca rāmakeśavasaṃjñitam
tathaiva rukmiṇītīrthaṃ śivatīrthamanuttamam / jayavārāhartīrthaṃ ca tīrthamasmāhakāhvayam
aṅgāreśaṃ ca siddheśaṃ tapeśvaramataḥ param / punaḥ siddheśvaraṃ nāmatīrthaṃ ca varuṇeśvaram
parāśareśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ kusumeśamanuttamam / kuṇḍaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathā kalakaleśvaram
nyaṅkuvārāhasaṃjñaṃ ca aṅkolaṃ tīrthamuttamam / śvetavārāhatīrthaṃ ca bhārgalaṃ sauramuttamam
huṅkārasvāmitīrthaṃ ca śuklatīrthaṃ ca śobhanam / saṅgamo madhumatyāśca tīrthaṃ vai saṅgameśvaram
narmadeśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca nadītritayasaṅgamaḥ / anekeśvaratīrthaṃ ca śarbheśaṃ mokṣasaṃjñitam
kāverīsaṅgamaḥ puṇyastīrthaṃ gopeśvarāhvayam / mārkaṇḍeśaṃ ca nāgeśam udambaryāśca saṅgamaḥ
sāmbādityāhvayaṃ tīrtham udambaryāśca saṅgamaḥ / siddheśvaraṃ ca mārkaṇḍaṃ tathā siddheśvarīkṛtam
gopeśaṃ kapileśaṃ ca vaidyanāthamanuttamam / piṅgaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca saindhavāyatanaṃ mahat
bhūtīśvarāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ gaṅgāvāhamataḥ param / gautameśvaratīrthaṃ ca daśāśvamedhikaṃ tathā
bhṛgutīrthaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ khyātā saubhāgyasundarī / vṛṣakhātaṃ ca tatraiva kedāraṃ dhūtapātakam
tīrthaṃ dhūteśvarīsaṅgameraṇḍīsaṃjñakaṃ tathā / tīrthaṃ ca kanakeśvaryā jvāleśvaraṃ tataḥ param
śālagrāmāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ somanāthamanuttamam / tathaivodīrṇavārāhaṃ tīrthaṃ candraprabhāsakam
dvādaśādityatīrthaṃ ca tathā siddheśvarābhidham / kapileśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathā traivikramaṃ śubham
viśvarūpāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇakṛtaṃ tathā / mūlaśrīpatitīrthaṃ ca caulaśrīpatisaṃjñakam
devatīrthaṃ haṃsatīrtha prabhāsaṃ tīrthamuttamam / mūlasthānaṃ ca kaṇṭheśamaṭṭahāsamataḥ param
bhūrbhuveśvaratīrthaṃ ca khyātā śūleśvarī tathā / sārasvataṃ dārukeśamaśvinostīrthamuttamam
sāvitrītīrthamatulaṃ vālakhilyeśvaraṃ tathā / narmadeśaṃ mātṛtīrthaṃ devatīrthamanuttamam
macchakeśvaratīrthaṃ ca śikhitīrthaṃ ca śobhanam / koṭitīrthaṃ muniśreṣṭhāstatra koṭīśvarī mṛḍā
tīrthaṃ paitāmahaṃ nāma māṇḍavye śvarasaṃjñitam / tatra nārāyaṇeśaṃ ca akrūreśamataḥ param
devakhātaṃ siddharudraṃ vaidyanāthamanuttamam / tathaiva mātṛtīrthaṃ ca uttareśamataḥ param
tathaiva narmadeśāṃ ca mātṛtīrthaṃ tathā punaḥ / tathā ca kurarītīrthaṃ ḍhauṇḍheśaṃ daśakanyakam
suvarṇabindutīrthaṃ ca ṛṇapāpapramocanam / bhārabhūteśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ tathā muṇḍīśvaraṃ viduḥ
ekaśālaṃ ḍiṇḍipāṇiṃ tīrthaṃ cāpsarasaṃ param / munyālayaṃ ca mārkaṇḍaṃ gaṇitādevatāhvayam
āmaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ kantheśvaraṃ tathā / āṣāḍhītīrthamityāhuḥ śṛṅgītīrthaṃ tathaiva ca
bakeśvaratīrthaṃ ca kapāleśaṃ tathaiva ca / mārkaṇḍaṃ kapileśaṃ ca eraṇḍīsaṅgamastathā
eraṇḍīdevatātīrthaṃ rāmatīrthamataḥparam / jamadagneḥ paraṃ tīrthaṃ revāsāgarasaṅgamaḥ
loṭaneśvaratīrtha tal luṅkeśanāmakaṃ tathā / vṛṣarakhātaṃ tatra kuṇḍaṃ tathaiva ṛṣisattamāḥ
tathā haṃseśvaraṃnāma tilādaṃ vāsaveśvaram / tathā koṭīśvaraṃ tīrtham alikātīrthamuttamam / vimaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca revāsāgarasaṅgame
evaṃ tīrthāvaliḥ puṇyā mayā proktā maharṣayaḥ / tīrthasuktāvaliḥ puṇyā grathitā taṭarajjunā
narmadānīranirṇiktā mārkaṇḍeyavinirmitā / maṇḍanāyeha sādhūnāṃ sarvalokahitāya ca
daritadhvāntaśamanīdhāryā dharmārthibhiḥ sadā / ahorātrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sakṛjjaptvāśu nāśayet
trikālaṃ japtvā māsotthaṃ śivāgre ca trimāsikam / māsaṃ japtvātha varṣotthaṃ varṣaṃ japtvā śatābdikam
śrāddhakāle ca viprāṇāṃ bhuñjatāṃ purataḥ sthitaḥ / paṭhaṃstīrthāvaliṃ puṇyāṃ gayāśrāddhaprado bhavet
pūjākāle ca devānāṃ śraddhayā purataḥ paṭhan / prīṇayetsarvadevāṃśca punāti sakalaṃ kulam
evaṃ tīrthāvaliḥ puṇyā revātīradvayāśritā / mayā proktā muniśreṣṭhāstathaivaśṛṇutānaghāḥ

vibhakto bhaktalokānāmānandaprathanaḥ śubhaḥ / mṛkaṇḍatanayaḥ pūrvaṃ prāha pārthāya pṛcchate
yathā tathāhaṃ vakṣyāmi tīrthānāṃ stabakāniha / śivāmbupānajā puṇyā revā kalpalatā kila
tīradvayodbhūtatīrthaprasūnaiḥ puṣpitā śubhā / yatpuṇyagandhalakṣmyā vai trailokyaṃ surabhīkṛtam
tatpuṣpamakarandasya rasāsvādaviduttamaḥ / bhramaraḥ khalu mārkaṇḍo munirmatimatāṃ varaḥ
tatpuṣpamālāṃ hṛdaye tīrthastabakacitritām / dadhāti satataṃ puṇyāṃ munirbhṛgukulodvahaḥ / tasyāḥ stabakasaṃsthānaṃ vakṣye 'ham ṛṣisattamāḥ
oṅkāratīrthamārabhya yāvatpaścimasāgaram / saṃgamāḥ pañcatriṃśadvai nadīnāṃ pāpanāśanāḥ
daśaikamuttare tīre satriviṃśati dakṣiṇe / pañcatriṃśattamaḥ śreṣṭho revāsāgarasaṅgamaḥ
saṅgamaḥ sahitānyevaṃ revātīradvaye 'pi ca / catuḥśatāni tīrthāni prasiddhāni dvijottamāḥ
triśataṃ śivatīrthāni trayīstriṃśatsamanvitam / tatrāpi vyaktito vakṣye śṛṇudhvaṃ tāni sattamāḥ
mārkaṇḍeśvaratīrthāni daśa teṣu munīśvarāḥ / daśādityabhavānyatra navaiva kapileśvarāḥ
somasaṃsthāpitānyaṣṭau tāvanto narmadeśvarāḥ / koṭitīrthānyathāṣṭau ca sapta siddheśvarāstathā
nāgeśvarāśca saptaiva revātīradvaye 'pi tu / saptaiva vahnivihitānyathāpyāvartasaptakam
kedāreśvaratīrthāni pañca pañcendrajāni ca / varuṇeśāśca pañcaiva pañcaiva dhanadeśvarāḥ
devatīrthāni pañcaiva catvāro vai yameśvarāḥ / vaidyanāthāśca catvāraścatvāro vānareśvarāḥ
aṅgāreśvaratīrthāni tāvantyeva munīśvarāḥ / sārasvatāni catvāri catvāro dārukeśvarāḥ
gautameśvaratīrthāni trīṇi rāmeśvarāstrayaḥ / kapāleśvaratīrthāni trīṇi haṃsakṛtāni ca
trīṇyeva mokṣatīrthāni trayo vai vimaleśvarāḥ / sahasrayajñatīrthāni trīṇyeva munirabravīt
bhīmeśvarāstrayaḥ khyātāḥ svarṇatīrthāni trīṇi ca / dhautapāpadvayaṃ proktaṃ karañjeśadvayaṃ tathā
ṛṇamocanatīrthe dve tathā skandeśvaradvayam / daśāśvamedhatīrthe dve nandītīrthadvayaṃ dvijāḥ
manmatheśadvayaṃ caiva bhṛgutīrthadvayaṃ tathā / parāśareśvarau dvau ca ayonīsaṃbhavadvayam
vyāseśvaradvayaṃ proktaṃ pitṛtīrthadvayaṃ tathā / nandikeśvaratīrthe dve dvau ca gopeśvarau smṛtau
māruteśadvayaṃ tadvad dvau ca jvāleśvarau smṛtau / śuklatīrthadvayaṃ puṇyam apsareśadvayaṃ tathā
pippaleśvaratīrthe dve māṇḍavyeśvarasaṃjñite / dvīpeśvaradvayaṃ caiva prāha tadvadbhṛgūdvahaḥ / uttareśvaratīrthe dve aśokeśadvayī tathā
dve yodhanapure caiva rohiṇītīrthakadvayam / luṅkeśvaradvayaṃ khyātamākhyānaṃ muninā tathā
saikonaviṃśatiśataṃ tīrthānyekaikaśo dvijāḥ / stabakeṣu kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ dviśataṃ sacaturdaśam
śaivānyetāni tīrthāni vaiṣṇavāni ca sattamāḥ / śṛṇudhvaṃ procyamānāni brāhmaśāktāni ca kramāt
aṣṭaviṃśatitīrthāni vaiṣṇavānyabravīnmuniḥ / teṣu vārāhatīrthāni ṣaḍeva munisattamāḥ
catvāri cakratīrthāni śeṣāṇyaṣṭādaśaiva hi / viṣṇunādhiṣṭhitāny eva prāha pūrvaṃ mṛkaṇḍajaḥ
tathaiva brahmaṇā siddhyai saptatīrthānyavīvadat / triṣu ca brahmaṇaḥ pūjā brahmeśāścaturo 'pare / aṣṭāviṃśanmayā khyātā yathāsaṅkhyaṃ yathākramam
etatpavitramatulaṃ hyetat pāpaharaṃ param / narmadācaritaṃ puṇyaṃ māhātmyaṃ munibhāṣitam
sūta uvāca: evamuddeśataḥ prokto revātīrthakramo mayā / yathā pārthāya saṃkṣepān mārkaṇḍo munirabravīt
avāntarāṇi tīrthāni teṣu guptānyanekaśaḥ / yatra yāvatpramāṇāni tānyākarṇayatānaghāḥ
oṅkāratīrthaparitaḥ parvatād amarakaṇṭāt / krośadvaye sarvadikṣu sārdhakoṭītrayī matā
tīrthānāṃ saṃkhyayā guptaprakaṭānāṃ dvijottamāḥ / koṭirekā tu tīrthānāṃ kapilāsaṅgame pṛthak
aśokavanikāyāśca tīrthaṃ lakṣaṃ pratiṣṭhitam / śatamaṃ gāragartāyāḥ saṅgame munisattamāḥ
tīrthānāmayutaṃ tadvatkubjāyāḥ saṅgame sthitam / śataṃ hiraṇyagarbhāyāḥ saṅgame samavasthitam
tīrthānāmaṣṭaṣaṣṭiśca viśokāsaṅgame sthitā / tathā sahasraṃ tīrthānāṃ saṃsthitaṃ vāgusaṅgame
śataṃ sarasvatīsaṅge śuklatīrthe śatadvayam / sahasraṃ viṣṇutīrtheṣu mahiṣmatyāmathāyutam
śūlabhede ca tīrthānāṃ sāgraṃ lakṣaṃ sthitaṃ dvijāḥ / devagrāme sahasraṃ ca tīrthānāṃ munirabravīt
luṅkeśvare ca tīrthānāṃ sāgrā saptaśatī sthitā / tīrthānyaṣṭottaraśataṃ maṇinadyāśca saṅgame / vaidyanāthe ca tīrthānāṃ śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ viduḥ
evaṃ tāvatpramāṇāni tīrthe kumbheśvare dvijāḥ / sāgraṃ lakṣaṃ ca tīrthānāṃ sthitaṃ revorasaṅgame
tataścāpyadhikāni syuriti mārkaṇḍabhāṣitam / aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi vyāsadvīpāśritāni ca
saṅgame ca karañjāyāḥ sthitamaṣṭottarāyutam / eraṇḍīsaṅgame tadvattīrthānyaṣṭādhikaṃ śatam
dhūtapāpe ca tīrthānāṃ ṣaṣṭiraṣṭādhikā sthitā / skandatīrthe śataṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthānāṃ muniruktavān
kohaneśa ca tīrthānāṃ ṣaṣṭiraṣṭādhikā sthitā / sārdhakoṭī ca tīrthānāṃ sthitā vai korilāpure
rāmakeśavatīrthe ca sahasraṃ sāgramuktavān / asmāhake sahasraṃ ca tīrthāni nivasanti hi
lakṣāṣṭakaṃ sahasre dve śuklatīrthe dvijottamāḥ / tīrthāni kathayāmāsa purā pārthāya bhārgavaḥ
śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ prāha pratyekaṃ saṅgameṣu ca / nadīnāmavaśiṣṭānāṃ kāverīsaṅgamaṃ vinā
kāveryāḥ saṅgame viprāḥ sthitā pañcaśatī tathā / tīrthānāṃ parvasu tathā viśeṣo muninoditaḥ
mokṣatīrthaṃ hi satprāhuḥ purāṇapuruṣāśritam / bhṛgoḥ kṣetre ca tīrthānāṃ koṭirekā samāśritā
sādhikānāmṛṣiśreṣṭhā vaktuṃ śakto hi ko bhavet / sarvāmarāśrayaṃ proktaṃ sarvatīrthāśrayaṃ tathā
triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ pūjitaṃ siddhisādhanam / bhārabhūtyāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ sthitamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam
akrūreśvaratīrthe ca sārdhaṃ tīrthaśataṃ sthitam / vimaleśvaratīrthe tu revāsāgarasaṅgame / daśāyutāni tīrthānāṃ sādhikānyabravīnmuniḥ
